    Properties:

      AlarmDescription: Missing data treated as notBreaching, so the alarm stays in OK.

      EvaluationPeriods: 1

      MetricName: AlwaysOK
      Statistic: Minimum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: breaching
      ActionsEnabled: false

  AlwaysINSUFFICIENTAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: AlwaysINSUFFICIENTAlarm
      AlarmDescription: Missing data treated as missing, so the alarm stays in INSUFFICIENT_DATA.

      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Serverless workflow using AWS Step Functions that sends custom events to a custom
  Amazon EventBridge event bus. A rule on the bus forwards all events to a CloudWatch
  Logs log group for testing and debugging.

Parameters:
  EventBusName:
    Type: String
    Default: custom-workflow-bus
    Description: Name of the custom EventBridge event bus.
  EventSource:
    Type: String
    Default: com.example.workflow
    Description: Source value set on custom events emitted by the state machine.
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365]
    Description: Retention period for the debug log group.

Resources:
  CustomEventBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref EventBusName

  EventsDebugLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/events/${EventBusName}-debug
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays

  EventsToLogsResourcePolicy:
    Type: AWS::Logs::ResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub ${EventBusName}-events-to-logs
      PolicyDocument: !Sub |
        {
          "Version": "2012-10-17",
          "Statement": [
            {
              "Sid": "EventBridgeToCloudWatchLogs",
              "Effect": "Allow",
              "Principal": {
                "Service": [
                  "events.amazonaws.com",
                  "delivery.logs.amazonaws.com"
                ]
              },
              "Action": [
                "logs:CreateLogStream",
                "logs:PutLogEvents"
              ],
              "Resource": "${EventsDebugLogGroup.Arn}"
            }
          ]
        }

  CatchAllEventsRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    DependsOn: EventsToLogsResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${EventBusName}-catch-all-to-logs
      Description: Forwards all events on the custom bus to CloudWatch Logs for debugging.
      EventBusName: !Ref CustomEventBus
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        account:
          - !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Targets:
        - Id: DebugLogGroupTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt EventsDebugLogGroup.Arn

  StateMachineLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/vendedlogs/states/${AWS::StackName}-workflow
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PutEventsToCustomBus
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: events:PutEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn
        - PolicyName: StateMachineLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'

  EventPublisherStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-event-publisher
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
      DefinitionSubstitutions:
        EventBusName: !Ref CustomEventBus
        EventSource: !Ref EventSource
      Definition:
        Comment: Sends custom events to a custom EventBridge event bus.
        StartAt: SendWorkflowStartedEvent
        States:
          SendWorkflowStartedEvent:
            Type: Task
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::events:putEvents
            Parameters:
              Entries:
                - EventBusName: ${EventBusName}
                  Source: ${EventSource}
                  DetailType: WorkflowStarted
                  Detail:
                    ExecutionId.$: $$.Execution.Id
                    StartTime.$: $$.Execution.StartTime
                    Input.$: $
            ResultPath: $.startedEventResult
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - States.TaskFailed
                IntervalSeconds: 2
                MaxAttempts: 3
                BackoffRate: 2
            Next: ProcessStep
          ProcessStep:
            Type: Pass
            Comment: Placeholder for workflow business logic.
            Result:
              status: PROCESSED
            ResultPath: $.processing
            Next: SendWorkflowCompletedEvent
          SendWorkflowCompletedEvent:
            Type: Task
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::events:putEvents
            Parameters:
              Entries:
                - EventBusName: ${EventBusName}
                  Source: ${EventSource}
                  DetailType: WorkflowCompleted
                  Detail:
                    ExecutionId.$: $$.Execution.Id
                    Status.$: $.processing.status
            ResultPath: $.completedEventResult
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - States.TaskFailed
                IntervalSeconds: 2
                MaxAttempts: 3
                BackoffRate: 2
            End: true

Outputs:
  EventBusName:
    Description: Name of the custom EventBridge event bus.
    Value: !Ref CustomEventBus
  EventBusArn:
    Description: ARN of the custom EventBridge event bus.
    Value: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine that publishes events.
    Value: !Ref EventPublisherStateMachine
  CatchAllRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the rule forwarding all bus events to CloudWatch Logs.
    Value: !GetAtt CatchAllEventsRule.Arn
  DebugLogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Logs log group receiving all events from the custom bus.
    Value: !Ref EventsDebugLogGroup

            - location: !Ref EdgeLocation2
            - location: !Ref EdgeLocation3

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Serverless workflow that monitors EC2 instance state changes on the default
  event bus and triggers a Step Functions state machine when an instance
  transitions to running, stopped, or terminated. Includes placeholder states
  for business logic in each path and CloudWatch Logs logging for the state machine.

Parameters:
  StateMachineName:
    Type: String
    Default: Ec2StateChangeWorkflow
    Description: Name of the Step Functions state machine.

  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1827, 3653]
    Description: Retention period for state machine execution logs.

  LogLevel:
    Type: String
    Default: ALL
    AllowedValues: [ALL, ERROR, FATAL, 'OFF']
    Description: Logging level for the state machine.

  IncludeExecutionData:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Whether to include execution input/output data in logs.

Conditions:
  IncludeData: !Equals [!Ref IncludeExecutionData, 'true']

Resources:
  StateMachineLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/vendedlogs/states/${StateMachineName}
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays

  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StateMachineLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
        - PolicyName: StateMachineXRay
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                  - xray:GetSamplingRules
                  - xray:GetSamplingTargets
                Resource: '*'

  Ec2StateChangeStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Ref StateMachineName
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
      TracingConfiguration:
        Enabled: true
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Level: !Ref LogLevel
        IncludeExecutionData: !If [IncludeData, true, false]
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
      Definition:
        Comment: Routes EC2 instance state change events to state-specific processing paths.
        StartAt: ExtractEventDetails
        States:
          ExtractEventDetails:
            Type: Pass
            Comment: Normalize the incoming EventBridge event.
            Parameters:
              instanceId.$: $.detail.instance-id
              state.$: $.detail.state
              region.$: $.region
              account.$: $.account
              time.$: $.time
              eventId.$: $.id
            Next: RouteByState
          RouteByState:
            Type: Choice
            Choices:
              - Variable: $.state
                StringEquals: running
                Next: HandleRunning
              - Variable: $.state
                StringEquals: stopped
                Next: HandleStopped
              - Variable: $.state
                StringEquals: terminated
                Next: HandleTerminated
            Default: UnhandledState
          HandleRunning:
            Type: Pass
            Comment: 'PLACEHOLDER - Add business logic for instances entering the running state (e.g. tagging, inventory registration, notifications).'
            Result:
              action: running-handler-placeholder
            ResultPath: $.result
            Next: Succeeded
          HandleStopped:
            Type: Pass
            Comment: 'PLACEHOLDER - Add business logic for instances entering the stopped state (e.g. cost tracking, snapshot creation, notifications).'
            Result:
              action: stopped-handler-placeholder
            ResultPath: $.result
            Next: Succeeded
          HandleTerminated:
            Type: Pass
            Comment: 'PLACEHOLDER - Add business logic for instances entering the terminated state (e.g. cleanup, CMDB deregistration, audit records).'
            Result:
              action: terminated-handler-placeholder
            ResultPath: $.result
            Next: Succeeded
          UnhandledState:
            Type: Fail
            Error: UnhandledInstanceState
            Cause: The EC2 instance state is not handled by this workflow.
          Succeeded:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates an S3 bucket for AWS CloudTrail logs, a Glue database, and a Glue crawler
  that catalogs CloudTrail logs stored under cloud-trail/AWSLogs/ so they can be
  queried with Amazon Athena.

Parameters:
  DatabaseNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: cloudtrail
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores.
    Description: Prefix for the Glue database name. The suffix -kk-admin-db is appended automatically.

  CrawlerSchedule:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional cron schedule for the crawler, for example cron(0 1 * * ? *). Leave empty to run it on demand.

Conditions:
  HasCrawlerSchedule: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CrawlerSchedule, '']]

Resources:
  CloudTrailLogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  CloudTrailLogsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref CloudTrailLogsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AWSCloudTrailAclCheck
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:GetBucketAcl
            Resource: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogsBucket.Arn
          - Sid: AWSCloudTrailWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${CloudTrailLogsBucket.Arn}/cloud-trail/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                s3:x-amz-acl: bucket-owner-full-control
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt CloudTrailLogsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${CloudTrailLogsBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  GlueCrawlerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudTrailLogsBucketAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogsBucket.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub '${CloudTrailLogsBucket.Arn}/cloud-trail/AWSLogs/*'

  CloudTrailGlueDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Sub '${DatabaseNamePrefix}-kk-admin-db'
        Description: Glue database for cataloging AWS CloudTrail logs to query with Athena.

  CloudTrailGlueCrawler:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Crawler
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cloudtrail-crawler'
      Description: Crawls AWS CloudTrail logs under cloud-trail/AWSLogs/ for Athena queries.
      Role: !GetAtt GlueCrawlerRole.Arn
      DatabaseName: !Ref CloudTrailGlueDatabase
      TablePrefix: cloudtrail_
      Targets:
        S3Targets:
          - Path: !Sub 's3://${CloudTrailLogsBucket}/cloud-trail/AWSLogs/'
            Exclusions:
              - '**/CloudTrail-Digest/**'
              - '**/Config/**'
      SchemaChangePolicy:
        UpdateBehavior: UPDATE_IN_DATABASE
        DeleteBehavior: LOG
      RecrawlPolicy:
        RecrawlBehavior: CRAWL_EVERYTHING
      Configuration: '{"Version":1.0,"Grouping":{"TableGroupingPolicy":"CombineCompatibleSchemas"},"CrawlerOutput":{"Partitions":{"AddOrUpdateBehavior":"InheritFromTable"}}}'
      Schedule: !If
        - HasCrawlerSchedule
        - ScheduleExpression: !Ref CrawlerSchedule
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue

Outputs:
  BucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket that stores the CloudTrail logs.
    Value: !Ref CloudTrailLogsBucket
  CloudTrailLogsS3Path:
    Description: S3 path that the crawler catalogs.
    Value: !Sub 's3://${CloudTrailLogsBucket}/cloud-trail/AWSLogs/'
  GlueDatabaseName:
    Description: Name of the Glue database.
    Value: !Ref CloudTrailGlueDatabase
  GlueCrawlerName:
    Description: Name of the Glue crawler.
    Value: !Ref CloudTrailGlueCrawler
  GlueCrawlerRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role that the Glue crawler uses.
    Value: !GetAtt GlueCrawlerRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Foundational infrastructure for Amazon ECS Anywhere: an ECS cluster, an IAM role
  for registering and managing external container instances through SSM, and an
  SSM document that installs the ECS agent and joins the instance to the cluster.

Parameters:
  ClusterName:
    Type: String
    Default: ecs-anywhere-cluster
    Description: Name of the ECS cluster that external instances will join.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,255}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Up to 255 letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores.

  ContainerInstanceName:
    Type: String
    Default: ecs-anywhere-instance
    Description: Name applied to the external container instance as an ECS attribute.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{1,128}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Up to 128 letters, numbers, periods, hyphens, and underscores.

  ExternalInstanceRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: ECSAnywhereRole
    Description: Name of the IAM role that external instances assume through SSM.
    AllowedPattern: '^[\w+=,.@-]{1,64}$'

Resources:
  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Ref ClusterName
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: ECSAnywhere

  ECSAnywhereRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref ExternalInstanceRoleName
      Description: Role for ECS Anywhere external instances registered via SSM hybrid activation.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonEC2ContainerServiceforEC2Role'
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: ECSAnywhere

  ECSAnywhereRegistrationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Command
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      TargetType: /AWS::SSM::ManagedInstance
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '2.2'
        description: Installs the Amazon ECS agent on an SSM-managed external instance and registers it with the ECS Anywhere cluster.
        parameters:
          ClusterName:
            type: String
            description: ECS cluster to register the external instance with.
            default: !Ref ClusterName
            allowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,255}$'
          ContainerInstanceName:
            type: String
            description: Name applied to the container instance as an ECS attribute.
            default: !Ref ContainerInstanceName
            allowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{1,128}$'
          Region:
            type: String
            description: AWS Region of the ECS cluster.
            default: !Ref AWS::Region
            allowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
        mainSteps:
          - action: aws:runShellScript
            name: RegisterECSAnywhereInstance
            precondition:
              StringEquals:
                - platformType
                - Linux
            inputs:
              timeoutSeconds: '1800'
              runCommand:
                - '#!/bin/bash'
                - set -euo pipefail
                - mkdir -p /etc/ecs
                - touch /etc/ecs/ecs.config
                - sed -i '/^ECS_INSTANCE_ATTRIBUTES=/d' /etc/ecs/ecs.config
                - echo 'ECS_INSTANCE_ATTRIBUTES={"name":"{{ ContainerInstanceName }}"}' >> /etc/ecs/ecs.config
                - curl --proto "https" -fsSL -o /tmp/ecs-anywhere-install.sh "https://amazon-ecs-agent.s3.amazonaws.com/ecs-anywhere-install-latest.sh"
                - bash /tmp/ecs-anywhere-install.sh --region "{{ Region }}" --cluster "{{ ClusterName }}" --skip-registration
                - rm -f /tmp/ecs-anywhere-install.sh
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: ECSAnywhere

Outputs:
  ClusterName:
    Description: Name of the ECS Anywhere cluster.
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ClusterName'

  ClusterArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS Anywhere cluster.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Idempotency store (DynamoDB) for hybrid mode deduplication. Both polling-based
  and event-driven workflows may trigger executions for the same file; this table
  records processing state per file/version so duplicate executions can be
  detected and skipped. Includes a managed IAM policy granting Lambda and
  Step Functions read/write access.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Naming
        Parameters:
          - ProjectPrefix
          - EnvironmentName
      - Label:
          default: Table Configuration
        Parameters:
          - PartitionKeyName
          - SortKeyName
          - BillingMode
          - ReadCapacityUnits
          - WriteCapacityUnits
          - TtlAttributeName
          - DefaultTtlDays
          - EnablePointInTimeRecovery
          - EnableDeletionProtection
      - Label:
          default: IAM Attachment (optional)
        Parameters:
          - LambdaExecutionRoleNames
          - StepFunctionsRoleNames

Parameters:
  ProjectPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: fsxn-s3ap
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,30}[a-z0-9]$"
    ConstraintDescription: Lowercase alphanumerics and hyphens, 2-32 characters.
    Description: Prefix used for naming all resources.

  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z0-9-]{1,16}$"
    Description: Environment suffix used in resource names (e.g. dev, stg, prod).

  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: pk
    Description: >-
      Partition key attribute name (e.g. file identity such as
      "<volume>#<s3-access-point-key>").

  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: sk
    Description: >-
      Sort key attribute name (e.g. version/ETag/mtime or processing stage, such as
      "<etag>#<stage>").

  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Default: PAY_PER_REQUEST
    AllowedValues:
      - PAY_PER_REQUEST
      - PROVISIONED
    Description: DynamoDB billing mode.

  ReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Read capacity units (used only when BillingMode is PROVISIONED).

  WriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Write capacity units (used only when BillingMode is PROVISIONED).

  TtlAttributeName:
    Type: String
    Default: expiresAt
    Description: >-
      Attribute holding the expiry time as Unix epoch seconds. Writers should set
      it to now + (DefaultTtlDays * 86400).

  DefaultTtlDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 365
    Description: >-
      Default retention in days for idempotency records. Exposed as an output and
      table tag so Lambda / Step Functions can compute the TTL attribute value.

  EnablePointInTimeRecovery:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: Enable DynamoDB Point-in-Time Recovery.

  EnableDeletionProtection:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Description: Enable DynamoDB table deletion protection.

  LambdaExecutionRoleNames:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      Optional comma-separated list of existing Lambda execution role names to
      attach the managed policy to. Leave empty to skip.

  StepFunctionsRoleNames:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      Optional comma-separated list of existing Step Functions state machine role
      names to attach the managed policy to. Leave empty to skip.

Conditions:
  IsProvisioned: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, PROVISIONED]
  PitrEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnablePointInTimeRecovery, "true"]
  DeletionProtectionEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableDeletionProtection, "true"]
  HasLambdaRoles: !Not [!Equals [!Join ["", !Ref LambdaExecutionRoleNames], ""]]
  HasStepFunctionsRoles: !Not [!Equals [!Join ["", !Ref StepFunctionsRoleNames], ""]]
  HasAnyRoles: !Or
    - !Condition HasLambdaRoles
    - !Condition HasStepFunctionsRoles

Resources:
  IdempotencyTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-${EnvironmentName}-idempotency"
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - IsProvisioned
        - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
          WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
          KeyType: RANGE
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: !Ref TtlAttributeName
        Enabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: !If [PitrEnabled, true, false]
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      DeletionProtectionEnabled: !If [DeletionProtectionEnabled, true, false]
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectPrefix
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: hybrid-mode-idempotency-store
        - Key: DefaultTtlDays
          Value: !Ref DefaultTtlDays

  IdempotencyTableAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-${EnvironmentName}-idempotency-rw"
      Description: !Sub >-
        Read/write access to the ${ProjectPrefix}-${EnvironmentName} idempotency
        table for Lambda functions and Step Functions state machines.
      Roles: !If
        - HasAnyRoles
        - !Split
          - ","
          - !Join
            - ","
            - - !If
                - HasLambdaRoles
                - !Join [",", !Ref LambdaExecutionRoleNames]
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - !If
                - HasStepFunctionsRoles
                - !Join [",", !Ref StepFunctionsRoleNames]
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: IdempotencyTableReadWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:GetItem
              - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
              - dynamodb:Query
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:UpdateItem
              - dynamodb:DeleteItem
              - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
              - dynamodb:ConditionCheckItem
              - dynamodb:DescribeTable
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt IdempotencyTable.Arn
              - !Sub "${IdempotencyTable.Arn}/index/*"
          - Sid: IdempotencyTableTransactions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:TransactGetItems
              - dynamodb:TransactWriteItems
            Resource: !GetAtt IdempotencyTable.Arn

Outputs:
  IdempotencyTableName:
    Description: Name of the idempotency DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref IdempotencyTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-${EnvironmentName}-IdempotencyTableName"

  IdempotencyTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the idempotency DynamoDB table.
    Value: !GetAtt IdempotencyTable.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-${EnvironmentName}-IdempotencyTableArn"

  PartitionKeyName:
    Description: Partition key attribute name.
    Value: !Ref PartitionKeyName

  SortKeyName:
    Description: Sort key attribute name.
    Value: !Ref SortKeyName

  TtlAttributeName:
    Description: TTL attribute name (Unix epoch seconds).
    Value: !Ref TtlAttributeName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-${EnvironmentName}-IdempotencyTtlAttribute"

  DefaultTtlDays:
    Description: Default number of days before idempotency records expire.
    Value: !Ref DefaultTtlDays
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-${EnvironmentName}-IdempotencyDefaultTtlDays"

  IdempotencyTableAccessPolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the managed policy granting read/write access to the table.
    Value: !Ref IdempotencyTableAccessPolicy
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${ProjectPrefix}-${EnvironmentName}-IdempotencyAccessPolicyArn"

    Default: my-table
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table to create.

  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH

  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub states.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

        - PolicyName: DynamoDBPutGetAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                Resource: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
      DefinitionSubstitutions:
        TableName: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      Definition:
        Comment: Put an item into DynamoDB and then retrieve it by ID.
        StartAt: PutItem
        States:

            Type: Task
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::dynamodb:putItem

            Next: GetItem

            Type: Task

            Parameters:

              Key:
                id:
                  S.$: $.id
            OutputPath: $.Item
            End: true

  TableNameOutput:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Chaos engineering workflow using AWS Step Functions. It terminates a target EC2
  instance, waits 300 seconds, checks the health of an ECS service, and publishes
  an SNS alert if the service is unhealthy. All resources are created by this stack.

Parameters:
  LatestAmiId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Default: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
    Description: AMI ID for the chaos target EC2 instance (resolved from SSM).
  InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: t3.micro
    Description: Instance type for the chaos target EC2 instance.
  AlertEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional email address to subscribe to the SNS alert topic (leave blank to skip).
  ContainerImage:
    Type: String
    Default: public.ecr.aws/nginx/nginx:stable
    Description: Container image for the ECS service.
  DesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Desired number of ECS tasks.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.20.0.0/16
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.20.1.0/24
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.20.2.0/24
  WaitSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Seconds to wait between instance termination and health check.

Conditions:
  HasAlertEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlertEmail, '']]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  InstanceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for the chaos target EC2 instance (egress only)
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-instance-sg'

  ServiceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ECS service tasks
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-service-sg'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Chaos target EC2 instance
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ChaosTargetInstance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    DependsOn: PublicDefaultRoute
    Properties:
      ImageId: !Ref LatestAmiId
      InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref InstanceSecurityGroup
      DisableApiTermination: false
      InstanceInitiatedShutdownBehavior: terminate
      MetadataOptions:
        HttpTokens: required
        HttpEndpoint: enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-chaos-target'
        - Key: ChaosTarget
          Value: 'true'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ECS cluster and service
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cluster'
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled

  ServiceLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/ecs/${AWS::StackName}-service'
      RetentionInDays: 14

  TaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy'

  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-task'
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      Cpu: '256'
      Memory: '512'
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt TaskExecutionRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: web
          Image: !Ref ContainerImage
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: 80
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref ServiceLogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: web

  ECSService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn: PublicDefaultRoute
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-service'
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCount
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 50
        MaximumPercent: 200
        DeploymentCircuitBreaker:
          Enable: true
          Rollback: true
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: ENABLED
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PublicSubnet1
            - !Ref PublicSubnet2
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ServiceSecurityGroup

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SNS alert topic
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AlertTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-chaos-alerts'
      DisplayName: Chaos Experiment Alerts

  AlertEmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasAlertEmail
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref AlertTopic
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref AlertEmail

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda: terminate instance
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TerminateInstanceFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: TerminateChaosTargetInstance
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:TerminateInstances
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/${ChaosTargetInstance}'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                Resource: '*'

  TerminateInstanceFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-terminate-instance'
      RetentionInDays: 14

  TerminateInstanceFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: TerminateInstanceFunctionLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-terminate-instance'
      Description: Terminates the chaos target EC2 instance.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt TerminateInstanceFunctionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          DEFAULT_INSTANCE_ID: !Ref ChaosTargetInstance
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import json
          import boto3

          ec2 = boto3.client("ec2")

          def handler(event, context):
              instance_id = (event or {}).get("InstanceId") or os.environ["DEFAULT_INSTANCE_ID"]
              print(json.dumps({"action": "terminate", "instanceId": instance_id}))

              desc = ec2.describe_instances(InstanceIds=[instance_id])
              state = desc["Reservations"][0]["Instances"][0]["State"]["Name"]
              if state in ("shutting-down", "terminated"):
                  return {"InstanceId": instance_id, "PreviousState": state, "CurrentState": state, "Terminated": True}

              resp = ec2.terminate_instances(InstanceIds=[instance_id])
              change = resp["TerminatingInstances"][0]
              return {
                  "InstanceId": instance_id,
                  "PreviousState": change["PreviousState"]["Name"],
                  "CurrentState": change["CurrentState"]["Name"],
                  "Terminated": True,
              }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda: health check + SNS alert
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HealthCheckFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ECSHealthCheckAndAlert
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecs:DescribeServices
                Resource: !Ref ECSService
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecs:ListTasks
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  ArnEquals:
                    ecs:cluster: !GetAtt ECSCluster.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref AlertTopic

  HealthCheckFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-ecs-health-check'
      RetentionInDays: 14

  HealthCheckFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: HealthCheckFunctionLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ecs-health-check'
      Description: Checks ECS service health and publishes an SNS alert if unhealthy.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt HealthCheckFunctionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          DEFAULT_CLUSTER_NAME: !Ref ECSCluster
          DEFAULT_SERVICE_NAME: !GetAtt ECSService.Name
          DEFAULT_TOPIC_ARN: !Ref AlertTopic
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import json
          from datetime import datetime, timezone
          import boto3

          ecs = boto3.client("ecs")
          sns = boto3.client("sns")

          def handler(event, context):
              event = event or {}
              cluster = event.get("ClusterName") or os.environ["DEFAULT_CLUSTER_NAME"]
              service = event.get("ServiceName") or os.environ["DEFAULT_SERVICE_NAME"]
              topic_arn = event.get("TopicArn") or os.environ["DEFAULT_TOPIC_ARN"]
              experiment = event.get("ExperimentContext", {})

              reasons = []
              resp = ecs.describe_services(cluster=cluster, services=[service])
              if resp.get("failures") or not resp.get("services"):
                  reasons.append("Service not found: %s" % resp.get("failures"))
                  svc = {}
              else:
                  svc = resp["services"][0]
                  if svc.get("status") != "ACTIVE":
                      reasons.append("Service status is %s" % svc.get("status"))
                  desired = svc.get("desiredCount", 0)
                  running = svc.get("runningCount", 0)
                  if running < desired:
                      reasons.append("runningCount (%d) < desiredCount (%d)" % (running, desired))
                  for d in svc.get("deployments", []):
                      if d.get("rolloutState") == "FAILED":
                          reasons.append("Deployment %s rollout FAILED: %s" % (d.get("id"), d.get("rolloutStateReason")))

              healthy = len(reasons) == 0
              result = {
                  "ClusterName": cluster,
                  "ServiceName": service,
                  "Status": svc.get("status"),
                  "DesiredCount": svc.get("desiredCount"),
                  "RunningCount": svc.get("runningCount"),
                  "PendingCount": svc.get("pendingCount"),
                  "Healthy": healthy,
                  "Reasons": reasons,
                  "CheckedAt": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                  "AlertPublished": False,
              }

              if not healthy:
                  message = {
                      "Alert": "ECS service unhealthy after chaos experiment",
                      "Experiment": experiment,
                      "HealthCheck": result,
                  }
                  sns.publish(
                      TopicArn=topic_arn,
                      Subject=("Chaos alert: ECS service %s unhealthy" % service)[:100],
                      Message=json.dumps(message, indent=2, default=str),
                  )
                  result["AlertPublished"] = True

              print(json.dumps(result, default=str))
              return result

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step Functions state machine
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StateMachineLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vendedlogs/states/${AWS::StackName}-chaos-workflow'
      RetentionInDays: 14

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeChaosLambdas
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt TerminateInstanceFunction.Arn
                  - !Sub '${TerminateInstanceFunction.Arn}:*'
                  - !GetAtt HealthCheckFunction.Arn
                  - !Sub '${HealthCheckFunction.Arn}:*'
        - PolicyName: StateMachineLogging
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'

  ChaosStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-chaos-workflow'
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
      DefinitionSubstitutions:
        TerminateFunctionArn: !GetAtt TerminateInstanceFunction.Arn
        HealthCheckFunctionArn: !GetAtt HealthCheckFunction.Arn
        InstanceId: !Ref ChaosTargetInstance
        ClusterName: !Ref ECSCluster
        ServiceName: !GetAtt ECSService.Name
        TopicArn: !Ref AlertTopic
        WaitSeconds: !Ref WaitSeconds
      Definition:
        Comment: Chaos experiment - terminate EC2 instance, wait, then verify ECS service health and alert on failure.
        StartAt: TerminateInstance
        States:
          TerminateInstance:
            Type: Task
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke
            Parameters:
              FunctionName: ${TerminateFunctionArn}
              Payload:
                InstanceId: ${InstanceId}
                ExecutionId.$: $$.Execution.Id
            ResultSelector:
              InstanceId.$: $.Payload.InstanceId
              PreviousState.$: $.Payload.PreviousState
              CurrentState.$: $.Payload.CurrentState
              Terminated.$: $.Payload.Terminated
            ResultPath: $.Termination
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - Lambda.ServiceException
                  - Lambda.AWSLambdaException
                  - Lambda.SdkClientException
                  - Lambda.TooManyRequestsException
                IntervalSeconds: 2
                MaxAttempts: 3
                BackoffRate: 2
            Catch:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - States.ALL
                ResultPath: $.Error
                Next: ExperimentFailed
            Next: WaitForImpact
          WaitForImpact:
            Type: Wait
            Seconds: ${WaitSeconds}
            Next: CheckServiceHealth
          CheckServiceHealth:
            Type: Task
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke
            Parameters:
              FunctionName: ${HealthCheckFunctionArn}
              Payload:
                ClusterName: ${ClusterName}
                ServiceName: ${ServiceName}
                TopicArn: ${TopicArn}
                ExperimentContext:
                  ExecutionId.$: $$.Execution.Id
                  StartTime.$: $$.Execution.StartTime
                  Termination.$: $.Termination
            ResultSelector:
              Healthy.$: $.Payload.Healthy
              Reasons.$: $.Payload.Reasons
              DesiredCount.$: $.Payload.DesiredCount
              RunningCount.$: $.Payload.RunningCount
              AlertPublished.$: $.Payload.AlertPublished
              CheckedAt.$: $.Payload.CheckedAt
            ResultPath: $.HealthCheck
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - Lambda.ServiceException
                  - Lambda.AWSLambdaException
                  - Lambda.SdkClientException
                  - Lambda.TooManyRequestsException
                IntervalSeconds: 2
                MaxAttempts: 3
                BackoffRate: 2
            Catch:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - States.ALL
                ResultPath: $.Error
                Next: ExperimentFailed
            Next: EvaluateHealth
          EvaluateHealth:
            Type: Choice
            Choices:
              - Variable: $.HealthCheck.Healthy
                BooleanEquals: true
                Next: ServiceHealthy
            Default: ServiceUnhealthy
          ServiceHealthy:
            Type: Succeed
          ServiceUnhealthy:
            Type: Fail
            Error: ServiceUnhealthy
            Cause: ECS service was unhealthy after the chaos experiment; an SNS alert was published.
          ExperimentFailed:
            Type: Fail
            Error: ExperimentError
            Cause: The chaos experiment encountered an error while executing.

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the chaos engineering state machine
    Value: !Ref ChaosStateMachine
  ChaosTargetInstanceId:
    Description: ID of the EC2 instance targeted by the chaos experiment
    Value: !Ref ChaosTargetInstance
  ECSClusterName:
    Description: Name of the ECS cluster
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster
  ECSServiceName:
    Description: Name of the ECS service under test
    Value: !GetAtt ECSService.Name
  AlertTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS alert topic
    Value: !Ref AlertTopic
  TerminateInstanceFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the terminate-instance Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt TerminateInstanceFunction.Arn
  HealthCheckFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the health-check Lambda function

Description: >-

Parameters:

    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:

      - test

    Default: appuser
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 32
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_]*$'
    Description: Username stored in the generated secret.

Resources:
  EnvironmentParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AWS::StackName}/environment'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref Environment
      Description: Deployment environment name.

  ApiEndpointParameter:

  FeatureFlagsParameter:

  MaxConnectionsParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AWS::StackName}/db/max-connections'

      Value: '100'

  DatabaseSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:

      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: !Sub '{"username": "${DatabaseUsername}"}'
        GenerateStringKey: password
        PasswordLength: 24
        ExcludeCharacters: '"@/\'''

  ParameterStoreDemoRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ParameterAndSecretAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadStackParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${AWS::StackName}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${AWS::StackName}/*'
              - Sid: ListSecrets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:ListSecrets
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ReadStackSecrets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${AWS::StackName}/*'

  ParameterStoreDemoLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/ParameterStoreDemo
      RetentionInDays: 14

  ParameterStoreDemoFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn:
      - ParameterStoreDemoLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: ParameterStoreDemo
      Description: Retrieves and prints SSM parameters and Secrets Manager secrets for this stack.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt ParameterStoreDemoRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STACK_NAME: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os

          import boto3

          ssm = boto3.client("ssm")
          secretsmanager = boto3.client("secretsmanager")


          def get_parameters(path):
              parameters = []
              paginator = ssm.get_paginator("get_parameters_by_path")
              for page in paginator.paginate(Path=path, Recursive=True, WithDecryption=True):
                  parameters.extend(page.get("Parameters", []))
              return parameters


          def get_secrets(prefix):
              secrets = []
              paginator = secretsmanager.get_paginator("list_secrets")
              for page in paginator.paginate(Filters=[{"Key": "name", "Values": [prefix]}]):
                  for secret in page.get("SecretList", []):
                      if not secret["Name"].startswith(prefix):
                          continue
                      value = secretsmanager.get_secret_value(SecretId=secret["ARN"])
                      secrets.append({"Name": secret["Name"], "SecretString": value.get("SecretString")})
              return secrets


          def handler(event, context):
              stack_name = os.environ["STACK_NAME"]
              path = f"/{stack_name}"
              prefix = f"{stack_name}/"

              print(f"Parameters under path {path}:")
              parameters = get_parameters(path)
              for param in parameters:
                  print(f"  {param['Name']} ({param['Type']}) = {param['Value']}")

              print(f"Secrets with prefix {prefix}:")
              secrets = get_secrets(prefix)
              for secret in secrets:
                  print(f"  {secret['Name']} = {secret['SecretString']}")

              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "body": json.dumps({
                      "parameterCount": len(parameters),
                      "parameterNames": [p["Name"] for p in parameters],
                      "secretCount": len(secrets),
                      "secretNames": [s["Name"] for s in secrets],
                  }),
              }

Outputs:

    Description: SSM Parameter Store path containing this stack's parameters.
    Value: !Sub '/${AWS::StackName}'

  SecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the generated database secret.
    Value: !Ref DatabaseSecret

  LambdaFunctionName:
    Description: Name of the demo Lambda function.
    Value: !Ref ParameterStoreDemoFunction

  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the demo Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt ParameterStoreDemoFunction.Arn

Description: >-
  Lambda-based CI/CD deployment environment using CodeDeploy blue/green
  canary traffic shifting with pre- and post-traffic validation hooks.

    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod

      - CodeDeployDefault.LambdaCanary10Percent15Minutes
      - CodeDeployDefault.LambdaCanary10Percent30Minutes
    Description: Canary traffic-shifting configuration for the deployment group.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM Roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MainFunctionExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  HookFunctionExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

                  - codedeploy:PutLifecycleEventHookExecutionStatus

                  - lambda:InvokeFunction

                  - !GetAtt MainFunction.Arn

  CodeDeployServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:

            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:CodeDeployHook_*

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Main Lambda Function, Version and Alias
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MainFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Main application function deployed via CodeDeploy blue/green.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt MainFunctionExecutionRole.Arn

      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          ENVIRONMENT: !Ref EnvironmentName
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os

          def handler(event, context):
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "body": json.dumps({

                      "environment": os.environ.get("ENVIRONMENT", "unknown")
                  })
              }

  MainFunctionVersion:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Version
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref MainFunction
      Description: Published version of the main function.

  MainFunctionAlias:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Alias
    Properties:
      Name: live
      FunctionName: !Ref MainFunction
      FunctionVersion: !GetAtt MainFunctionVersion.Version
    UpdatePolicy:
      CodeDeployLambdaAliasUpdate:
        ApplicationName: !Ref CodeDeployApplication
        DeploymentGroupName: !Ref CodeDeployDeploymentGroup
        BeforeAllowTrafficHook: !Ref PreTrafficHookFunction
        AfterAllowTrafficHook: !Ref PostTrafficHookFunction

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Validation Hook Lambda Functions
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PreTrafficHookFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub CodeDeployHook_${AWS::StackName}_PreTraffic
      Description: Validates the new function version before traffic is shifted.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt HookFunctionExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TARGET_FUNCTION: !Ref MainFunction
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          codedeploy = boto3.client("codedeploy")
          lambda_client = boto3.client("lambda")

          def handler(event, context):
              deployment_id = event["DeploymentId"]
              hook_execution_id = event["LifecycleEventHookExecutionId"]
              status = "Succeeded"
              try:
                  # Invoke the latest published version and validate the response.
                  versions = lambda_client.list_versions_by_function(
                      FunctionName=os.environ["TARGET_FUNCTION"]
                  )["Versions"]
                  latest = max(
                      (v for v in versions if v["Version"] != "$LATEST"),
                      key=lambda v: int(v["Version"])
                  )
                  response = lambda_client.invoke(
                      FunctionName=latest["FunctionArn"],
                      Payload=json.dumps({"source": "pre-traffic-hook"})
                  )
                  payload = json.loads(response["Payload"].read())
                  if response.get("FunctionError") or payload.get("statusCode") != 200:
                      status = "Failed"
              except Exception as exc:
                  print(f"Pre-traffic validation error: {exc}")
                  status = "Failed"

              codedeploy.put_lifecycle_event_hook_execution_status(
                  deploymentId=deployment_id,
                  lifecycleEventHookExecutionId=hook_execution_id,
                  status=status
              )
              return {"status": status}

  PostTrafficHookFunction:

      Role: !GetAtt HookFunctionExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TARGET_FUNCTION: !Ref MainFunction
          TARGET_ALIAS: live
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          codedeploy = boto3.client("codedeploy")
          lambda_client = boto3.client("lambda")

          def handler(event, context):
              deployment_id = event["DeploymentId"]
              hook_execution_id = event["LifecycleEventHookExecutionId"]
              status = "Succeeded"
              try:
                  response = lambda_client.invoke(
                      FunctionName=os.environ["TARGET_FUNCTION"],
                      Qualifier=os.environ["TARGET_ALIAS"],
                      Payload=json.dumps({"source": "post-traffic-hook"})
                  )
                  payload = json.loads(response["Payload"].read())
                  if response.get("FunctionError") or payload.get("statusCode") != 200:
                      status = "Failed"
              except Exception as exc:
                  print(f"Post-traffic validation error: {exc}")
                  status = "Failed"

              codedeploy.put_lifecycle_event_hook_execution_status(

                  lifecycleEventHookExecutionId=hook_execution_id,
                  status=status
              )
              return {"status": status}

  # CodeDeploy Application and Deployment Group

    Properties:

  CodeDeployDeploymentGroup:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Custom Systems Manager inventory collection that tracks running database and
  caching processes on Windows and Linux EC2 instances.

Parameters:
  LinuxProcesses:
    Type: String
    Description: Comma-separated list of process keywords to search for on Linux instances.
    Default: CassandraDaemon,dse cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached
  WindowsProcesses:
    Type: String
    Description: Comma-separated list of process keywords to search for on Windows instances.
    Default: sqlservr,cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached
  ScheduleExpressionCron:
    Type: String
    Description: Schedule expression (cron or rate) for the inventory association.
    Default: rate(30 days)

Resources:
  CustomInventoryProcessesDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Command
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '2.2'
        description: Collects running database and caching processes and writes them to a custom inventory file (Custom:RunningProcesses).
        parameters:
          linuxProcesses:
            type: String
            description: Comma-separated list of process keywords to search for on Linux instances.
            default: CassandraDaemon,dse cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached
          windowsProcesses:
            type: String
            description: Comma-separated list of process keywords to search for on Windows instances.
            default: sqlservr,cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached
        mainSteps:
          - action: aws:runShellScript
            name: CollectLinuxProcesses
            precondition:
              StringEquals:
                - platformType
                - Linux
            inputs:
              timeoutSeconds: '600'
              runCommand:
                - |
                  #!/bin/bash
                  set -u
                  TOKEN=$(curl -s -m 5 -X PUT "http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token" -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600")
                  if [ -n "$TOKEN" ]; then
                    INSTANCE_ID=$(curl -s -m 5 -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN" http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id)
                  else
                    INSTANCE_ID=$(curl -s -m 5 http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id)
                  fi
                  if [ -z "$INSTANCE_ID" ]; then
                    echo "Unable to determine instance ID from instance metadata." >&2
                    exit 1
                  fi
                  INVENTORY_DIR="/var/lib/amazon/ssm/$INSTANCE_ID/inventory/custom"
                  mkdir -p "$INVENTORY_DIR"
                  INVENTORY_FILE="$INVENTORY_DIR/RunningProcesses.json"
                  KEYWORDS="{{ linuxProcesses }}"
                  json_escape() {
                    printf '%s' "$1" | sed -e 's/\\/\\\\/g' -e 's/"/\\"/g' -e 's/\t/ /g' | tr -d '\r\n'
                  }
                  SEEN=" "
                  CONTENT=""
                  IFS=',' read -ra KW_LIST <<< "$KEYWORDS"
                  for KW in "${KW_LIST[@]}"; do
                    KW=$(echo "$KW" | sed -e 's/^[[:space:]]*//' -e 's/[[:space:]]*$//')
                    [ -z "$KW" ] && continue
                    while read -r PID PNAME ARGS; do
                      [ -z "$PID" ] && continue
                      case "$SEEN" in *" $PID "*) continue ;; esac
                      SEEN="$SEEN$PID "
                      ENTRY="{\"ProcessId\":\"$PID\",\"ProcessName\":\"$(json_escape "$PNAME")\",\"CommandLine\":\"$(json_escape "$ARGS")\",\"Keyword\":\"$(json_escape "$KW")\"}"
                      if [ -z "$CONTENT" ]; then CONTENT="$ENTRY"; else CONTENT="$CONTENT,$ENTRY"; fi
                    done < <(ps -eo pid=,comm=,args= | grep -F -- "$KW" | grep -v -e "grep -F" -e "_script.sh")
                  done
                  echo "{\"SchemaVersion\":\"1.0\",\"TypeName\":\"Custom:RunningProcesses\",\"Content\":[$CONTENT]}" > "$INVENTORY_FILE"
                  echo "Custom inventory written to $INVENTORY_FILE"
                  cat "$INVENTORY_FILE"
          - action: aws:runPowerShellScript
            name: CollectWindowsProcesses
            precondition:
              StringEquals:
                - platformType
                - Windows
            inputs:
              timeoutSeconds: '600'
              runCommand:
                - |
                  $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
                  $instanceId = $null
                  try {
                    $token = Invoke-RestMethod -Method PUT -Uri 'http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token' -Headers @{ 'X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds' = '21600' } -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5
                    $instanceId = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id' -Headers @{ 'X-aws-ec2-metadata-token' = $token } -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5
                  } catch {
                    $instanceId = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 5
                  }
                  if ([string]::IsNullOrEmpty($instanceId)) {
                    throw 'Unable to determine instance ID from instance metadata.'
                  }
                  $inventoryDir = Join-Path $env:ProgramData "Amazon\SSM\InstanceData\$instanceId\inventory\custom"
                  if (-not (Test-Path $inventoryDir)) {
                    New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $inventoryDir -Force | Out-Null
                  }

                  $seen = @{}
                  $results = New-Object System.Collections.ArrayList
                  foreach ($kw in $keywords) {
                    $matched = $processes | Where-Object { ($_.Name -like "*$kw*") -or ($_.CommandLine -like "*$kw*") }

Description: >-

  a target bucket, and an optional EMR log bucket. All buckets carry a lifecycle

  on region) and expires them after 2555 days. The rule is enabled only on the
  EMR log bucket.

Parameters:
  CreateEMRLogBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Set to true to create the EMR log bucket.

  BucketNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: data-pipeline
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{1,30}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only (3-32 characters).
    Description: Prefix used when naming the buckets.

  ShouldCreateEMRLogBucket: !Equals
    - !Ref CreateEMRLogBucket
    - 'true'

  UseGlacierStorageClass: !Or
    - !Equals [!Ref 'AWS::Region', us-east-1]
    - !Equals [!Ref 'AWS::Region', us-east-2]
    - !Equals [!Ref 'AWS::Region', us-west-2]
    - !Equals [!Ref 'AWS::Region', eu-west-1]
    - !Equals [!Ref 'AWS::Region', eu-central-1]
    - !Equals [!Ref 'AWS::Region', ap-northeast-1]

        Rules:

Outputs:

  the running state by triggering the AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata Systems Manager

Parameters:
  HttpPutResponseHopLimit:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 64
    Description: The desired HTTP PUT response hop limit for instance metadata requests (1-64).

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by the AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata automation to modify instance metadata options.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

        - PolicyName: ConfigureEC2MetadataPolicy

            Version: '2012-10-17'

                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances

                Action:
                  - ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/*

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by EventBridge to start the AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata automation.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
