AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless WebSocket API (API Gateway) that asynchronously starts a Standard Step Functions state machine. The state machine waits five seconds and then sends a response back to the connected client through the API Gateway Management API.

Parameters:
  ApiStageName:
    Type: String
    Default: api
    Description: Name of the WebSocket API stage.

Resources:
  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-websocket-api'
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: '$request.body.action'

  ApiGatewayStepFunctionsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartStateMachineExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachine

  DefaultRouteIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution'
      CredentialsArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayStepFunctionsRole.Arn
      PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
      TemplateSelectionExpression: '\$default'
      RequestTemplates:
        $default: !Sub |
          {
            "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachine}",
            "input": "{\"connectionId\": \"$context.connectionId\", \"message\": $util.escapeJavaScript($input.json('$'))}"
          }

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $default
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      OperationName: DefaultRoute
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${DefaultRouteIntegration}'

  Deployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - DefaultRoute
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi

  Stage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      StageName: !Ref ApiStageName
      DeploymentId: !Ref Deployment
      Description: WebSocket API stage

  SendResponseFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ManageWebSocketConnections
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: execute-api:ManageConnections
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${ApiStageName}/POST/@connections/*'

  SendResponseFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Sends a message back to a WebSocket client via the API Gateway Management API.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt SendResponseFunctionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          CALLBACK_URL: !Sub 'https://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${ApiStageName}'
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          client = boto3.client(
              "apigatewaymanagementapi",
              endpoint_url=os.environ["CALLBACK_URL"],
          )

          def handler(event, context):
              connection_id = event["connectionId"]
              payload = {
                  "status": "completed",
                  "message": event.get("message"),
              }
              client.post_to_connection(
                  ConnectionId=connection_id,
                  Data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8"),
              )
              return {"connectionId": connection_id, "sent": True}

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeSendResponseFunction
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt SendResponseFunction.Arn
                  - !Sub '${SendResponseFunction.Arn}:*'

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionSubstitutions:
        SendResponseFunctionArn: !GetAtt SendResponseFunction.Arn
      Definition:
        Comment: Waits five seconds and then responds to the WebSocket client.
        StartAt: Wait
        States:
          Wait:
            Type: Wait
            Seconds: 5
            Next: SendResponse
          SendResponse:
            Type: Task
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::lambda:invoke
            Parameters:
              FunctionName: ${SendResponseFunctionArn}
              Payload:
                connectionId.$: $.connectionId
                message.$: $.message
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - Lambda.ServiceException
                  - Lambda.AWSLambdaException
                  - Lambda.SdkClientException
                  - Lambda.TooManyRequestsException
                IntervalSeconds: 2
                MaxAttempts: 3
                BackoffRate: 2
            OutputPath: $.Payload
            End: true

Outputs:
  WebSocketApiId:
    Description: WebSocket API ID
    Value: !Ref WebSocketApi
  WebSocketUrl:
    Description: WebSocket connection URL
    Value: !Sub 'wss://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${ApiStageName}'
  ConnectionsCallbackUrl:
    Description: API Gateway Management API callback URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${ApiStageName}/@connections'
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: Step Functions state machine ARN
    Value: !Ref StateMachine

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Cost management stack that creates a monthly cost budget with notifications
  at 80% and 99% of actual spend, delivered through a KMS-encrypted SNS topic
  to an SMS or email endpoint.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Budget Configuration
        Parameters:
          - BudgetLimit
      - Label:
          default: Notification Configuration
        Parameters:
          - NotificationProtocol
          - NotificationEndpoint
    ParameterLabels:
      BudgetLimit:
        default: Monthly budget limit (USD)
      NotificationProtocol:
        default: Notification method
      NotificationEndpoint:
        default: Notification endpoint (phone number or email address)

Parameters:
  BudgetLimit:
    Type: Number
    Default: 100
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Monthly cost budget limit in USD.

  NotificationProtocol:
    Type: String
    Default: sms
    AllowedValues:
      - sms
      - email
    Description: Method used to deliver budget notifications.

  NotificationEndpoint:
    Type: String
    Default: '+61'
    MinLength: 1
    Description: >-
      Phone number in E.164 format (e.g. +61400000000) when using SMS, or an
      email address when using email.

Resources:
  BillingTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key used to encrypt the billing alerts SNS topic.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowBudgetsToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: budgets.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:budgets::${AWS::AccountId}:*'
          - Sid: AllowSNSToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CostManagement

  BillingTopicKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/billing-topic-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref BillingTopicKey

  BillingAlertsTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: Billing Alerts
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref BillingTopicKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CostManagement

  BillingAlertsTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref BillingAlertsTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowBudgetsToPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: budgets.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref BillingAlertsTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:budgets::${AWS::AccountId}:*'
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref BillingAlertsTopic
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  BillingAlertsSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref BillingAlertsTopic
      Protocol: !Ref NotificationProtocol
      Endpoint: !Ref NotificationEndpoint

  MonthlyCostBudget:

        CostTypes:

          IncludeSubscription: true
          IncludeSupport: true
          IncludeOtherSubscription: true
          IncludeRecurring: true
          IncludeUpfront: true
          IncludeDiscount: true
          IncludeCredit: false
          IncludeRefund: false
          UseBlended: false
          UseAmortized: false

            NotificationType: ACTUAL
            ComparisonOperator: GREATER_THAN
            Threshold: 80
            ThresholdType: PERCENTAGE

            - SubscriptionType: SNS

        - Notification:
            NotificationType: ACTUAL
            ComparisonOperator: GREATER_THAN
            Threshold: 99
            ThresholdType: PERCENTAGE
          Subscribers:
            - SubscriptionType: SNS
              Address: !Ref BillingAlertsTopic

Outputs:

  InvokeContentModerationFunction:

          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          rekognition = boto3.client("rekognition")

          MAX_SIZE_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024
          ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = (".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png")
          ALLOWED_CONTENT_TYPES = ("image/jpeg", "image/jpg", "image/png")
          MIN_CONFIDENCE = float(os.environ.get("MIN_CONFIDENCE", "60"))
          USER_AGENT = "ContentModeration/1.0"


          def response(status_code, body):
              return {
                  "statusCode": status_code,
                  "headers": {
                      "Content-Type": "application/json",
                      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
                  },
                  "body": json.dumps(body),
              }


          def parse_body(event):
              body = event.get("body") if isinstance(event, dict) else None
              if body is None:
                  return event if isinstance(event, dict) else {}
              if isinstance(body, dict):
                  return body
              if event.get("isBase64Encoded"):
                  import base64
                  body = base64.b64decode(body).decode("utf-8")
              return json.loads(body) if body else {}


          def has_allowed_extension(url):
              path = urllib.parse.urlparse(url).path.lower()
              return path.endswith(ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS)


          def detect_format(data):
              if data[:3] == b"\xff\xd8\xff":
                  return "jpeg"
              if data[:8] == b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n":
                  return "png"
              return None


          def fetch_image(url):
              request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": USER_AGENT})
              with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=15) as resp:
                  content_type = (resp.headers.get("Content-Type") or "").split(";")[0].strip().lower()
                  content_length = resp.headers.get("Content-Length")
                  if content_length and content_length.isdigit() and int(content_length) > MAX_SIZE_BYTES:
                      raise ValueError("TOO_LARGE")
                  data = resp.read(MAX_SIZE_BYTES + 1)
                  if len(data) > MAX_SIZE_BYTES:
                      raise ValueError("TOO_LARGE")
                  return data, content_type


          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              try:
                  payload = parse_body(event)
              except (ValueError, json.JSONDecodeError):
                  return response(400, {"error": "Request body must be valid JSON."})

              url = payload.get("url") if isinstance(payload, dict) else None
              if not url or not isinstance(url, str):
                  return response(400, {"error": "Missing required field 'url'."})

              parsed = urllib.parse.urlparse(url)
              if parsed.scheme not in ("http", "https") or not parsed.netloc:
                  return response(400, {"error": "The 'url' must be a valid http or https URL."})

              if not has_allowed_extension(url):
                  return response(415, {"error": "Unsupported image format. Only jpg, jpeg, and png are allowed."})

              try:
                  image_bytes, content_type = fetch_image(url)
              except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
                  if e.code == 404:
                      return response(404, {"error": "Image not found at the provided URL."})
                  return response(502, {"error": "Failed to fetch image. Upstream returned HTTP %d." % e.code})
              except urllib.error.URLError as e:
                  return response(404, {"error": "Image could not be retrieved: %s" % str(e.reason)})
              except ValueError as e:
                  if str(e) == "TOO_LARGE":
                      return response(413, {"error": "Image exceeds the maximum allowed size of 5MB."})
                  raise
              except Exception as e:
                  print("Error fetching image: %s" % str(e))
                  return response(502, {"error": "Failed to fetch image from the provided URL."})

              if not image_bytes:
                  return response(404, {"error": "Image not found or empty at the provided URL."})

              if content_type and content_type.startswith("image/") and content_type not in ALLOWED_CONTENT_TYPES:
                  return response(415, {"error": "Unsupported image format. Only jpg, jpeg, and png are allowed."})

              if detect_format(image_bytes) is None:
                  return response(415, {"error": "Unsupported image format. Only jpg, jpeg, and png are allowed."})

              try:
                  result = rekognition.detect_moderation_labels(
                      Image={"Bytes": image_bytes},
                      MinConfidence=MIN_CONFIDENCE,
                  )
              except ClientError as e:
                  code = e.response.get("Error", {}).get("Code", "")
                  print("Rekognition error: %s" % str(e))
                  if code in ("InvalidImageFormatException",):
                      return response(415, {"error": "Unsupported image format."})
                  if code in ("ImageTooLargeException",):
                      return response(413, {"error": "Image exceeds the maximum allowed size of 5MB."})
                  if code in ("InvalidParameterException",):
                      return response(400, {"error": "Invalid image or parameters."})
                  return response(500, {"error": "Error calling Amazon Rekognition."})
              except Exception as e:
                  print("Unexpected error: %s" % str(e))
                  return response(500, {"error": "Internal server error."})

              return response(200, {
                  "url": url,
                  "minConfidence": MIN_CONFIDENCE,
                  "ModerationLabels": result.get("ModerationLabels", []),
                  "ModerationModelVersion": result.get("ModerationModelVersion"),
              })

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Scheduled workflow that closes AWS Organizations member accounts tagged
  organizations:account-closure=REQUESTED. An EventBridge rule runs every hour
  and starts an EXPRESS Step Functions state machine. The state machine pages
  through the organization's accounts, finds accounts tagged for closure,
  describes each one, closes it if it is ACTIVE, and then tags it
  organizations:account-closure=ACKNOWLEDGED. Deploy this template in the
  Organizations management account.

Parameters:
  ScheduleState:
    Type: String
    Default: ENABLED
    AllowedValues:
      - ENABLED
      - DISABLED
    Description: Whether the hourly EventBridge schedule is enabled.

  MaxConcurrency:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 40
    Description: Maximum number of accounts processed in parallel per page. Keep this low to avoid Organizations API throttling.

Resources:
  AccountClosureLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vendedlogs/states/${AWS::StackName}-account-closure"
      RetentionInDays: 365

  AccountClosureStateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the account closure state machine.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub "states.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: OrganizationsAccountClosure
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListAccounts
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:ListAccounts
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: ReadAccounts
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:DescribeAccount
                  - organizations:ListTagsForResource
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:account/o-*/*"
              - Sid: CloseRequestedAccounts
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:CloseAccount
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:account/o-*/*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:ResourceTag/organizations:account-closure: REQUESTED
              - Sid: AcknowledgeClosure
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:TagResource
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:account/o-*/*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:RequestTag/organizations:account-closure: ACKNOWLEDGED
                  ForAllValues:StringEquals:
                    aws:TagKeys:
                      - organizations:account-closure
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLogsDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: LogDelivery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: "*"

  AccountClosureStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-account-closure"
      StateMachineType: EXPRESS
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AccountClosureStateMachineRole.Arn
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Level: ALL
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt AccountClosureLogGroup.Arn
      Definition:
        Comment: Close AWS Organizations accounts tagged organizations:account-closure=REQUESTED.
        QueryLanguage: JSONata
        StartAt: ListAccounts
        States:
          ListAccounts:
            Type: Task
            Comment: Fetch one page of accounts in the organization.
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:listAccounts
            Arguments: "{% $exists($states.input.NextToken) ? {'NextToken': $states.input.NextToken} : {} %}"
            Output: "{% {'Accounts': [$states.result.Accounts.Id], 'NextToken': $states.result.NextToken} %}"
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals:
                  - Organizations.TooManyRequestsException
                  - Organizations.ServiceException
                  - Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException
                IntervalSeconds: 2
                MaxAttempts: 6
                BackoffRate: 2
                JitterStrategy: FULL
            Next: ProcessAccounts

          ProcessAccounts:
            Type: Map
            Comment: Evaluate each account on the current page.
            Items: "{% $states.input.Accounts %}"
            MaxConcurrency: !Ref MaxConcurrency
            ItemProcessor:
              ProcessorConfig:
                Mode: INLINE
              StartAt: GetAccountTags
              States:
                GetAccountTags:
                  Type: Task
                  Resource: arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:listTagsForResource
                  Arguments:
                    ResourceId: "{% $states.input %}"
                  Output: "{% {'AccountId': $states.input, 'ClosureRequested': 'REQUESTED' in $states.result.Tags[Key = 'organizations:account-closure'].Value} %}"
                  Retry:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.TooManyRequestsException
                        - Organizations.ServiceException
                      IntervalSeconds: 2
                      MaxAttempts: 6
                      BackoffRate: 2
                      JitterStrategy: FULL
                    - Comment: Newly created or moved accounts may not be visible yet.
                      ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.TargetNotFoundException
                      IntervalSeconds: 5
                      MaxAttempts: 3
                      BackoffRate: 2
                  Catch:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - States.ALL
                      Output: "{% {'AccountId': $states.input, 'Stage': 'GetAccountTags', 'Error': $states.errorOutput} %}"
                      Next: RecordFailure
                  Next: IsClosureRequested

                IsClosureRequested:
                  Type: Choice
                  Choices:
                    - Condition: "{% $states.input.ClosureRequested = true %}"
                      Next: DescribeAccount
                  Default: SkipAccount

                DescribeAccount:
                  Type: Task
                  Resource: arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:describeAccount
                  Arguments:
                    AccountId: "{% $states.input.AccountId %}"
                  Output: "{% {'AccountId': $states.input.AccountId, 'Status': $states.result.Account.Status} %}"
                  Retry:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.TooManyRequestsException
                        - Organizations.ServiceException
                      IntervalSeconds: 2
                      MaxAttempts: 6
                      BackoffRate: 2
                      JitterStrategy: FULL
                    - Comment: Account data is eventually consistent.
                      ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.AccountNotFoundException
                      IntervalSeconds: 5
                      MaxAttempts: 3
                      BackoffRate: 2
                  Catch:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - States.ALL
                      Output: "{% {'AccountId': $states.input.AccountId, 'Stage': 'DescribeAccount', 'Error': $states.errorOutput} %}"
                      Next: RecordFailure
                  Next: IsAccountActive

                IsAccountActive:
                  Type: Choice
                  Choices:
                    - Condition: "{% $states.input.Status = 'ACTIVE' %}"
                      Next: CloseAccount
                  Default: SkipAccount

                CloseAccount:
                  Type: Task
                  Resource: arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:closeAccount
                  Arguments:
                    AccountId: "{% $states.input.AccountId %}"
                  Output: "{% $states.input %}"
                  Retry:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.TooManyRequestsException
                        - Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException
                        - Organizations.ServiceException
                      IntervalSeconds: 2
                      MaxAttempts: 6
                      BackoffRate: 2
                      JitterStrategy: FULL
                    - Comment: Account data is eventually consistent.
                      ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.AccountNotFoundException
                      IntervalSeconds: 5
                      MaxAttempts: 3
                      BackoffRate: 2
                  Catch:
                    - Comment: Already closing or closed - still acknowledge the request.
                      ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.AccountAlreadyClosedException
                      Output: "{% $states.input %}"
                      Next: TagAccountAcknowledged
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - States.ALL
                      Output: "{% {'AccountId': $states.input.AccountId, 'Stage': 'CloseAccount', 'Error': $states.errorOutput} %}"
                      Next: RecordFailure
                  Next: TagAccountAcknowledged

                TagAccountAcknowledged:
                  Type: Task
                  Resource: arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:organizations:tagResource
                  Arguments:
                    ResourceId: "{% $states.input.AccountId %}"
                    Tags:
                      - Key: organizations:account-closure
                        Value: ACKNOWLEDGED
                  Output: "{% {'AccountId': $states.input.AccountId, 'Result': 'CLOSURE_ACKNOWLEDGED'} %}"
                  Retry:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.TooManyRequestsException
                        - Organizations.ConcurrentModificationException
                        - Organizations.ServiceException
                      IntervalSeconds: 2
                      MaxAttempts: 6
                      BackoffRate: 2
                      JitterStrategy: FULL
                    - Comment: Account data is eventually consistent.
                      ErrorEquals:
                        - Organizations.TargetNotFoundException
                      IntervalSeconds: 5
                      MaxAttempts: 3
                      BackoffRate: 2
                  Catch:
                    - ErrorEquals:
                        - States.ALL
                      Output: "{% {'AccountId': $states.input.AccountId, 'Stage': 'TagAccountAcknowledged', 'Error': $states.errorOutput} %}"
                      Next: RecordFailure
                  End: true

                SkipAccount:
                  Type: Pass
                  Output: "{% {'AccountId': $states.input.AccountId, 'Result': 'SKIPPED'} %}"
                  End: true

                RecordFailure:
                  Type: Pass
                  Comment: Failure for a single account is logged without stopping the other accounts.
                  Output: "{% $merge([$states.input, {'Result': 'FAILED'}]) %}"
                  End: true
            Output: "{% {'NextToken': $states.input.NextToken, 'Results': $states.result} %}"
            Next: HasMorePages

          HasMorePages:
            Type: Choice
            Choices:
              - Condition: "{% $exists($states.input.NextToken) %}"
                Next: ListAccounts
            Default: Done

          Done:
            Type: Succeed

  SchedulerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows EventBridge to start the account closure state machine.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartAccountClosureStateMachine
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref AccountClosureStateMachine

  HourlyScheduleRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Run the account closure workflow every hour.
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 hour)
      State: !Ref ScheduleState
      Targets:
        - Id: AccountClosureStateMachine
          Arn: !Ref AccountClosureStateMachine
          RoleArn: !GetAtt SchedulerRole.Arn
          Input: "{}"
          RetryPolicy:
            MaximumRetryAttempts: 3
            MaximumEventAgeInSeconds: 3600

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the account closure state machine.
    Value: !Ref AccountClosureStateMachine
  LogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch log group receiving execution logs.
    Value: !Ref AccountClosureLogGroup
  ScheduleRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the hourly EventBridge rule.
    Value: !GetAtt HourlyScheduleRule.Arn

                  "userName": event.get("userName"),
              }))
              # Place post-authentication logic here (e.g. record last login).
              return event
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: StudyBuddy

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito User Pool
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-studybuddy-user-pool'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_CODE
        EmailSubject: Your StudyBuddy verification code
        EmailMessage: 'Your StudyBuddy verification code is {####}'
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: given_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: family_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      LambdaConfig:
        PreSignUp: !GetAtt PreSignUpFunction.Arn
        PostConfirmation: !GetAtt PostConfirmationFunction.Arn
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationFunction.Arn
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: StudyBuddy

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PreSignUpFunction.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  PostConfirmationInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PostConfirmationFunction.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  PostAuthenticationInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PostAuthenticationFunction.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ProviderName: Google
      ProviderType: Google
      ProviderDetails:
        client_id: !Sub '{{resolve:secretsmanager:${GoogleOAuthSecret}:SecretString:client_id}}'
        client_secret: !Sub '{{resolve:secretsmanager:${GoogleOAuthSecret}:SecretString:client_secret}}'
        authorize_scopes: profile email openid
      AttributeMapping:
        email: email
        given_name: given_name
        family_name: family_name
        username: sub

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Hosted UI domain (Cognito-provided prefix)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Sub '${CognitoDomainPrefix}-${AWS::AccountId}'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # App client for the frontend
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: GoogleIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-studybuddy-web-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Sub 'https://${FrontendDomainName}/callback'
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Sub 'https://${FrontendDomainName}/logout'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
        - Google
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        RefreshToken: days

Outputs:

    Value: !Ref UserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId'

  UserPoolArn:

    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Edge-computing architecture with two self-contained VPCs (Users layer and Fog layer),
  each with one subnet and route table in the first available AZ. Both VPCs have private
  connectivity to Amazon S3 (gateway endpoint) and AWS KMS (interface endpoint). The Fog VPC
  additionally has interface endpoints for Secrets Manager, EventBridge, STS, and Lambda.

Parameters:
  UsersVpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.50.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the Users layer VPC.
  UsersSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.50.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the Users layer subnet.
  FogVpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.60.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the Fog layer VPC.
  FogSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.60.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the Fog layer subnet.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Users layer VPC
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UsersVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref UsersVpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-users-vpc"
        - Key: Layer
          Value: Users

  UsersSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref UsersSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-users-subnet"
        - Key: Layer
          Value: Users

  UsersRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-users-rt"
        - Key: Layer
          Value: Users

  UsersSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref UsersSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref UsersRouteTable

  UsersEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTPS from the Users VPC to interface VPC endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref UsersVpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS from within the Users VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref UsersVpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS responses within the Users VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-users-endpoint-sg"

  UsersS3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref UsersRouteTable

  UsersKmsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref UsersSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref UsersEndpointSecurityGroup

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Fog layer VPC
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FogVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref FogVpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-fog-vpc"
        - Key: Layer
          Value: Fog

  FogSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref FogSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-fog-subnet"
        - Key: Layer
          Value: Fog

  FogRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-fog-rt"
        - Key: Layer
          Value: Fog

  FogSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref FogSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref FogRouteTable

  FogEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTPS from the Fog VPC to interface VPC endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref FogVpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS from within the Fog VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref FogVpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS responses within the Fog VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-fog-endpoint-sg"

  FogS3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref FogRouteTable

  FogKmsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref FogSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref FogEndpointSecurityGroup

  FogSecretsManagerInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.secretsmanager"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref FogSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref FogEndpointSecurityGroup

  FogEventBridgeInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.events"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref FogSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref FogEndpointSecurityGroup

  FogStsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sts"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref FogSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref FogEndpointSecurityGroup

  FogLambdaInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVPC
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.lambda"
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref FogSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref FogEndpointSecurityGroup

Outputs:
  UsersVpcId:
    Description: ID of the Users layer VPC
    Value: !Ref UsersVPC
  UsersSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the Users layer subnet
    Value: !Ref UsersSubnet
  UsersRouteTableId:
    Description: ID of the Users layer route table
    Value: !Ref UsersRouteTable
  UsersS3EndpointId:
    Description: ID of the Users VPC S3 gateway endpoint
    Value: !Ref UsersS3GatewayEndpoint
  UsersKmsEndpointId:
    Description: ID of the Users VPC KMS interface endpoint
    Value: !Ref UsersKmsInterfaceEndpoint
  FogVpcId:
    Description: ID of the Fog layer VPC
    Value: !Ref FogVPC
  FogSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the Fog layer subnet
    Value: !Ref FogSubnet
  FogRouteTableId:
    Description: ID of the Fog layer route table
    Value: !Ref FogRouteTable
  FogS3EndpointId:
    Description: ID of the Fog VPC S3 gateway endpoint
    Value: !Ref FogS3GatewayEndpoint
  FogKmsEndpointId:
    Description: ID of the Fog VPC KMS interface endpoint
    Value: !Ref FogKmsInterfaceEndpoint
  FogSecretsManagerEndpointId:
    Description: ID of the Fog VPC Secrets Manager interface endpoint
    Value: !Ref FogSecretsManagerInterfaceEndpoint
  FogEventBridgeEndpointId:
    Description: ID of the Fog VPC EventBridge interface endpoint
    Value: !Ref FogEventBridgeInterfaceEndpoint
  FogStsEndpointId:
    Description: ID of the Fog VPC STS interface endpoint
    Value: !Ref FogStsInterfaceEndpoint
  FogLambdaEndpointId:
    Description: ID of the Fog VPC Lambda interface endpoint
    Value: !Ref FogLambdaInterfaceEndpoint

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Security Hub automation rules that suppress reviewed and accepted findings.
  Security Hub must already be enabled in this account and Region. Deploy this
  in the delegated administrator account so the rules apply to findings from
  all member accounts.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: General
        Parameters:
          - RuleStatus
          - NoteUpdatedBy
      - Label:
          default: IAM Rule - Excluded Human Users
        Parameters:
          - ExcludedIamUserName1
          - ExcludedIamUserName2
      - Label:
          default: Designated Account Scoping
        Parameters:
          - CisScopedAccountId
          - EbsEncryptionExemptAccountId
          - AutomationAccountId1
          - AutomationAccountId2
      - Label:
          default: Intentionally Public S3 Buckets
        Parameters:
          - PublicBucketName1
          - PublicBucketName2
          - PublicBucketName3
      - Label:
          default: GuardDuty Bedrock Rule
        Parameters:
          - GuardDutyBedrockFindingType

Parameters:
  RuleStatus:
    Type: String
    Default: ENABLED
    AllowedValues:
      - ENABLED
      - DISABLED
    Description: Whether the automation rules are active.

  NoteUpdatedBy:
    Type: String
    Default: SecurityHubAutomationRules
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 128
    Description: Value recorded as the author of the note added to suppressed findings.

  ExcludedIamUserName1:
    Type: String
    MinLength: 1
    AllowedPattern: '^[\w+=,.@-]+$'
    Description: First IAM user name that must NOT have IAM findings suppressed.

  ExcludedIamUserName2:
    Type: String
    MinLength: 1
    AllowedPattern: '^[\w+=,.@-]+$'
    Description: Second IAM user name that must NOT have IAM findings suppressed.

  CisScopedAccountId:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    Description: Designated sub-account in which selected CIS findings are suppressed.

  EbsEncryptionExemptAccountId:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    Description: Account for which the EBS default encryption finding is suppressed.

  AutomationAccountId1:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    Description: First account running infrequent automation (unused credential / key rotation findings suppressed).

  AutomationAccountId2:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    Description: Second account running infrequent automation (unused credential / key rotation findings suppressed).

  PublicBucketName1:
    Type: String
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 63
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*[a-z0-9]$'
    Description: Name of an intentionally public S3 bucket.

  PublicBucketName2:
    Type: String
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 63
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*[a-z0-9]$'
    Description: Name of an intentionally public S3 bucket.

  PublicBucketName3:
    Type: String
    MinLength: 3
    MaxLength: 63
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*[a-z0-9]$'
    Description: Name of an intentionally public S3 bucket.

  GuardDutyBedrockFindingType:
    Type: String
    Default: TTPs/Discovery/Discovery:IAMUser-AnomalousBehavior
    MinLength: 1
    Description: >-
      ASFF finding type (Types field) of the GuardDuty finding generated by
      expected cross-account Bedrock API activity.

Resources:
  SuppressIamFindingsExceptHumanUsersRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: Suppress-IAM-Findings-Org-Wide-Except-Named-Users
      RuleOrder: 1
      RuleStatus: !Ref RuleStatus
      IsTerminal: false
      Description: >-
        Suppresses reviewed IAM findings across the organization, except for
        findings on specific named human users which remain actionable.
      Criteria:
        RecordState:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: ACTIVE
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: IAM.2
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: IAM.5
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: IAM.19
        ResourceId:
          - Comparison: NOT_CONTAINS
            Value: !Sub ':user/${ExcludedIamUserName1}'
          - Comparison: NOT_CONTAINS
            Value: !Sub ':user/${ExcludedIamUserName2}'
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: >-
                Auto-suppressed: IAM finding reviewed and accepted as expected
                across the organization. Findings for designated human users are
                excluded from this rule.
              UpdatedBy: !Ref NoteUpdatedBy

  SuppressCisFindingsDesignatedAccountRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: Suppress-CIS-Findings-Designated-Account
      RuleOrder: 2
      RuleStatus: !Ref RuleStatus
      IsTerminal: false
      Description: >-
        Suppresses selected CIS benchmark findings in one designated
        sub-account where they have been reviewed and accepted.
      Criteria:
        RecordState:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: ACTIVE
        AwsAccountId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref CisScopedAccountId
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: IAM.6
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: IAM.9
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: CloudTrail.7
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: EC2.6
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: >-
                Auto-suppressed: CIS benchmark finding reviewed and accepted as
                non-actionable for this designated sub-account.
              UpdatedBy: !Ref NoteUpdatedBy

  SuppressOrgWideCisFsbpFindingsRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: Suppress-CIS-FSBP-Findings-Org-Wide
      RuleOrder: 3
      RuleStatus: !Ref RuleStatus
      IsTerminal: false
      Description: >-
        Suppresses accepted CIS and AWS Foundational Security Best Practices
        findings organization-wide: admin ports on security groups for bastion
        hosts and testing, S3 public-access and HTTP-access settings, and AWS
        Config regional coverage.
      Criteria:
        RecordState:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: ACTIVE
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          # Security groups permitting administrative ports (bastion hosts / testing)
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: EC2.13
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: EC2.14
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: EC2.53
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: EC2.54
          # S3 public access and HTTP (non-SSL) access settings
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: S3.1
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: S3.5
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: S3.8
          # AWS Config regional coverage
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: Config.1
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: >-
                Auto-suppressed: CIS/FSBP finding reviewed and accepted
                organization-wide (admin ports required for bastion hosts and
                testing, S3 public/HTTP access settings, AWS Config regional
                coverage).
              UpdatedBy: !Ref NoteUpdatedBy

  SuppressIntentionallyPublicBucketsRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: Suppress-Public-Access-Intentionally-Public-Buckets
      RuleOrder: 4
      RuleStatus: !Ref RuleStatus
      IsTerminal: false
      Description: >-
        Suppresses public-access findings for a known list of S3 buckets that
        are intentionally public.
      Criteria:
        RecordState:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: ACTIVE
        ResourceType:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: AwsS3Bucket
        ResourceId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${PublicBucketName1}'
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${PublicBucketName2}'
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${PublicBucketName3}'
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: S3.2
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: S3.3
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: S3.8
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: S3.19
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: >-
                Auto-suppressed: S3 bucket is intentionally public and has been
                reviewed and accepted.
              UpdatedBy: !Ref NoteUpdatedBy

  SuppressEbsDefaultEncryptionAccountRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: Suppress-EBS-Default-Encryption-Specific-Account
      RuleOrder: 5
      RuleStatus: !Ref RuleStatus
      IsTerminal: false
      Description: >-
        Suppresses the EBS default encryption finding for one specific account.
      Criteria:
        RecordState:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: ACTIVE
        AwsAccountId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref EbsEncryptionExemptAccountId
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: EC2.7
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: >-
                Auto-suppressed: EBS default encryption finding reviewed and
                accepted for this account.
              UpdatedBy: !Ref NoteUpdatedBy

  SuppressUnusedCredentialsAutomationAccountsRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: Suppress-Unused-Credentials-Key-Rotation-Automation-Accounts
      RuleOrder: 6
      RuleStatus: !Ref RuleStatus
      IsTerminal: false
      Description: >-
        Suppresses unused-credential and access-key-rotation findings for two
        accounts that run automation infrequently.
      Criteria:
        RecordState:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: ACTIVE
        AwsAccountId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref AutomationAccountId1
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref AutomationAccountId2
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: IAM.3
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: IAM.8
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: IAM.22
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: >-
                Auto-suppressed: account runs automation infrequently; unused
                credential and access key rotation findings reviewed and
                accepted.
              UpdatedBy: !Ref NoteUpdatedBy

  SuppressGuardDutyBedrockCrossAccountRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: Suppress-GuardDuty-Expected-Cross-Account-Bedrock-Activity
      RuleOrder: 7
      RuleStatus: !Ref RuleStatus
      IsTerminal: false
      Description: >-
        Suppresses one specific GuardDuty finding type raised by expected
        cross-account Amazon Bedrock API activity.
      Criteria:
        RecordState:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: ACTIVE
        ProductName:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: GuardDuty
        Type:
          - Comparison: EQUALS
            Value: !Ref GuardDutyBedrockFindingType
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: >-
                Auto-suppressed: GuardDuty finding reflects expected
                cross-account Amazon Bedrock API activity that has been reviewed
                and accepted.
              UpdatedBy: !Ref NoteUpdatedBy

Outputs:
  IamFindingsRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the org-wide IAM findings suppression rule.
    Value: !GetAtt SuppressIamFindingsExceptHumanUsersRule.RuleArn
  CisDesignatedAccountRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the designated-account CIS suppression rule.
    Value: !GetAtt SuppressCisFindingsDesignatedAccountRule.RuleArn
  OrgWideCisFsbpRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the org-wide CIS/FSBP suppression rule.
    Value: !GetAtt SuppressOrgWideCisFsbpFindingsRule.RuleArn
  PublicBucketsRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the intentionally public buckets suppression rule.
    Value: !GetAtt SuppressIntentionallyPublicBucketsRule.RuleArn
  EbsEncryptionRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EBS default encryption suppression rule.
    Value: !GetAtt SuppressEbsDefaultEncryptionAccountRule.RuleArn
  UnusedCredentialsRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the unused credentials / key rotation suppression rule.
    Value: !GetAtt SuppressUnusedCredentialsAutomationAccountsRule.RuleArn
  GuardDutyBedrockRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the GuardDuty Bedrock cross-account suppression rule.
    Value: !GetAtt SuppressGuardDutyBedrockCrossAccountRule.RuleArn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Description: >
  Lambda function bac-mcp-tool that acts as an MCP tool for testing an Amazon
  Bedrock AgentCore Gateway used by an AWS operations agent, plus an IAM role
  that the AgentCore Gateway service assumes to invoke it.

Resources:
  BacMcpToolLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/bac-mcp-tool
      RetentionInDays: 14

  BacMcpToolFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    DependsOn: BacMcpToolLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: bac-mcp-tool
      Description: MCP tool Lambda for testing the Bedrock AgentCore Gateway used by the AWS operations agent
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 900
      MemorySize: 1024
      Tracing: Active
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref BacMcpToolLogGroup
      InlineCode: |
        import json
        import logging

        logger = logging.getLogger()
        logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)


        def lambda_handler(event, context):
            logger.info("Received event: %s", json.dumps(event))
            tool_name = None
            client_context = getattr(context, "client_context", None)
            if client_context is not None and getattr(client_context, "custom", None):
                tool_name = client_context.custom.get("bedrockAgentCoreToolName")
            return {
                "statusCode": 200,
                "body": json.dumps({
                    "message": "bac-mcp-tool invoked successfully",
                    "tool": tool_name,
                    "input": event,
                }),
            }
      Policies:
        - Version: '2012-10-17'
          Statement:
            - Sid: BedrockInvokeModels
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - bedrock:InvokeModel
                - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
              Resource:
                - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:*::foundation-model/*
                - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:*:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/*
            - Sid: CostExplorerAndUsageAccess
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - ce:GetCostAndUsage
                - ce:GetCostAndUsageWithResources
                - ce:GetCostForecast
                - ce:GetUsageForecast
                - ce:GetDimensionValues
                - ce:GetTags
                - ce:GetCostCategories
                - ce:GetReservationUtilization
                - ce:GetSavingsPlansUtilization
                - cur:DescribeReportDefinitions
              Resource: '*'
            - Sid: S3ObjectOperations
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - s3:GetObject
                - s3:PutObject
                - s3:DeleteObject
                - s3:ListBucket
              Resource:
                - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*
                - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*
            - Sid: CloudWatchLogsWrite
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - logs:CreateLogStream
                - logs:PutLogEvents
              Resource:
                - !GetAtt BacMcpToolLogGroup.Arn
                - !Sub '${BacMcpToolLogGroup.Arn}:*'

  BedrockAgentCoreGatewayExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role assumed by Bedrock AgentCore Gateway to invoke Lambda MCP tools
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAgentCoreGatewayAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:gateway/*
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: BedrockAgentCoreGatewayExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: InvokeLambdaTools
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt BacMcpToolFunction.Arn
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*
              - Sid: ManageBedrockAgentCore
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock-agentcore:*
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*
              - Sid: PassRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/*
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: S3ObjectAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogsWrite
