AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained SLO monitoring dashboard and CloudWatch alarms for the
  FSx for ONTAP (FSxN) S3 Access Point event-driven pipeline pattern.
  Creates four SLO alarms (EventIngestionLatency, ProcessingSuccessRate,
  FPolicyReconnectTime, ReplayCompletionTime), a CloudWatch dashboard with
  SLO metric widgets, synthetic canary widgets, and an alarm status widget.
  All resources are deployed only when EnableSLODashboard is set to "true".

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: General Settings
        Parameters:
          - EnableSLODashboard
          - ProjectPrefix
          - DashboardRegion
          - MetricNamespace
          - CanaryMetricNamespace
          - SnsTopicArn
      - Label:
          default: SLO Thresholds
        Parameters:
          - EventIngestionLatencyThresholdSeconds
          - ProcessingSuccessRateThresholdPercent
          - FPolicyReconnectTimeThresholdSeconds
          - ReplayCompletionTimeThresholdSeconds
      - Label:
          default: Alarm Evaluation Settings
        Parameters:
          - AlarmPeriodSeconds
          - AlarmEvaluationPeriods
    ParameterLabels:
      EnableSLODashboard:
        default: Enable SLO dashboard and alarms
      SnsTopicArn:
        default: Optional SNS topic ARN for alarm notifications

Parameters:
  EnableSLODashboard:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Set to "true" to deploy the SLO dashboard and alarms.

  ProjectPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: fsxn-s3ap
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    Description: Prefix applied to dashboard and alarm names.

  DashboardRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-\d$'
    Description: AWS Region in which the dashboard widgets query metrics.

  MetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Default: FSxN-S3AP-Patterns
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255
    Description: CloudWatch namespace for the pipeline SLO metrics.

  CanaryMetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Default: FSxN-S3AP-Patterns/Canary
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 255
    Description: CloudWatch namespace for the synthetic canary metrics.

  SnsTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:sns:[a-z0-9-]+:\d{12}:[A-Za-z0-9_-]+(\.fifo)?$'
    Description: >-
      Optional SNS topic ARN to receive alarm notifications. Leave empty to
      create alarms without notification actions.

  EventIngestionLatencyThresholdSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 0
    Description: P99 event ingestion latency threshold in seconds.

  ProcessingSuccessRateThresholdPercent:
    Type: Number
    Default: 99.5
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 100
    Description: Average processing success rate threshold in percent (alarm when below).

  FPolicyReconnectTimeThresholdSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 0
    Description: Maximum FPolicy reconnect time threshold in seconds.

  ReplayCompletionTimeThresholdSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    MinValue: 0
    Description: Maximum replay completion time threshold in seconds (default 5 minutes).

  AlarmPeriodSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    AllowedValues:
      - 60
      - 300
      - 900
      - 3600
    Description: Alarm evaluation period length in seconds (default 5 minutes).

  AlarmEvaluationPeriods:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Number of consecutive periods that must breach before alarming.

Conditions:
  CreateSLOResources: !Equals
    - !Ref EnableSLODashboard
    - 'true'
  HasSnsTopic: !And
    - !Condition CreateSLOResources
    - !Not
      - !Equals
        - !Ref SnsTopicArn
        - ''

Resources:
  EventIngestionLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: CreateSLOResources
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-slo-event-ingestion-latency'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        SLO breach: P99 EventIngestionLatency exceeded
        ${EventIngestionLatencyThresholdSeconds} seconds for
        ${AlarmEvaluationPeriods} consecutive periods.
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: EventIngestionLatency
      ExtendedStatistic: p99
      Period: !Ref AlarmPeriodSeconds
      EvaluationPeriods: !Ref AlarmEvaluationPeriods
      DatapointsToAlarm: !Ref AlarmEvaluationPeriods
      Threshold: !Ref EventIngestionLatencyThresholdSeconds
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: !If
        - HasSnsTopic
        - - !Ref SnsTopicArn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      OKActions: !If
        - HasSnsTopic
        - - !Ref SnsTopicArn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  ProcessingSuccessRateAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: CreateSLOResources
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-slo-processing-success-rate'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        SLO breach: average ProcessingSuccessRate fell below
        ${ProcessingSuccessRateThresholdPercent}% for
        ${AlarmEvaluationPeriods} consecutive periods.
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: ProcessingSuccessRate
      Statistic: Average
      Period: !Ref AlarmPeriodSeconds
      EvaluationPeriods: !Ref AlarmEvaluationPeriods
      DatapointsToAlarm: !Ref AlarmEvaluationPeriods
      Threshold: !Ref ProcessingSuccessRateThresholdPercent
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: !If
        - HasSnsTopic
        - - !Ref SnsTopicArn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      OKActions: !If
        - HasSnsTopic
        - - !Ref SnsTopicArn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  FPolicyReconnectTimeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: CreateSLOResources
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-slo-fpolicy-reconnect-time'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        SLO breach: maximum FPolicyReconnectTime exceeded
        ${FPolicyReconnectTimeThresholdSeconds} seconds for
        ${AlarmEvaluationPeriods} consecutive periods.
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: FPolicyReconnectTime
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: !Ref AlarmPeriodSeconds
      EvaluationPeriods: !Ref AlarmEvaluationPeriods
      DatapointsToAlarm: !Ref AlarmEvaluationPeriods
      Threshold: !Ref FPolicyReconnectTimeThresholdSeconds
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: !If
        - HasSnsTopic
        - - !Ref SnsTopicArn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      OKActions: !If
        - HasSnsTopic
        - - !Ref SnsTopicArn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  ReplayCompletionTimeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: CreateSLOResources
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-slo-replay-completion-time'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub >-
        SLO breach: maximum ReplayCompletionTime exceeded
        ${ReplayCompletionTimeThresholdSeconds} seconds for
        ${AlarmEvaluationPeriods} consecutive periods.
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: ReplayCompletionTime
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: !Ref AlarmPeriodSeconds
      EvaluationPeriods: !Ref AlarmEvaluationPeriods
      DatapointsToAlarm: !Ref AlarmEvaluationPeriods
      Threshold: !Ref ReplayCompletionTimeThresholdSeconds
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: !If
        - HasSnsTopic
        - - !Ref SnsTopicArn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      OKActions: !If
        - HasSnsTopic
        - - !Ref SnsTopicArn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  SLODashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Condition: CreateSLOResources
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-slo-dashboard'
      DashboardBody: !Sub |
        {
          "widgets": [
            {
              "type": "text",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 24,
              "height": 2,
              "properties": {
                "markdown": "# ${ProjectPrefix} SLO Dashboard\nEvent-driven pipeline SLOs for FSx for ONTAP (namespace: `${MetricNamespace}`) and synthetic canaries (namespace: `${CanaryMetricNamespace}`)."
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 2,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Event Ingestion Latency (P99)",
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "region": "${DashboardRegion}",
                "period": ${AlarmPeriodSeconds},
                "stat": "p99",
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "EventIngestionLatency", { "label": "P99 Ingestion Latency (s)" } ]
                ],
                "annotations": {
                  "horizontal": [
                    { "label": "SLO Threshold (${EventIngestionLatencyThresholdSeconds}s)", "value": ${EventIngestionLatencyThresholdSeconds}, "color": "#d62728", "fill": "above" }
                  ]
                },
                "yAxis": { "left": { "label": "Seconds", "showUnits": false, "min": 0 } }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 2,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Processing Success Rate (Average)",
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "region": "${DashboardRegion}",
                "period": ${AlarmPeriodSeconds},
                "stat": "Average",
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "ProcessingSuccessRate", { "label": "Success Rate (%)" } ]
                ],
                "annotations": {
                  "horizontal": [
                    { "label": "SLO Threshold (${ProcessingSuccessRateThresholdPercent}%)", "value": ${ProcessingSuccessRateThresholdPercent}, "color": "#d62728", "fill": "below" }
                  ]
                },
                "yAxis": { "left": { "label": "Percent", "showUnits": false, "max": 100 } }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 8,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "FPolicy Reconnect Time (Maximum)",
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "region": "${DashboardRegion}",
                "period": ${AlarmPeriodSeconds},
                "stat": "Maximum",
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "FPolicyReconnectTime", { "label": "Max Reconnect Time (s)" } ]
                ],
                "annotations": {
                  "horizontal": [
                    { "label": "SLO Threshold (${FPolicyReconnectTimeThresholdSeconds}s)", "value": ${FPolicyReconnectTimeThresholdSeconds}, "color": "#d62728", "fill": "above" }
                  ]
                },
                "yAxis": { "left": { "label": "Seconds", "showUnits": false, "min": 0 } }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 8,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Replay Completion Time (Maximum)",
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "region": "${DashboardRegion}",
                "period": ${AlarmPeriodSeconds},
                "stat": "Maximum",
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "ReplayCompletionTime", { "label": "Max Replay Completion Time (s)" } ]
                ],
                "annotations": {
                  "horizontal": [
                    { "label": "SLO Threshold (${ReplayCompletionTimeThresholdSeconds}s)", "value": ${ReplayCompletionTimeThresholdSeconds}, "color": "#d62728", "fill": "above" }
                  ]
                },
                "yAxis": { "left": { "label": "Seconds", "showUnits": false, "min": 0 } }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 14,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Canary: S3 Access Point Latency",
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "region": "${DashboardRegion}",
                "period": ${AlarmPeriodSeconds},
                "stat": "Average",
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${CanaryMetricNamespace}", "S3APListLatency", { "label": "S3AP List Latency" } ],
                  [ "${CanaryMetricNamespace}", "S3APGetLatency", { "label": "S3AP Get Latency" } ]
                ],
                "yAxis": { "left": { "min": 0 } }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 14,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Canary: ONTAP Health Check",
                "view": "timeSeries",
                "stacked": false,
                "region": "${DashboardRegion}",
                "period": ${AlarmPeriodSeconds},
                "stat": "Minimum",
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${CanaryMetricNamespace}", "OntapHealthCheck", { "label": "ONTAP Health (1 = healthy)" } ]
                ],
                "yAxis": { "left": { "min": 0, "max": 1 } }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "alarm",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 20,
              "width": 24,
              "height": 4,
              "properties": {
                "title": "SLO Alarm Status",
                "sortBy": "stateUpdatedTimestamp",
                "alarms": [
                  "${EventIngestionLatencyAlarm.Arn}",
                  "${ProcessingSuccessRateAlarm.Arn}",
                  "${FPolicyReconnectTimeAlarm.Arn}",
                  "${ReplayCompletionTimeAlarm.Arn}"
                ]
              }
            }
          ]
        }

Outputs:
  DashboardName:
    Condition: CreateSLOResources
    Description: Name of the SLO CloudWatch dashboard.
    Value: !Ref SLODashboard

  DashboardUrl:
    Condition: CreateSLOResources
    Description: Console URL of the SLO CloudWatch dashboard.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${DashboardRegion}.console.aws.amazon.com/cloudwatch/home?region=${DashboardRegion}#dashboards:name=${SLODashboard}'

  EventIngestionLatencyAlarmArn:
    Condition: CreateSLOResources
    Description: ARN of the EventIngestionLatency SLO alarm.
    Value: !GetAtt EventIngestionLatencyAlarm.Arn

  ProcessingSuccessRateAlarmArn:
    Condition: CreateSLOResources
    Description: ARN of the ProcessingSuccessRate SLO alarm.
    Value: !GetAtt ProcessingSuccessRateAlarm.Arn

  FPolicyReconnectTimeAlarmArn:
    Condition: CreateSLOResources
    Description: ARN of the FPolicyReconnectTime SLO alarm.

  ReplayCompletionTimeAlarmArn:

    Description: ARN of the ReplayCompletionTime SLO alarm.

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-service Cognito User Pool for testing JWT authentication flows with an
  AgentCore Gateway and MCP server. Includes hosted UI domain, resource server
  with custom scopes, a public PKCE web client, and two machine-to-machine
  clients using the client credentials grant.

Parameters:
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: agentcore-jwt-test-pool
    Description: Name of the Cognito User Pool.

  DomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: agentcore-jwt-test
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,40}[a-z0-9])?$'
    Description: >-
      Prefix for the Cognito hosted UI domain. The AWS account ID is appended
      to help ensure global uniqueness.

  CallbackURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: 'http://localhost:3000/callback,http://localhost:8080/callback'
    Description: Comma-delimited list of allowed OAuth callback URLs for the web client.

  LogoutURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: 'http://localhost:3000/logout,http://localhost:8080/logout'
    Description: Comma-delimited list of allowed logout URLs for the web client.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: false
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_CODE
        EmailSubject: Verify your email for AgentCore JWT testing
        EmailMessage: 'Your verification code is {####}'
      EmailConfiguration:
        EmailSendingAccount: COGNITO_DEFAULT
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub '${DomainPrefix}-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: api
      Name: AgentCore API
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: mcp
          ScopeDescription: Access to the MCP server
        - ScopeName: gateway
          ScopeDescription: Access to the AgentCore Gateway

  WebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: agentcore-web-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
        - api/mcp
        - api/gateway
      CallbackURLs: !Ref CallbackURLs
      LogoutURLs: !Ref LogoutURLs
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days

  GatewayM2MClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: agentcore-gateway-m2m-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - api/gateway
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days

  McpM2MClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: agentcore-mcp-m2m-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - api/mcp
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool ID
    Value: !Ref UserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId'

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Cognito User Pool ARN
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  DiscoveryUrl:
    Description: OIDC discovery URL for JWT authorizer configuration
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration'

  IssuerUrl:
    Description: JWT issuer URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}'

  HostedUIDomain:
    Description: Cognito hosted UI base URL
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'

  HostedUISignupUrl:
    Description: Hosted UI signup page for the web client
    Value: !Sub
      - 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/signup?client_id=${WebClient}&response_type=code&scope=openid+email+profile&redirect_uri=${FirstCallback}'
      - FirstCallback: !Select [0, !Ref CallbackURLs]

  HostedUILoginUrl:
    Description: Hosted UI login page for the web client
    Value: !Sub
      - 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/login?client_id=${WebClient}&response_type=code&scope=openid+email+profile&redirect_uri=${FirstCallback}'
      - FirstCallback: !Select [0, !Ref CallbackURLs]

  TokenEndpoint:
    Description: OAuth2 token endpoint
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'

  WebClientId:
    Description: Public web client ID (authorization code + PKCE, USER_PASSWORD_AUTH, USER_SRP_AUTH)
    Value: !Ref WebClient

  GatewayM2MClientId:
    Description: Gateway machine-to-machine client ID (scope api/gateway). Retrieve the secret with aws cognito-idp describe-user-pool-client.
    Value: !Ref GatewayM2MClient

  McpM2MClientId:
    Description: MCP server machine-to-machine client ID (scope api/mcp). Retrieve the secret with aws cognito-idp describe-user-pool-client.
    Value: !Ref McpM2MClient

  GatewayScope:
    Description: Custom scope for gateway access
    Value: api/gateway

  McpScope:
    Description: Custom scope for MCP server access
    Value: api/mcp

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Cognito User Pool with resource server and machine-to-machine app client, a customer-managed
  KMS key for EventBridge, and an API Gateway REST API secured by a Cognito User Pool authorizer.

Parameters:
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyServerlessLandUserPool
    Description: Name of the Cognito User Pool
  AppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyWebClient
    Description: Name of the Cognito User Pool app client
  CallbackURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: https://localhost:3000/callback
    Description: Comma-delimited list of allowed callback URLs for the app client
  LogoutURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: https://localhost:3000/logout
    Description: Comma-delimited list of allowed logout URLs for the app client

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Join
        - '-'
        - - serverlessland
          - !Select [0, !Split ['-', !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]]]

  UserPoolResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: petstore-api.example.com
      Name: petstore-api
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: domestic.read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to domestic pet data

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref AppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - petstore-api.example.com/domestic.read
      CallbackURLs: !Ref CallbackURLs
      LogoutURLs: !Ref LogoutURLs
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EventBridgeKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed KMS key usable by Amazon EventBridge
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: eventbridge-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowEventBridgeUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'

  EventBridgeKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${AWS::StackName}-eventbridge-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref EventBridgeKmsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # API Gateway account-level CloudWatch logging role (required for INFO logging)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonAPIGatewayPushToCloudWatchLogs

  ApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # API Gateway REST API
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-petstore-api
      Description: REST API secured by a Cognito User Pool authorizer
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  CognitoAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: CognitoUserPoolAuthorizer
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  PostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref CognitoAuthorizer
      AuthorizationScopes:
        - petstore-api.example.com/domestic.read
      Integration:
        Type: HTTP_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: http://petstore-demo-endpoint.execute-api.com/petstore/pets

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: PostMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Description: Initial deployment

  ProdStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    DependsOn: ApiGatewayAccount
    Properties:
      StageName: prod
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      MethodSettings:
        - ResourcePath: '/*'
          HttpMethod: '*'
          LoggingLevel: INFO
          DataTraceEnabled: true

Outputs:
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cognito User Pool
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: Invoke URL of the API Gateway prod stage
    Value: !Sub https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${ProdStage}
  AppClientId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito User Pool app client
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key
    Value: !GetAtt EventBridgeKmsKey.Arn
  TokenEndpoint:
    Description: OAuth 2.0 token endpoint of the Cognito User Pool domain
    Value: !Sub https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AWS Backup infrastructure with daily, weekly, and monthly backup plans driven
  by the "backup" resource tag. Includes encrypted backup vaults, a KMS key with
  rotation enabled, an IAM service role for AWS Backup, and Service Catalog
  TagOptions for the backup tag values.

Parameters:
  BackupTagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: backup
    Description: Tag key used to select resources for backup.

  DailyTagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: daily
    Description: Tag value that selects resources for daily backups.

  WeeklyTagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: weekly
    Description: Tag value that selects resources for weekly backups.

  MonthlyTagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: monthly
    Description: Tag value that selects resources for monthly backups.

  DailyRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 14
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Number of days to retain daily backups.

  WeeklyRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 56
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Number of days to retain weekly backups.

  MonthlyRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 365
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Number of days to retain monthly backups.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS key for backup vault encryption
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BackupKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key used to encrypt AWS Backup vaults.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: backup-kms-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowAWSBackupServiceUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AllowBackupRoleUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt BackupServiceRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowAttachmentOfPersistentResources
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt BackupServiceRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:RevokeGrant
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                kms:GrantIsForAWSResource: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-backup-key

  BackupKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${AWS::StackName}-backup-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref BackupKmsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM service role for AWS Backup
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BackupServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Service role assumed by AWS Backup to perform backups and restores.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSBackupServiceRolePolicyForBackup
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSBackupServiceRolePolicyForRestores
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-backup-role

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Encrypted backup vaults
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DailyBackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-daily-vault
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt BackupKmsKey.Arn
      BackupVaultTags:
        Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-daily-vault
        Schedule: daily

  WeeklyBackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-weekly-vault
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt BackupKmsKey.Arn
      BackupVaultTags:
        Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-weekly-vault
        Schedule: weekly

  MonthlyBackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-monthly-vault
      EncryptionKeyArn: !GetAtt BackupKmsKey.Arn
      BackupVaultTags:
        Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-monthly-vault
        Schedule: monthly

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Backup plans
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DailyBackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-daily-plan
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: DailyBackupRule
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref DailyBackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: cron(0 5 * * ? *)
            ScheduleExpressionTimezone: Etc/UTC
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            CompletionWindowMinutes: 720
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: !Ref DailyRetentionDays
            RecoveryPointTags:
              Schedule: daily
      BackupPlanTags:
        Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-daily-plan

  WeeklyBackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-weekly-plan
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: WeeklyBackupRule
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref WeeklyBackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: cron(0 5 ? * SUN *)
            ScheduleExpressionTimezone: Etc/UTC
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            CompletionWindowMinutes: 720
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: !Ref WeeklyRetentionDays
            RecoveryPointTags:
              Schedule: weekly
      BackupPlanTags:
        Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-weekly-plan

  MonthlyBackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-monthly-plan
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: MonthlyBackupRule
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref MonthlyBackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: cron(0 5 1 * ? *)
            ScheduleExpressionTimezone: Etc/UTC
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            CompletionWindowMinutes: 720
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: !Ref MonthlyRetentionDays
            RecoveryPointTags:
              Schedule: monthly
      BackupPlanTags:
        Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-monthly-plan

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Tag-based backup selections
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DailyBackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref DailyBackupPlan
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-daily-selection
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupServiceRole.Arn
        ListOfTags:
          - ConditionType: STRINGEQUALS
            ConditionKey: !Ref BackupTagKey
            ConditionValue: !Ref DailyTagValue

  WeeklyBackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref WeeklyBackupPlan
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-weekly-selection
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupServiceRole.Arn
        ListOfTags:
          - ConditionType: STRINGEQUALS
            ConditionKey: !Ref BackupTagKey
            ConditionValue: !Ref WeeklyTagValue

  MonthlyBackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref MonthlyBackupPlan
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-monthly-selection
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupServiceRole.Arn
        ListOfTags:
          - ConditionType: STRINGEQUALS
            ConditionKey: !Ref BackupTagKey
            ConditionValue: !Ref MonthlyTagValue

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Service Catalog TagOptions
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DailyBackupTagOption:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption
    Properties:
      Key: !Ref BackupTagKey
      Value: !Ref DailyTagValue
      Active: true

  WeeklyBackupTagOption:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption
    Properties:
      Key: !Ref BackupTagKey
      Value: !Ref WeeklyTagValue
      Active: true

  MonthlyBackupTagOption:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::TagOption
    Properties:
      Key: !Ref BackupTagKey
      Value: !Ref MonthlyTagValue
      Active: true

Outputs:
  BackupKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key used to encrypt backup vaults.
    Value: !GetAtt BackupKmsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-BackupKmsKeyArn

  BackupServiceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM service role used by AWS Backup.
    Value: !GetAtt BackupServiceRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-BackupServiceRoleArn

  DailyBackupVaultArn:
    Description: ARN of the daily backup vault.
    Value: !GetAtt DailyBackupVault.BackupVaultArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DailyBackupVaultArn

  WeeklyBackupVaultArn:
    Description: ARN of the weekly backup vault.
    Value: !GetAtt WeeklyBackupVault.BackupVaultArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-WeeklyBackupVaultArn

  MonthlyBackupVaultArn:
    Description: ARN of the monthly backup vault.
    Value: !GetAtt MonthlyBackupVault.BackupVaultArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-MonthlyBackupVaultArn

  DailyBackupPlanId:
    Description: ID of the daily backup plan.
    Value: !GetAtt DailyBackupPlan.BackupPlanId

  WeeklyBackupPlanId:
    Description: ID of the weekly backup plan.
    Value: !GetAtt WeeklyBackupPlan.BackupPlanId

  MonthlyBackupPlanId:
    Description: ID of the monthly backup plan.
    Value: !GetAtt MonthlyBackupPlan.BackupPlanId

  DailyBackupTagOptionId:
    Description: ID of the Service Catalog TagOption for daily backups.
    Value: !Ref DailyBackupTagOption
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DailyBackupTagOptionId

  WeeklyBackupTagOptionId:
    Description: ID of the Service Catalog TagOption for weekly backups.
    Value: !Ref WeeklyBackupTagOption
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-WeeklyBackupTagOptionId

  MonthlyBackupTagOptionId:
    Description: ID of the Service Catalog TagOption for monthly backups.
    Value: !Ref MonthlyBackupTagOption
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-MonthlyBackupTagOptionId

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Route 53 public hosted zone and DNS record sets for external services
  (Squarespace website, Google Workspace mail, ZenDesk helpdesk, Campaign Monitor
  email marketing, and an internal office printer).

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Domain
        Parameters:
          - DomainName
      - Label:
          default: Google Workspace
        Parameters:
          - GoogleSiteVerificationToken
          - GoogleDkimSelector
          - GoogleDkimKeyPart1
          - GoogleDkimKeyPart2
          - DmarcReportEmail
      - Label:
          default: Squarespace
        Parameters:
          - SquarespaceCnameTarget
      - Label:
          default: Office Network
        Parameters:
          - PrinterHostname
          - PrinterIpAddress
      - Label:
          default: ZenDesk
        Parameters:
          - ZendeskVerificationToken
          - ZendeskSubdomain
      - Label:
          default: Campaign Monitor
        Parameters:
          - CampaignMonitorDkimSelector
          - CampaignMonitorDkimKey
          - CampaignMonitorSubdomain

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: podcastgarage.org
    Description: Apex domain name for the public hosted zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^(?!-)[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,63}(?<!-)(\.[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,63})*\.[A-Za-z]{2,63}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid domain name (e.g. example.org).

  GoogleSiteVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACE_WITH_GOOGLE_SITE_VERIFICATION_TOKEN
    Description: Google site verification token (the value after "google-site-verification=").

  GoogleDkimSelector:
    Type: String
    Default: google
    Description: DKIM selector configured in the Google Workspace admin console.

  GoogleDkimKeyPart1:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACE_WITH_FIRST_PART_OF_GOOGLE_DKIM_PUBLIC_KEY
    MaxLength: 200
    Description: >-
      First part of the Google Workspace DKIM public key (the "p=" value).
      Split long 2048-bit keys across Part1 and Part2 to respect the 255-character TXT string limit.

  GoogleDkimKeyPart2:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    MaxLength: 255
    Description: Remaining part of the Google Workspace DKIM public key (leave empty if not needed).

  DmarcReportEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: dmarc-reports@podcastgarage.org
    Description: Mailbox that receives aggregate DMARC reports.

  SquarespaceCnameTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: ext-cust.squarespace.com
    Description: Squarespace CNAME target for the www subdomain.

  PrinterHostname:
    Type: String
    Default: printer
    Description: Hostname label for the office printer record.

  PrinterIpAddress:
    Type: String
    Default: 192.168.1.50
    Description: Private LAN IPv4 address of the office printer.
    AllowedPattern: '^((25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])\.){3}(25[0-5]|2[0-4][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|[1-9]?[0-9])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address.

  ZendeskVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACE_WITH_ZENDESK_VERIFICATION_TOKEN
    Description: ZenDesk domain verification token.

  ZendeskSubdomain:
    Type: String
    Default: podcastgarage
    Description: Your ZenDesk account subdomain (the part before .zendesk.com).

  CampaignMonitorDkimSelector:
    Type: String
    Default: cm
    Description: DKIM selector provided by Campaign Monitor.

  CampaignMonitorDkimKey:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACE_WITH_CAMPAIGN_MONITOR_DKIM_PUBLIC_KEY
    MaxLength: 240
    Description: Campaign Monitor DKIM public key (the "p=" value).

  CampaignMonitorSubdomain:
    Type: String
    Default: cmail20
    Description: SPF-aligned (return-path) subdomain label provided by Campaign Monitor.

Conditions:
  HasGoogleDkimKeyPart2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GoogleDkimKeyPart2, '']]

Resources:
  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: !Sub 'Public hosted zone for ${DomainName}'
      HostedZoneTags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref DomainName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Apex TXT: SPF policy + Google site verification
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RootTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '"v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com include:mail.zendesk.com ~all"'
        - !Sub '"google-site-verification=${GoogleSiteVerificationToken}"'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Squarespace website hosting
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RootARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: A
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - 198.185.159.144
        - 198.185.159.145
        - 198.49.23.144
        - 198.49.23.145

  WwwCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'www.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref SquarespaceCnameTarget

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Google Workspace (G Suite) mail delivery, DMARC, and DKIM
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RootMxRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: MX
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - 1 aspmx.l.google.com.
        - 5 alt1.aspmx.l.google.com.
        - 5 alt2.aspmx.l.google.com.
        - 10 alt3.aspmx.l.google.com.
        - 10 alt4.aspmx.l.google.com.

  DmarcTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '_dmarc.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; rua=mailto:${DmarcReportEmail}; fo=1"'

  GoogleDkimTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${GoogleDkimSelector}._domainkey.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !If
          - HasGoogleDkimKeyPart2
          - !Sub '"v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=${GoogleDkimKeyPart1}" "${GoogleDkimKeyPart2}"'
          - !Sub '"v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=${GoogleDkimKeyPart1}"'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Internal office printer (private LAN address)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrinterARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${PrinterHostname}.${DomainName}'
      Type: A
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref PrinterIpAddress

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ZenDesk helpdesk integration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ZendeskVerificationTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'zendeskverification.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${ZendeskVerificationToken}"'

  ZendeskDomainValidation1:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'zendesk1.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - mail1.zendesk.com

  ZendeskDomainValidation2:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'zendesk2.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - mail2.zendesk.com

  ZendeskDomainValidation3:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'zendesk3.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - mail3.zendesk.com

  ZendeskDomainValidation4:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'zendesk4.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - mail4.zendesk.com

  ZendeskDkim1CnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'zendesk1._domainkey.${DomainName}'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub 'zendesk1._domainkey.${ZendeskSubdomain}.zendesk.com'

  ZendeskDkim2CnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone

      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub 'zendesk2._domainkey.${ZendeskSubdomain}.zendesk.com'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Campaign Monitor email marketing integration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CampaignMonitorDkimTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${CampaignMonitorDkimSelector}._domainkey.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"k=rsa; p=${CampaignMonitorDkimKey}"'

  CampaignMonitorSpfTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${CampaignMonitorSubdomain}.${DomainName}'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '"v=spf1 include:cmail1.com ~all"'

  CampaignMonitorMxRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${CampaignMonitorSubdomain}.${DomainName}'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: IAM roles and managed policies for an e-commerce serverless architecture (SQS -> Lambda -> DynamoDB -> Streams -> Lambda -> SNS, and API Gateway -> SQS).

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment name.

Resources:
  LambdaBasicExecutionPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub 'ecommerce-lambda-basic-execution-${Environment}'
      Description: Allows Lambda functions to write logs to CloudWatch Logs.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: CreateLogGroup
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
          - Sid: WriteLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*:*'

  SQSReadPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub 'ecommerce-sqs-read-${Environment}'
      Description: Allows reading and deleting messages from the POC queue.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ReadFromQueue
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sqs:ReceiveMessage
              - sqs:DeleteMessage
              - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
              - sqs:GetQueueUrl
              - sqs:ChangeMessageVisibility
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:POC-Queue-${Environment}'

  DynamoDBWritePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub 'ecommerce-dynamodb-write-${Environment}'
      Description: Allows writing items to the orders DynamoDB table.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: WriteToOrdersTable
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:UpdateItem
              - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
              - dynamodb:DescribeTable
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/ecommerce-orders-${Environment}'

  DynamoDBStreamReadPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub 'ecommerce-dynamodb-stream-read-${Environment}'
      Description: Allows reading from the orders table DynamoDB Stream.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ReadOrdersStream
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:DescribeStream
              - dynamodb:GetRecords
              - dynamodb:GetShardIterator
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/ecommerce-orders-${Environment}/stream/*'
          - Sid: ListStreams
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:ListStreams
            Resource: '*'

  SNSPublishPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub 'ecommerce-sns-publish-${Environment}'
      Description: Allows publishing messages to the POC topic.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: PublishToTopic
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sns:Publish
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sns:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:POC-Topic-${Environment}'

  SQSSendPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub 'ecommerce-sqs-send-${Environment}'
      Description: Allows sending messages to the POC queue.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: SendToQueue
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sqs:SendMessage
              - sqs:GetQueueUrl
              - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:POC-Queue-${Environment}'

  SQSToDynamoDBLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'ecommerce-sqs-to-dynamodb-lambda-role-${Environment}'
      Description: Role for Lambda that consumes SQS messages and writes orders to DynamoDB.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref LambdaBasicExecutionPolicy
        - !Ref SQSReadPolicy
        - !Ref DynamoDBWritePolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  DynamoDBStreamToSNSLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'ecommerce-stream-to-sns-lambda-role-${Environment}'
      Description: Role for Lambda that processes DynamoDB Stream records and publishes to SNS.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref LambdaBasicExecutionPolicy
        - !Ref DynamoDBStreamReadPolicy
        - !Ref SNSPublishPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  APIGatewayToSQSRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'ecommerce-apigw-to-sqs-role-${Environment}'
      Description: Role for API Gateway to send messages to the SQS queue.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref SQSSendPolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

Outputs:
  SQSToDynamoDBLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda role that reads from SQS and writes to DynamoDB.
    Value: !GetAtt SQSToDynamoDBLambdaRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SQSToDynamoDBLambdaRoleArn'

  DynamoDBStreamToSNSLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda role that reads DynamoDB Streams and publishes to SNS.
    Value: !GetAtt DynamoDBStreamToSNSLambdaRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DynamoDBStreamToSNSLambdaRoleArn'

  APIGatewayToSQSRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the API Gateway role that sends messages to SQS.
    Value: !GetAtt APIGatewayToSQSRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-APIGatewayToSQSRoleArn'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: VPC with a public subnet and a private subnet, with outbound internet access for the private subnet through a NAT gateway in the public subnet.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 172.18.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
  PublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 172.18.0.0/22
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
  PrivateSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 172.18.32.0/21
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet'

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip'

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat'

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Amazon Athena named queries for analyzing Amazon AppStream 2.0 usage report data.
  Queries run against the "appstream-usage" database (sessions and applications tables
  created by the AppStream 2.0 usage reports Glue crawler) and support current and
  previous month reporting of session metrics.

Parameters:
  DatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: appstream-usage
    Description: Name of the Glue/Athena database containing the AppStream 2.0 usage report tables.

Resources:
  CurrentMonthAvgSessionLengthPerStackQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AppStream - Current Month - Average Session Length Per Stack
      Description: Average session length in minutes per stack for the current month.
      Database: !Ref DatabaseName
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT stack_name,
               COUNT(DISTINCT user_session_id) AS session_count,
               ROUND(AVG(CAST(session_duration_in_seconds AS DOUBLE)) / 60, 2) AS avg_session_length_minutes
        FROM "${DatabaseName}"."sessions"
        WHERE year = date_format(current_date, '%Y')
          AND month = date_format(current_date, '%m')
        GROUP BY stack_name
        ORDER BY avg_session_length_minutes DESC;

  PreviousMonthAvgSessionLengthPerStackQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AppStream - Previous Month - Average Session Length Per Stack
      Description: Average session length in minutes per stack for the previous month.
      Database: !Ref DatabaseName
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT stack_name,
               COUNT(DISTINCT user_session_id) AS session_count,
               ROUND(AVG(CAST(session_duration_in_seconds AS DOUBLE)) / 60, 2) AS avg_session_length_minutes
        FROM "${DatabaseName}"."sessions"
        WHERE year = date_format(date_add('month', -1, current_date), '%Y')
          AND month = date_format(date_add('month', -1, current_date), '%m')
        GROUP BY stack_name
        ORDER BY avg_session_length_minutes DESC;

  CurrentMonthDailySessionsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AppStream - Current Month - Daily Session Count
      Description: Number of sessions per day for the current month.
      Database: !Ref DatabaseName
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT year, month, day,
               COUNT(DISTINCT user_session_id) AS session_count
        FROM "${DatabaseName}"."sessions"
        WHERE year = date_format(current_date, '%Y')
          AND month = date_format(current_date, '%m')
        GROUP BY year, month, day
        ORDER BY year, month, day;

  PreviousMonthDailySessionsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AppStream - Previous Month - Daily Session Count
      Description: Number of sessions per day for the previous month.
      Database: !Ref DatabaseName
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT year, month, day,
               COUNT(DISTINCT user_session_id) AS session_count
        FROM "${DatabaseName}"."sessions"
        WHERE year = date_format(date_add('month', -1, current_date), '%Y')
          AND month = date_format(date_add('month', -1, current_date), '%m')
        GROUP BY year, month, day
        ORDER BY year, month, day;

  CurrentMonthSessionDetailsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AppStream - Current Month - All Session Details
      Description: All session details for the current month.
      Database: !Ref DatabaseName
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT *
        FROM "${DatabaseName}"."sessions"
        WHERE year = date_format(current_date, '%Y')
          AND month = date_format(current_date, '%m')
        ORDER BY session_start_time;

  PreviousMonthSessionDetailsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AppStream - Previous Month - All Session Details
      Description: All session details for the previous month.
      Database: !Ref DatabaseName
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT *
        FROM "${DatabaseName}"."sessions"
        WHERE year = date_format(date_add('month', -1, current_date), '%Y')
          AND month = date_format(date_add('month', -1, current_date), '%m')
        ORDER BY session_start_time;

  CurrentMonthStreamingHoursPerUserQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AppStream - Current Month - Streaming Hours Per User
      Description: Total streaming hours and session count per user for the current month.
      Database: !Ref DatabaseName
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT user_id,
               authentication_type,
               COUNT(DISTINCT user_session_id) AS session_count,
               ROUND(SUM(CAST(session_duration_in_seconds AS DOUBLE)) / 3600, 2) AS streaming_hours
        FROM "${DatabaseName}"."sessions"
        WHERE year = date_format(current_date, '%Y')
          AND month = date_format(current_date, '%m')
        GROUP BY user_id, authentication_type
        ORDER BY streaming_hours DESC;

  PreviousMonthStreamingHoursPerUserQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AppStream - Previous Month - Streaming Hours Per User
      Description: Total streaming hours and session count per user for the previous month.
      Database: !Ref DatabaseName
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT user_id,
               authentication_type,
               COUNT(DISTINCT user_session_id) AS session_count,
               ROUND(SUM(CAST(session_duration_in_seconds AS DOUBLE)) / 3600, 2) AS streaming_hours
        FROM "${DatabaseName}"."sessions"
        WHERE year = date_format(date_add('month', -1, current_date), '%Y')
          AND month = date_format(date_add('month', -1, current_date), '%m')
        GROUP BY user_id, authentication_type
        ORDER BY streaming_hours DESC;

  CurrentMonthUniqueUsersPerAppQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AppStream - Current Month - Unique Users Per Application
      Description: Number of unique users who launched each application in the current month.
      Database: !Ref DatabaseName
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT a.application_name,
               COUNT(DISTINCT s.user_id) AS unique_users,
               COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_session_id) AS session_count
        FROM "${DatabaseName}"."applications" a
        JOIN "${DatabaseName}"."sessions" s
          ON a.user_session_id = s.user_session_id
        WHERE s.year = date_format(current_date, '%Y')
          AND s.month = date_format(current_date, '%m')
        GROUP BY a.application_name
        ORDER BY unique_users DESC;

  PreviousMonthUniqueUsersPerAppQuery:
    Type: AWS::Athena::NamedQuery
    Properties:
      Name: AppStream - Previous Month - Unique Users Per Application
      Description: Number of unique users who launched each application in the previous month.
      Database: !Ref DatabaseName
      QueryString: !Sub |
        SELECT a.application_name,
               COUNT(DISTINCT s.user_id) AS unique_users,
               COUNT(DISTINCT a.user_session_id) AS session_count
        FROM "${DatabaseName}"."applications" a
        JOIN "${DatabaseName}"."sessions" s
          ON a.user_session_id = s.user_session_id
        WHERE s.year = date_format(date_add('month', -1, current_date), '%Y')
          AND s.month = date_format(date_add('month', -1, current_date), '%m')
        GROUP BY a.application_name
        ORDER BY unique_users DESC;

Outputs:
  CurrentMonthAvgSessionLengthPerStackQueryId:
    Value: !Ref CurrentMonthAvgSessionLengthPerStackQuery
  PreviousMonthAvgSessionLengthPerStackQueryId:
    Value: !Ref PreviousMonthAvgSessionLengthPerStackQuery
  CurrentMonthDailySessionsQueryId:
    Value: !Ref CurrentMonthDailySessionsQuery
  PreviousMonthDailySessionsQueryId:
    Value: !Ref PreviousMonthDailySessionsQuery
  CurrentMonthSessionDetailsQueryId:
    Value: !Ref CurrentMonthSessionDetailsQuery
  PreviousMonthSessionDetailsQueryId:
    Value: !Ref PreviousMonthSessionDetailsQuery
  CurrentMonthStreamingHoursPerUserQueryId:
    Value: !Ref CurrentMonthStreamingHoursPerUserQuery
  PreviousMonthStreamingHoursPerUserQueryId:
    Value: !Ref PreviousMonthStreamingHoursPerUserQuery
  CurrentMonthUniqueUsersPerAppQueryId:
    Value: !Ref CurrentMonthUniqueUsersPerAppQuery
  PreviousMonthUniqueUsersPerAppQueryId:
    Value: !Ref PreviousMonthUniqueUsersPerAppQuery

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Three-tier VPC network foundation with public, private application, and private database subnets across three availability zones, an internet gateway, and a single NAT gateway.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: three-tier
    Description: Name prefix applied to resource tags.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-vpc

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-igw

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Public subnets
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 9, 8]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 9, 8]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 9, 8]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-3

  # Private application subnets
  PrivateAppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 9, 8]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-app-subnet-1

  PrivateAppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [4, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 9, 8]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-app-subnet-2

  PrivateAppSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [5, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 9, 8]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-app-subnet-3

  # Private database subnets
  PrivateDBSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [6, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 9, 8]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-db-subnet-1

  PrivateDBSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [7, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 9, 8]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-db-subnet-2

  PrivateDBSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [8, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 9, 8]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-db-subnet-3

  # NAT gateway
  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-nat-gateway

  # Public routing
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-public-rt

  DefaultPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3

  # Private application routing
  PrivateAppRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-app-rt

  DefaultPrivateAppRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateAppRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateAppSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateAppRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateAppSubnet1

  PrivateAppSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateAppRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateAppSubnet2

  PrivateAppSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateAppRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateAppSubnet3

  # Private database routing
  PrivateDBRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${EnvironmentName}-private-db-rt

  DefaultPrivateDBRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateDBRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateDBSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateDBRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateDBSubnet1

  PrivateDBSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateDBRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateDBSubnet2

  PrivateDBSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateDBRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateDBSubnet3

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-VpcId

  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: Public subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2, !Ref PublicSubnet3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnetIds

  PrivateAppSubnetIds:
    Description: Private application subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateAppSubnet1, !Ref PrivateAppSubnet2, !Ref PrivateAppSubnet3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-PrivateAppSubnetIds

  PrivateDBSubnetIds:
    Description: Private database subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateDBSubnet1, !Ref PrivateDBSubnet2, !Ref PrivateDBSubnet3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-PrivateDBSubnetIds

  NatGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the NAT gateway
    Value: !Ref NatGateway

  InternetGatewayId:
