AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  QuickSight administrative monitoring and data pipeline environment. Extracts QuickSight
  usage metadata, dataset properties, Q topic metadata, folder asset relationships, datasource
  properties and user access information via scheduled Glue jobs, and streams QuickSight
  CloudWatch metrics through Kinesis Firehose into an S3 data lake for Athena analytics.

Parameters:
  ScriptBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: admin-console-cfn-dataprepare-code
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket that will be created to hold the Glue ETL scripts.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$'
  QuickSightIdentityRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    Description: Region where the QuickSight identity (users/groups) is hosted.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 Buckets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminSuiteBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}'
      AccessControl: Private
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  ScriptBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Ref ScriptBucketName
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Consolidated IAM Role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminSuiteRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'QuickSightAdminSuiteRole-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
                - lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: QuickSightAdminSuitePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3Access
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:*
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${AdminSuiteBucket.Arn}/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}/*'
              - Sid: GlueAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: QuickSightAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:Describe*
                  - quicksight:List*
                  - quicksight:Search*
                  - quicksight:Get*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: IAMAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:GetUser
                  - iam:ListRoles
                  - iam:ListUsers
                  - iam:ListGroups
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:*MetricStream*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: LogsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: FirehoseAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                  - firehose:DescribeDeliveryStream
                  - firehose:ListDeliveryStreams
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:firehose:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deliverystream/*'
              - Sid: StsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Script deployment (custom resource writes Glue scripts into ScriptBucket)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ScriptDeployerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'qs-admin-suite-script-deployer-${AWS::Region}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 300
      MemorySize: 256
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          COMMON = r'''
          import sys, json, datetime, boto3
          from awsglue.utils import getResolvedOptions

          args = getResolvedOptions(sys.argv, ['REGION', 'IDENTITY_REGION', 'DEST_BUCKET'])
          REGION = args['REGION']
          IDENTITY_REGION = args['IDENTITY_REGION']
          BUCKET = args['DEST_BUCKET']
          ACCOUNT = boto3.client('sts').get_caller_identity()['Account']
          qs = boto3.client('quicksight', region_name=REGION)
          qs_id = boto3.client('quicksight', region_name=IDENTITY_REGION)
          s3 = boto3.client('s3')
          RUN_DATE = datetime.datetime.utcnow().strftime('%Y-%m-%d')

          def paginate(client, op, key, **kw):
              out, token = [], None
              while True:
                  if token:
                      kw['NextToken'] = token
                  try:
                      resp = getattr(client, op)(**kw)
                  except Exception as e:
                      print(f'{op} failed: {e}')
                      break
                  out.extend(resp.get(key, []))
                  token = resp.get('NextToken')
                  if not token:
                      break
              return out

          def write(prefix, name, rows):
              body = '\n'.join(json.dumps(r, default=str) for r in rows)
              key = f'monitoring/quicksight/{prefix}/{name}.json'
              s3.put_object(Bucket=BUCKET, Key=key, Body=body.encode('utf-8'))
              print(f'Wrote {len(rows)} rows to s3://{BUCKET}/{key}')

          def safe(fn, **kw):
              try:
                  return fn(**kw)
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f'{fn.__name__} failed: {e}')
                  return {}
          '''

          ACCESS = COMMON + r'''
          namespaces = [n['Name'] for n in paginate(qs_id, 'list_namespaces', 'Namespaces', AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT)] or ['default']
          users, memberships = [], []
          for ns in namespaces:
              for u in paginate(qs_id, 'list_users', 'UserList', AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT, Namespace=ns):
                  users.append({'namespace': ns, 'user_name': u.get('UserName'), 'email': u.get('Email'),
                                'role': u.get('Role'), 'identity_type': u.get('IdentityType'),
                                'active': u.get('Active'), 'arn': u.get('Arn')})
              for g in paginate(qs_id, 'list_groups', 'GroupList', AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT, Namespace=ns):
                  for m in paginate(qs_id, 'list_group_memberships', 'GroupMemberList', AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT,
                                    Namespace=ns, GroupName=g['GroupName']):
                      memberships.append({'namespace': ns, 'group_name': g['GroupName'],
                                          'member_name': m.get('MemberName'), 'member_arn': m.get('Arn')})
          write('user_info', 'users', users)
          write('group_membership', 'group_membership', memberships)

          assets = [
              ('dashboard', 'list_dashboards', 'DashboardSummaryList', 'DashboardId', 'describe_dashboard_permissions', 'DashboardId'),
              ('analysis', 'list_analyses', 'AnalysisSummaryList', 'AnalysisId', 'describe_analysis_permissions', 'AnalysisId'),
              ('dataset', 'list_data_sets', 'DataSetSummaries', 'DataSetId', 'describe_data_set_permissions', 'DataSetId'),
              ('datasource', 'list_data_sources', 'DataSources', 'DataSourceId', 'describe_data_source_permissions', 'DataSourceId'),
              ('theme', 'list_themes', 'ThemeSummaryList', 'ThemeId', 'describe_theme_permissions', 'ThemeId'),
              ('topic', 'list_topics', 'TopicsSummaries', 'TopicId', 'describe_topic_permissions', 'TopicId'),
          ]
          rows = []
          for atype, list_op, key, id_field, perm_op, perm_arg in assets:
              for a in paginate(qs, list_op, key, AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT):
                  aid = a.get(id_field)
                  if atype == 'theme' and a.get('ThemeId', '').startswith(('CLASSIC', 'MIDNIGHT', 'SEASIDE', 'RAINIER')):
                      continue
                  resp = safe(getattr(qs, perm_op), AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT, **{perm_arg: aid})
                  for p in resp.get('Permissions', []):
                      rows.append({'asset_type': atype, 'asset_id': aid, 'asset_name': a.get('Name'),
                                   'principal': p.get('Principal'), 'actions': p.get('Actions'),
                                   'principal_name': p.get('Principal', '').split('/')[-1]})
          write('assets_access', 'assets_access', rows)
          '''

          DATASET = COMMON + r'''
          rows, schedules, ingestions = [], [], []
          for ds in paginate(qs, 'list_data_sets', 'DataSetSummaries', AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT):
              dsid = ds['DataSetId']
              d = safe(qs.describe_data_set, AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT, DataSetId=dsid).get('DataSet', {})
              rows.append({'dataset_id': dsid, 'dataset_name': ds.get('Name'), 'arn': ds.get('Arn'),
                           'import_mode': ds.get('ImportMode'), 'created_time': ds.get('CreatedTime'),
                           'last_updated_time': ds.get('LastUpdatedTime'),
                           'row_level_permission': ds.get('RowLevelPermissionDataSetSummary') is not None,
                           'column_level_permission': ds.get('ColumnLevelPermissionRulesApplied'),
                           'consumed_spice_bytes': d.get('ConsumedSpiceCapacityInBytes'),
                           'physical_table_count': len(d.get('PhysicalTableMap', {})),
                           'logical_table_count': len(d.get('LogicalTableMap', {})),
                           'output_column_count': len(d.get('OutputColumns', [])),
                           'datasource_arns': [t.get(k, {}).get('DataSourceArn') for t in d.get('PhysicalTableMap', {}).values() for k in t]})
              if ds.get('ImportMode') == 'SPICE':
                  for s in safe(qs.list_refresh_schedules, AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT, DataSetId=dsid).get('RefreshSchedules', []):
                      schedules.append({'dataset_id': dsid, 'schedule_id': s.get('ScheduleId'),
                                        'refresh_type': s.get('RefreshType'), 'schedule_frequency': s.get('ScheduleFrequency'),
                                        'start_after': s.get('StartAfterDateTime')})
                  for i in safe(qs.list_ingestions, AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT, DataSetId=dsid, MaxResults=20).get('Ingestions', []):
                      ingestions.append({'dataset_id': dsid, 'ingestion_id': i.get('IngestionId'),
                                         'status': i.get('IngestionStatus'), 'error': i.get('ErrorInfo'),
                                         'rows_ingested': i.get('RowInfo', {}).get('RowsIngested'),
                                         'rows_dropped': i.get('RowInfo', {}).get('RowsDropped'),
                                         'created_time': i.get('CreatedTime'),
                                         'time_seconds': i.get('IngestionTimeInSeconds'),
                                         'size_bytes': i.get('IngestionSizeInBytes'),
                                         'request_source': i.get('RequestSource'), 'request_type': i.get('RequestType')})
          write('dataset_info', 'dataset_info', rows)
          write('dataset_refresh_schedule', 'dataset_refresh_schedule', schedules)
          write('dataset_ingestion', 'dataset_ingestion', ingestions)
          '''

          FOLDER = COMMON + r'''
          folders, members = [], []
          for f in paginate(qs, 'list_folders', 'FolderSummaryList', AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT):
              fid = f['FolderId']
              d = safe(qs.describe_folder, AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT, FolderId=fid).get('Folder', {})
              folders.append({'folder_id': fid, 'folder_name': f.get('Name'), 'folder_type': f.get('FolderType'),
                              'arn': f.get('Arn'), 'folder_path': d.get('FolderPath'),
                              'sharing_model': f.get('SharingModel'),
                              'created_time': f.get('CreatedTime'), 'last_updated_time': f.get('LastUpdatedTime')})
              for m in paginate(qs, 'list_folder_members', 'FolderMemberList', AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT, FolderId=fid):
                  arn = m.get('MemberArn', '')
                  members.append({'folder_id': fid, 'folder_name': f.get('Name'), 'member_id': m.get('MemberId'),
                                  'member_arn': arn, 'member_type': arn.split(':')[-1].split('/')[0] if arn else None})
          write('folder_info', 'folder_info', folders)
          write('folder_assets', 'folder_assets', members)
          '''

          QMETA = COMMON + r'''
          topics, topic_datasets, refreshes = [], [], []
          for t in paginate(qs, 'list_topics', 'TopicsSummaries', AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT):
              tid = t['TopicId']
              d = safe(qs.describe_topic, AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT, TopicId=tid).get('Topic', {})
              topics.append({'topic_id': tid, 'topic_name': t.get('Name'), 'arn': t.get('Arn'),
                             'user_experience_version': t.get('UserExperienceVersion'),
                             'description': d.get('Description'), 'dataset_count': len(d.get('DataSets', []))})
              for ds in d.get('DataSets', []):
                  topic_datasets.append({'topic_id': tid, 'dataset_arn': ds.get('DatasetArn'),
                                         'dataset_name': ds.get('DatasetName'),
                                         'column_count': len(ds.get('Columns', []) or []),
                                         'calculated_field_count': len(ds.get('CalculatedFields', []) or []),
                                         'filter_count': len(ds.get('Filters', []) or [])})
              for s in safe(qs.list_topic_refresh_schedules, AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT, TopicId=tid).get('RefreshSchedules', []):
                  refreshes.append({'topic_id': tid, 'dataset_id': s.get('DatasetId'), 'dataset_arn': s.get('DatasetArn'),
                                    'refresh_schedule': s.get('RefreshSchedule')})
          write('q_topic_info', 'q_topic_info', topics)
          write('q_topic_dataset', 'q_topic_dataset', topic_datasets)
          write('q_topic_refresh', 'q_topic_refresh', refreshes)
          '''

          DATASOURCE = COMMON + r'''
          rows = []
          for s in paginate(qs, 'list_data_sources', 'DataSources', AwsAccountId=ACCOUNT):
              params = s.get('DataSourceParameters', {}) or {}
              ptype = next(iter(params), None)
              p = params.get(ptype, {}) if ptype else {}
              rows.append({'datasource_id': s.get('DataSourceId'), 'datasource_name': s.get('Name'),
                           'arn': s.get('Arn'), 'type': s.get('Type'), 'status': s.get('Status'),
                           'created_time': s.get('CreatedTime'), 'last_updated_time': s.get('LastUpdatedTime'),
                           'parameter_type': ptype, 'host': p.get('Host'), 'port': p.get('Port'),
                           'database': p.get('Database'), 'work_group': p.get('WorkGroup'),
                           'vpc_connection': (s.get('VpcConnectionProperties') or {}).get('VpcConnectionArn'),
                           'ssl_disabled': (s.get('SslProperties') or {}).get('DisableSsl'),
                           'secret_arn': s.get('SecretArn'), 'error_info': s.get('ErrorInfo')})
          write('datasource_property', 'datasource_property', rows)
          '''

          SCRIPTS = {
              'glue/qs_assets_access.py': ACCESS,
              'glue/qs_dataset_metadata.py': DATASET,
              'glue/qs_folder_assets.py': FOLDER,
              'glue/qs_q_metadata.py': QMETA,
              'glue/qs_datasource_property.py': DATASOURCE,
          }

          def dedent(s):
              return '\n'.join(l[10:] if l.startswith(' ' * 10) else l.lstrip() if not l.strip() else l for l in s.split('\n'))

          def handler(event, context):
              s3 = boto3.client('s3')
              bucket = event['ResourceProperties']['Bucket']
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] in ('Create', 'Update'):
                      for key, body in SCRIPTS.items():
                          s3.put_object(Bucket=bucket, Key=key, Body=dedent(body).encode('utf-8'))
                  elif event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      paginator = s3.get_paginator('list_object_versions')
                      for page in paginator.paginate(Bucket=bucket):
                          objs = [{'Key': o['Key'], 'VersionId': o['VersionId']}
                                  for o in page.get('Versions', []) + page.get('DeleteMarkers', [])]
                          if objs:
                              s3.delete_objects(Bucket=bucket, Delete={'Objects': objs})
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {'Bucket': bucket}, bucket)
              except Exception as e:
                  print(e)
                  status = cfnresponse.SUCCESS if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete' else cfnresponse.FAILED
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, status, {'Error': str(e)}, bucket)

  ScriptDeployment:
    Type: Custom::GlueScriptDeployment
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt ScriptDeployerFunction.Arn
      Bucket: !Ref ScriptBucket
      ScriptVersion: '1.0.0'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Glue Jobs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AssetsAccessGlueJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    DependsOn: ScriptDeployment
    Properties:
      Name: qs-admin-assets-access
      Description: Extracts QuickSight users, groups and asset permission relationships.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.2X
      NumberOfWorkers: 5
      Timeout: 360
      MaxRetries: 0
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/glue/qs_assets_access.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--REGION': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--IDENTITY_REGION': !Ref QuickSightIdentityRegion
        '--DEST_BUCKET': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket

  DatasetMetadataGlueJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    DependsOn: ScriptDeployment
    Properties:
      Name: qs-admin-dataset-metadata
      Description: Extracts QuickSight dataset properties, refresh schedules and ingestion history.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 240
      MaxRetries: 0
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/glue/qs_dataset_metadata.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--REGION': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--IDENTITY_REGION': !Ref QuickSightIdentityRegion
        '--DEST_BUCKET': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket

  FolderAssetsGlueJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    DependsOn: ScriptDeployment
    Properties:
      Name: qs-admin-folder-assets
      Description: Extracts QuickSight folders and folder-to-asset relationships.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 240
      MaxRetries: 0
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/glue/qs_folder_assets.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--REGION': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--IDENTITY_REGION': !Ref QuickSightIdentityRegion
        '--DEST_BUCKET': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket

  QMetadataGlueJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    DependsOn: ScriptDeployment
    Properties:
      Name: qs-admin-q-metadata
      Description: Extracts QuickSight Q topic metadata, dataset references and refresh schedules.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 240
      MaxRetries: 0
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/glue/qs_q_metadata.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--REGION': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--IDENTITY_REGION': !Ref QuickSightIdentityRegion
        '--DEST_BUCKET': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket

  DatasourcePropertyGlueJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    DependsOn: ScriptDeployment
    Properties:
      Name: qs-admin-datasource-property
      Description: Extracts QuickSight datasource connection properties.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Timeout: 240
      MaxRetries: 0
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/glue/qs_datasource_property.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--REGION': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--IDENTITY_REGION': !Ref QuickSightIdentityRegion
        '--DEST_BUCKET': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Glue Triggers (staggered daily schedule starting 02:00 UTC)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AssetsAccessTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: qs-admin-assets-access-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 2 * * ? *)
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref AssetsAccessGlueJob

  DatasetMetadataTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: qs-admin-dataset-metadata-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(30 2 * * ? *)
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref DatasetMetadataGlueJob

  FolderAssetsTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: qs-admin-folder-assets-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 3 * * ? *)
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref FolderAssetsGlueJob

  QMetadataTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: qs-admin-q-metadata-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(30 3 * * ? *)
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref QMetadataGlueJob

  DatasourcePropertyTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: qs-admin-datasource-property-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: cron(0 4 * * ? *)
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref DatasourcePropertyGlueJob

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Kinesis Firehose Delivery Streams
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  IngestionDatasetFirehose:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: qs-admin-ingestion-dataset-metrics
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
        Prefix: cloudwatch/ingestion_dataset/
        ErrorOutputPrefix: cloudwatch-errors/ingestion_dataset/
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5

  DashboardVisualFirehose:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: qs-admin-dashboard-visual-metrics
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
        Prefix: cloudwatch/dashboard_visual/
        ErrorOutputPrefix: cloudwatch-errors/dashboard_visual/
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5

  SpiceCapacityFirehose:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: qs-admin-spice-capacity-metrics
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:

Description: VPC infrastructure for a Puppet Quick Start deployment, including a public subnet, internet gateway, routing, and a private Route53 hosted zone with A records for the Puppet master and agents.

Parameters:
  VPCCIDR:
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: CIDR block parameter must be in the form x.x.x.x/16-28
  PublicSubnetCIDR:
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/19
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(\/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$
    ConstraintDescription: CIDR block parameter must be in the form x.x.x.x/16-28
  PuppetMasterIP:
    Description: Private IP address for puppet.example.com
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.10
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address
  LinuxAgentIP:
    Description: Private IP address for linuxagent.example.com
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.11
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address
  WindowsAgentIP:
    Description: Private IP address for windowsagent.example.com
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.12
    AllowedPattern: ^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 address

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VPCCIDR
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PuppetVPC

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCIDR
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']

      Tags:

          Value: PuppetPublicSubnet

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PuppetIGW

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: PuppetPublicRouteTable

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: example.com

      ResourceRecords:

    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone

Outputs:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained ECS Fargate microservice with its own VPC (one public subnet,
  two private subnets, IGW and NAT gateway). The service registers with a
  private Cloud Map DNS namespace through SRV records and uses step-based
  application auto scaling driven by CloudWatch CPU alarms.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: Name of the environment. Used to name and tag resources.
  ServiceName:
    Type: String
    Default: nginx
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$'
    Description: Name of the service. Also used as the Cloud Map service name for DNS discovery.
  ImageUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: nginx
    Description: URL of a Docker image that contains the application process that will handle the traffic for this service.
  ContainerPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 65535
    Description: Port number that the application inside the Docker container is binding to.
  ContainerCpu:
    Type: Number
    Default: 256
    AllowedValues: [256, 512, 1024, 2048, 4096]
    Description: CPU units to give the container. 1024 is 1 vCPU.
  ContainerMemory:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    Description: Memory in MiB to give the container. Must be a valid value for the chosen CPU.
  DesiredCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 2
    MaxValue: 10
    Description: Number of copies of the service task to run.
  Role:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      (Optional) ARN of an IAM role to give the service's containers if the code
      in the container needs to access other AWS resources such as S3 buckets or
      DynamoDB tables.

Conditions:
  HasCustomRole: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Role, '']]

Mappings:
  SubnetConfig:
    VPC:
      CIDR: 10.0.0.0/16
    PublicOne:
      CIDR: 10.0.0.0/24
    PrivateOne:
      CIDR: 10.0.100.0/24
    PrivateTwo:
      CIDR: 10.0.101.0/24

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, VPC, CIDR]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'

  PublicSubnetOne:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, PublicOne, CIDR]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-1'

  PrivateSubnetOne:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, PrivateOne, CIDR]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-1'

  PrivateSubnetTwo:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, PrivateTwo, CIDR]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-2'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'

  GatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: GatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetOneRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetOne
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: GatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip'

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetOne
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat'

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt'

  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateSubnetOneRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetOne
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnetTwoRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetTwo
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ECS cluster and security
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-cluster'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ContainerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow containers to communicate with each other within the VPC CIDR
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - Description: All traffic from within the VPC
          IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, VPC, CIDR]
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: All outbound traffic
          IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-container-sg'

  ECSTaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy'

  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/ecs/${EnvironmentName}/${ServiceName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Service discovery
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}.internal'
      Description: !Sub 'Private service discovery namespace for ${EnvironmentName}'
      Vpc: !Ref VPC

  DiscoveryService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ServiceName
      Description: !Sub 'Discovery service for ${ServiceName}'
      NamespaceId: !Ref PrivateNamespace
      DnsConfig:
        RoutingPolicy: MULTIVALUE
        DnsRecords:
          - Type: SRV
            TTL: 60
      HealthCheckCustomConfig:
        FailureThreshold: 1

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Task definition and service
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      Cpu: !Ref ContainerCpu
      Memory: !Ref ContainerMemory
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !If [HasCustomRole, !Ref Role, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Ref ServiceName
          Image: !Ref ImageUrl
          Cpu: !Ref ContainerCpu
          Memory: !Ref ContainerMemory
          Essential: true
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref AWS::Region
              awslogs-stream-prefix: !Ref ServiceName

  Service:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn:
      - PrivateRoute
      - PrivateSubnetOneRouteTableAssociation
      - PrivateSubnetTwoRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Ref ServiceName
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCount
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        MaximumPercent: 200
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 75
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ContainerSecurityGroup
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnetOne
            - !Ref PrivateSubnetTwo
      ServiceRegistries:
        - RegistryArn: !GetAtt DiscoveryService.Arn
          ContainerName: !Ref ServiceName
          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Auto scaling
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      ServiceNamespace: ecs
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      ResourceId: !Sub 'service/${ECSCluster}/${Service.Name}'
      MinCapacity: 2
      MaxCapacity: 10

  ScaleDownPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${ServiceName}-scale-down'
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 60
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalUpperBound: 0
            ScalingAdjustment: -1

  ScaleUpPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${ServiceName}-scale-up'
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 60
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 15
            ScalingAdjustment: 1
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 15
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 25
            ScalingAdjustment: 2
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 25
            ScalingAdjustment: 3

  LowCpuUsageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-low-cpu'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Low CPU utilization for service ${ServiceName}'
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !GetAtt Service.Name
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 20
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanOrEqualToThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleDownPolicy

  HighCpuUsageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-high-cpu'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'High CPU utilization for service ${ServiceName}'
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !GetAtt Service.Name
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref ECSCluster
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleUpPolicy

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: Private subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateSubnetOne, !Ref PrivateSubnetTwo]]
  ClusterName:
    Description: Name of the ECS cluster
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster
  ServiceArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS service
    Value: !Ref Service
  NamespaceId:
    Description: ID of the Cloud Map private DNS namespace
    Value: !Ref PrivateNamespace
  DiscoveryServiceArn:
    Description: ARN of the Cloud Map service
    Value: !GetAtt DiscoveryService.Arn
  ServiceDnsName:
    Description: DNS name other services can use to discover this service (SRV record)
    Value: !Sub '${ServiceName}.${EnvironmentName}.internal'
  ContainerSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group used by the service's containers
    Value: !Ref ContainerSecurityGroup

    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.

  PrivateSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.10.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR between /16 and /28 within the VPC CIDR.
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet (must be within the VPC CIDR).

  InternalCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/8
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR.
    Description: Internal CIDR range allowed to reach workloads over HTTPS (inbound).

  OciBackboneCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.95.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR.
    Description: CIDR block of the OCI primary region backbone (HTTPS outbound destination and TGW route).

  TransitGatewayAmazonSideAsn:
    Type: Number
    Default: 64512
    MinValue: 64512
    MaxValue: 65534
    Description: Private ASN for the Amazon side of the transit gateway.

  CreateOciVpn:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Set to true to create a customer gateway and static-route VPN connection to OCI.

  OciVpnPublicIp:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid IPv4 address.
    Description: Public IP of the OCI IPSec (DRG) endpoint. Required when CreateOciVpn is true.

  OciCustomerGatewayBgpAsn:
    Type: Number
    Default: 31898
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 4294967294
    Description: ASN for the customer gateway object (required by AWS even for static routing; 31898 is the OCI ASN).

Rules:
  VpnRequiresPublicIp:
    RuleCondition: !Equals
      - !Ref CreateOciVpn
      - 'true'
    Assertions:
      - Assert: !Not
          - !Equals
            - !Ref OciVpnPublicIp
            - ''
        AssertDescription: OciVpnPublicIp must be provided when CreateOciVpn is true.

Conditions:
  CreateVpn: !Equals
    - !Ref CreateOciVpn
    - 'true'

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Core VPC networking
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet'

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-rt'

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  OciRouteViaTransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security group: HTTPS in from internal CIDR, HTTPS out to OCI only
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  HybridSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: HTTPS inbound from internal CIDR and HTTPS outbound to OCI backbone only
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref InternalCidr
          Description: HTTPS from internal CIDR range
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
          Description: HTTPS to OCI backbone
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-hybrid-sg'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Transit gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub '${EnvironmentName} transit gateway for OCI interconnect'
      AmazonSideAsn: !Ref TransitGatewayAmazonSideAsn
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-tgw'

  TransitGatewayRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-tgw-rt'

  TransitGatewayVpcAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-tgw-vpc-attachment'

  TransitGatewayVpcAttachmentAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  TransitGatewayVpcAttachmentPropagation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTablePropagation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  # Routes OCI traffic to the VPN attachment when the VPN exists; otherwise a
  # blackhole route so OCI-bound traffic is explicitly dropped at the TGW.
  TransitGatewayOciRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !If
        - CreateVpn
        - !GetAtt VpnAttachmentLookup.AttachmentId
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Blackhole: !If
        - CreateVpn
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Optional OCI site-to-site VPN (static routes only)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  OciCustomerGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::CustomerGateway
    Condition: CreateVpn
    Properties:
      Type: ipsec.1
      IpAddress: !Ref OciVpnPublicIp
      BgpAsn: !Ref OciCustomerGatewayBgpAsn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-oci-cgw'

  OciVpnConnection:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnection
    Condition: CreateVpn
    Properties:
      Type: ipsec.1
      CustomerGatewayId: !Ref OciCustomerGateway
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      StaticRoutesOnly: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-oci-vpn'

  # The VPNConnection resource does not expose its TGW attachment ID, so a small
  # custom resource looks it up (and waits until it is available).
  VpnAttachmentLookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: CreateVpn
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DescribeTgwAttachments
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayAttachments
                Resource: '*'

  VpnAttachmentLookupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Condition: CreateVpn
    Properties:
      Description: Resolves the transit gateway attachment ID of the OCI VPN connection
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 900
      Role: !GetAtt VpnAttachmentLookupRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import time
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          def handler(event, context):
              physical_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId', 'vpn-attachment-lookup')
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, physical_id)
                      return
                  props = event['ResourceProperties']
                  ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                  deadline = time.time() + 840
                  while True:
                      resp = ec2.describe_transit_gateway_attachments(Filters=[
                          {'Name': 'resource-id', 'Values': [props['VpnConnectionId']]},
                          {'Name': 'transit-gateway-id', 'Values': [props['TransitGatewayId']]},
                          {'Name': 'resource-type', 'Values': ['vpn']},
                      ])
                      available = [a for a in resp['TransitGatewayAttachments'] if a['State'] == 'available']
                      if available:
                          attachment_id = available[0]['TransitGatewayAttachmentId']
                          cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS,
                                           {'AttachmentId': attachment_id}, attachment_id)
                          return
                      if time.time() > deadline:
                          raise Exception('Timed out waiting for VPN transit gateway attachment')
                      time.sleep(15)
              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {}, physical_id, reason=str(e))

  VpnAttachmentLookup:
    Type: Custom::VpnTransitGatewayAttachment
    Condition: CreateVpn
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt VpnAttachmentLookupFunction.Arn
      VpnConnectionId: !Ref OciVpnConnection
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  VpnAttachmentAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateVpn
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !GetAtt VpnAttachmentLookup.AttachmentId
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC flow logs -> KMS-encrypted CloudWatch Logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'CMK for ${EnvironmentName} VPC flow log encryption'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flowlogs-key'

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flowlogs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${EnvironmentName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PublishFlowLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn}:*'

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceType: VPC
      ResourceId: !Ref Vpc
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flowlog'

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref Vpc
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'
  PrivateSubnetId:
    Description: Private subnet ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetId'
  RouteTableId:
    Description: Route table ID
    Value: !Ref RouteTable
  SecurityGroupId:
    Description: Hybrid HTTPS security group ID
    Value: !Ref HybridSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SecurityGroupId'
  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: Transit gateway ID
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TransitGatewayId'
  TransitGatewayRouteTableId:
    Description: Transit gateway route table ID
    Value: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
  TransitGatewayVpcAttachmentId:
    Description: Transit gateway VPC attachment ID
    Value: !Ref TransitGatewayVpcAttachment
  OciVpnConnectionId:
    Condition: CreateVpn
    Description: Site-to-site VPN connection ID to OCI
    Value: !Ref OciVpnConnection
  OciVpnTransitGatewayAttachmentId:
    Condition: CreateVpn
    Description: Transit gateway attachment ID of the OCI VPN
    Value: !GetAtt VpnAttachmentLookup.AttachmentId
  FlowLogsKmsKeyArn:
    Description: KMS key ARN used to encrypt VPC flow logs
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn
  FlowLogsLogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Logs group for VPC flow logs
    Value: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained infrastructure for the QuickSight Admin Console data preparation pipeline.
  Creates an S3 bucket, an IAM role, five AWS Glue jobs (PythonShell and Glue ETL), and
  scheduled Glue triggers that run every 3 hours.

Parameters:
  ScriptBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: aws-bigdata-blog
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket that hosts the predefined Glue job scripts.
  ScriptPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: artifacts/aws-blog-QuickSight-Admin-Console/glue-scripts/
    Description: S3 key prefix (ending with /) where the Glue job scripts are stored.
  CloudTrailTableName:
    Type: String
    Default: cloudtrail_logs
    Description: Name of the CloudTrail log table used by downstream analytics.
  GlueDatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: admin_console
    Description: Glue Data Catalog database name used by the jobs.

Resources:
  AdminConsoleBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'admin-console-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  AdminConsoleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'QuickSightAdminConsoleRole-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: QuickSightAdminConsolePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: IAMFullAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: QuickSightFullAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action: quicksight:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: GlueFullAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action: glue:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: S3FullAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchFullAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action: cloudwatch:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: LogsFullAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action: logs:*
                Resource: '*'

  GroupMembershipJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: adminconsole-group-membership-info
      Description: Collects QuickSight group membership information.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminConsoleRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 1
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 60
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/${ScriptPrefix}adminconsole_group_membership.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--bucket_name': !Ref AdminConsoleBucket
        '--aws_region': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--aws_account_id': !Ref AWS::AccountId
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1

  ObjectAccessJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: adminconsole-object-access-info
      Description: Collects QuickSight dashboard, analysis and dataset access permissions.
      Role: !GetAtt AdminConsoleRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 1
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 60
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucket}/${ScriptPrefix}adminconsole_object_access.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--bucket_name': !Ref AdminConsoleBucket
        '--aws_region': !Ref AWS::Region
