AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  EC2 Image Builder pipeline for custom AMIs built from the latest Amazon Linux 2
  ECS-optimized AMI, with a Chef-based custom component, custom build workflow,
  daily schedule, image scanning, tests, cross-region distribution and an AMI
  lifecycle (deprecation) policy.

Parameters:
  ResourceNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: ecs-al2-golden
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+$'
    Description: Prefix used for naming all Image Builder resources.

  SemanticVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: 1.0.0
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$'
    Description: Semantic version for the component, recipe and workflow. Increment on change.

  ParentImageId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Default: /aws/service/ecs/optimized-ami/amazon-linux-2/recommended/image_id
    Description: SSM parameter that resolves to the latest Amazon Linux 2 ECS-optimized AMI.

  ChefRecipeBucketName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket containing the Chef recipe.

  ChefRecipeObjectKey:
    Type: String
    Default: chef/recipes/default.rb
    Description: S3 object key of the Chef recipe file to download and run.

  ChefClientVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '18'
    Description: Chef Infra Client major/full version to install on the build instance.

  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 30
    MaxValue: 1024
    Description: Root EBS volume size in GiB.

  RootVolumeType:
    Type: String
    Default: gp3
    AllowedValues:
      - gp2
      - gp3
      - io1
      - io2
    Description: Root EBS volume type.

  BuildInstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: m5.large
    Description: Instance type used to build and test the image.

  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-[0-9]$'
    Description: Additional AWS region the resulting AMI is distributed to and shared in.

  PipelineScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Default: cron(0 3 * * ? *)
    Description: Cron expression for the daily pipeline run (UTC).

  LifecycleTagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    Description: Value of the "LifecycleManaged" tag used by the lifecycle policy to select AMIs.

  DeprecateAfterDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 365
    Description: Age in days after which AMIs selected by the lifecycle policy are deprecated.

  RetainAtLeast:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 10
    Description: Minimum number of AMIs to keep non-deprecated regardless of age.

Conditions:
  DistributeToSeparateRegion: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TargetRegion, !Ref 'AWS::Region']]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-instance-role-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: Role assumed by EC2 Image Builder build and test instances.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'ec2.${AWS::URLSuffix}'
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ChefRecipeS3Read
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ChefRecipeBucketName}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ChefRecipeBucketName}'

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-instance-profile-${AWS::Region}'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  WorkflowExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-workflow-exec-role-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: Role assumed by EC2 Image Builder to run custom image workflows.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderWorkflowExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EC2Lifecycle
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:RunInstances
                  - ec2:StopInstances
                  - ec2:StartInstances
                  - ec2:TerminateInstances
                  - ec2:CreateImage
                  - ec2:CopyImage
                  - ec2:RegisterImage
                  - ec2:DeregisterImage
                  - ec2:ModifyImageAttribute
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshot
                  - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                  - ec2:ModifySnapshotAttribute
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:CreateLaunchTemplateVersion
                  - ec2:ModifyLaunchTemplate
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - ec2:EnableFastLaunch
                  - ec2:DisableFastLaunch
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: SSMCommands
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:SendCommand
                  - ssm:GetCommandInvocation
                  - ssm:ListCommands
                  - ssm:ListCommandInvocations
                  - ssm:DescribeInstanceInformation
                  - ssm:ListInventoryEntries
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:SendAutomationSignal
                  - ssm:StopAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:PutInventory
                  - ssm:PutComplianceItems
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ImageBuilderRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - imagebuilder:GetComponent
                  - imagebuilder:GetWorkflow
                  - imagebuilder:GetImage
                  - imagebuilder:GetImageRecipe
                  - imagebuilder:GetInfrastructureConfiguration
                  - imagebuilder:GetDistributionConfiguration
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: Inspector
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - inspector2:ListFindings
                  - inspector2:ListCoverage
                  - inspector2:BatchGetAccountStatus
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PassInstanceRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt ImageBuilderInstanceRole.Arn
              - Sid: ServiceLinkedRoles
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringLike:
                    iam:AWSServiceName:
                      - imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
                      - ssm.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: Logs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:*:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/imagebuilder/*'

  LifecycleExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-lifecycle-role-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: Role assumed by EC2 Image Builder to run lifecycle policies.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/EC2ImageBuilderLifecycleExecutionPolicy'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Custom component: download and execute a Chef recipe from S3
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ChefRecipeComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-chef-recipe'
      Version: !Ref SemanticVersion
      Platform: Linux
      Description: Installs Chef Infra Client, downloads a Chef recipe from S3 and applies it.
      ChangeDescription: !Sub 'Version ${SemanticVersion}'
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - Amazon Linux 2
      Data: !Sub |
        name: ${ResourceNamePrefix}-chef-recipe
        description: Download and execute a Chef recipe from S3.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: CreateChefWorkingDirectory
                action: CreateFolder
                inputs:
                  - path: /opt/imagebuilder/chef
                    overwrite: true
              - name: DownloadChefRecipe
                action: S3Download
                maxAttempts: 3
                inputs:
                  - source: s3://${ChefRecipeBucketName}/${ChefRecipeObjectKey}
                    destination: /opt/imagebuilder/chef/recipe.rb
                    overwrite: true
              - name: InstallChefClient
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - curl -fsSL https://omnitruck.chef.io/install.sh -o /tmp/chef-install.sh
                    - bash /tmp/chef-install.sh -P chef -v ${ChefClientVersion}
                    - rm -f /tmp/chef-install.sh
              - name: ApplyChefRecipe
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - export CHEF_LICENSE=accept-silent
                    - chef-apply /opt/imagebuilder/chef/recipe.rb
              - name: CleanupChefArtifacts
                action: DeleteFolder
                inputs:
                  - path: /opt/imagebuilder/chef
                    force: true
          - name: validate
            steps:
              - name: ValidateChefClient
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - command -v chef-client
                    - chef-client --version
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: TestChefClientInstalled
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - chef-client --version
              - name: TestEcsAgentConfigPresent
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euo pipefail
                    - test -d /etc/ecs
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-chef-recipe'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image recipe
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EcsImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-recipe'
      Version: !Ref SemanticVersion
      Description: Amazon Linux 2 ECS-optimized image customised with a Chef recipe.
      ParentImage: !Ref ParentImageId
      WorkingDirectory: /tmp
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:component/update-linux/x.x.x'
        - ComponentArn: !Ref ChefRecipeComponent
        - ComponentArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:component/simple-boot-test-linux/x.x.x'
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: !Ref RootVolumeType
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true
      AdditionalInstanceConfiguration:
        SystemsManagerAgent:
          UninstallAfterBuild: false
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-recipe'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Infrastructure configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-infra'
      Description: Build/test infrastructure; instances are terminated on failure.
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - !Ref BuildInstanceType
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      InstanceMetadataOptions:
        HttpTokens: required
        HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 2
      ResourceTags:
        Name: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-build-instance'
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-infra'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Distribution configuration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-distribution'
      Description: Distributes the AMI and shares it with the current account.
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix} AMI built by EC2 Image Builder'
            AmiTags:
              Name: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}'
              LifecycleManaged: !Ref LifecycleTagValue
              ParentImage: '{{ imagebuilder:parentImage }}'
              BuildDate: '{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserIds:
                - !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
        - !If
          - DistributeToSeparateRegion
          - Region: !Ref TargetRegion
            AmiDistributionConfiguration:
              Name: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
              Description: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix} AMI built by EC2 Image Builder'
              AmiTags:
                Name: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}'
                LifecycleManaged: !Ref LifecycleTagValue
                ParentImage: '{{ imagebuilder:parentImage }}'
                BuildDate: '{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
              LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
                UserIds:
                  - !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-distribution'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Custom build workflow: update SSM agent, collect metadata, create AMI
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BuildWorkflow:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Workflow
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-build-workflow'
      Version: !Ref SemanticVersion
      Type: BUILD
      Description: Launches the build instance, updates the SSM agent, runs components, collects metadata and creates the AMI.
      ChangeDescription: !Sub 'Version ${SemanticVersion}'
      Data: |
        name: custom-build-workflow
        description: Custom build workflow that updates the SSM agent and collects image metadata before creating the AMI.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        steps:
          - name: LaunchBuildInstance
            action: LaunchInstance
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              waitFor: "ssmAgent"

          - name: UpdateSSMAgent
            action: RunCommand
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              documentName: "AWS-UpdateSSMAgent"
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"

          - name: ApplyBuildComponents
            action: ExecuteComponents
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"

          - name: CollectImageMetadata
            action: CollectImageMetadata
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"

          - name: CreateOutputAMI
            action: CreateImage
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"

          - name: TerminateBuildInstance
            action: TerminateInstance
            onFailure: Continue
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: "$.stepOutputs.LaunchBuildInstance.instanceId"

        outputs:
          - name: "ImageId"
            value: "$.stepOutputs.CreateOutputAMI.imageId"
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-build-workflow'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image pipeline
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-pipeline'
      Description: Daily pipeline building the ECS-optimized golden AMI.
      Status: ENABLED
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref EcsImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt WorkflowExecutionRole.Arn
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true
      Workflows:
        - WorkflowArn: !Ref BuildWorkflow
        - WorkflowArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:workflow/test/test-image/x.x.x'
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: true
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 90
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: !Ref PipelineScheduleExpression
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_ONLY
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-pipeline'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lifecycle policy: deprecate AMIs by age, selected by tag
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AmiLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-lifecycle'
      Description: Deprecates tagged AMIs older than the configured age.
      Status: ENABLED
      ResourceType: AMI_IMAGE
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt LifecycleExecutionRole.Arn
      ResourceSelection:
        TagMap:
          LifecycleManaged: !Ref LifecycleTagValue
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DEPRECATE
          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: !Ref DeprecateAfterDays
            Unit: DAYS
            RetainAtLeast: !Ref RetainAtLeast
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-lifecycle'

Outputs:
  ImagePipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Image Builder pipeline.
    Value: !Ref ImagePipeline
  ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the image recipe.
    Value: !Ref EcsImageRecipe
  ChefRecipeComponentArn:
    Description: ARN of the Chef recipe component.
    Value: !Ref ChefRecipeComponent
  BuildWorkflowArn:
    Description: ARN of the custom build workflow.
    Value: !Ref BuildWorkflow
  InfrastructureConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the infrastructure configuration.
    Value: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
  DistributionConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the distribution configuration.
    Value: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
  LifecyclePolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the AMI lifecycle policy.
    Value: !Ref AmiLifecyclePolicy
  InstanceProfileName:
    Description: Instance profile used by build and test instances.
    Value: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
  WorkflowExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: IAM role used by Image Builder to execute workflows.
    Value: !GetAtt WorkflowExecutionRole.Arn
  LifecycleExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: IAM role used by Image Builder to execute lifecycle policies.
    Value: !GetAtt LifecycleExecutionRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Lambda functions used for contract testing the AWSSamples::LambdaFunctionInvoker::Hook. Each function has an independent callback setting.

Parameters:

      - "yes"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Provisions five EC2 instances with CloudWatch alarms for CPU utilization on all instances, plus status check failed and attached EBS status check alarms on the first three instances.

Parameters:
  LatestAmiId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Default: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
    Description: SSM parameter path for the AMI used by all instances.
  InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: t3.micro
    AllowedValues:
      - t3.micro
      - t3.small
      - t3.medium
      - t3.large
    Description: EC2 instance type for all instances. Nitro-based types are required for the attached EBS status check metric.
  SubnetId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id
    Description: Subnet in which to launch the instances.
  AlarmEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional email address to receive alarm notifications. Leave blank to skip the subscription.

Conditions:
  HasAlarmEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmEmail, '']]

Resources:
  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: EC2 Monitoring Alarms

  AlarmTopicSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasAlarmEmail
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref AlarmTopic
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref AlarmEmail

  Instance1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      ImageId: !Ref LatestAmiId
      InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType
      SubnetId: !Ref SubnetId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-instance-1'

  Instance2:

    Properties:

  Instance5:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance

      SubnetId: !Ref SubnetId

        - Key: Name

      Namespace: AWS/EC2
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: InstanceId
          Value: !Ref Instance1
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Threshold: 80
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  Instance2CPUAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-instance-2-high-cpu'

      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: InstanceId
          Value: !Ref Instance2
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Threshold: 80
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

      Dimensions:
        - Name: InstanceId

      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Threshold: 80
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

    Properties:

      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: InstanceId
          Value: !Ref Instance4
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Threshold: 80
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  Instance5CPUAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-instance-5-high-cpu'

        - Name: InstanceId

      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Threshold: 80
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  Instance1StatusCheckAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-instance-1-status-check-failed'

      MetricName: StatusCheckFailed

        - Name: InstanceId

      TreatMissingData: missing
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

      TreatMissingData: missing
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

      TreatMissingData: missing
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

        - !Ref AlarmTopic

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Content-level PII classification scanner for objects exposed through an S3 Access Point.
  A Lambda function pages through the access point, samples and chunks object content,
  calls Amazon Comprehend DetectPiiEntities, writes per-object results to an encrypted
  DynamoDB table, and can send an optional SNS summary. Before deploying, check the
  access point's network origin with
  "aws s3control get-access-point --account-id <acct> --name <ap>".
  If NetworkOrigin is Internet, leave all VPC parameters empty. If NetworkOrigin is VPC,
  supply VpcId, SubnetIds, SecurityGroupId and RouteTableIds for that same VPC. Set
  CreateVpcEndpoints to false if the VPC already has an S3, DynamoDB, Comprehend or SNS
  endpoint, because duplicates fail and roll back the stack. The underlying bucket policy
  must delegate access control to access points.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Target
        Parameters:
          - AccessPointArn
          - ObjectKmsKeyArn
      - Label:
          default: Network (only for VPC-origin access points)
        Parameters:
          - VpcId
          - SubnetIds
          - SecurityGroupId
          - RouteTableIds
          - CreateVpcEndpoints
      - Label:
          default: Scanner settings
        Parameters:
          - LambdaMemorySize
          - LambdaTimeout
          - DefaultLanguageCode
          - DefaultMaxFiles
          - DefaultMaxBytesPerFile
          - DefaultMinScore
          - LogRetentionDays
      - Label:
          default: Notifications
        Parameters:
          - EnableSnsNotifications
          - NotificationEmail

Parameters:
  AccessPointArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the S3 Access Point to scan (arn:aws:s3:<region>:<account>:accesspoint/<name>).
    AllowedPattern: '^arn:aws[a-z-]*:s3:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:accesspoint/[a-z0-9.-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 Access Point ARN.

  ObjectKmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional KMS key ARN used to encrypt objects behind the access point (SSE-KMS). Leave empty if not applicable.

  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Leave empty for Internet-origin access points. For VPC-origin access points, the VPC the access point is bound to.

  SubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Private subnet IDs in VpcId for the Lambda ENIs and the interface endpoints. Required when VpcId is set.

  SecurityGroupId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Security group for the Lambda function. It must allow outbound HTTPS (443). Required when VpcId is set.

  RouteTableIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Route tables of the Lambda subnets, used by the S3 and DynamoDB gateway endpoints. Required when VpcId is set.

  CreateVpcEndpoints:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: >-
      Only used when VpcId is set. Creates S3 and DynamoDB gateway endpoints and Comprehend and SNS
      interface endpoints. Set this to false if the VPC already has any of these endpoints.

  LambdaMemorySize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    MinValue: 128
    MaxValue: 10240
    Description: Scanner Lambda memory in MB.

  LambdaTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 600
    MinValue: 30
    MaxValue: 900
    Description: Scanner Lambda timeout in seconds.

  DefaultLanguageCode:
    Type: String
    Default: en
    AllowedValues: [en, es]
    Description: Default Comprehend language code. DetectPiiEntities supports en and es.

  DefaultMaxFiles:
    Type: Number
    Default: 500
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 100000
    Description: Default maximum number of files scanned per invocation, used to control cost and runtime.

  DefaultMaxBytesPerFile:
    Type: Number
    Default: 500000
    MinValue: 1000
    MaxValue: 10000000
    Description: Default number of leading bytes sampled from each file. Larger files are truncated to this sample.

  DefaultMinScore:
    Type: String
    Default: '0.5'
    AllowedPattern: '^(0(\.[0-9]+)?|1(\.0+)?)$'
    Description: Minimum Comprehend confidence score (0-1) for an entity to be counted.

  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1827, 3653]
    Description: CloudWatch Logs retention in days for the scanner.

  EnableSnsNotifications:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Creates an SNS topic that receives a scan summary whenever PII is found.

  NotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional email address subscribed to the SNS topic. Only used when EnableSnsNotifications is true.

Rules:
  VpcParametersRequired:
    RuleCondition: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VpcId, '']]
    Assertions:
      - Assert: !Not [!Contains [!Ref SubnetIds, '']]
        AssertDescription: SubnetIds must be supplied when VpcId is set.
      - Assert: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SecurityGroupId, '']]
        AssertDescription: SecurityGroupId must be supplied when VpcId is set.
      - Assert: !Not [!Contains [!Ref RouteTableIds, '']]
        AssertDescription: RouteTableIds must be supplied when VpcId is set.

Conditions:
  UseVpc: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VpcId, '']]
  CreateEndpoints: !And
    - !Condition UseVpc
    - !Equals [!Ref CreateVpcEndpoints, 'true']
  HasObjectKmsKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ObjectKmsKeyArn, '']]
  EnableSns: !Equals [!Ref EnableSnsNotifications, 'true']
  CreateEmailSubscription: !And
    - !Condition EnableSns
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref NotificationEmail, '']]

Resources:
  ReportTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: ScanId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: ObjectKey
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: Classification
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: ScannedAt
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: ScanId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: ObjectKey
          KeyType: RANGE
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: ClassificationIndex
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: Classification
              KeyType: HASH
            - AttributeName: ScannedAt
              KeyType: RANGE
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
      Tags:
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: pii-classification-reports

  NotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Condition: EnableSns
    Properties:
      DisplayName: PII Scanner Alerts
      KmsMasterKeyId: alias/aws/sns

  NotificationSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: CreateEmailSubscription
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref NotificationTopic
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref NotificationEmail

  ScannerLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-pii-scanner'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  ScannerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns: !If
        - UseVpc
        - - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole'
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: pii-scanner
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListAccessPoint
                Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !Ref AccessPointArn
              - Sid: ReadAccessPointObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub '${AccessPointArn}/object/*'
              - Sid: Comprehend
                Effect: Allow
                Action: comprehend:DetectPiiEntities
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: WriteReports
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt ReportTable.Arn
              - Sid: Logs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub '${ScannerLogGroup.Arn}'
              - !If
                - EnableSns
                - Sid: PublishNotifications
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action: sns:Publish
                  Resource: !Ref NotificationTopic
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - !If
                - HasObjectKmsKey
                - Sid: DecryptObjects
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action: kms:Decrypt
                  Resource: !Ref ObjectKmsKeyArn
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: HTTPS from the PII scanner Lambda to the interface endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref SecurityGroupId
          Description: PII scanner Lambda

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      RouteTableIds: !Ref RouteTableIds

  DynamoDbGatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb'
      RouteTableIds: !Ref RouteTableIds

  ComprehendInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.comprehend'
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  SnsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sns'
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  ScannerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-pii-scanner'
      Description: Scans S3 Access Point objects for PII using Amazon Comprehend DetectPiiEntities
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt ScannerRole.Arn
      MemorySize: !Ref LambdaMemorySize
      Timeout: !Ref LambdaTimeout
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref ScannerLogGroup
      VpcConfig: !If
        - UseVpc
        - SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
          SecurityGroupIds:
            - !Ref SecurityGroupId
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Environment:
        Variables:
          AP_ARN: !Ref AccessPointArn
          TABLE: !Ref ReportTable
          TOPIC: !If [EnableSns, !Ref NotificationTopic, '']
          LANG_CODE: !Ref DefaultLanguageCode
          MAX_FILES: !Ref DefaultMaxFiles
          MAX_BYTES: !Ref DefaultMaxBytesPerFile
          MIN_SCORE: !Ref DefaultMinScore
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os, uuid, datetime, boto3
          s3 = boto3.client('s3')
          cp = boto3.client('comprehend')
          sns = boto3.client('sns')
          tb = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE'])
          AP = os.environ['AP_ARN']
          TOPIC = os.environ.get('TOPIC', '')
          CHUNK = 90000  # DetectPiiEntities limit is 100KB of UTF-8
          TXT = ('.txt', '.csv', '.tsv', '.json', '.jsonl', '.log', '.md', '.xml',
                 '.html', '.htm', '.yaml', '.yml', '.sql', '.ini', '.conf', '.eml')

          def chunks(text):
              b = text.encode('utf-8')
              while b:
                  c = b[:CHUNK]
                  if len(b) > CHUNK:
                      i = max(c.rfind(b' '), c.rfind(b'\n'))
                      if i > CHUNK // 2:
                          c = c[:i]
                  b = b[len(c):]
                  yield c.decode('utf-8', 'ignore')

          def scan(key, size, lang, max_bytes, min_score):
              rng = 'bytes=0-%d' % (max_bytes - 1)
              body = s3.get_object(Bucket=AP, Key=key, Range=rng)['Body'].read()
              text = body.decode('utf-8', 'ignore')
              counts = {}
              for c in chunks(text):
                  if not c.strip():
                      continue
                  ents = cp.detect_pii_entities(Text=c, LanguageCode=lang)['Entities']
                  for e in ents:
                      if e['Score'] >= min_score:
                          counts[e['Type']] = counts.get(e['Type'], 0) + 1
              return counts

          def handler(event, ctx):
              event = event or {}
              sid = event.get('scan_id') or str(uuid.uuid4())
              lang = event.get('language_code', os.environ['LANG_CODE'])
              max_files = int(event.get('max_files', os.environ['MAX_FILES']))
              max_bytes = int(event.get('max_bytes_per_file', os.environ['MAX_BYTES']))
              min_score = float(event.get('min_score', os.environ['MIN_SCORE']))
              step = max(1, int(event.get('sample_every', 1)))
              prefix = event.get('prefix', '')
              all_types = bool(event.get('include_all_extensions', False))
              last = event.get('start_after')
              token, scanned, seen, flagged, done = None, 0, 0, [], False
              while True:
                  kw = {'Bucket': AP, 'Prefix': prefix, 'MaxKeys': 1000}
                  if token:
                      kw['ContinuationToken'] = token
                  elif last:
                      kw['StartAfter'] = last
                  page = s3.list_objects_v2(**kw)
                  stop = False
                  for o in page.get('Contents', []):
                      if scanned >= max_files or ctx.get_remaining_time_in_millis() < 30000:
                          stop = True
                          break
                      key, size = o['Key'], o['Size']
                      last = key
                      seen += 1
                      if (seen - 1) % step or size == 0 or key.endswith('/'):
                          continue
                      if not all_types and not key.lower().endswith(TXT):
                          continue
                      now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + 'Z'
                      item = {'ScanId': sid, 'ObjectKey': key, 'Size': size,
                              'SampledBytes': min(size, max_bytes),
                              'Truncated': size > max_bytes, 'ScannedAt': now,
                              'LanguageCode': lang}
                      try:
                          counts = scan(key, size, lang, max_bytes, min_score)
                          total = sum(counts.values())
                          item.update(EntityCounts=counts, TotalEntities=total,
                                      Classification='PII' if total else 'CLEAN')
                          if total:
                              flagged.append(key)
                      except Exception as ex:
                          print('ERROR %s: %s' % (key, ex))
                          item.update(Classification='ERROR', Error=str(ex)[:1000])
                      tb.put_item(Item=item)
                      scanned += 1
                  if stop:
                      break
                  if not page.get('IsTruncated'):
                      done = True
                      break
                  token = page['NextContinuationToken']
              result = {'scan_id': sid, 'files_scanned': scanned,
                        'files_with_pii': len(flagged), 'complete': done}
              if not done:
                  result['start_after'] = last
              if TOPIC and flagged:
                  msg = 'PII scan %s on %s found PII in %d of %d files.\n\n%s' % (
                      sid, AP, len(flagged), scanned, '\n'.join(flagged[:50]))
                  sns.publish(TopicArn=TOPIC, Subject='PII detected (scan %s)' % sid[:40],
                              Message=msg)
              print(result)
              return result

Outputs:
  ScannerFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the PII scanner Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt ScannerFunction.Arn
  ReportTableName:
    Description: DynamoDB table holding per-object classification reports
    Value: !Ref ReportTable
  NotificationTopicArn:
    Condition: EnableSns
    Description: SNS topic for PII scan alerts
    Value: !Ref NotificationTopic
  ExampleInvokeCommand:
    Description: >-
      Example CLI invocation. To continue a scan, pass back scan_id and start_after from the
      response. Optional keys are language_code, max_bytes_per_file, sample_every, min_score
      and include_all_extensions.
    Value: !Sub >-
      aws lambda invoke --region ${AWS::Region} --function-name ${ScannerFunction}
      --cli-binary-format raw-in-base64-out
      --payload '{"prefix":"","max_files":${DefaultMaxFiles},"language_code":"${DefaultLanguageCode}"}'
      response.json && cat response.json

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Creates two AWS Glue databases, one for property graph (LPG) tables and one for RDF tables,
  with tables for the Athena Neptune connector based on the air-routes sample dataset.

Parameters:
  GlueDatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: graph-database
    Description: Name of the Glue database for property graph (LPG) tables.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores.
  GlueDatabaseNameRDF:
    Type: String
    Default: graph-database-rdf
    Description: Name of the Glue database for RDF tables.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Databases
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GlueDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Ref GlueDatabaseName
        Description: Glue database for Neptune property graph (LPG) tables

  GlueDatabaseRDF:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Ref GlueDatabaseNameRDF
        Description: Glue database for Neptune RDF tables

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # LPG tables
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AirportTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GlueDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: airport
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          separatorChar: ','
          componenttype: vertex
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
            - Name: type
              Type: string
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: icao
              Type: string
            - Name: desc
              Type: string
            - Name: region
              Type: string
            - Name: runways
              Type: int
            - Name: longest
              Type: int
            - Name: elev
              Type: int
            - Name: country
              Type: string
            - Name: city
              Type: string
            - Name: lat
              Type: double
            - Name: lon
              Type: double
          SerdeInfo:
            Parameters:
              separatorChar: ','

  CountryTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GlueDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: country
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          separatorChar: ','
          componenttype: vertex
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: desc
              Type: string
          SerdeInfo:
            Parameters:
              separatorChar: ','

  ContinentTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GlueDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: continent
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          separatorChar: ','
          componenttype: vertex
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: desc
              Type: string
          SerdeInfo:
            Parameters:
              separatorChar: ','

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GlueDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: route
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          separatorChar: ','
          componenttype: edge
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
            - Name: out
              Type: string
            - Name: in
              Type: string
            - Name: dist
              Type: int
          SerdeInfo:
            Parameters:
              separatorChar: ','

  CustomAirportTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GlueDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: customairport
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          separatorChar: ','
          componenttype: view
          query: "g.V().hasLabel('airport').as('source').out('route').as('destination').select('source','destination').by('code').limit(10)"
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: source
              Type: string
            - Name: destination
              Type: string
          SerdeInfo:
            Parameters:
              separatorChar: ','

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # RDF tables
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AirportRDFTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GlueDatabaseRDF
      TableInput:
        Name: airport_rdf
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          separatorChar: ','
          componenttype: rdf
          querymode: class
          classuri: 'class:Airport'
          subject: id
          strip_uri: 'true'
          preds_prefix: prop
          prefix_class: 'http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/class/'
          prefix_prop: 'http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty#'
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: id
              Type: string
            - Name: type
              Type: string
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: icao
              Type: string
            - Name: desc
              Type: string
            - Name: region
              Type: string
            - Name: runways
              Type: int
            - Name: longest
              Type: int
            - Name: elev
              Type: int
            - Name: country
              Type: string
            - Name: city
              Type: string
            - Name: lat
              Type: double
            - Name: lon
              Type: double
          SerdeInfo:
            Parameters:
              separatorChar: ','

  RouteRDFTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GlueDatabaseRDF
      TableInput:
        Name: route_rdf
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          separatorChar: ','
          componenttype: rdf
          querymode: sparql
          strip_uri: 'true'
          prefix_prop: 'http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty#'
          prefix_op: 'http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/objectProperty#'
          sparql: >-
            select ?incode ?outcode ?dist where {
            ?resin op:route ?resout .
            GRAPH ?route { ?resin op:route ?resout } .
            ?route prop:dist ?dist .
            ?resin prop:code ?incode .
            ?resout prop:code ?outcode . }
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: incode
              Type: string
            - Name: outcode
              Type: string
            - Name: dist
              Type: int
          SerdeInfo:
            Parameters:
              separatorChar: ','

  RouteRDFNoPrefixTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GlueDatabaseRDF
      TableInput:
        Name: route_rdf_nopfx
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          separatorChar: ','
          componenttype: rdf
          querymode: sparql
          strip_uri: 'true'
          sparql: >-
            select ?incode ?outcode ?dist where {
            ?resin <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/objectProperty#route> ?resout .
            GRAPH ?route { ?resin <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/objectProperty#route> ?resout } .
            ?route <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty#dist> ?dist .
            ?resin <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty#code> ?incode .
            ?resout <http://kelvinlawrence.net/air-routes/datatypeProperty#code> ?outcode . }
        StorageDescriptor:
          Columns:
            - Name: incode
              Type: string
            - Name: outcode
              Type: string
            - Name: dist
              Type: int
          SerdeInfo:
            Parameters:
              separatorChar: ','

Outputs:
  GlueDatabaseName:
    Description: Name of the Glue database for property graph (LPG) tables
    Value: !Ref GlueDatabase
  GlueDatabaseNameRDF:
    Description: Name of the Glue database for RDF tables
    Value: !Ref GlueDatabaseRDF

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Public Route 53 hosted zone and production DNS records for radiotopia.fm,
  including apex web hosting, mail routing, SPF/DMARC/DKIM, CloudFront-backed
  subdomains, ACM validation records, and third-party service verification records.

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: radiotopia.fm
    Description: Apex domain name for the hosted zone.

  MediaDistributionDomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: d1media0example.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name for media.radiotopia.fm.
  TowerDistributionDomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: d2tower0example.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name for tower.radiotopia.fm.
  V1DistributionDomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: d3v10000example.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name for v1.radiotopia.fm.
  PlusDistributionDomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: d4plus00example.cloudfront.net
    Description: CloudFront distribution domain name for plus.radiotopia.fm.

  FeedProxyTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: feeds.feedpress.it
    Description: Feed-proxy service hostname for the podcast feed subdomain.
  SpecialEventIpAddress:
    Type: String
    Default: 203.0.113.10
    Description: IPv4 address for the special event subdomain.

  GoogleSiteVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: google-site-verification=REPLACE_WITH_GOOGLE_TOKEN
    Description: Google Workspace domain ownership verification token.
  SecondaryVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: zendesk-verification=REPLACE_WITH_SECONDARY_TOKEN
    Description: Second domain ownership verification token for the apex TXT record.

  ZendeskVerificationToken:
    Type: String
    Default: REPLACE_WITH_ZENDESK_TOKEN
    Description: Value for the zendeskverification TXT record.
  ZendeskSubdomain:
    Type: String
    Default: radiotopia.zendesk.com
    Description: Zendesk help center host used by the support CNAME.

  SquarespaceVerificationName:
    Type: String
    Default: sqs-verify-REPLACE
    Description: Host label issued by Squarespace for domain verification.

  CampaignMonitorDkimPublicKey:
    Type: String
    Default: k=rsa; p=REPLACE_WITH_CAMPAIGN_MONITOR_DKIM_PUBLIC_KEY
    Description: Campaign Monitor DKIM TXT record value.
  GoogleDkimPublicKey:
    Type: String
    Default: v=DKIM1; k=rsa; p=REPLACE_WITH_GOOGLE_WORKSPACE_DKIM_PUBLIC_KEY
    Description: Google Workspace DKIM TXT record value (must be <= 255 chars or pre-split).

  MediaAcmValidationName:
    Type: String
    Default: _0a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f9.media.radiotopia.fm.
  MediaAcmValidationValue:
    Type: String
    Default: _1f2e3d4c5b6a79880716253443526170.acm-validations.aws.
  TowerAcmValidationName:
    Type: String
    Default: _1a2b3c4d5e6f708192a3b4c5d6e7f809.tower.radiotopia.fm.
  TowerAcmValidationValue:
    Type: String
    Default: _2e3d4c5b6a7988071625344352617081.acm-validations.aws.
  V1AcmValidationName:
    Type: String
    Default: _2a3b4c5d6e7f8091a2b3c4d5e6f70819.v1.radiotopia.fm.
  V1AcmValidationValue:
    Type: String
    Default: _3d4c5b6a798807162534435261708192.acm-validations.aws.
  PlusAcmValidationName:
    Type: String
    Default: _3a4b5c6d7e8f9011a2b3c4d5e6f70829.plus.radiotopia.fm.
  PlusAcmValidationValue:
    Type: String
    Default: _4c5b6a79880716253443526170819203.acm-validations.aws.

Mappings:
  Constants:
    CloudFront:
      HostedZoneId: Z2FDTNDATAQYW2

Resources:
  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: !Sub Public hosted zone for ${DomainName} (production)

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Apex records
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApexTxtRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '"v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com include:mail.zendesk.com include:servers.mcsv.net include:_spf.createsend.com ~all"'
        - !Sub '"${GoogleSiteVerificationToken}"'
        - !Sub '"${SecondaryVerificationToken}"'

  DmarcRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub _dmarc.${DomainName}
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"v=DMARC1; p=reject; rua=mailto:dmarc-reports@${DomainName}; adkim=r; aspf=r; pct=100"'

  ApexMxRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: MX
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - 1 ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.
        - 5 ALT1.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.
        - 5 ALT2.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.
        - 10 ALT3.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.
        - 10 ALT4.ASPMX.L.GOOGLE.COM.

  ApexARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref DomainName
      Type: A
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - 198.185.159.144
        - 198.185.159.145
        - 198.49.23.144
        - 198.49.23.145

  WwwCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub www.${DomainName}
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - ext-cust.squarespace.com

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudFront-backed subdomains
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MediaARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub media.${DomainName}
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref MediaDistributionDomainName
        HostedZoneId: !FindInMap [Constants, CloudFront, HostedZoneId]
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  MediaAaaaRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub media.${DomainName}
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref MediaDistributionDomainName
        HostedZoneId: !FindInMap [Constants, CloudFront, HostedZoneId]
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  TowerARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub tower.${DomainName}
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref TowerDistributionDomainName
        HostedZoneId: !FindInMap [Constants, CloudFront, HostedZoneId]
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  TowerAaaaRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub tower.${DomainName}
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref TowerDistributionDomainName
        HostedZoneId: !FindInMap [Constants, CloudFront, HostedZoneId]
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  V1ARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub v1.${DomainName}
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref V1DistributionDomainName
        HostedZoneId: !FindInMap [Constants, CloudFront, HostedZoneId]
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  V1AaaaRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub v1.${DomainName}
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref V1DistributionDomainName
        HostedZoneId: !FindInMap [Constants, CloudFront, HostedZoneId]
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  PlusARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub plus.${DomainName}
      Type: A
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref PlusDistributionDomainName
        HostedZoneId: !FindInMap [Constants, CloudFront, HostedZoneId]
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  PlusAaaaRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub plus.${DomainName}
      Type: AAAA
      AliasTarget:
        DNSName: !Ref PlusDistributionDomainName
        HostedZoneId: !FindInMap [Constants, CloudFront, HostedZoneId]
        EvaluateTargetHealth: false

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Other subdomains
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FeedsCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub feeds.${DomainName}
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref FeedProxyTarget

  LiveEventARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub live.${DomainName}
      Type: A
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref SpecialEventIpAddress

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ACM certificate validation records
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MediaAcmValidationRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref MediaAcmValidationName
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref MediaAcmValidationValue

  TowerAcmValidationRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref TowerAcmValidationName
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref TowerAcmValidationValue

  V1AcmValidationRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref V1AcmValidationName
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref V1AcmValidationValue

  PlusAcmValidationRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref PlusAcmValidationName
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref PlusAcmValidationValue

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Zendesk
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ZendeskVerificationRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub zendeskverification.${DomainName}
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${ZendeskVerificationToken}"'

  ZendeskDkim1Record:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub zendesk1._domainkey.${DomainName}
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - zendesk1._domainkey.zendesk.com

  ZendeskDkim2Record:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub zendesk2._domainkey.${DomainName}
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - zendesk2._domainkey.zendesk.com

  ZendeskMail1Record:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub zendesk1.${DomainName}
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - mail1.zendesk.com

  ZendeskMail2Record:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub zendesk2.${DomainName}
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - mail2.zendesk.com

  ZendeskMail3Record:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub zendesk3.${DomainName}
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - mail3.zendesk.com

  ZendeskMail4Record:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub zendesk4.${DomainName}
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - mail4.zendesk.com

  SupportCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub support.${DomainName}
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref ZendeskSubdomain

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # MailChimp
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MailChimpDkimRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub k1._domainkey.${DomainName}
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - dkim.mcsv.net

  MailChimpDkim2Record:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub k2._domainkey.${DomainName}
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - dkim2.mcsv.net

  MailChimpDkim3Record:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub k3._domainkey.${DomainName}
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - dkim3.mcsv.net

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Squarespace
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SquarespaceVerificationRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub ${SquarespaceVerificationName}.${DomainName}
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - verify.squarespace.com

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Campaign Monitor
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CampaignMonitorDkimRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub cm._domainkey.${DomainName}
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${CampaignMonitorDkimPublicKey}"'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Google Workspace
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GoogleDkimRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub google._domainkey.${DomainName}
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${GoogleDkimPublicKey}"'

  GoogleMailCnameRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub mail.${DomainName}
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '300'
      ResourceRecords:
        - ghs.googlehosted.com

Outputs:
  HostedZoneId:
    Description: ID of the radiotopia.fm public hosted zone.
    Value: !Ref HostedZone
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-HostedZoneId
  NameServers:
    Description: Name servers to configure at the domain registrar.
    Value: !Join [',', !GetAtt HostedZone.NameServers]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway (MCP) for a protein variant effect prediction agent.
  Resolves existing Lambda backend and Cognito authentication configuration from SSM
  Parameter Store, creates the gateway execution role, the gateway with a custom JWT
  authorizer, and a Lambda-backed gateway target with an inline MCP tool schema.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    Description: Project name used for resource naming and SSM parameter path prefixes.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with an alphanumeric character and contain only alphanumerics and hyphens.

  GatewayDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: AgentCore MCP Gateway for protein variant effect prediction tools
    Description: Description for the AgentCore Gateway.

  GatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional gateway name. If left blank, defaults to <ProjectName>-gateway.
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^([0-9a-zA-Z][-]?){1,100}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be blank or contain only alphanumerics and single hyphens (max 100 characters).

Conditions:
  HasGatewayName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GatewayName, '']]

Resources:
  GatewayExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agentcore-gateway-role-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: Execution role assumed by Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway to invoke the backend Lambda function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeGatewayTargetLambda
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: InvokeBackendLambda
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !Sub '{{resolve:ssm:/${ProjectName}/lambda/arn}}'
                  - !Sub '{{resolve:ssm:/${ProjectName}/lambda/arn}}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  GatewayExecutionRoleArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore/gateway-role-arn'
      Description: ARN of the IAM role used by the AgentCore Gateway.
      Type: String
      Tier: Standard
      Value: !GetAtt GatewayExecutionRole.Arn
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  AgentCoreGateway:
    Type: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::Gateway
    Properties:
      Name: !If
        - HasGatewayName
        - !Ref GatewayName
        - !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway'
      Description: !Ref GatewayDescription
      RoleArn: !GetAtt GatewayExecutionRole.Arn
      ProtocolType: MCP
      ProtocolConfiguration:
        Mcp:
          SupportedVersions:
            - '2025-03-26'
          SearchType: SEMANTIC
      AuthorizerType: CUSTOM_JWT
      AuthorizerConfiguration:
        CustomJWTAuthorizer:
          DiscoveryUrl: !Sub '{{resolve:ssm:/${ProjectName}/cognito/discovery-url}}'
          AllowedClients:
            - !Sub '{{resolve:ssm:/${ProjectName}/cognito/client-id}}'
      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  AgentCoreGatewayTarget:
    Type: AWS::BedrockAgentCore::GatewayTarget
    Properties:
      GatewayIdentifier: !GetAtt AgentCoreGateway.GatewayIdentifier
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-lambda-target'
      Description: Lambda target exposing protein variant effect prediction tools over MCP.
      CredentialProviderConfigurations:
        - CredentialProviderType: GATEWAY_IAM_ROLE
      TargetConfiguration:
        Mcp:
          Lambda:
            LambdaArn: !Sub '{{resolve:ssm:/${ProjectName}/lambda/arn}}'
            ToolSchema:
              InlinePayload:
                - Name: invoke_endpoint
                  Description: >-
                    Submit a protein sequence (and optional list of variants) for variant effect
                    prediction. Starts an asynchronous inference job and returns a job identifier
                    and output location that can be polled with get_results.
                  InputSchema:
                    Type: object
                    Properties:
                      sequence:
                        Type: string
                        Description: Wild-type protein amino acid sequence in single-letter code.
                      variants:
                        Type: array
                        Description: Optional list of variants to score, e.g. A123G.
                        Items:
                          Type: string
                      model_name:
                        Type: string
                        Description: Optional identifier of the prediction model or endpoint to use.
                    Required:
                      - sequence
                - Name: get_results
                  Description: >-
                    Check the status of a previously submitted variant effect prediction job and
                    return the results when the job has completed.
                  InputSchema:
                    Type: object
                    Properties:
                      job_id:
                        Type: string
                        Description: Job identifier returned by invoke_endpoint.
                      output_location:
                        Type: string
                        Description: Optional output location (e.g. S3 URI) returned by invoke_endpoint.
                    Required:
                      - job_id

Outputs:
  GatewayId:
    Description: Identifier of the AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !GetAtt AgentCoreGateway.GatewayIdentifier
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GatewayId'

  GatewayArn:
    Description: ARN of the AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !GetAtt AgentCoreGateway.GatewayArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GatewayArn'

  GatewayUrl:
    Description: MCP endpoint URL of the AgentCore Gateway.
    Value: !GetAtt AgentCoreGateway.GatewayUrl
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GatewayUrl'

  GatewayTargetId:
    Description: Identifier of the Lambda gateway target.
    Value: !GetAtt AgentCoreGatewayTarget.TargetId

  GatewayExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the AgentCore Gateway execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt GatewayExecutionRole.Arn

  GatewayExecutionRoleArnParameterName:
    Description: SSM parameter storing the gateway execution role ARN.
    Value: !Ref GatewayExecutionRoleArnParameter
