AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Private VPC infrastructure with three private subnets (two for an Application Load Balancer
  across AZs and one for Lambda functions), optional NAT Gateway internet egress for OAuth and
  external identity provider flows, and a customer-managed KMS key for an encrypted artifact bucket.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Network Configuration
        Parameters:
          - VpcCidr
          - PrivateSubnetAlb1Cidr
          - PrivateSubnetAlb2Cidr
          - PrivateSubnetLambdaCidr
      - Label:
          default: Internet Egress
        Parameters:
          - EnableNatGateway
          - PublicSubnetCidr
      - Label:
          default: General
        Parameters:
          - EnvironmentName

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: private-app
    Description: Name prefix applied to resource tags.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'

  PrivateSubnetAlb1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the first private ALB subnet (AZ 1).
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'

  PrivateSubnetAlb2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the second private ALB subnet (AZ 2).
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'

  PrivateSubnetLambdaCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the private Lambda subnet.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'

  EnableNatGateway:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: >-
      Set to true to create a NAT Gateway (with a small public subnet and Internet Gateway)
      to allow outbound internet egress for OAuth / external identity provider flows.

  PublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/28
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet hosting the NAT Gateway (used only when EnableNatGateway is true).
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'

Conditions:
  CreateNatGateway: !Equals [!Ref EnableNatGateway, 'true']

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateSubnetAlb1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetAlb1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-alb-1'

  PrivateSubnetAlb2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetAlb2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-alb-2'

  PrivateSubnetLambda:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnetLambdaCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-lambda'

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt'

  PrivateSubnetAlb1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetAlb1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnetAlb2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetAlb2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnetLambdaRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetLambda
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Optional internet egress (NAT Gateway)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-nat'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatGatewayEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip'

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat'

  PrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS key and artifact bucket
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ArtifactKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer-managed key for ${EnvironmentName} artifact bucket encryption'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3UseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-artifact-key'

  ArtifactKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentName}-artifacts'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref ArtifactKmsKey

  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt ArtifactKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-artifacts'

  ArtifactBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ArtifactBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC.
    Value: !Ref Vpc
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  VpcCidrBlock:
    Description: CIDR block of the VPC.
    Value: !GetAtt Vpc.CidrBlock
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcCidr'

  PrivateSubnetAlb1Id:
    Description: ID of the first private ALB subnet.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnetAlb1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetAlb1'

  PrivateSubnetAlb2Id:
    Description: ID of the second private ALB subnet.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnetAlb2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetAlb2'

  AlbSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of the private ALB subnet IDs.
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateSubnetAlb1, !Ref PrivateSubnetAlb2]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AlbSubnetIds'

  PrivateSubnetLambdaId:
    Description: ID of the private Lambda subnet.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnetLambda
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetLambda'

  PrivateRouteTableId:
    Description: ID of the private route table.
    Value: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTable'

  NatGatewayId:
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Description: ID of the NAT Gateway (only when egress is enabled).
    Value: !Ref NatGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NatGatewayId'

  ArtifactKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key for artifact encryption.
    Value: !GetAtt ArtifactKmsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ArtifactKmsKeyArn'

  ArtifactBucketName:
    Description: Name of the encrypted artifact bucket.
    Value: !Ref ArtifactBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ArtifactBucketName'

  ArtifactBucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the encrypted artifact bucket.
    Value: !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ArtifactBucketArn'

              Service: !Sub states.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /

  PassStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: |
        {
          "Comment": "Simple two-step Pass workflow",
          "StartAt": "FirstPass",
          "States": {
            "FirstPass": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": { "step": "first" },
              "ResultPath": "$.first",
              "Next": "SecondPass"
            },
            "SecondPass": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": { "step": "second" },
              "ResultPath": "$.second",
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }

  GetApiRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: GetApiStartExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref PassStateMachine

  PostApiRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PostApiStartExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref PassStateMachine

  GetRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-get-api
      Description: REST API exposing a GET endpoint that starts the state machine.
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  GetExecutionResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetRestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt GetRestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: execution

  GetExecutionMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref GetExecutionResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution
        Credentials: !GetAtt GetApiRole.Arn
        PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            #set($params = $input.params().querystring)
            {
              "stateMachineArn": "${PassStateMachine}",
              "input": "{#foreach($key in $params.keySet())\"$util.escapeJavaScript($key)\": \"$util.escapeJavaScript($params.get($key))\"#if($foreach.hasNext),#end#end}"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''
          - StatusCode: '400'
            SelectionPattern: '4\d{2}'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
        - StatusCode: '400'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Error

  GetApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - GetExecutionMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetRestApi
      Description: Deployment for the GET REST API.

  GetApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetRestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref GetApiDeployment
      StageName: !Ref GetApiStageName
      Description: Stage for the GET REST API.

  PostRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-post-api
      Description: REST API exposing a POST endpoint that starts the state machine.
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  PostExecutionResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostRestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt PostRestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: execution

  PostExecutionMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref PostExecutionResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution
        Credentials: !GetAtt PostApiRole.Arn
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_TEMPLATES
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "stateMachineArn": "${PassStateMachine}",
              "input": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.json('$'))"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''
          - StatusCode: '400'
            SelectionPattern: '4\d{2}'
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
        - StatusCode: '400'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Error

  PostApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - PostExecutionMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostRestApi
      Description: Deployment for the POST REST API.

  PostApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostRestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref PostApiDeployment
      StageName: !Ref PostApiStageName
      Description: Stage for the POST REST API.

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the two-step Pass state machine.
    Value: !Ref PassStateMachine
  GetApiEndpoint:
    Description: Invoke URL for the GET endpoint.
    Value: !Sub https://${GetRestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${GetApiStage}/execution
  PostApiEndpoint:
    Description: Invoke URL for the POST endpoint.
    Value: !Sub https://${PostRestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${PostApiStage}/execution

    Value: !GetAtt GetApiRole.Arn
  PostApiRoleArn:
    Description: IAM role used by the POST API to start executions.
    Value: !GetAtt PostApiRole.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Hospitality Insights - Foundation IAM roles (Lambda microservices and Bedrock AgentCore runtime)
  and Secrets Manager placeholders.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: hospitality-insights
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    Description: Project name used for resource naming and tagging.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Secrets Manager placeholders
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SecretsPrefixSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}/${Environment}/_prefix'
      Description: !Sub 'Placeholder secret establishing the ${ProjectName}/${Environment}/ naming prefix.'
      SecretString: '{"purpose":"namespace-placeholder"}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ScrapingBeeApiKeySecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}/${Environment}/scrapingbee-api-key'
      Description: ScrapingBee API key used by the scraper microservice. Replace the placeholder value after deployment.
      SecretString: '{"api_key":"REPLACE_ME"}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Scraper Lambda role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ScraperLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-scraper-lambda-role'
      Description: Execution role for the scraper Lambda microservice.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: scraper-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DynamoDBReadWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-properties'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-properties/index/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-reviews'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-reviews/index/*'
              - Sid: ConsumeScrapeQueue
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                  - sqs:DeleteMessage
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                  - sqs:ChangeMessageVisibility
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-scrape-jobs'
              - Sid: PublishAnalysisQueue
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:SendMessage
                  - sqs:GetQueueUrl
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-analysis-jobs'
              - Sid: RawDataBucketWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-raw*/*'
              - Sid: ReadProjectSecrets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Analysis Lambda role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AnalysisLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-analysis-lambda-role'
      Description: Execution role for the analysis Lambda microservice (Comprehend and Bedrock).
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: analysis-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadReviews
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-reviews'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-reviews/index/*'
              - Sid: WriteAnalysis
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-analysis'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-analysis/index/*'
              - Sid: ConsumeAnalysisQueue
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                  - sqs:DeleteMessage
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                  - sqs:ChangeMessageVisibility
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-analysis-jobs'
              - Sid: PublishAlertsQueue
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:SendMessage
                  - sqs:GetQueueUrl
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-alerts'
              - Sid: ComprehendDetect
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - comprehend:DetectSentiment
                  - comprehend:BatchDetectSentiment
                  - comprehend:DetectTargetedSentiment
                  - comprehend:BatchDetectTargetedSentiment
                  - comprehend:DetectKeyPhrases
                  - comprehend:BatchDetectKeyPhrases
                  - comprehend:DetectEntities
                  - comprehend:BatchDetectEntities
                  - comprehend:DetectDominantLanguage
                  - comprehend:BatchDetectDominantLanguage
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: BedrockInvoke
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                  - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:*::foundation-model/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:*:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/*'
              - Sid: RawDataBucketRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-raw*/*'
              - Sid: ReadProjectSecrets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Alerts Lambda role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AlertsLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-alerts-lambda-role'
      Description: Execution role for the alerts Lambda microservice.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: alerts-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AlertsTablesReadWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-alerts'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-alerts/index/*'
              - Sid: SubscriptionsRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-subscriptions'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-subscriptions/index/*'
              - Sid: ConsumeAlertsQueue
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                  - sqs:DeleteMessage
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                  - sqs:ChangeMessageVisibility
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-alerts'
              - Sid: PublishAlertTopics
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sns:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
              - Sid: ReadProjectSecrets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # API Lambda role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApiLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-api-lambda-role'
      Description: Execution role for the public API Lambda microservice (read-mostly).
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: api-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DynamoDBRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-properties'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-properties/index/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-reviews'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-reviews/index/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-analysis'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-analysis/index/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-alerts'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-alerts/index/*'
              - Sid: SubscriptionsReadWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-subscriptions'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-subscriptions/index/*'
              - Sid: EnqueueScrapeJobs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:SendMessage
                  - sqs:GetQueueUrl
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-scrape-jobs'
              - Sid: ReportsBucketRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-reports*/*'
              - Sid: ReadProjectSecrets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Admin Lambda role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdminLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-admin-lambda-role'
      Description: Execution role for the admin Lambda microservice (operational management).
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: admin-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DynamoDBProjectTablesCrud
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*/index/*'
              - Sid: QueueManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:SendMessage
                  - sqs:GetQueueUrl
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                  - sqs:PurgeQueue
                  - sqs:StartMessageMoveTask
                  - sqs:ListMessageMoveTasks
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
              - Sid: TopicManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                  - sns:Subscribe
                  - sns:Unsubscribe
                  - sns:ListSubscriptionsByTopic
                  - sns:GetTopicAttributes
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sns:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'

                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                  - states:StopExecution

                  - states:ListExecutions

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  SQS queue for audit events with KMS encryption (key rotation enabled), an optional
  dead letter queue for non-dev environments, CloudWatch alarms for message age and
  DLQ activity, and SNS notifications for alarms.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: General
        Parameters:
          - Environment
          - QueueNamePrefix
      - Label:
          default: Dead Letter Queue
        Parameters:
          - MaxReceiveCount
      - Label:
          default: Alerting
        Parameters:
          - AlertEmail

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Deployment environment. The dead letter queue is created only in non-dev environments.
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Default: dev

  QueueNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Prefix used for naming the audit event queues.
    Default: audit-events
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,50}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-50 characters of alphanumerics, hyphens, or underscores.

  MaxReceiveCount:
    Type: Number
    Description: Number of receive attempts before a message is moved to the dead letter queue.
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 1000

  AlertEmail:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional email address to subscribe to alarm notifications. Leave blank to skip.
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid email address or empty.

Mappings:
  EnvironmentConfig:
    dev:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 345600        # 4 days
      VisibilityTimeout: 30
      OldestMessageAgeThreshold: 3600       # 1 hour
      AlarmEvaluationPeriods: 3
    staging:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 604800        # 7 days
      VisibilityTimeout: 60
      OldestMessageAgeThreshold: 1800       # 30 minutes
      AlarmEvaluationPeriods: 2
    prod:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600       # 14 days
      VisibilityTimeout: 120
      OldestMessageAgeThreshold: 900        # 15 minutes
      AlarmEvaluationPeriods: 1

Conditions:
  IsNotDev: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Environment, dev]]
  HasAlertEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlertEmail, '']]

Resources:
  AuditEventsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS key for ${QueueNamePrefix} SQS queues and alarm topic (${Environment})'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      PendingWindowInDays: 30
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSQSUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AllowSNSUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsToPublishToEncryptedTopic
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: audit-events

  AuditEventsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${QueueNamePrefix}-${Environment}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref AuditEventsKey

  AuditEventsDeadLetterQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${QueueNamePrefix}-${Environment}-dlq'
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditEventsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: audit-events-dlq

  AuditEventsQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${QueueNamePrefix}-${Environment}'
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, MessageRetentionPeriod]
      VisibilityTimeout: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, VisibilityTimeout]
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditEventsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      RedrivePolicy: !If
        - IsNotDev
        - deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt AuditEventsDeadLetterQueue.Arn
          maxReceiveCount: !Ref MaxReceiveCount
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: audit-events

  AuditEventsQueuePolicy:
    Type: AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy
    Properties:
      Queues: !If
        - IsNotDev
        - - !Ref AuditEventsQueue
          - !Ref AuditEventsDeadLetterQueue
        - - !Ref AuditEventsQueue
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 'sqs:*'
            Resource: !If
              - IsNotDev
              - - !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.Arn
                - !GetAtt AuditEventsDeadLetterQueue.Arn
              - - !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.Arn
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  AlarmNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${QueueNamePrefix}-${Environment}-alarms'
      DisplayName: !Sub 'Audit Events Alarms (${Environment})'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AuditEventsKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: audit-events-alarms

  AlarmNotificationTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsToPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  AlarmEmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasAlertEmail
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref AlertEmail

  OldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${QueueNamePrefix}-${Environment}-oldest-message-age'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub
        - 'Oldest message in ${QueueName} has exceeded ${Threshold} seconds; consumers may be stalled.'
        - QueueName: !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.QueueName
          Threshold: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, OldestMessageAgeThreshold]
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, AlarmEvaluationPeriods]
      Threshold: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, OldestMessageAgeThreshold]
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic

  DeadLetterQueueMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${QueueNamePrefix}-${Environment}-dlq-messages-visible'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub
        - 'Messages are present in dead letter queue ${QueueName}; audit events failed processing.'
        - QueueName: !GetAtt AuditEventsDeadLetterQueue.QueueName
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsDeadLetterQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic

Outputs:
  AuditEventsQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the audit events queue.
    Value: !Ref AuditEventsQueue
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AuditEventsQueueUrl'

  AuditEventsQueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the audit events queue.
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsQueue.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AuditEventsQueueArn'

  AuditEventsDeadLetterQueueUrl:
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Description: URL of the audit events dead letter queue.
    Value: !Ref AuditEventsDeadLetterQueue
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AuditEventsDLQUrl'

  AuditEventsDeadLetterQueueArn:
    Condition: IsNotDev
    Description: ARN of the audit events dead letter queue.
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsDeadLetterQueue.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AuditEventsDLQArn'

  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key used to encrypt the queues and alarm topic.
    Value: !GetAtt AuditEventsKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KmsKeyArn'

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Description: Alias of the KMS key.
    Value: !Ref AuditEventsKeyAlias

  AlarmNotificationTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the SNS topic receiving alarm notifications.
    Value: !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AlarmTopicArn'

    Default: TemplateMachineClient
    Description: Name of the machine-to-machine app client
  WebAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateWebClient
    Description: Name of the web app client

Mappings:
  Config:
    ResourceServer:
      Identifier: researchapp-agentcore
      Name: ResearchAppAgentCoreResourceServer
      ReadScope: read

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: researchapp
        Component: AgentCore

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      Description: Administrators with elevated privileges
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  CustomerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: customer
      Description: Standard customer users
      Precedence: 2
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub researchapp-agentcore-${AWS::AccountId}
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: !FindInMap [Config, ResourceServer, Identifier]
      Name: !FindInMap [Config, ResourceServer, Name]
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: !FindInMap [Config, ResourceServer, ReadScope]
          ScopeDescription: Read access to researchapp AgentCore resources

  WebAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref WebAppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
        - !Sub
          - ${Identifier}/${Scope}
          - Identifier: !FindInMap [Config, ResourceServer, Identifier]
            Scope: !FindInMap [Config, ResourceServer, ReadScope]
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:8501/
        - https://example.com/auth/callback
      LogoutURLs:
        - http://localhost:8501/
        - https://example.com/
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true

  MachineAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref MachineAppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub
          - ${Identifier}/${Scope}
          - Identifier: !FindInMap [Config, ResourceServer, Identifier]
            Scope: !FindInMap [Config, ResourceServer, ReadScope]
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true

  AddToCustomerGroupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoAddUserToGroup
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  AddToCustomerGroupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Adds newly confirmed users to the customer group (not wired as an active trigger)
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 10
      Role: !GetAtt AddToCustomerGroupRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          DEFAULT_GROUP: customer
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import boto3

          cognito = boto3.client("cognito-idp")

          def handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = event["userPoolId"]
              username = event["userName"]
              group_name = os.environ.get("DEFAULT_GROUP", "customer")
              cognito.admin_add_user_to_group(
                  UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                  Username=username,
                  GroupName=group_name,
              )
              return event

  AddToCustomerGroupPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt AddToCustomerGroupFunction.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  UserPoolIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/userpool_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPool
      Description: Cognito User Pool ID

  UserPoolArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/userpool_arn
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
      Description: Cognito User Pool ARN

  WebClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/web_client_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref WebAppClient
      Description: Web app client ID

  MachineClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/machine_client_id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref MachineAppClient
      Description: Machine-to-machine app client ID

  MachineClientSecretParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/machine_client_secret
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt MachineAppClient.ClientSecret
      Description: Machine-to-machine app client secret

  CognitoAuthScopeParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/cognito_auth_scope
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub
        - ${Identifier}/${Scope}
        - Identifier: !FindInMap [Config, ResourceServer, Identifier]
          Scope: !FindInMap [Config, ResourceServer, ReadScope]
      Description: Custom resource server OAuth scope

  WebClientScopesParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/web_client_scopes
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub
        - openid email profile ${Identifier}/${Scope}
        - Identifier: !FindInMap [Config, ResourceServer, Identifier]
          Scope: !FindInMap [Config, ResourceServer, ReadScope]
      Description: OAuth scopes for the web app client (space separated)

  CognitoDiscoveryUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/cognito_discovery_url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration
      Description: OpenID Connect discovery URL

  CognitoDomainParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    DependsOn: UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/cognito_domain
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub https://researchapp-agentcore-${AWS::AccountId}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com
      Description: Cognito hosted UI domain

  CognitoTokenUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    DependsOn: UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/cognito_token_url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub https://researchapp-agentcore-${AWS::AccountId}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token
      Description: Cognito OAuth2 token endpoint

  CognitoAuthorizeUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    DependsOn: UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/cognito_authorize_url
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub https://researchapp-agentcore-${AWS::AccountId}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize
      Description: Cognito OAuth2 authorize endpoint

  WebCallbackUrlsParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/web_callback_urls
      Type: StringList
      Value: http://localhost:8501/,https://example.com/auth/callback
      Description: Web app client callback URLs

  AddToGroupFunctionArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/add_to_group_lambda_arn
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt AddToCustomerGroupFunction.Arn
      Description: ARN of the Lambda that adds users to the customer group (not wired as trigger)

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  WebAppClientId:
    Value: !Ref WebAppClient
  MachineAppClientId:
    Value: !Ref MachineAppClient
  CognitoDomain:
    Value: !Sub https://researchapp-agentcore-${AWS::AccountId}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com
  DiscoveryUrl:
    Value: !Sub https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration
  AddToCustomerGroupFunctionArn:
    Value: !GetAtt AddToCustomerGroupFunction.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AWS Elemental MediaPackage live streaming channel with HLS and/or DASH origin
  endpoints, optional live-to-VOD archive support, optional VOD packaging
  workflows, and the IAM role MediaPackage needs to access the S3 buckets.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: General
        Parameters:
          - NamePrefix
          - Environment
          - CustomTagKey
          - CustomTagValue
      - Label:
          default: Live Packaging
        Parameters:
          - OutputType
          - ManifestName
          - SegmentDurationSeconds
          - StartoverWindowSeconds
      - Label:
          default: VOD and Live-to-VOD
        Parameters:
          - ArchiveBucket
          - VodSourceBucket
          - VodSourceObjectKey

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: live
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,39}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 1-40 characters; letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores only.
    Description: Logical name prefix used when naming resources.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Environment name applied as a tag to all taggable resources.

  CustomTagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional custom tag key. Leave blank to skip the custom tag.

  CustomTagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Value for the optional custom tag.

  OutputType:
    Type: String
    Default: APPLE_HLS
    AllowedValues:
      - APPLE_HLS
      - ISO_DASH
      - ALL
    Description: Which origin endpoint types to create.

  ManifestName:
    Type: String
    Default: index
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores only.
    Description: Manifest name used by the origin endpoints and VOD packaging configurations.

  SegmentDurationSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 30
    Description: Segment duration in seconds for HLS output (DASH is fixed at 2 seconds).

  StartoverWindowSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 86400
    MinValue: 0
    MaxValue: 1209600
    Description: Startover window in seconds (0 disables startover).

  ArchiveBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be blank or a valid S3 bucket name.
    Description: >-
      Optional S3 bucket for live-to-VOD archives (harvest jobs). When supplied,
      origin endpoint origination is set to DENY.

  VodSourceBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be blank or a valid S3 bucket name.
    Description: Optional S3 bucket containing VOD source content. When supplied, VOD packaging resources are created.

  VodSourceObjectKey:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional key of a VOD source manifest (e.g. .smil or .m3u8) in VodSourceBucket.
      When supplied together with VodSourceBucket, a MediaPackage VOD asset is created.

Conditions:
  HasArchiveBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ArchiveBucket, '']]
  HasVodSourceBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VodSourceBucket, '']]
  HasVodSourceObjectKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VodSourceObjectKey, '']]
  CreateVodAsset: !And
    - !Condition HasVodSourceBucket
    - !Condition HasVodSourceObjectKey
  CreateS3AccessRole: !Or
    - !Condition HasArchiveBucket
    - !Condition HasVodSourceBucket
  HasCustomTag: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CustomTagKey, '']]
  CreateHls: !Or
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, APPLE_HLS]
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ALL]
  CreateDash: !Or
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ISO_DASH]
    - !Equals [!Ref OutputType, ALL]
  CreateVodHls: !And
    - !Condition HasVodSourceBucket
    - !Condition CreateHls
  CreateVodDash: !And
    - !Condition HasVodSourceBucket
    - !Condition CreateDash

Resources:
  MediaPackageChannel:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::Channel
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-channel'
      Description: !Sub 'Live channel for ${NamePrefix} (${Environment})'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-channel'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  HlsOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Condition: CreateHls
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-hls'
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      Description: !Sub 'HLS origin endpoint for ${NamePrefix} (${Environment})'
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      TimeDelaySeconds: 0
      Origination: !If [HasArchiveBucket, DENY, ALLOW]
      HlsPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref SegmentDurationSeconds
        PlaylistType: EVENT
        PlaylistWindowSeconds: 60
        ProgramDateTimeIntervalSeconds: 0
        IncludeIframeOnlyStream: false
        UseAudioRenditionGroup: false
        AdMarkers: NONE
        StreamSelection:
          StreamOrder: ORIGINAL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-hls'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  DashOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackage::OriginEndpoint
    Condition: CreateDash
    Properties:
      Id: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-dash'
      ChannelId: !Ref MediaPackageChannel
      Description: !Sub 'DASH origin endpoint for ${NamePrefix} (${Environment})'
      ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      TimeDelaySeconds: 0
      Origination: !If [HasArchiveBucket, DENY, ALLOW]
      DashPackage:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
        ManifestWindowSeconds: 60
        MinBufferTimeSeconds: 30
        MinUpdatePeriodSeconds: 15
        SuggestedPresentationDelaySeconds: 25
        Profile: NONE
        SegmentTemplateFormat: NUMBER_WITH_TIMELINE
        ManifestLayout: FULL
        StreamSelection:
          StreamOrder: ORIGINAL
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-dash'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  MediaPackageS3AccessRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: CreateS3AccessRole
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-mediapackage-s3-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: Allows AWS Elemental MediaPackage to read VOD sources and write live-to-VOD archives.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: mediapackage.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MediaPackageS3Access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - !If
                - HasVodSourceBucket
                - Sid: VodSourceObjectRead
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:GetObject
                  Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${VodSourceBucket}/*'
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - !If
                - HasVodSourceBucket
                - Sid: VodSourceBucketRead
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:ListBucket
                    - s3:GetBucketLocation
                    - s3:GetBucketRequestPayment
                  Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${VodSourceBucket}'
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - !If
                - HasArchiveBucket
                - Sid: ArchiveObjectWrite
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:PutObject
                    - s3:GetObject
                  Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ArchiveBucket}/*'
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - !If
                - HasArchiveBucket
                - Sid: ArchiveBucketAccess
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:ListBucket
                    - s3:GetBucketLocation
