AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  DynamoDB table with a configurable partition key and optional sort key, PROVISIONED or
  PAY_PER_REQUEST billing, point-in-time recovery, optional customer-managed KMS encryption,
  and optional CloudWatch alarms for throttling and system errors that publish to SNS.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Table
        Parameters:
          - TableName
          - PartitionKeyName
          - PartitionKeyType
          - SortKeyName
          - SortKeyType
      - Label:
          default: Capacity
        Parameters:
          - BillingMode
          - ReadCapacityUnits
          - WriteCapacityUnits
      - Label:
          default: Data Protection
        Parameters:
          - EnablePointInTimeRecovery
          - EnableKmsEncryption
          - KmsKeyArn
      - Label:
          default: Alerting
        Parameters:
          - EnableAlarms
          - AlarmSnsTopicArn
          - AlarmEmail
          - ThrottleThreshold
          - SystemErrorThreshold
          - AlarmPeriod
          - AlarmEvaluationPeriods
    ParameterLabels:
      SortKeyName:
        default: Sort key name (leave empty for no sort key)
      KmsKeyArn:
        default: Existing KMS key ARN (leave empty to create a new key)
      AlarmSnsTopicArn:
        default: Existing SNS topic ARN (leave empty to create a new topic)

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Name of the table. Leave empty to let CloudFormation generate a unique name.
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{3,255}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or 3-255 characters of a-z, A-Z, 0-9, underscore, period, or hyphen.

  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: id
    Description: Attribute name of the partition (hash) key.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{1,255}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-255 characters of a-z, A-Z, 0-9, underscore, period, or hyphen.

  PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
    Description: Attribute type of the partition key (S = String, N = Number, B = Binary).

  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Attribute name of the optional sort (range) key. Leave empty to create a table without a sort key.
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{1,255}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or 1-255 characters of a-z, A-Z, 0-9, underscore, period, or hyphen.

  SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: N
    AllowedValues:
      - S
      - N
      - B
    Description: Attribute type of the sort key (ignored when no sort key name is provided).

  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Default: PROVISIONED
    AllowedValues:
      - PROVISIONED
      - PAY_PER_REQUEST
    Description: PROVISIONED for fixed capacity, PAY_PER_REQUEST for on-demand.

  ReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Provisioned read capacity units (ignored when BillingMode is PAY_PER_REQUEST).

  WriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Provisioned write capacity units (ignored when BillingMode is PAY_PER_REQUEST).

  EnablePointInTimeRecovery:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Enable point-in-time recovery for continuous backups.

  EnableKmsEncryption:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: >-
      Encrypt the table with a customer-managed KMS key. When false, DynamoDB uses its default
      AWS owned key encryption.

  KmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      ARN of an existing customer-managed KMS key. Leave empty to have this stack create a key
      (only used when EnableKmsEncryption is true).
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:kms:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:key/[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid KMS key ARN.

  EnableAlarms:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Create CloudWatch alarms for throttling and system errors.

  AlarmSnsTopicArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      ARN of an existing SNS topic for alarm notifications. Leave empty to have this stack create
      a topic (only used when EnableAlarms is true).
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:sns:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+(\.fifo)?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid SNS topic ARN.

  AlarmEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional email address to subscribe to the stack-created alarm topic (ignored when an
      existing topic ARN is supplied).
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid email address.

  ThrottleThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Number of read or write throttle events per period that triggers an alarm.

  SystemErrorThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Number of DynamoDB system errors (HTTP 500) per period that triggers an alarm.

  AlarmPeriod:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    AllowedValues:
      - 60
      - 300
      - 900
      - 3600
    Description: Alarm evaluation period in seconds.

  AlarmEvaluationPeriods:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Number of consecutive periods that must breach the threshold before alarming.

Conditions:
  HasTableName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TableName, '']]
  HasSortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SortKeyName, '']]
  IsProvisioned: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, PROVISIONED]
  EnablePITR: !Equals [!Ref EnablePointInTimeRecovery, 'true']
  UseKms: !Equals [!Ref EnableKmsEncryption, 'true']
  HasKmsKeyArn: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KmsKeyArn, '']]
  CreateKmsKey: !And
    - !Condition UseKms
    - !Not [!Condition HasKmsKeyArn]
  CreateAlarms: !Equals [!Ref EnableAlarms, 'true']
  HasExternalTopic: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmSnsTopicArn, '']]
  CreateAlarmTopic: !And
    - !Condition CreateAlarms
    - !Not [!Condition HasExternalTopic]
  CreateAlarmEmailSubscription: !And
    - !Condition CreateAlarmTopic
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmEmail, '']]

Resources:
  TableKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: CreateKmsKey
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub Customer-managed key for DynamoDB table in stack ${AWS::StackName}
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowDynamoDBUseViaService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: '*'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
                kms:ViaService: !Sub dynamodb.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com

  TableKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: CreateKmsKey
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${AWS::StackName}-dynamodb
      TargetKeyId: !Ref TableKmsKey

  Table:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !If [HasTableName, !Ref TableName, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      AttributeDefinitions: !If
        - HasSortKey
        - - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
        - - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
      KeySchema: !If
        - HasSortKey
        - - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            KeyType: HASH
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            KeyType: RANGE
        - - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - IsProvisioned
        - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
          WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: !If [EnablePITR, true, false]
      SSESpecification: !If
        - UseKms
        - SSEEnabled: true
          SSEType: KMS
          KMSMasterKeyId: !If [HasKmsKeyArn, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !GetAtt TableKmsKey.Arn]
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Tags:
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Condition: CreateAlarmTopic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub DynamoDB alarms for ${AWS::StackName}

  AlarmTopicEmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: CreateAlarmEmailSubscription
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref AlarmTopic
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref AlarmEmail

  ReadThrottleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: !Sub Read throttle events detected on DynamoDB table ${Table}
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ReadThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref Table
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: !Ref AlarmPeriod
      EvaluationPeriods: !Ref AlarmEvaluationPeriods
      Threshold: !Ref ThrottleThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !If [HasExternalTopic, !Ref AlarmSnsTopicArn, !Ref AlarmTopic]
      OKActions:
        - !If [HasExternalTopic, !Ref AlarmSnsTopicArn, !Ref AlarmTopic]

  WriteThrottleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: !Sub Write throttle events detected on DynamoDB table ${Table}
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: WriteThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref Table
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: !Ref AlarmPeriod
      EvaluationPeriods: !Ref AlarmEvaluationPeriods
      Threshold: !Ref ThrottleThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !If [HasExternalTopic, !Ref AlarmSnsTopicArn, !Ref AlarmTopic]
      OKActions:
        - !If [HasExternalTopic, !Ref AlarmSnsTopicArn, !Ref AlarmTopic]

  SystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: !Sub DynamoDB system errors (HTTP 500) detected on table ${Table} across common operations
      EvaluationPeriods: !Ref AlarmEvaluationPeriods
      Threshold: !Ref SystemErrorThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !If [HasExternalTopic, !Ref AlarmSnsTopicArn, !Ref AlarmTopic]
      OKActions:
        - !If [HasExternalTopic, !Ref AlarmSnsTopicArn, !Ref AlarmTopic]
      Metrics:
        - Id: totalerrors
          Label: SystemErrorsTotal
          Expression: SUM([FILL(getitem,0),FILL(putitem,0),FILL(updateitem,0),FILL(deleteitem,0),FILL(query,0),FILL(scan,0),FILL(batchget,0),FILL(batchwrite,0)])
          ReturnData: true
        - Id: getitem
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: SystemErrors
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref Table
                - Name: Operation
                  Value: GetItem
            Period: !Ref AlarmPeriod
            Stat: Sum
        - Id: putitem
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: SystemErrors
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref Table
                - Name: Operation
                  Value: PutItem
            Period: !Ref AlarmPeriod
            Stat: Sum
        - Id: updateitem
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: SystemErrors
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref Table
                - Name: Operation
                  Value: UpdateItem
            Period: !Ref AlarmPeriod
            Stat: Sum
        - Id: deleteitem
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: SystemErrors
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref Table
                - Name: Operation
                  Value: DeleteItem
            Period: !Ref AlarmPeriod
            Stat: Sum
        - Id: query
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: SystemErrors
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref Table
                - Name: Operation
                  Value: Query
            Period: !Ref AlarmPeriod
            Stat: Sum
        - Id: scan
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: SystemErrors
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref Table
                - Name: Operation
                  Value: Scan
            Period: !Ref AlarmPeriod
            Stat: Sum
        - Id: batchget
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: SystemErrors
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref Table
                - Name: Operation
                  Value: BatchGetItem
            Period: !Ref AlarmPeriod
            Stat: Sum
        - Id: batchwrite
          ReturnData: false
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
              MetricName: SystemErrors
              Dimensions:
                - Name: TableName
                  Value: !Ref Table
                - Name: Operation
                  Value: BatchWriteItem
            Period: !Ref AlarmPeriod
            Stat: Sum

Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref Table
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-TableName

  TableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table.
    Value: !GetAtt Table.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-TableArn

  KmsKeyArn:
    Condition: UseKms
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key encrypting the table.
    Value: !If [HasKmsKeyArn, !Ref KmsKeyArn, !GetAtt TableKmsKey.Arn]

  AlarmTopicArn:
    Condition: CreateAlarms
    Description: ARN of the SNS topic receiving alarm notifications.
    Value: !If [HasExternalTopic, !Ref AlarmSnsTopicArn, !Ref AlarmTopic]
all_security_errors: [AWS-0095] HIGH: Unencrypted SNS topic. — Topic does not have encryption enabled.
latest_error_trivy: [AWS-0095] HIGH: Unencrypted SNS topic. — Topic does not have encryption enabled.

final_template:
# EC2 Image Builder pipeline: custom Amazon Linux 2023 AMIs (x86_64 and arm64)
# with Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages, and SSM user sudo access.
# Built AMIs are made public and shared with an AWS Organization.
#
# NOTE: Public AMI sharing requires "Block public access for AMIs" to be disabled
# in the target account/region, otherwise distribution will fail.
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  EC2 Image Builder pipelines that build custom Amazon Linux 2023 AMIs (x86_64 and arm64)
  with Docker, Docker Compose, synapseclient, pandas, pysftp and SSM user sudo access,
  distributed publicly and shared with an AWS Organization.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Image Settings
        Parameters:
          - ImageVersion
          - RootVolumeSize
      - Label:
          default: Distribution Settings
        Parameters:
          - OrganizationManagementAccountId
          - OrganizationId
      - Label:
          default: Build Infrastructure
        Parameters:
          - X86InstanceType
          - Arm64InstanceType

Parameters:
  ImageVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: 1.0.0
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a semantic version in the form major.minor.patch (e.g. 1.0.0).
    Description: Semantic version of the image recipes and component. Increment to build a new version.
  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 32
    MinValue: 8
    MaxValue: 16384
    Description: Size (GiB) of the root EBS volume of the built AMIs.
  OrganizationManagementAccountId:
    Type: String
    Default: '111111111111'
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12-digit AWS account ID.
    Description: Account ID of the AWS Organization management account (used to build the organization ARN).
  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Default: o-xxxxxxxxxx
    AllowedPattern: '^o-[a-z0-9]{10,32}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS Organization ID (e.g. o-abc123defg).
    Description: AWS Organization ID to share the AMIs with.
  X86InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: t3.medium
    Description: Instance type used to build and test the x86_64 image.
  Arm64InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: t4g.medium
    Description: Instance type used to build and test the arm64 image.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM for build/test instances
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub ec2.${AWS::URLSuffix}
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/EC2InstanceProfileForImageBuilder
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Component: software installation + tests
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SoftwareComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-software
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Platform: Linux
      SupportedOsVersions:
        - Amazon Linux 2023
      Description: Installs Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages and enables SSM user sudo access.
      Data: |
        name: InstallDockerPythonSsmSudo
        description: Install Docker, Docker Compose, synapseclient, pandas, pysftp and enable ssm-user sudo.
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: UpdateSystem
                action: UpdateOS
              - name: InstallDocker
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - dnf install -y docker
                    - systemctl enable docker
                    - usermod -aG docker ec2-user
              - name: InstallDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - ARCH="$(uname -m)"
                    - mkdir -p /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins
                    - curl -fsSL "https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/latest/download/docker-compose-linux-${ARCH}" -o /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
                    - chmod 755 /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
                    - ln -sf /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose /usr/local/bin/docker-compose
              - name: InstallPythonPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - dnf install -y python3 python3-pip
                    - python3 -m pip install --no-cache-dir synapseclient pandas pysftp
              - name: EnableSsmUserSudo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - echo 'ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL' > /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users
                    - chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users
                    - visudo -cf /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users
          - name: validate
            steps:
              - name: ValidateInstall
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - command -v docker
                    - test -x /usr/local/lib/docker/cli-plugins/docker-compose
                    - test -f /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: TestDocker
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - systemctl start docker
                    - docker --version
                    - docker info
              - name: TestDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - docker compose version
                    - docker-compose version
              - name: TestPythonImports
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - python3 -c "import synapseclient, pandas, pysftp; print('synapseclient', synapseclient.__version__); print('pandas', pandas.__version__); print('pysftp', pysftp.__version__)"
              - name: TestSsmUserSudo
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - set -euxo pipefail
                    - grep -q '^ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL$' /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-agent-users
                    - visudo -c
      Tags:
        Name: !Ref AWS::StackName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Image recipes
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  X86ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-al2023-x86
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Description: Amazon Linux 2023 (x86_64) with Docker, Docker Compose and Python packages.
      ParentImage: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2023-x86/x.x.x
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SoftwareComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: false
      AdditionalInstanceConfiguration:
        SystemsManagerAgent:
          UninstallAfterBuild: false
      Tags:
        Name: !Ref AWS::StackName

  Arm64ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-al2023-arm64
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Description: Amazon Linux 2023 (arm64) with Docker, Docker Compose and Python packages.
      ParentImage: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:imagebuilder:${AWS::Region}:aws:image/amazon-linux-2023-arm64/x.x.x
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !Ref SoftwareComponent
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: false
      AdditionalInstanceConfiguration:
        SystemsManagerAgent:
          UninstallAfterBuild: false
      Tags:
        Name: !Ref AWS::StackName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Shared infrastructure configuration
  # Image Builder uses the first instance type compatible with the recipe's architecture.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-infrastructure
      Description: Shared build/test infrastructure for x86_64 and arm64 images.
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - !Ref X86InstanceType
        - !Ref Arm64InstanceType
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      InstanceMetadataOptions:
        HttpTokens: required
        HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 2
      ResourceTags:
        Name: !Ref AWS::StackName
      Tags:
        Name: !Ref AWS::StackName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Distribution: public + organization sharing
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-distribution
      Description: Distributes AMIs publicly and shares them with the AWS Organization.
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref AWS::Region
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: !Sub Custom Amazon Linux 2023 AMI built by ${AWS::StackName}
            AmiTags:
              Name: !Ref AWS::StackName
              StackName: !Ref AWS::StackName
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              UserGroups:
                - all
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${OrganizationManagementAccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}
      Tags:
        Name: !Ref AWS::StackName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Pipelines
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  X86ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-al2023-x86
      Description: Builds the custom Amazon Linux 2023 x86_64 AMI.
      ImageRecipeArn: !Ref X86ImageRecipe
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !Ref InfrastructureConfiguration
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !Ref DistributionConfiguration
      EnhancedImageMetadataEnabled: true
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 60
      Status: ENABLED
      Tags:
        Name: !Ref AWS::StackName

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AgentOps e-commerce analytics demo - Cognito User Pool with public SRP app client,
  team/admin groups, and a custom resource Lambda that seeds six demo users.
  WARNING: Demo users share a hardcoded password. For local development/demo use only.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: agentops-ecommerce-users
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      VerificationMessageTemplate:
        DefaultEmailOption: CONFIRM_WITH_CODE
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      MfaConfiguration: 'OPTIONAL'
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: role
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: '1'
            MaxLength: '64'
      UserPoolTags:
        Project: agentops-ecommerce-analytics
        Environment: demo

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: agentops-web-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:3000/auth/callback
      LogoutURLs:
        - http://localhost:3000
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      Description: Platform administrators with access to all teams
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  TeamAlphaGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: team-alpha
      Description: Team Alpha analytics users
      Precedence: 10
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  TeamBetaGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: team-beta
      Description: Team Beta analytics users
      Precedence: 20
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  UserSeederRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoUserSeeding
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminCreateUser
                  - cognito-idp:AdminSetUserPassword
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                  - cognito-idp:AdminGetUser
                  - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  UserSeederFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Seeds demo users into the AgentOps e-commerce Cognito User Pool
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 120
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt UserSeederRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import logging
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          cognito = boto3.client("cognito-idp")

          # Demo-only shared password. Never use in production.
          DEMO_PASSWORD = "Demo1234!"

          USERS = [
              {"email": "alice@demo.local", "group": "team-alpha", "role": "member"},
              {"email": "bob@demo.local", "group": "team-alpha", "role": "member"},
              {"email": "charlie@demo.local", "group": "team-alpha", "role": "team_admin"},
              {"email": "dave@demo.local", "group": "team-beta", "role": "member"},
              {"email": "eve@demo.local", "group": "team-beta", "role": "team_admin"},
              {"email": "admin@demo.local", "group": "admin", "role": "admin"},
          ]


          def seed_user(pool_id, user):
              email = user["email"]
              attributes = [
                  {"Name": "email", "Value": email},
                  {"Name": "email_verified", "Value": "true"},
                  {"Name": "custom:role", "Value": user["role"]},
              ]
              try:
                  cognito.admin_create_user(
                      UserPoolId=pool_id,
                      Username=email,
                      UserAttributes=attributes,
                      MessageAction="SUPPRESS",
                  )
                  logger.info("Created user %s", email)
              except cognito.exceptions.UsernameExistsException:
                  logger.info("User %s already exists, updating attributes", email)
                  cognito.admin_update_user_attributes(
                      UserPoolId=pool_id,
                      Username=email,
                      UserAttributes=attributes,
                  )

              cognito.admin_set_user_password(
                  UserPoolId=pool_id,
                  Username=email,
                  Password=DEMO_PASSWORD,
                  Permanent=True,
              )
              cognito.admin_add_user_to_group(
                  UserPoolId=pool_id,
                  Username=email,
                  GroupName=user["group"],
              )
              logger.info("User %s added to group %s", email, user["group"])


          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info("Received event: %s", {k: v for k, v in event.items() if k != "ResponseURL"})
              physical_id = event.get("PhysicalResourceId", "agentops-demo-user-seeder")
              try:
                  request_type = event["RequestType"]
                  if request_type in ("Create", "Update"):
                      pool_id = event["ResourceProperties"]["UserPoolId"]
                      for user in USERS:
                          seed_user(pool_id, user)
                      physical_id = "agentops-demo-user-seeder-" + pool_id
                      cfnresponse.send(
                          event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS,
                          {"SeededUsers": ",".join(u["email"] for u in USERS)},
                          physical_id,
                      )
                  else:
                      # Users are removed together with the user pool on stack deletion.
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, physical_id)
              except Exception as exc:
                  logger.exception("User seeding failed")
                  cfnresponse.send(
                      event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED,
                      {"Error": str(exc)}, physical_id,
                  )
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: agentops-ecommerce-analytics
        - Key: Environment
          Value: demo

  SeedDemoUsers:
    Type: Custom::CognitoUserSeeder
    DependsOn:
      - AdminGroup
      - TeamAlphaGroup
      - TeamBetaGroup
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt UserSeederFunction.Arn
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      SeedVersion: '1'

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito User Pool ID
    Value: !Ref UserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Cognito User Pool ARN
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolArn

  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: Public app client ID (agentops-web-client)
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolClientId

  Region:
    Description: AWS region where the user pool is deployed
    Value: !Ref AWS::Region
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-Region

  UserSeederFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda function that seeds demo users
    Value: !GetAtt UserSeederFunction.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-UserSeederFunctionArn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  CloudWatch Logs Insights saved queries and a CloudWatch dashboard for AWS Client VPN
  usage reporting across AD/SAML, Mutual Auth, and Mixed Auth authentication methods.

Parameters:
  QueryFolderPath:
    Type: String
    Default: aws-client-vpn
    Description: >-
      Optional folder path used to organize the saved Logs Insights queries
      (e.g. "aws-client-vpn" or "reports/aws-client-vpn"). Leave empty to save queries at the top level.
    AllowedPattern: '^[^\s].*[^/\s]$|^[^\s/]?$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must not start with whitespace or end with a slash or whitespace.
  ClientVpnLogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: aws/aws-client-vpn/prod
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives AWS Client VPN connection logs.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 512

Conditions:
  HasFolderPath: !Not [!Equals [!Ref QueryFolderPath, '']]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Overall usage
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TotalUsagePerEndpointQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !If
        - HasFolderPath
        - !Sub '${QueryFolderPath}/Total-Usage-Per-Endpoint'
        - Total-Usage-Per-Endpoint
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields `client-vpn-endpoint-id`, `connection-duration-seconds`, `ingress-bytes`, `egress-bytes`
        | filter `connection-end-time` != 'NA'
        | stats count(*) as Sessions,
                count_distinct(`connection-id`) as DistinctConnections,
                sum(`connection-duration-seconds`) / 3600 as TotalHours,
                sum(`ingress-bytes`) / 1048576 as IngressMB,
                sum(`egress-bytes`) / 1048576 as EgressMB
          by `client-vpn-endpoint-id`
        | sort TotalHours desc

  ConnectionAttemptsPerEndpointQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !If
        - HasFolderPath
        - !Sub '${QueryFolderPath}/Connection-Attempts-Per-Endpoint'
        - Connection-Attempts-Per-Endpoint
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields `client-vpn-endpoint-id`, `connection-attempt-status`, `connection-attempt-failure-reason`
        | filter `connection-attempt-status` != 'NA'
        | stats count(*) as Attempts by `client-vpn-endpoint-id`, `connection-attempt-status`, `connection-attempt-failure-reason`
        | sort Attempts desc

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Usage per authentication type
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AdSamlUsageQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !If
        - HasFolderPath
        - !Sub '${QueryFolderPath}/Usage-AD-SAML-Auth'
        - Usage-AD-SAML-Auth
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields `client-vpn-endpoint-id`, username, `connection-duration-seconds`
        | filter `connection-end-time` != 'NA' and username != 'NA' and `common-name` = 'NA'
        | stats count(*) as Sessions,
                count_distinct(username) as DistinctUsers,
                sum(`connection-duration-seconds`) / 3600 as TotalHours,
                sum(`ingress-bytes`) / 1048576 as IngressMB,
                sum(`egress-bytes`) / 1048576 as EgressMB
          by `client-vpn-endpoint-id`
        | sort TotalHours desc

  MutualAuthUsageQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !If
        - HasFolderPath
        - !Sub '${QueryFolderPath}/Usage-Mutual-Auth'
        - Usage-Mutual-Auth
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields `client-vpn-endpoint-id`, `common-name`, `connection-duration-seconds`
        | filter `connection-end-time` != 'NA' and `common-name` != 'NA' and username = 'NA'
        | stats count(*) as Sessions,
                count_distinct(`common-name`) as DistinctCertificates,
                sum(`connection-duration-seconds`) / 3600 as TotalHours,
                sum(`ingress-bytes`) / 1048576 as IngressMB,
                sum(`egress-bytes`) / 1048576 as EgressMB
          by `client-vpn-endpoint-id`
        | sort TotalHours desc

  MixedAuthUsageQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !If
        - HasFolderPath
        - !Sub '${QueryFolderPath}/Usage-Mixed-Auth'
        - Usage-Mixed-Auth
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields `client-vpn-endpoint-id`, username, `common-name`, `connection-duration-seconds`
        | filter `connection-end-time` != 'NA' and `common-name` != 'NA' and username != 'NA'
        | stats count(*) as Sessions,
                count_distinct(username) as DistinctUsers,
                count_distinct(`common-name`) as DistinctCertificates,
                sum(`connection-duration-seconds`) / 3600 as TotalHours,
                sum(`ingress-bytes`) / 1048576 as IngressMB,
                sum(`egress-bytes`) / 1048576 as EgressMB
          by `client-vpn-endpoint-id`
        | sort TotalHours desc

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Distinct users
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DistinctUsersPerEndpointQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !If
        - HasFolderPath
        - !Sub '${QueryFolderPath}/Distinct-Users-Per-Endpoint'
        - Distinct-Users-Per-Endpoint
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields `client-vpn-endpoint-id`, username, `common-name`
        | filter `connection-end-time` != 'NA'
        | stats count_distinct(username) as DistinctUsernames,
                count_distinct(`common-name`) as DistinctCommonNames,
                count(*) as Sessions
          by `client-vpn-endpoint-id`
        | sort DistinctUsernames desc

  DistinctUsersDetailQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !If
        - HasFolderPath
        - !Sub '${QueryFolderPath}/Distinct-Users-Detail'
        - Distinct-Users-Detail
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields `client-vpn-endpoint-id`, username, `common-name`, `connection-duration-seconds`
        | filter `connection-end-time` != 'NA'
        | stats count(*) as Sessions,
                sum(`connection-duration-seconds`) / 60 as TotalMinutes,
                sum(`ingress-bytes`) / 1048576 as IngressMB,
                sum(`egress-bytes`) / 1048576 as EgressMB,
                max(`connection-end-time`) as LastSeen
          by username, `common-name`, `client-vpn-endpoint-id`
        | sort TotalMinutes desc

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Connection durations
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ConnectionDurationStatsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !If
        - HasFolderPath
        - !Sub '${QueryFolderPath}/Connection-Duration-Stats'
        - Connection-Duration-Stats
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields `client-vpn-endpoint-id`, `connection-duration-seconds`
        | filter `connection-end-time` != 'NA'
        | stats count(*) as Sessions,
                avg(`connection-duration-seconds`) / 60 as AvgMinutes,
                min(`connection-duration-seconds`) / 60 as MinMinutes,
                max(`connection-duration-seconds`) / 60 as MaxMinutes,
                pct(`connection-duration-seconds`, 90) / 60 as P90Minutes
          by `client-vpn-endpoint-id`
        | sort AvgMinutes desc

  ConnectionDurationDetailQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !If
        - HasFolderPath
        - !Sub '${QueryFolderPath}/Connection-Duration-Detail'
        - Connection-Duration-Detail
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref ClientVpnLogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields `client-vpn-endpoint-id`, username, `common-name`, `client-ip`, `device-ip`,
               `connection-start-time`, `connection-end-time`,
               `connection-duration-seconds` / 60 as DurationMinutes
        | filter `connection-end-time` != 'NA'
        | sort `connection-duration-seconds` desc
        | display `client-vpn-endpoint-id`, username, `common-name`, `client-ip`, `device-ip`, `connection-start-time`, `connection-end-time`, DurationMinutes
        | limit 1000

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Dashboard
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ClientVpnUsageDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-client-vpn-usage'
      DashboardBody: !Sub |
        {
          "widgets": [
            {
              "type": "text",
              "x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 24, "height": 2,
              "properties": {
                "markdown": "# AWS Client VPN Usage Report\nLog group: `${ClientVpnLogGroupName}`. AD/SAML = username only, Mutual Auth = certificate common name only, Mixed Auth = both."
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 0, "y": 2, "width": 24, "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Total Usage per Endpoint",

                "query": "SOURCE '${ClientVpnLogGroupName}' | fields `client-vpn-endpoint-id`, `connection-duration-seconds`, `ingress-bytes`, `egress-bytes` | filter `connection-end-time` != 'NA' | stats count(*) as Sessions, count_distinct(`connection-id`) as DistinctConnections, sum(`connection-duration-seconds`) / 3600 as TotalHours, sum(`ingress-bytes`) / 1048576 as IngressMB, sum(`egress-bytes`) / 1048576 as EgressMB by `client-vpn-endpoint-id` | sort TotalHours desc"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 0, "y": 8, "width": 8, "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Usage per Auth Type - AD/SAML",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "view": "table",
                "query": "SOURCE '${ClientVpnLogGroupName}' | fields `client-vpn-endpoint-id`, username, `connection-duration-seconds` | filter `connection-end-time` != 'NA' and username != 'NA' and `common-name` = 'NA' | stats count(*) as Sessions, count_distinct(username) as DistinctUsers, sum(`connection-duration-seconds`) / 3600 as TotalHours, sum(`ingress-bytes`) / 1048576 as IngressMB, sum(`egress-bytes`) / 1048576 as EgressMB by `client-vpn-endpoint-id` | sort TotalHours desc"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 8, "y": 8, "width": 8, "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Usage per Auth Type - Mutual Auth",

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  AnyCompany Hotel guest and staff authentication - Cognito User Pool (PLUS tier,
  advanced security enforced), SPA client, admin auth client, M2M OAuth2 client,
  resource server, staff role groups, and hosted domain.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment.

Conditions:

Resources:

  AdminAuthClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:

        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  ApiResourceServer:

    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

      Name: !Sub anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-api

        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to AnyCompany Hotel APIs
        - ScopeName: write
          ScopeDescription: Write access to AnyCompany Hotel APIs
        - ScopeName: admin

  M2MClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ApiResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub anycompany-hotel-${Environment}-m2m-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub anycompany-hotel-api-${Environment}/read
        - !Sub anycompany-hotel-api-${Environment}/write
        - !Sub anycompany-hotel-api-${Environment}/admin
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      Description: System administrators with full access
      Precedence: 0
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  RegionalManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegionalManager
      Description: Regional managers overseeing multiple properties
      Precedence: 10
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  ManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Manager
      Description: Property managers
      Precedence: 20
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  RevenueManagerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RevenueManager
      Description: Revenue and pricing managers
      Precedence: 30
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  FrontDeskGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: FrontDesk
      Description: Front desk staff
      Precedence: 40
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  HousekeepingGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Housekeeping
      Description: Housekeeping staff
      Precedence: 50
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

Outputs:

    Description: Cognito User Pool ID
    Value: !Ref UserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Cognito User Pool ARN

    Export:

    Export:

    Export:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Cognito user pool for the Hospitality Insights application with a hosted UI domain,
  a 24-hour session app client, a post-authentication Lambda trigger that records last_login,
  Admin/RegularUser/PowerUser groups, and optional SAML SSO federation.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: General
        Parameters:
          - ApplicationName
          - Environment
      - Label:
          default: Hosted UI
        Parameters:
          - DomainPrefix
          - CallbackUrl
          - LogoutUrl
      - Label:
          default: Optional SSO (leave both empty to disable)
        Parameters:
          - SSOProviderName
          - SSOLoginUrl

Parameters:
  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: hospitality-insights
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z0-9-]+$"
    Description: Lowercase application name used for resource naming.

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment.

  DomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: hospitality-insights-prod
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$"
    ConstraintDescription: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only; must not start or end with a hyphen.
    Description: >-
      Custom domain prefix for the Cognito hosted UI
      (https://<prefix>.auth.<region>.amazoncognito.com). Must be globally unique per region
      and must not contain the words aws, amazon, or cognito.

  CallbackUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: https://localhost:3000/callback
    Description: OAuth callback URL for the hosted UI.

  LogoutUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: https://localhost:3000/logout
    Description: OAuth sign-out URL for the hosted UI.

  SSOProviderName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^[^_\\p{Z}][\\p{L}\\p{M}\\p{S}\\p{N}\\p{P}][^_\\p{Z}]{0,30}$"
    Description: >-
      Name of the federated SAML identity provider (e.g. CorporateSSO).
      Leave empty to disable SSO.

  SSOLoginUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >-
      SAML metadata/login URL of the federated identity provider.
      Leave empty to disable SSO.

Conditions:
  EnableSSO: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SSOProviderName, ""]]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SSOLoginUrl, ""]]
  IsProd: !Equals [!Ref Environment, prod]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Post-authentication Lambda trigger
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PostAuthLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-post-auth-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: UpdateLastLoginAttribute
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                # Wildcard pool ARN avoids a circular dependency between the pool and the trigger.
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PostAuthLambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/lambda/${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-post-auth"
      RetentionInDays: !If [IsProd, 90, 14]

  PostAuthLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: PostAuthLambdaLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-post-auth"
      Description: Cognito post-authentication trigger that updates the custom:last_login attribute.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt PostAuthLambdaRole.Arn
      Timeout: 5
      MemorySize: 128
      Environment:
        Variables:
          ENVIRONMENT: !Ref Environment
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import logging
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          import boto3

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          cognito = boto3.client("cognito-idp")


          def handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = event["userPoolId"]
              username = event["userName"]
              timestamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")

              try:
                  cognito.admin_update_user_attributes(
                      UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                      Username=username,
                      UserAttributes=[
                          {"Name": "custom:last_login", "Value": timestamp},
                      ],
                  )
                  logger.info("Updated last_login for user %s to %s", username, timestamp)
              except Exception:
                  # Never block sign-in because the attribute update failed.
                  logger.exception("Failed to update last_login for user %s", username)

              return event
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PostAuthLambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !GetAtt PostAuthLambdaFunction.Arn
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # User pool
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub "${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-user-pool"
      DeletionProtection: !If [IsProd, ACTIVE, INACTIVE]
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      AdminCreateUserConfig:
        AllowAdminCreateUserOnly: true
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: last_login
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          StringAttributeConstraints:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  WebSocket API that tracks client connections in a DynamoDB session table.
  $connect stores the connection ID, $disconnect removes it, and $default echoes
  messages back to the sender through a Lambda function.

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: api
    Description: Name of the WebSocket API stage.
  SessionTtlSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7200
    MinValue: 60
    Description: Number of seconds after connecting before a session item expires through DynamoDB TTL.

Resources:
  SessionTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          KeyType: HASH
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-websocket'
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: $request.body.action

  ApiGatewayDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SessionTableWriteDelete
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt SessionTable.Arn

  ConnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/PutItem'
      CredentialsArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayDynamoDBRole.Arn
      PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
      TemplateSelectionExpression: \$default
      RequestTemplates:
        $default: !Sub |
          #set($ttl = $context.requestTimeEpoch / 1000 + ${SessionTtlSeconds})
          {
            "TableName": "${SessionTable}",
            "Item": {
              "connectionId": { "S": "$context.connectionId" },
              "connectedAt": { "N": "$context.requestTimeEpoch" },
              "sourceIp": { "S": "$context.identity.sourceIp" },
              "ttl": { "N": "$ttl" }
            }
          }

  ConnectIntegrationResponse:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::IntegrationResponse
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationId: !Ref ConnectIntegration
      IntegrationResponseKey: $default

  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $connect
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      OperationName: ConnectRoute
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${ConnectIntegration}'

  DisconnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS
      IntegrationMethod: POST
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/DeleteItem'
      CredentialsArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayDynamoDBRole.Arn
      PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
      TemplateSelectionExpression: \$default
      RequestTemplates:
        $default: !Sub |
          {
            "TableName": "${SessionTable}",
            "Key": {
              "connectionId": { "S": "$context.connectionId" }
            }
          }

  DisconnectIntegrationResponse:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::IntegrationResponse
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationId: !Ref DisconnectIntegration
      IntegrationResponseKey: $default

  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $disconnect
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      OperationName: DisconnectRoute
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${DisconnectIntegration}'

  EchoFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ManageWebSocketConnections
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: execute-api:ManageConnections
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*'

  EchoFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Echoes incoming WebSocket messages back to the sending client.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt EchoFunctionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3

          def handler(event, context):
              ctx = event["requestContext"]
              endpoint = f"https://{ctx['domainName']}/{ctx['stage']}"
              client = boto3.client("apigatewaymanagementapi", endpoint_url=endpoint)
              body = event.get("body") or ""
              try:
                  client.post_to_connection(
                      ConnectionId=ctx["connectionId"],
                      Data=body.encode("utf-8"),
                  )
              except client.exceptions.GoneException:
                  return {"statusCode": 410}
              return {"statusCode": 200}

  EchoFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref EchoFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*'

  DefaultIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${EchoFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $default
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      OperationName: DefaultRoute
      Target: !Sub 'integrations/${DefaultIntegration}'

  Deployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ConnectRoute
      - DisconnectRoute
      - DefaultRoute
      - ConnectIntegrationResponse
      - DisconnectIntegrationResponse
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi

  Stage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      StageName: !Ref StageName
      DeploymentId: !Ref Deployment
      DefaultRouteSettings:
        ThrottlingBurstLimit: 500
        ThrottlingRateLimit: 1000

Outputs:
  WebSocketUrl:
    Description: WebSocket endpoint URL for clients.
    Value: !Sub 'wss://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}'
  ConnectionsManagementUrl:
    Description: HTTPS endpoint for the API Gateway Management API.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}'
  SessionTableName:
    Description: DynamoDB table that tracks active WebSocket sessions.
    Value: !Ref SessionTable
  WebSocketApiId:
    Description: WebSocket API ID.
    Value: !Ref WebSocketApi

Description: Basic test VPC with a single public subnet, internet gateway, public route table, and network ACL.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC. The public subnet uses the first /22 of this range.
    Default: 172.18.0.0/16
    AllowedValues:
      - 172.18.0.0/16
      - 172.19.0.0/16
      - 172.20.0.0/16
      - 172.21.0.0/16
      - 172.22.0.0/16
      - 172.23.0.0/16

Mappings:
  SubnetConfig:
    172.18.0.0/16:
      PublicSubnetCidr: 172.18.0.0/22
    172.19.0.0/16:
      PublicSubnetCidr: 172.19.0.0/22
    172.20.0.0/16:
      PublicSubnetCidr: 172.20.0.0/22
    172.21.0.0/16:
      PublicSubnetCidr: 172.21.0.0/22
    172.22.0.0/16:
      PublicSubnetCidr: 172.22.0.0/22
    172.23.0.0/16:
      PublicSubnetCidr: 172.23.0.0/22

  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: test

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, !Ref VpcCidr, PublicSubnetCidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: test
        - Key: Network
          Value: public

    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment

    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535

      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0

        From: 0

      PortRange:
        From: 0

      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 17
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: true
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 0
        To: 65535
