AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Landing zone hub VPC for multi-account spoke attachment. Provisions a VPC with
  public and private subnets across two AZs, NAT gateways, a Transit Gateway,
  VPC flow logs to CloudWatch, and VPC endpoints for SSM, EC2 Messages,
  SSM Messages, CloudWatch Logs, and S3.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: General
        Parameters:
          - EnvironmentName
      - Label:
          default: Network Addressing
        Parameters:
          - VpcCidr
          - PublicSubnet1Cidr
          - PublicSubnet2Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet1Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet2Cidr
          - SpokeSummaryCidr
      - Label:
          default: Transit Gateway
        Parameters:
          - TransitGatewayAsn
      - Label:
          default: Logging
        Parameters:
          - FlowLogRetentionDays

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: landing-zone
    Description: Environment name prefix applied to resource names and tags.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the hub VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'

  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet in AZ 1.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'

  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet in AZ 2.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'

  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.10.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet in AZ 1.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'

  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.11.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet in AZ 2.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'

  SpokeSummaryCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/8
    Description: Summary CIDR for spoke networks routed via the Transit Gateway.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/([0-9]|[1-2][0-9]|3[0-2])$'

  TransitGatewayAsn:
    Type: Number
    Default: 64512
    Description: Private ASN for the Amazon side of the Transit Gateway.
    MinValue: 64512
    MaxValue: 65534

  FlowLogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 90
    Description: Retention period in days for VPC flow logs.
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1827, 3653]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Role
          Value: hub

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-az1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-az2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-az1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-az2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT Gateways
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-az1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-az2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-az1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-az2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public Routing
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  DefaultPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private Routing
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-az1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-az2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  DefaultPrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  DefaultPrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Transit Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub '${EnvironmentName} hub Transit Gateway for spoke connectivity'
      AmazonSideAsn: !Ref TransitGatewayAsn
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: enable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: enable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: enable
      MulticastSupport: disable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-tgw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  TransitGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      Options:
        DnsSupport: enable
        Ipv6Support: disable
        ApplianceModeSupport: disable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc-tgw-attachment'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRoute1ToTransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref SpokeSummaryCidr
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  PrivateRoute2ToTransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref SpokeSummaryCidr
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Flow Logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VpcFlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VpcFlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-log-role-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc-flow-log/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: vpc-flow-logs-to-cloudwatch
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt VpcFlowLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${VpcFlowLogGroup.Arn}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-log-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref VpcFlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt VpcFlowLogRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-hub-vpc-flow-log'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security Groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VpcEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-endpoints-sg'
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTPS from VPC and spoke networks to interface VPC endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS from hub VPC
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref SpokeSummaryCidr
          Description: HTTPS from spoke networks via Transit Gateway
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS responses within VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-endpoints-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateInstanceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-instance-sg'
      GroupDescription: Baseline security group for private workloads managed via SSM
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: HTTPS to VPC endpoints and AWS services
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-instance-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM - SSM Managed Instance Role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SsmInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ssm-instance-role-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/CloudWatchAgentServerPolicy'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ssm-instance-role'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  SsmInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ssm-instance-profile-${AWS::Region}'
      Roles:
        - !Ref SsmInstanceRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Endpoints
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  SsmEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  Ec2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  SsmMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  CloudWatchLogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: Hub VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-VpcId'

  VpcCidr:
    Description: Hub VPC CIDR block
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-VpcCidr'

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Public subnet in AZ 1
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet1Id'

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Public subnet in AZ 2
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnet2Id'

  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-delimited list of public subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PublicSubnetIds'

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Private subnet in AZ 1
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet1Id'

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Private subnet in AZ 2
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnet2Id'

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-delimited list of private subnet IDs
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PrivateSubnetIds'

  PublicRouteTableId:
    Description: Public route table ID
    Value: !Ref PublicRouteTable
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PublicRouteTableId'

  PrivateRouteTable1Id:
    Description: Private route table ID for AZ 1
    Value: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PrivateRouteTable1Id'

  PrivateRouteTable2Id:
    Description: Private route table ID for AZ 2
    Value: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PrivateRouteTable2Id'

  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: Transit Gateway ID for spoke attachments
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-TransitGatewayId'

  TransitGatewayAttachmentId:
    Description: Hub VPC Transit Gateway attachment ID
    Value: !Ref TransitGatewayAttachment
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-TransitGatewayAttachmentId'

  VpcEndpointSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group attached to interface VPC endpoints
    Value: !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-VpcEndpointSecurityGroupId'

  PrivateInstanceSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Baseline security group for private SSM-managed workloads
    Value: !Ref PrivateInstanceSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-PrivateInstanceSecurityGroupId'

  SsmInstanceProfileArn:
    Description: Instance profile ARN for SSM-managed instances
    Value: !GetAtt SsmInstanceProfile.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-SsmInstanceProfileArn'

  VpcFlowLogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch log group for VPC flow logs
    Value: !Ref VpcFlowLogGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-VpcFlowLogGroupName'

  S3GatewayEndpointId:
    Description: S3 gateway VPC endpoint ID
    Value: !Ref S3GatewayEndpoint
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-S3GatewayEndpointId'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Student Services agent infrastructure for an educational platform using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore.
  Each agent or microservice domain gets its own Cognito user pool for OAuth2 client credentials
  authentication and its own least-privilege IAM execution role.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: student-services
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.
    Description: Lowercase prefix used for resource naming and Cognito domain prefixes.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Shared base managed policy
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AgentCoreBasePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: Base permissions for Student Services AgentCore execution roles.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: BedrockModelInvocation
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - bedrock:InvokeModel
              - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
              - bedrock:Converse
              - bedrock:ConverseStream
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:*::foundation-model/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:*:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/*'
          - Sid: CloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
              - logs:DescribeLogGroups
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/bedrock-agentcore/*:log-stream:*'
          - Sid: CloudWatchMetrics
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cloudwatch:namespace: bedrock-agentcore
          - Sid: XRayTracing
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - xray:PutTraceSegments
              - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
              - xray:GetSamplingRules
              - xray:GetSamplingTargets
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SSMParameterAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
              - ssm:GetParametersByPath
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/student-services/*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # StudentServicesAgent (orchestrator) - execution role only (IAM inbound auth)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StudentServicesAgentExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the StudentServicesAgent orchestrator.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref AgentCoreBasePolicy
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Component
          Value: StudentServicesAgent

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # StudentServicesGateway - Cognito only (no execution role)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GatewayUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway-pool'
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireUppercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  GatewayUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref GatewayUserPool

  GatewayResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref GatewayUserPool
      Identifier: student-services-gateway
      Name: StudentServicesGatewayResourceServer
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: access
          ScopeDescription: Access to the Student Services Gateway

  GatewayUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: GatewayResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-gateway-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref GatewayUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - student-services-gateway/access
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CourseRegistration
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CourseRegistrationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the CourseRegistration agent.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref AgentCoreBasePolicy
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonDynamoDBFullAccess'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Component
          Value: CourseRegistration

  CourseRegistrationUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-course-registration-pool'
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: false
          RequireUppercase: false
          RequireNumbers: false
          RequireSymbols: false
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true

  CourseRegistrationUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub '${ProjectName}-course-registration-${AWS::AccountId}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseRegistrationUserPool

  CourseRegistrationResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseRegistrationUserPool
      Identifier: course-registration
      Name: CourseRegistrationResourceServer
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: access
          ScopeDescription: Access to the CourseRegistration agent

  CourseRegistrationUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: CourseRegistrationResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-course-registration-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref CourseRegistrationUserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark section 3 log-based monitoring controls. Creates a CloudWatch Logs
  log group for CloudTrail management events, a KMS customer managed key, an encrypted SNS topic for
  alarm notifications, and metric filters, alarms, and Logs Insights query definitions for each control.

Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: cis-cloudtrail-management-events
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives CloudTrail management events.
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 365
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1096, 1827, 2192, 2557, 2922, 3288, 3653]
    Description: Retention period for the CloudTrail log group.
  MetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Default: CISBenchmark
    Description: CloudWatch metric namespace for the metric filters.
  AlarmNotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional email address to subscribe to the alarm SNS topic. Leave blank to skip.

Conditions:
  HasNotificationEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmNotificationEmail, '']]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Encryption key
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MonitoringKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for CIS monitoring SNS topic and CloudTrail log group
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSNSToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${LogGroupName}'

  MonitoringKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/cis-monitoring-${AWS::StackName}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref MonitoringKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Notification topic
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: CIS Monitoring Alarms
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref MonitoringKey

  AlarmTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlarmTopic
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlarmTopic
            Condition:
              Bool:
                'aws:SecureTransport': 'false'

  AlarmEmailSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Condition: HasNotificationEmail
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref AlarmTopic
      Protocol: email
      Endpoint: !Ref AlarmNotificationEmail

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudTrail log group and delivery role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt MonitoringKey.Arn

  CloudTrailToCloudWatchLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudTrailLogDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub '${CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn}'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.1 Unauthorized API calls
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UnauthorizedApiCallsMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterName: cis-unauthorized-api-calls
      FilterPattern: '{ (($.errorCode = "*UnauthorizedOperation") || ($.errorCode = "AccessDenied*")) && ($.sourceIPAddress != "delivery.logs.amazonaws.com") && ($.eventName != "HeadBucket") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: UnauthorizedAPICalls
          MetricValue: '1'

  UnauthorizedApiCallsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    DependsOn: UnauthorizedApiCallsMetricFilter
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cis-unauthorized-api-calls'
      AlarmDescription: CIS 3.1 - Unauthorized API calls detected
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: UnauthorizedAPICalls
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  UnauthorizedApiCallsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS/3.1-UnauthorizedApiCalls
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, eventSource, eventName, errorCode, errorMessage, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress
        | filter (errorCode like /UnauthorizedOperation$/ or errorCode like /^AccessDenied/) and sourceIPAddress != "delivery.logs.amazonaws.com" and eventName != "HeadBucket"
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 200

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.2 Console sign-in without MFA
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ConsoleSignInWithoutMfaMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterName: cis-console-signin-without-mfa
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = "ConsoleLogin") && ($.additionalEventData.MFAUsed != "Yes") && ($.userIdentity.type = "IAMUser") && ($.responseElements.ConsoleLogin = "Success") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: ConsoleSignInWithoutMFA
          MetricValue: '1'

  ConsoleSignInWithoutMfaAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    DependsOn: ConsoleSignInWithoutMfaMetricFilter
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cis-console-signin-without-mfa'
      AlarmDescription: CIS 3.2 - Management console sign-in without MFA
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: ConsoleSignInWithoutMFA
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  ConsoleSignInWithoutMfaQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS/3.2-ConsoleSignInWithoutMfa
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress, additionalEventData.MFAUsed, responseElements.ConsoleLogin
        | filter eventName = "ConsoleLogin" and additionalEventData.MFAUsed != "Yes" and userIdentity.type = "IAMUser" and responseElements.ConsoleLogin = "Success"
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 200

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.3 Root account usage
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RootAccountUsageMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterName: cis-root-account-usage
      FilterPattern: '{ $.userIdentity.type = "Root" && $.userIdentity.invokedBy NOT EXISTS && $.eventType != "AwsServiceEvent" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: RootAccountUsage
          MetricValue: '1'

  RootAccountUsageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    DependsOn: RootAccountUsageMetricFilter
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cis-root-account-usage'
      AlarmDescription: CIS 3.3 - Root account usage detected
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: RootAccountUsage
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  RootAccountUsageQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS/3.3-RootAccountUsage
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, eventSource, eventName, sourceIPAddress, userAgent
        | filter userIdentity.type = "Root" and not ispresent(userIdentity.invokedBy) and eventType != "AwsServiceEvent"
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 200

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.4 IAM policy changes
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  IamPolicyChangesMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterName: cis-iam-policy-changes
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = DeleteGroupPolicy) || ($.eventName = DeleteRolePolicy) || ($.eventName = DeleteUserPolicy) || ($.eventName = PutGroupPolicy) || ($.eventName = PutRolePolicy) || ($.eventName = PutUserPolicy) || ($.eventName = CreatePolicy) || ($.eventName = DeletePolicy) || ($.eventName = CreatePolicyVersion) || ($.eventName = DeletePolicyVersion) || ($.eventName = AttachRolePolicy) || ($.eventName = DetachRolePolicy) || ($.eventName = AttachUserPolicy) || ($.eventName = DetachUserPolicy) || ($.eventName = AttachGroupPolicy) || ($.eventName = DetachGroupPolicy) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: IAMPolicyChanges
          MetricValue: '1'

  IamPolicyChangesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    DependsOn: IamPolicyChangesMetricFilter
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cis-iam-policy-changes'
      AlarmDescription: CIS 3.4 - IAM policy changes detected
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: IAMPolicyChanges
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  IamPolicyChangesQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS/3.4-IamPolicyChanges
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress, requestParameters.policyArn, requestParameters.policyName
        | filter eventName in ["DeleteGroupPolicy", "DeleteRolePolicy", "DeleteUserPolicy", "PutGroupPolicy", "PutRolePolicy", "PutUserPolicy", "CreatePolicy", "DeletePolicy", "CreatePolicyVersion", "DeletePolicyVersion", "AttachRolePolicy", "DetachRolePolicy", "AttachUserPolicy", "DetachUserPolicy", "AttachGroupPolicy", "DetachGroupPolicy"]
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 200

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.5 CloudTrail configuration changes
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudTrailChangesMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterName: cis-cloudtrail-config-changes
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = CreateTrail) || ($.eventName = UpdateTrail) || ($.eventName = DeleteTrail) || ($.eventName = StartLogging) || ($.eventName = StopLogging) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: CloudTrailConfigChanges
          MetricValue: '1'

  CloudTrailChangesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    DependsOn: CloudTrailChangesMetricFilter
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cis-cloudtrail-config-changes'
      AlarmDescription: CIS 3.5 - CloudTrail configuration changes detected
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: CloudTrailConfigChanges
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  CloudTrailChangesQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS/3.5-CloudTrailConfigChanges
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress, requestParameters.name
        | filter eventName in ["CreateTrail", "UpdateTrail", "DeleteTrail", "StartLogging", "StopLogging"]
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 200

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.6 Console authentication failures
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ConsoleLoginFailuresMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterName: cis-console-login-failures
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = ConsoleLogin) && ($.errorMessage = "Failed authentication") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: ConsoleLoginFailures
          MetricValue: '1'

  ConsoleLoginFailuresAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    DependsOn: ConsoleLoginFailuresMetricFilter
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cis-console-login-failures'
      AlarmDescription: CIS 3.6 - Management console authentication failures
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: ConsoleLoginFailures
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  ConsoleLoginFailuresQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS/3.6-ConsoleLoginFailures
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, userIdentity.arn, userIdentity.userName, sourceIPAddress, errorMessage
        | filter eventName = "ConsoleLogin" and errorMessage = "Failed authentication"
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 200

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.7 Disabling or scheduled deletion of customer managed KMS keys
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  KmsKeyDisableOrDeletionMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterName: cis-kms-key-disable-or-deletion
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventSource = kms.amazonaws.com) && (($.eventName = DisableKey) || ($.eventName = ScheduleKeyDeletion)) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: KMSKeyDisableOrScheduledDeletion
          MetricValue: '1'

  KmsKeyDisableOrDeletionAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    DependsOn: KmsKeyDisableOrDeletionMetricFilter
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cis-kms-key-disable-or-deletion'
      AlarmDescription: CIS 3.7 - Customer managed KMS key disabled or scheduled for deletion
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: KMSKeyDisableOrScheduledDeletion
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  KmsKeyDisableOrDeletionQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS/3.7-KmsKeyDisableOrScheduledDeletion
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress, requestParameters.keyId, requestParameters.pendingWindowInDays
        | filter eventSource = "kms.amazonaws.com" and eventName in ["DisableKey", "ScheduleKeyDeletion"]
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 200

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.8 S3 bucket policy changes
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  S3BucketPolicyChangesMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterName: cis-s3-bucket-policy-changes
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventSource = s3.amazonaws.com) && (($.eventName = PutBucketAcl) || ($.eventName = PutBucketPolicy) || ($.eventName = PutBucketCors) || ($.eventName = PutBucketLifecycle) || ($.eventName = PutBucketReplication) || ($.eventName = DeleteBucketPolicy) || ($.eventName = DeleteBucketCors) || ($.eventName = DeleteBucketLifecycle) || ($.eventName = DeleteBucketReplication)) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: S3BucketPolicyChanges
          MetricValue: '1'

  S3BucketPolicyChangesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    DependsOn: S3BucketPolicyChangesMetricFilter
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cis-s3-bucket-policy-changes'
      AlarmDescription: CIS 3.8 - S3 bucket policy changes detected
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: S3BucketPolicyChanges
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

    Properties:
      Name: CIS/3.8-S3BucketPolicyChanges
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress, requestParameters.bucketName
        | filter eventSource = "s3.amazonaws.com" and eventName in ["PutBucketAcl", "PutBucketPolicy", "PutBucketCors", "PutBucketLifecycle", "PutBucketReplication", "DeleteBucketPolicy", "DeleteBucketCors", "DeleteBucketLifecycle", "DeleteBucketReplication"]
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 200

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.9 AWS Config configuration changes
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ConfigChangesMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterName: cis-aws-config-changes
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventSource = config.amazonaws.com) && (($.eventName = StopConfigurationRecorder) || ($.eventName = DeleteDeliveryChannel) || ($.eventName = PutDeliveryChannel) || ($.eventName = PutConfigurationRecorder)) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: AWSConfigChanges
          MetricValue: '1'

  ConfigChangesAlarm:

    DependsOn: ConfigChangesMetricFilter
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cis-aws-config-changes'
      AlarmDescription: CIS 3.9 - AWS Config configuration changes detected
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: AWSConfigChanges
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  ConfigChangesQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS/3.9-AwsConfigChanges
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress
        | filter eventSource = "config.amazonaws.com" and eventName in ["StopConfigurationRecorder", "DeleteDeliveryChannel", "PutDeliveryChannel", "PutConfigurationRecorder"]
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 200

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.10 Security group changes
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SecurityGroupChangesMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterName: cis-security-group-changes
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress) || ($.eventName = AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress) || ($.eventName = RevokeSecurityGroupIngress) || ($.eventName = RevokeSecurityGroupEgress) || ($.eventName = CreateSecurityGroup) || ($.eventName = DeleteSecurityGroup) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: SecurityGroupChanges
          MetricValue: '1'

  SecurityGroupChangesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    DependsOn: SecurityGroupChangesMetricFilter
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cis-security-group-changes'
      AlarmDescription: CIS 3.10 - Security group changes detected
      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: SecurityGroupChanges
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  SecurityGroupChangesQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS/3.10-SecurityGroupChanges
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, eventName, userIdentity.arn, sourceIPAddress, requestParameters.groupId
        | filter eventName in ["AuthorizeSecurityGroupIngress", "AuthorizeSecurityGroupEgress", "RevokeSecurityGroupIngress", "RevokeSecurityGroupEgress", "CreateSecurityGroup", "DeleteSecurityGroup"]
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 200

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3.11 Network ACL changes
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NetworkAclChangesMetricFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter

      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup

      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = CreateNetworkAcl) || ($.eventName = CreateNetworkAclEntry) || ($.eventName = DeleteNetworkAcl) || ($.eventName = DeleteNetworkAclEntry) || ($.eventName = ReplaceNetworkAclEntry) || ($.eventName = ReplaceNetworkAclAssociation) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: NetworkACLChanges
          MetricValue: '1'

  NetworkAclChangesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    DependsOn: NetworkAclChangesMetricFilter
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cis-network-acl-changes'

      Namespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
      MetricName: NetworkACLChanges
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Event-driven AWS Security Hub deployment for an AWS Control Tower based AWS Organization.
  Enables the audit account as Security Hub delegated administrator, then enables Security Hub in
  the log archive account and all future Control Tower managed accounts and adds them as members.
  Cross-account actions use the AWSControlTowerExecution role. Account IDs are read from
  Parameter Store under /superwerker/.

Resources:

  SecurityHubAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by SSM Automation to enable Security Hub across the organization
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SecurityHubOrgEnablement
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AssumeControlTowerExecutionRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:AssumeRole
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::*:role/AWSControlTowerExecution
              - Sid: GetCallerIdentity
                Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: OrganizationsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - organizations:DescribeAccount
                  - organizations:DescribeOrganization
                  - organizations:ListAccounts
                  - organizations:ListDelegatedAdministrators
                  - organizations:ListAWSServiceAccessForOrganization
                  - organizations:EnableAWSServiceAccess
                  - organizations:RegisterDelegatedAdministrator
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: SecurityHubDelegatedAdmin
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - securityhub:EnableOrganizationAdminAccount
                  - securityhub:ListOrganizationAdminAccounts
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: SecurityHubServiceLinkedRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::*:role/aws-service-role/securityhub.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForSecurityHub
                Condition:
                  StringLike:
                    iam:AWSServiceName: securityhub.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: ReadSuperwerkerParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/superwerker/*
              - Sid: NestedAutomation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationStepExecutions
                Resource: '*'

  SecurityHubAutomationRolePassRolePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: PassOwnRoleForNestedAutomation
      Roles:
        - !Ref SecurityHubAutomationRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:PassRole
            Resource: !GetAtt SecurityHubAutomationRole.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                iam:PassedToService: ssm.amazonaws.com

  SecurityHubAddMemberDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      UpdateMethod: NewVersion
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Enables Security Hub in a member account and adds it as a member of the Security Hub
          delegated administrator (audit) account, including invitation and acceptance if required.
        assumeRole: '{{AutomationAssumeRole}}'
        parameters:
          MemberAccountId:
            type: String
            description: Account ID of the account to add as Security Hub member
            allowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
          AuditAccountId:
            type: String
            description: Security Hub delegated administrator (audit) account ID
            default: '{{ssm:/superwerker/account_id_audit}}'
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: Role assumed by this automation
            default: !GetAtt SecurityHubAutomationRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableSecurityHubAndAddMember
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 900
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                MemberAccountId: '{{MemberAccountId}}'
                AuditAccountId: '{{AuditAccountId}}'
                Region: '{{global:REGION}}'
              Script: |
                import time
                import boto3
                from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

                ROLE_NAME = 'AWSControlTowerExecution'


                def assume(account_id, region):
                    sts = boto3.client('sts', region_name=region)
                    partition = sts.get_caller_identity()['Arn'].split(':')[1]
                    creds = sts.assume_role(
                        RoleArn=f'arn:{partition}:iam::{account_id}:role/{ROLE_NAME}',
                        RoleSessionName='superwerker-securityhub',
                    )['Credentials']
                    return boto3.session.Session(
                        aws_access_key_id=creds['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=creds['SessionToken'],
                        region_name=region,
                    )


                def enable_security_hub(client):
                    try:
                        client.enable_security_hub(EnableDefaultStandards=True)
                    except ClientError as e:
                        if e.response['Error']['Code'] != 'ResourceConflictException':
                            raise


                def member_status(audit_sh, member):
                    members = audit_sh.get_members(AccountIds=[member]).get('Members', [])
                    return members[0]['MemberStatus'] if members else None


                def handler(event, context):
                    member = event['MemberAccountId']
                    audit = event['AuditAccountId']
                    region = event['Region']

                    if member == audit:
                        return {'Status': 'Skipped', 'Reason': 'Account is the delegated administrator'}

                    member_sh = assume(member, region).client('securityhub')
                    audit_sh = assume(audit, region).client('securityhub')

                    enable_security_hub(member_sh)

                    email = boto3.client('organizations').describe_account(AccountId=member)['Account']['Email']
                    resp = audit_sh.create_members(AccountDetails=[{'AccountId': member, 'Email': email}])
                    for unprocessed in resp.get('UnprocessedAccounts', []):
                        raise Exception(f'Failed to create member {member}: {unprocessed}')

                    status = member_status(audit_sh, member)
                    if status in ('Enabled', 'Associated'):
                        return {'Status': status}

                    audit_sh.invite_members(AccountIds=[member])

                    for _ in range(30):
                        invitations = member_sh.list_invitations().get('Invitations', [])
                        invitation = next((i for i in invitations if i['AccountId'] == audit), None)
                        if invitation:
                            member_sh.accept_administrator_invitation(
                                AdministratorId=audit,
                                InvitationId=invitation['InvitationId'],
                            )
                            break
                        time.sleep(10)
                    else:
                        raise Exception(f'No Security Hub invitation from {audit} found in {member}')

                    for _ in range(30):
                        status = member_status(audit_sh, member)
                        if status in ('Enabled', 'Associated'):
                            return {'Status': status}
                        time.sleep(10)
                    raise Exception(f'Member {member} did not become associated, last status: {status}')
            outputs:
              - Name: MemberStatus
                Selector: $.Payload.Status
                Type: String

  SecurityHubEnableInOrgDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      UpdateMethod: NewVersion
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Registers the audit account as Security Hub delegated administrator, enables Security Hub
          in the audit account and adds the log archive account as member.
        assumeRole: '{{AutomationAssumeRole}}'
        parameters:
          AuditAccountId:
            type: String
            description: Security Hub delegated administrator (audit) account ID
            default: '{{ssm:/superwerker/account_id_audit}}'
          LogArchiveAccountId:
            type: String
            description: Log archive account ID
            default: '{{ssm:/superwerker/account_id_logarchive}}'
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: Role assumed by this automation
            default: !GetAtt SecurityHubAutomationRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableDelegatedAdministrator
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 600
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                AuditAccountId: '{{AuditAccountId}}'
                Region: '{{global:REGION}}'
              Script: |
                import time
                import boto3
                from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

                ROLE_NAME = 'AWSControlTowerExecution'


                def assume(account_id, region):
                    sts = boto3.client('sts', region_name=region)
                    partition = sts.get_caller_identity()['Arn'].split(':')[1]
                    creds = sts.assume_role(
                        RoleArn=f'arn:{partition}:iam::{account_id}:role/{ROLE_NAME}',
                        RoleSessionName='superwerker-securityhub',
                    )['Credentials']
                    return boto3.session.Session(
                        aws_access_key_id=creds['AccessKeyId'],
                        aws_secret_access_key=creds['SecretAccessKey'],
                        aws_session_token=creds['SessionToken'],
                        region_name=region,
                    )


                def handler(event, context):
                    audit = event['AuditAccountId']
                    region = event['Region']

                    sh = boto3.client('securityhub', region_name=region)
                    admins = sh.list_organization_admin_accounts().get('AdminAccounts', [])
                    if not any(a['AccountId'] == audit for a in admins):
                        sh.enable_organization_admin_account(AdminAccountId=audit)

                    audit_sh = assume(audit, region).client('securityhub')
                    for _ in range(30):
                        try:
                            audit_sh.enable_security_hub(EnableDefaultStandards=True)
                            break
                        except ClientError as e:
                            code = e.response['Error']['Code']
                            if code == 'ResourceConflictException':
                                break
                            if code not in ('AccessDeniedException', 'InvalidAccessException'):
                                raise
                            time.sleep(10)
                    else:
                        raise Exception(f'Could not enable Security Hub in audit account {audit}')

                    return {'Status': 'Enabled'}
          - name: AddLogArchiveAccountAsMember
            action: aws:executeAutomation
            timeoutSeconds: 1800
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              DocumentName: !Ref SecurityHubAddMemberDocument
              RuntimeParameters:
                MemberAccountId:
                  - '{{LogArchiveAccountId}}'
                AuditAccountId:
                  - '{{AuditAccountId}}'
                AutomationAssumeRole:
                  - '{{AutomationAssumeRole}}'

  EventBridgeStartAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows EventBridge to start the Security Hub SSM automations
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartSecurityHubAutomation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${SecurityHubEnableInOrgDocument}:*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${SecurityHubAddMemberDocument}:*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt SecurityHubAutomationRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: ssm.amazonaws.com

  LandingZoneSetupOrUpdateFinishedRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Enables Security Hub delegated admin and log archive membership when the Control Tower landing zone setup or update succeeds
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.controltower
        detail-type:
          - AWS Service Event via CloudTrail
        detail:
          eventName:
            - SetupLandingZone
            - UpdateLandingZone
          $or:
            - serviceEventDetails:
                setupLandingZoneStatus:
                  state:
                    - SUCCEEDED
            - serviceEventDetails:
                updateLandingZoneStatus:
                  state:
                    - SUCCEEDED
      Targets:
        - Id: SecurityHubEnableInOrg
          Arn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${SecurityHubEnableInOrgDocument}:$DEFAULT
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeStartAutomationRole.Arn

  CreateManagedAccountSucceededRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Enables Security Hub and adds membership for new accounts provisioned via Control Tower
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.controltower
        detail-type:
          - AWS Service Event via CloudTrail
        detail:
          eventName:
            - CreateManagedAccount
          serviceEventDetails:
            createManagedAccountStatus:
              state:
                - SUCCEEDED
      Targets:
        - Id: SecurityHubAddMember
          Arn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${SecurityHubAddMemberDocument}:$DEFAULT
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeStartAutomationRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap:
              accountId: $.detail.serviceEventDetails.createManagedAccountStatus.account.accountId
            InputTemplate: |
              {"MemberAccountId": ["<accountId>"]}

Outputs:
  SecurityHubAutomationRoleArn:
    Description: Role used by the Security Hub SSM automations
    Value: !GetAtt SecurityHubAutomationRole.Arn
  SecurityHubEnableInOrgDocumentName:
    Description: SSM automation document enabling Security Hub organization-wide
    Value: !Ref SecurityHubEnableInOrgDocument
  SecurityHubAddMemberDocumentName:
    Description: SSM automation document enabling Security Hub in a member account and adding it as member
    Value: !Ref SecurityHubAddMemberDocument

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Shared IAM roles and supporting resources for multiple EKS deployments, including
  GuardDuty enablement and activation of the AWSQS Kubernetes/EKS CloudFormation registry types.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Naming
        Parameters:
          - EnvironmentAlias
          - EnvironmentHash
      - Label:
          default: Access Scoping
        Parameters:
          - BucketName
          # - PermissionsBoundary
    ParameterLabels:
      EnvironmentAlias:
        default: Environment alias (optional)
      EnvironmentHash:
        default: Environment hash (optional)
      BucketName:
        default: S3 bucket readable by the bastion role
      # PermissionsBoundary:
      #   default: IAM permissions boundary policy ARN

Parameters:
  EnvironmentAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,20}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Up to 20 alphanumeric characters or hyphens.
    Description: Optional environment alias used as a prefix for resource names.
  EnvironmentHash:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9]{0,8}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Up to 8 alphanumeric characters.
    Description: Optional short hash appended to the environment alias for uniqueness.
  BucketName:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 bucket name.
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket the bastion role may read objects from (s3:GetObject only).
  # Uncomment for environments that require an IAM permissions boundary on all roles,
  # and uncomment the PermissionsBoundary property on every AWS::IAM::Role below.
  # PermissionsBoundary:
  #   Type: String
  #   AllowedPattern: '^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:iam::[0-9]{12}:policy/.+$'
  #   Description: ARN of the IAM permissions boundary policy to attach to all roles.

Conditions:
  HasEnvironmentAlias: !Not [!Equals [!Ref EnvironmentAlias, '']]
  HasEnvironmentHash: !Not [!Equals [!Ref EnvironmentHash, '']]

Mappings:
  Constants:
    AWSQS:
      PublisherId: 408988dff9e863704bcc72e7e13f8d645cee8311

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # GuardDuty
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GuardDutyDetector:
    Type: AWS::GuardDuty::Detector
    Properties:
      Enable: true
      FindingPublishingFrequency: FIFTEEN_MINUTES

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda execution role - read-only resource discovery
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaReadOnlyRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Join
        - '-'
        - - !If [HasEnvironmentAlias, !Ref EnvironmentAlias, 'shared']
          - !If [HasEnvironmentHash, !Ref EnvironmentHash, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
          - LambdaReadOnlyRole
          - !Ref AWS::Region
      Description: Lambda execution role with read-only access for resource discovery.
      # PermissionsBoundary: !Ref PermissionsBoundary
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda role - caller identity, CloudFormation and CloudTrail logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaCallerIdentityRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Join
        - '-'
        - - !If [HasEnvironmentAlias, !Ref EnvironmentAlias, 'shared']
          - !If [HasEnvironmentHash, !Ref EnvironmentHash, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
          - LambdaCallerIdentityRole
          - !Ref AWS::Region
      Description: Lambda role for STS caller identity and CloudFormation/CloudTrail log access.
      # PermissionsBoundary: !Ref PermissionsBoundary
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CallerIdentityAndAudit
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CallerIdentity
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudFormationRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResource
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:DescribeType
                  - cloudformation:DescribeTypeRegistration
                  - cloudformation:ListStacks
                  - cloudformation:ListStackResources
                  - cloudformation:ListTypes
                  - cloudformation:ListExports
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudTrailRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudtrail:LookupEvents
                  - cloudtrail:DescribeTrails
                  - cloudtrail:GetTrailStatus
                  - cloudtrail:GetEventSelectors
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: LogsRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                  - logs:FilterLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Role for describing EKS node groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EksNodeGroupDescribeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Join
        - '-'
        - - !If [HasEnvironmentAlias, !Ref EnvironmentAlias, 'shared']
          - !If [HasEnvironmentHash, !Ref EnvironmentHash, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
          - EksNodeGroupDescribeRole
          - !Ref AWS::Region
      Description: Role used to describe EKS clusters and node groups.
      # PermissionsBoundary: !Ref PermissionsBoundary
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DescribeEksNodeGroups
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup
                  - eks:ListClusters
                  - eks:ListNodegroups
                  - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudFormation execution role (registry types / stack operations)

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Join
        - '-'

          - !Ref AWS::Region

                - lambda.amazonaws.com

                  - lambda:InvokeFunction

                  - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole

              - Sid: Sts

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Logging delivery role for CloudFormation registry logs

                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*

              - Sid: Eks

                  - eks:DescribeCluster
