AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Comprehensive SQS test infrastructure with FIFO and standard queues, dead letter queues, KMS encryption, and CloudWatch alarms (actions disabled).

Parameters:
  QueueNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: sqs-test
    Description: Prefix applied to all queue names.

Resources:
  QueueEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key used to encrypt all SQS queues in this stack
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSQSUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'

  QueueEncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${QueueNamePrefix}-sqs-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey

  FifoQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-fifo-queue.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300

  FifoQueueWithDlqDeadLetterQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-fifo-with-dlq-dlq.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300

  FifoQueueWithDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-fifo-with-dlq.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt FifoQueueWithDlqDeadLetterQueue.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  StandardDeadLetterQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-standard-dlq
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300

  StandardQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-standard-queue
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt StandardDeadLetterQueue.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  SeparateFifoDeadLetterQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-separate-fifo-dlq.fifo
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueEncryptionKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300

  StandardQueueMessagesSentAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-standard-messages-sent
      AlarmDescription: Sum of messages sent to the standard queue
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: breaching

  FifoQueueWithDlqMessagesSentAnomalyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-fifo-with-dlq-messages-sent-anomaly
      AlarmDescription: Anomaly detection on average messages sent to the FIFO queue with DLQ
      ActionsEnabled: false
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanLowerOrGreaterThanUpperThreshold
      ThresholdMetricId: ad1
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Metrics:
        - Id: m1
          ReturnData: true
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/SQS
              MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
              Dimensions:
                - Name: QueueName
                  Value: !GetAtt FifoQueueWithDlq.QueueName
            Period: 300
            Stat: Average
        - Id: ad1
          ReturnData: true
          Expression: ANOMALY_DETECTION_BAND(m1, 2)
          Label: NumberOfMessagesSent (expected)

  StandardQueueSentMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-standard-sent-message-size
      AlarmDescription: Maximum sent message size on the standard queue
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: SentMessageSize
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 183500
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing

  FifoQueueSentMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-fifo-sent-message-size
      AlarmDescription: Maximum sent message size on the separate FIFO queue
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: SentMessageSize
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt FifoQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 183500
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing

  StandardDlqVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-standard-dlq-visible-messages
      AlarmDescription: Messages present in the standard DLQ
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardDeadLetterQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  FifoDlqVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-fifo-dlq-visible-messages
      AlarmDescription: Messages present in the FIFO DLQ
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt FifoQueueWithDlqDeadLetterQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  StandardQueueOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-standard-oldest-message-age
      AlarmDescription: Maximum age of the oldest message on the standard queue
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 15
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  FifoQueueOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-fifo-oldest-message-age
      AlarmDescription: Maximum age of the oldest message on the separate FIFO queue
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt FifoQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 15
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  StandardQueueMessagesNotVisibleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-standard-messages-not-visible
      AlarmDescription: Maximum in-flight messages on the standard queue
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 108000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing

  FifoQueueMessagesNotVisibleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-fifo-messages-not-visible
      AlarmDescription: Maximum in-flight messages on the separate FIFO queue
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt FifoQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 18000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing

  StandardDlqOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-standard-dlq-oldest-message-age
      AlarmDescription: Maximum age of the oldest message on the standard DLQ
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardDeadLetterQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 90
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing

  AlwaysOkAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}-synthetic-always-ok
      AlarmDescription: Synthetic alarm that always remains in OK state
      ActionsEnabled: false
      Namespace: !Sub ${QueueNamePrefix}/Synthetic
      MetricName: NonExistentMetric
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

Outputs:
  KmsKeyArn:
    Value: !GetAtt QueueEncryptionKey.Arn
  FifoQueueUrl:
    Value: !Ref FifoQueue
  FifoQueueWithDlqUrl:
    Value: !Ref FifoQueueWithDlq
  FifoQueueWithDlqDeadLetterQueueUrl:
    Value: !Ref FifoQueueWithDlqDeadLetterQueue
  StandardQueueUrl:
    Value: !Ref StandardQueue
  StandardDeadLetterQueueUrl:
    Value: !Ref StandardDeadLetterQueue
  SeparateFifoDeadLetterQueueUrl:
    Value: !Ref SeparateFifoDeadLetterQueue

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Private networking infrastructure for a private Red Hat OpenShift Service on AWS (ROSA)
  cluster using AWS PrivateLink. Creates a private ROSA VPC, an egress VPC with an Internet
  Gateway and NAT Gateway, and a Transit Gateway that routes ROSA egress traffic through the
  egress VPC. Optionally creates the ELB service-linked role and VPC Flow Logs encrypted with
  a customer managed KMS key.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: ROSA Private VPC
        Parameters:
          - NumberOfAZs
          - RosaVpcCidr
          - RosaPrivateSubnet1Cidr
          - RosaPrivateSubnet2Cidr
          - RosaPrivateSubnet3Cidr
      - Label:
          default: Egress VPC
        Parameters:
          - EgressVpcCidr
          - EgressPublicSubnetCidr
          - EgressPrivateSubnetCidr
      - Label:
          default: Optional Features
        Parameters:
          - CreateElbServiceLinkedRole
          - EnableFlowLogs
          - FlowLogsRetentionInDays
    ParameterLabels:
      NumberOfAZs:
        default: Number of Availability Zones
      CreateElbServiceLinkedRole:
        default: Create ELB service-linked role
      EnableFlowLogs:
        default: Enable VPC Flow Logs

Parameters:
  NumberOfAZs:
    Type: String
    Default: '1'
    AllowedValues:
      - '1'
      - '3'
    Description: Number of Availability Zones (and private subnets) to use for the ROSA VPC.

  RosaVpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the private ROSA VPC.

  RosaPrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.0.0/20
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for ROSA private subnet 1.

  RosaPrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.16.0/20
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for ROSA private subnet 2 (used only when NumberOfAZs is 3).

  RosaPrivateSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.32.0/20
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for ROSA private subnet 3 (used only when NumberOfAZs is 3).

  EgressVpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the egress VPC.

  EgressPublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the egress VPC public subnet.

  EgressPrivateSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the egress VPC private subnet (Transit Gateway attachment).

  CreateElbServiceLinkedRole:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: >-
      Create the Elastic Load Balancing service-linked role. Set to false if the role
      (AWSServiceRoleForElasticLoadBalancing) already exists in the account.

  EnableFlowLogs:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Enable VPC Flow Logs for both VPCs, delivered to KMS-encrypted CloudWatch Logs.

  FlowLogsRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1096, 1827, 2192, 2557, 2922, 3288, 3653]
    Description: Retention period (days) for VPC Flow Logs log groups.

Conditions:
  UseThreeAZs: !Equals [!Ref NumberOfAZs, '3']
  ShouldCreateElbServiceLinkedRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateElbServiceLinkedRole, 'true']
  ShouldEnableFlowLogs: !Equals [!Ref EnableFlowLogs, 'true']

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ROSA private VPC
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RosaVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-rosa-vpc

  RosaPrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-rosa-private-1
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  RosaPrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: UseThreeAZs
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-rosa-private-2
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  RosaPrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: UseThreeAZs
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-rosa-private-3
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  RosaPrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-rosa-private-rt

  RosaPrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: RosaTgwAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  RosaPrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateRouteTable

  RosaPrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: UseThreeAZs
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateRouteTable

  RosaPrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: UseThreeAZs
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaPrivateRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Egress VPC
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EgressVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressVpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-vpc

  EgressPublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-public

  EgressPrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-private

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-igw

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  NatGatewayEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-nat-eip

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEip.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-nat

  EgressPublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-public-rt

  EgressPublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Return traffic from the NAT gateway back to the ROSA VPC
  EgressPublicToRosaRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: EgressTgwAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCidr
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  EgressPublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable

  EgressPrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-private-rt

  EgressPrivateDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  EgressPrivateToRosaRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: EgressTgwAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCidr
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  EgressPrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Transit Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub Transit Gateway for ${AWS::StackName} ROSA private networking
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: disable
      DnsSupport: enable
      VpnEcmpSupport: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-tgw

  TransitGatewayRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-tgw-rt

  RosaTgwAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      SubnetIds: !If
        - UseThreeAZs
        - - !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet1
          - !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet2
          - !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet3
        - - !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-rosa-tgw-attachment

  EgressTgwAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-tgw-attachment

  RosaTgwRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref RosaTgwAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  EgressTgwRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref EgressTgwAttachment
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  # Internet-bound traffic from the ROSA VPC goes to the egress VPC
  TgwDefaultRouteToEgress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref EgressTgwAttachment

  # Return traffic destined to the ROSA VPC
  TgwRouteToRosa:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCidr
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref RosaTgwAttachment

  # Inter-VPC traffic destined to the egress VPC
  TgwRouteToEgressVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref EgressVpcCidr
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref EgressTgwAttachment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Optional: Elastic Load Balancing service-linked role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ElbServiceLinkedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ServiceLinkedRole
    Condition: ShouldCreateElbServiceLinkedRole
    Properties:
      AWSServiceName: elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com
      Description: Service-linked role for Elastic Load Balancing used by ROSA

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Optional: VPC Flow Logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: ShouldEnableFlowLogs
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub Customer managed key for ${AWS::StackName} VPC Flow Logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-flow-logs-key

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: ShouldEnableFlowLogs
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${AWS::StackName}-vpc-flow-logs
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  RosaVpcFlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: ShouldEnableFlowLogs
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/vpc-flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}/rosa-vpc
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogsRetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  EgressVpcFlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: ShouldEnableFlowLogs
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub /aws/vpc-flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}/egress-vpc
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogsRetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: ShouldEnableFlowLogs
    Properties:
      Description: Allows VPC Flow Logs to publish to CloudWatch Logs
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc-flow-log/*
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: vpc-flow-logs-to-cloudwatch
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt RosaVpcFlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub ${RosaVpcFlowLogsLogGroup.Arn}:*
                  - !GetAtt EgressVpcFlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub ${EgressVpcFlowLogsLogGroup.Arn}:*

  RosaVpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Condition: ShouldEnableFlowLogs
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref RosaVpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref RosaVpcFlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-rosa-vpc-flow-log

  EgressVpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Condition: ShouldEnableFlowLogs
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref EgressVpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref EgressVpcFlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-egress-vpc-flow-log

Outputs:
  RosaVpcId:
    Description: ID of the private ROSA VPC
    Value: !Ref RosaVpc
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-RosaVpcId

  RosaPrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of ROSA private subnet IDs
    Value: !If
      - UseThreeAZs
      - !Join [',', [!Ref RosaPrivateSubnet1, !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet2, !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet3]]
      - !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-RosaPrivateSubnetIds

  RosaPrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of ROSA private subnet 1
    Value: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet1

  RosaPrivateSubnet2Id:
    Condition: UseThreeAZs
    Description: ID of ROSA private subnet 2
    Value: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet2

  RosaPrivateSubnet3Id:
    Condition: UseThreeAZs
    Description: ID of ROSA private subnet 3
    Value: !Ref RosaPrivateSubnet3

  EgressVpcId:
    Description: ID of the egress VPC
    Value: !Ref EgressVpc
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-EgressVpcId

  EgressPublicSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the egress VPC public subnet
    Value: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet

  EgressPrivateSubnetId:
    Description: ID of the egress VPC private subnet
    Value: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet

  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the Transit Gateway
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-TransitGatewayId

  TransitGatewayRouteTableId:
    Description: ID of the Transit Gateway route table
    Value: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable

  NatGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the NAT Gateway in the egress VPC
    Value: !Ref NatGateway

  NatGatewayPublicIp:
    Description: Public Elastic IP address of the NAT Gateway
    Value: !Ref NatGatewayEip

  InternetGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the Internet Gateway attached to the egress VPC
    Value: !Ref InternetGateway

  FlowLogsKmsKeyArn:
    Condition: ShouldEnableFlowLogs
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key encrypting VPC Flow Logs
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  RosaVpcFlowLogsLogGroupName:
    Condition: ShouldEnableFlowLogs
    Description: CloudWatch Logs log group for ROSA VPC Flow Logs
    Value: !Ref RosaVpcFlowLogsLogGroup

  EgressVpcFlowLogsLogGroupName:
    Condition: ShouldEnableFlowLogs
    Description: CloudWatch Logs log group for egress VPC Flow Logs
    Value: !Ref EgressVpcFlowLogsLogGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Prerequisite resources and SSM Automation documents for automated remediation
  of PCI DSS controls. All outputs are exported for use by custom AWS Config
  conformance packs.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Prerequisites
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cloudtrail-logs'
      RetentionInDays: 1827

  PCIKMSKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for PCI DSS remediation (CloudTrail encryption)
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Id: pci-remediation-key-policy
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  PCIKMSKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-pci-remediation'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref PCIKMSKey

  AutomationAssumeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess'

  CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowLogDelivery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:PutRetentionPolicy
                  - logs:PutMetricFilter
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                  - logs:FilterLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*:log-stream:*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SSM Automation documents
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EncryptCloudTrailDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Encrypts a CloudTrail trail with the provided KMS key and integrates it with CloudWatch Logs.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: Name or ARN of the CloudTrail trail.
          KMSKeyId:
            type: String
            description: KMS key ID or ARN used to encrypt the trail log files.
            default: !GetAtt PCIKMSKey.Arn
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsRole.Arn
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt AutomationAssumeRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: EncryptTrailAndIntegrateCloudWatch
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              KmsKeyId: '{{ KMSKeyId }}'
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}'
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}'
            isEnd: true

  EnableKeyRotationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enables automatic key rotation for the specified KMS key.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          KeyId:
            type: String
            description: KMS key ID or ARN.
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt AutomationAssumeRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableKeyRotation
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: kms
              Api: EnableKeyRotation
              KeyId: '{{ KeyId }}'
            isEnd: true

  CloudTrailCloudWatchIntegrationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Integrates a CloudTrail trail with CloudWatch Logs.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: Name or ARN of the CloudTrail trail.
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsRole.Arn
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt AutomationAssumeRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: IntegrateTrailWithCloudWatch
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}'
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}'
            isEnd: true

  UpdatePasswordPolicyDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Updates the account IAM password policy to meet PCI DSS requirements.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt AutomationAssumeRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: iam
              Api: UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy
              MinimumPasswordLength: 14
              RequireSymbols: true
              RequireNumbers: true
              RequireUppercaseCharacters: true
              RequireLowercaseCharacters: true
              AllowUsersToChangePassword: true
              HardExpiry: true
              MaxPasswordAge: 90
              PasswordReusePrevention: 24
            isEnd: true

  EnableLogFileValidationDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enables log file validation on a CloudTrail trail and ensures it is multi-region and integrated with CloudWatch Logs.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: Name or ARN of the CloudTrail trail.
          CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn
          CloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsRole.Arn
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt AutomationAssumeRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableLogFileValidation
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              EnableLogFileValidation: true
              IsMultiRegionTrail: true
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn }}'
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: '{{ CloudWatchLogsRoleArn }}'
            isEnd: true

  RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRulesDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Revokes all inbound and outbound rules on the given default security group.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          GroupId:
            type: String
            description: ID of the default security group.
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt AutomationAssumeRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: RevokeAllRules
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                GroupId: '{{ GroupId }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def handler(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    group_id = events['GroupId']
                    sg = ec2.describe_security_groups(GroupIds=[group_id])['SecurityGroups'][0]
                    if sg['GroupName'] != 'default':
                        raise Exception('Security group %s is not a default security group.' % group_id)
                    if sg.get('IpPermissions'):
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_ingress(GroupId=group_id, IpPermissions=sg['IpPermissions'])
                    if sg.get('IpPermissionsEgress'):
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_egress(GroupId=group_id, IpPermissions=sg['IpPermissionsEgress'])
                    return {
                        'GroupId': group_id,
                        'IngressRulesRevoked': len(sg.get('IpPermissions', [])),
                        'EgressRulesRevoked': len(sg.get('IpPermissionsEgress', []))
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: Result
                Selector: $.Payload
                Type: StringMap
            isEnd: true

  DeleteSecurityGroupDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Deletes the specified security group.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          GroupId:
            type: String
            description: ID of the security group to delete.
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt AutomationAssumeRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: DeleteSecurityGroup
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DeleteSecurityGroup
              GroupId: '{{ GroupId }}'
            isEnd: true

  ReleaseElasticIPDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Releases an unused Elastic IP address given its allocation ID.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AllocationId:
            type: String
            description: Allocation ID of the Elastic IP address.
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt AutomationAssumeRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: ReleaseAddress
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: ReleaseAddress
              AllocationId: '{{ AllocationId }}'
            isEnd: true

  RemoveCodeBuildCredentialsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Removes AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY environment variables from a CodeBuild project.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          ProjectName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CodeBuild project.
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            default: !GetAtt AutomationAssumeRole.Arn
        mainSteps:
          - name: RemoveCredentialEnvironmentVariables
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                ProjectName: '{{ ProjectName }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                BLOCKED = ('AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID', 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY')

                def handler(events, context):
                    cb = boto3.client('codebuild')
                    name = events['ProjectName']
                    projects = cb.batch_get_projects(names=[name])['projects']
                    if not projects:
                        raise Exception('CodeBuild project %s not found.' % name)
                    environment = projects[0]['environment']
                    variables = environment.get('environmentVariables', [])
                    kept = [v for v in variables if v['name'] not in BLOCKED]
                    removed = len(variables) - len(kept)
                    if removed:
                        environment['environmentVariables'] = kept
                        cb.update_project(name=name, environment=environment)
                    return {'ProjectName': name, 'VariablesRemoved': str(removed)}
            outputs:
              - Name: Result
                Selector: $.Payload
                Type: StringMap
            isEnd: true

Outputs:
  CloudTrailLogGroupName:
    Description: CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs log group name
    Value: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CloudTrailLogGroupName'
  CloudTrailLogGroupArn:
    Description: CloudTrail CloudWatch Logs log group ARN
    Value: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CloudTrailLogGroupArn'
  KMSKeyId:
    Description: KMS key ID
    Value: !Ref PCIKMSKey
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KMSKeyId'
  KMSKeyArn:
    Description: KMS key ARN
    Value: !GetAtt PCIKMSKey.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-KMSKeyArn'
  AutomationAssumeRoleArn:
    Description: IAM role ARN assumed by SSM Automation
    Value: !GetAtt AutomationAssumeRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AutomationAssumeRoleArn'
  CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsRoleArn:
    Description: IAM role ARN used by CloudTrail to deliver to CloudWatch Logs
    Value: !GetAtt CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsRoleArn'
  EncryptCloudTrailDocumentName:
    Value: !Ref EncryptCloudTrailDocument
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EncryptCloudTrailDocument'
  EnableKeyRotationDocumentName:
    Value: !Ref EnableKeyRotationDocument
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EnableKeyRotationDocument'
  CloudTrailCloudWatchIntegrationDocumentName:
    Value: !Ref CloudTrailCloudWatchIntegrationDocument
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CloudTrailCloudWatchIntegrationDocument'
  UpdatePasswordPolicyDocumentName:
    Value: !Ref UpdatePasswordPolicyDocument
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-UpdatePasswordPolicyDocument'
  EnableLogFileValidationDocumentName:
    Value: !Ref EnableLogFileValidationDocument
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EnableLogFileValidationDocument'
  RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRulesDocumentName:
    Value: !Ref RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRulesDocument
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRulesDocument'
  DeleteSecurityGroupDocumentName:
    Value: !Ref DeleteSecurityGroupDocument
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DeleteSecurityGroupDocument'
  ReleaseElasticIPDocumentName:
    Value: !Ref ReleaseElasticIPDocument
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ReleaseElasticIPDocument'
  RemoveCodeBuildCredentialsDocumentName:
    Value: !Ref RemoveCodeBuildCredentialsDocument
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-RemoveCodeBuildCredentialsDocument'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Telemetry monitoring for Claude Desktop (CoWork). Creates a CloudWatch Logs log group for
  CoWork events, metric filters that normalize two event schemas into one set of metrics, and
  a CloudWatch dashboard. The two schemas are (1) local agent mode, with event_type
  "cowork.turn_completed", usage.* token fields, cost_usd, user_id, model and session_id, and
  (2) Claude Code for Desktop, with event_name "claude_code.api_request" or
  "claude_code.user_prompt", and attributes.* token fields, attributes.cost_usd,
  attributes.user_email, attributes.model and attributes.session_id.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Logging
        Parameters:
          - LogGroupName
          - LogRetentionInDays
      - Label:
          default: Metrics and Dashboard
        Parameters:
          - MetricNamespace
          - MetricsRegion
          - DashboardName

Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /claude/cowork/telemetry
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives CoWork telemetry events.
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1096, 1827, 2192, 2557, 2922, 3288, 3653]
    Description: Retention period for CoWork telemetry events.
  MetricNamespace:
    Type: String
    Default: ClaudeCoWork
    Description: CloudWatch metric namespace for the extracted CoWork metrics.
  MetricsRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-\\d$"
    Description: Region that dashboard widgets query for metrics and logs.
  DashboardName:
    Type: String
    Default: Claude-CoWork-Telemetry
    AllowedPattern: "^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,255}$"
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch dashboard.

Resources:
  CoWorkLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref LogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Local agent mode schema - totals (no attribution, default 0 when unmatched)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LocalInputTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_type = "cowork.turn_completed" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: InputTokens
          MetricValue: $.usage.input_tokens
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  LocalOutputTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_type = "cowork.turn_completed" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: OutputTokens
          MetricValue: $.usage.output_tokens
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  LocalCacheReadTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_type = "cowork.turn_completed" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: CacheReadTokens
          MetricValue: $.usage.cache_read_input_tokens
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  LocalCacheCreationTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_type = "cowork.turn_completed" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: CacheCreationTokens
          MetricValue: $.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  LocalEstimatedCostFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_type = "cowork.turn_completed" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: EstimatedCostUSD
          MetricValue: $.cost_usd
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: None

  LocalSessionTurnsFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_type = "cowork.turn_completed" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: SessionTurns
          MetricValue: "1"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Claude Code for Desktop schema - totals (no attribution, default 0)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CodeInputTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_name = "claude_code.api_request" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: InputTokens
          MetricValue: $.attributes.input_tokens
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  CodeOutputTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_name = "claude_code.api_request" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: OutputTokens
          MetricValue: $.attributes.output_tokens
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  CodeCacheReadTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_name = "claude_code.api_request" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: CacheReadTokens
          MetricValue: $.attributes.cache_read_tokens
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  CodeCacheCreationTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_name = "claude_code.api_request" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: CacheCreationTokens
          MetricValue: $.attributes.cache_creation_tokens
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  CodeEstimatedCostFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_name = "claude_code.api_request" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: EstimatedCostUSD
          MetricValue: $.attributes.cost_usd
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: None

  CodeSessionTurnsFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_name = "claude_code.user_prompt" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: SessionTurns
          MetricValue: "1"
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Model-attributed metrics (dimensions; DefaultValue not allowed with dimensions)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LocalInputTokensByModelFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_type = "cowork.turn_completed" && $.model = * }'
      MetricTransformations:

  LocalOutputTokensByModelFilter:

    Properties:

      MetricTransformations:

            - Key: Model
              Value: $.model

  LocalEstimatedCostByModelFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_type = "cowork.turn_completed" && $.model = * }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: EstimatedCostUSD
          MetricValue: $.cost_usd
          Unit: None
          Dimensions:
            - Key: Model
              Value: $.model

  CodeInputTokensByModelFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_name = "claude_code.api_request" && $.attributes.model = * }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: InputTokens
          MetricValue: $.attributes.input_tokens
          Unit: Count
          Dimensions:
            - Key: Model
              Value: $.attributes.model

  CodeOutputTokensByModelFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_name = "claude_code.api_request" && $.attributes.model = * }'

        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: OutputTokens
          MetricValue: $.attributes.output_tokens
          Unit: Count
          Dimensions:
            - Key: Model
              Value: $.attributes.model

  CodeEstimatedCostByModelFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.event_name = "claude_code.api_request" && $.attributes.model = * }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: !Ref MetricNamespace
          MetricName: EstimatedCostUSD
          MetricValue: $.attributes.cost_usd
          Unit: None
          Dimensions:
            - Key: Model
              Value: $.attributes.model

  CoWorkDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Ref DashboardName
      DashboardBody: !Sub |
        {
          "start": "-PT24H",
          "widgets": [
            {
              "type": "text", "x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 24, "height": 1,
              "properties": { "markdown": "## Claude Desktop (CoWork) Telemetry - local agent mode and Claude Code for Desktop" }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 1, "width": 6, "height": 4,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Total Tokens", "view": "singleValue", "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                "stat": "Sum", "period": 300, "setPeriodToTimeRange": true,
                "metrics": [
                  [ { "expression": "m1+m2+m3+m4", "label": "Total Tokens", "id": "e1" } ],
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "InputTokens", { "id": "m1", "visible": false } ],
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "OutputTokens", { "id": "m2", "visible": false } ],
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "CacheReadTokens", { "id": "m3", "visible": false } ],
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "CacheCreationTokens", { "id": "m4", "visible": false } ]
                ]
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric", "x": 6, "y": 1, "width": 6, "height": 4,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Total Estimated Cost (USD)", "view": "singleValue", "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                "stat": "Sum", "period": 300, "setPeriodToTimeRange": true,
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "EstimatedCostUSD", { "label": "Cost (USD)" } ]
                ]
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric", "x": 12, "y": 1, "width": 6, "height": 4,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Session Turns", "view": "singleValue", "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                "stat": "Sum", "period": 300, "setPeriodToTimeRange": true,
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "SessionTurns", { "label": "Turns" } ]
                ]
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric", "x": 18, "y": 1, "width": 6, "height": 4,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Cache Hit Tokens", "view": "singleValue", "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                "stat": "Sum", "period": 300, "setPeriodToTimeRange": true,
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "CacheReadTokens", { "label": "Cache Read Tokens" } ]
                ]
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 5, "width": 12, "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Token Usage Over Time", "view": "timeSeries", "stacked": true,
                "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "stat": "Sum", "period": 3600,
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "InputTokens", { "label": "Input" } ],
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "OutputTokens", { "label": "Output" } ],
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "CacheReadTokens", { "label": "Cache Read" } ],
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "CacheCreationTokens", { "label": "Cache Creation" } ]
                ]
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric", "x": 12, "y": 5, "width": 12, "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Estimated Cost Over Time (USD)", "view": "timeSeries", "stacked": false,
                "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "stat": "Sum", "period": 3600,
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "EstimatedCostUSD", { "label": "Total Cost" } ],
                  [ { "expression": "SEARCH('{${MetricNamespace},Model} MetricName=\"EstimatedCostUSD\"', 'Sum', 3600)", "label": "", "id": "e1" } ]
                ]
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 11, "width": 12, "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Session Turns and Average Cost per Turn", "view": "timeSeries",
                "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "stat": "Sum", "period": 3600,
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "SessionTurns", { "id": "m1", "label": "Turns" } ],
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "EstimatedCostUSD", { "id": "m2", "visible": false } ],
                  [ { "expression": "IF(m1 > 0, m2 / m1, 0)", "label": "Avg Cost per Turn (USD)", "id": "e1", "yAxis": "right" } ]
                ],
                "yAxis": { "left": { "label": "Turns", "min": 0 }, "right": { "label": "USD", "min": 0 } }
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "metric", "x": 12, "y": 11, "width": 12, "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Average Cost per Turn (USD)", "view": "singleValue",
                "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "stat": "Sum", "period": 300, "setPeriodToTimeRange": true,
                "metrics": [
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "SessionTurns", { "id": "m1", "visible": false } ],
                  [ "${MetricNamespace}", "EstimatedCostUSD", { "id": "m2", "visible": false } ],
                  [ { "expression": "IF(m1 > 0, m2 / m1, 0)", "label": "Avg Cost per Turn", "id": "e1" } ]
                ]
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log", "x": 0, "y": 17, "width": 12, "height": 7,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Token Usage and Cost by User", "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "view": "table",
                "query": "SOURCE '${CoWorkLogGroup}' | filter event_type = 'cowork.turn_completed' or event_name = 'claude_code.api_request' | fields coalesce(user_id, attributes.user_email, 'unknown') as user, coalesce(usage.input_tokens, attributes.input_tokens, 0) as inTok, coalesce(usage.output_tokens, attributes.output_tokens, 0) as outTok, coalesce(usage.cache_read_input_tokens, attributes.cache_read_tokens, 0) as cacheRead, coalesce(usage.cache_creation_input_tokens, attributes.cache_creation_tokens, 0) as cacheCreate, coalesce(cost_usd, attributes.cost_usd, 0) as cost | stats sum(inTok) as inputTokens, sum(outTok) as outputTokens, sum(cacheRead) as cacheReadTokens, sum(cacheCreate) as cacheCreationTokens, sum(cost) as costUSD by user | sort costUSD desc | limit 50"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log", "x": 12, "y": 17, "width": 12, "height": 7,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Session Activity by User", "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "view": "table",
                "query": "SOURCE '${CoWorkLogGroup}' | filter event_type = 'cowork.turn_completed' or event_name = 'claude_code.user_prompt' | fields coalesce(user_id, attributes.user_email, 'unknown') as user, coalesce(session_id, attributes.session_id, 'unknown') as session | stats count(*) as turns, count_distinct(session) as sessions, max(@timestamp) as lastActive by user | sort turns desc | limit 50"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log", "x": 0, "y": 24, "width": 8, "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Active Users", "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "view": "table",
                "query": "SOURCE '${CoWorkLogGroup}' | filter event_type = 'cowork.turn_completed' or event_name like /^claude_code\\./ | fields coalesce(user_id, attributes.user_email) as user | filter ispresent(user) | stats count_distinct(user) as activeUsers"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log", "x": 8, "y": 24, "width": 16, "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Active Users Over Time", "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "view": "timeSeries",
                "query": "SOURCE '${CoWorkLogGroup}' | filter event_type = 'cowork.turn_completed' or event_name like /^claude_code\\./ | fields coalesce(user_id, attributes.user_email) as user | filter ispresent(user) | stats count_distinct(user) as activeUsers by bin(1h)"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log", "x": 0, "y": 30, "width": 24, "height": 8,
              "properties": {
                "title": "Recent Raw Events", "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "view": "table",
                "query": "SOURCE '${CoWorkLogGroup}' | fields @timestamp, coalesce(event_type, event_name) as event, coalesce(user_id, attributes.user_email) as user, coalesce(model, attributes.model) as model, coalesce(cost_usd, attributes.cost_usd) as cost, @message | sort @timestamp desc | limit 100"
              }
            }
          ]
        }

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained bootstrap environment for deploying AWS CDK applications.

Parameters:
  Qualifier:
    Type: String
    Default: hnb659fds
    AllowedPattern: '[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,10}'
    ConstraintDescription: Qualifier must be 1-10 alphanumeric, underscore or hyphen characters.
    Description: Short string that uniquely identifies the bootstrap resources when multiple bootstrap stacks exist in the same account and region.
  TrustedAccounts:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: List of AWS account IDs that are trusted to publish assets and deploy stacks to this environment.
  TrustedAccountsForLookup:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: List of AWS account IDs that are trusted to look up values in this environment.
  CloudFormationExecutionPolicies:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: List of managed policy ARNs attached to the CloudFormation execution role. Defaults to AdministratorAccess when empty.
  FileAssetsBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Custom name for the file assets bucket. Leave empty to generate a name from the qualifier.
  FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Existing KMS key ID or ARN used to encrypt the file assets bucket. Leave empty to create a new key, or set to AWS_MANAGED_KEY to use the AWS managed S3 key.
  FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^alias/[a-zA-Z0-9:/_-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Alias must be empty or start with "alias/".
    Description: Custom alias for the newly created KMS key. Leave empty to use alias/cdk-<qualifier>-assets-key.
  ContainerAssetsRepositoryName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Custom name for the container assets ECR repository. Leave empty to generate a name from the qualifier.
  PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to block all public access on the file assets bucket.

Conditions:
  HasTrustedAccounts: !Not [!Equals ['', !Join ['', !Ref TrustedAccounts]]]
  HasTrustedAccountsForLookup: !Not [!Equals ['', !Join ['', !Ref TrustedAccountsForLookup]]]
  HasCloudFormationExecutionPolicies: !Not [!Equals ['', !Join ['', !Ref CloudFormationExecutionPolicies]]]
  HasCustomFileAssetsBucketName: !Not [!Equals ['', !Ref FileAssetsBucketName]]
  HasCustomContainerAssetsRepositoryName: !Not [!Equals ['', !Ref ContainerAssetsRepositoryName]]
  HasCustomKmsKeyAlias: !Not [!Equals ['', !Ref FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyAlias]]
  CreateNewKey: !Equals ['', !Ref FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId]
  UseAwsManagedKey: !Equals ['AWS_MANAGED_KEY', !Ref FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId]
  UsePublicAccessBlockConfiguration: !Equals ['true', !Ref PublicAccessBlockConfiguration]

Resources:
  FileAssetsBucketEncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: CreateNewKey
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'CDK bootstrap (${Qualifier}) file assets bucket encryption key'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - kms:Create*
              - kms:Describe*
              - kms:Enable*
              - kms:List*
              - kms:Put*
              - kms:Update*
              - kms:Revoke*
              - kms:Disable*
              - kms:Get*
              - kms:Delete*
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:CancelKeyDeletion
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:TagResource
              - kms:UntagResource
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowUseViaS3
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: '*'
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
          - Sid: AllowFilePublishingRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/cdk-${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'

  FileAssetsBucketEncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: CreateNewKey
    Properties:
      AliasName: !If
        - HasCustomKmsKeyAlias
        - !Ref FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyAlias
        - !Sub 'alias/cdk-${Qualifier}-assets-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FileAssetsBucketEncryptionKey

  StagingBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If
        - HasCustomFileAssetsBucketName
        - !Ref FileAssetsBucketName
        - !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AccessControl: Private
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !If
                - CreateNewKey
                - !GetAtt FileAssetsBucketEncryptionKey.Arn
                - !If
                  - UseAwsManagedKey
                  - !Ref AWS::NoValue
                  - !Ref FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration: !If
        - UsePublicAccessBlockConfiguration
        - BlockPublicAcls: true
          BlockPublicPolicy: true
          IgnorePublicAcls: true
          RestrictPublicBuckets: true
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: CleanupOldVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 365

  StagingBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref StagingBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSSLRequestsOnly
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:*
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt StagingBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${StagingBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  ContainerAssetsRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !If
        - HasCustomContainerAssetsRepositoryName
        - !Ref ContainerAssetsRepositoryName
        - !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-container-assets-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      EncryptionConfiguration:
        EncryptionType: AES256
      RepositoryPolicyText:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: LambdaECRImageRetrievalPolicy
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                aws:sourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*'

  FilePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Principal:
              AWS: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - !If
            - HasTrustedAccounts
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: sts:AssumeRole
              Principal:
                AWS: !Ref TrustedAccounts
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-file-publishing-role-default-policy-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject*
                  - s3:GetBucket*
                  - s3:GetEncryptionConfiguration
                  - s3:List*
                  - s3:DeleteObject*
                  - s3:PutObject*
                  - s3:Abort*
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt StagingBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${StagingBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                Resource: !If
                  - CreateNewKey
                  - !GetAtt FileAssetsBucketEncryptionKey.Arn
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:key/${FileAssetsBucketKmsKeyId}'
      Tags:
        - Key: aws-cdk:bootstrap-role
          Value: file-publishing

  ImagePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'cdk-${Qualifier}-image-publishing-role-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Principal:
              AWS: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - !If
            - HasTrustedAccounts
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: sts:AssumeRole
              Principal:
                AWS: !Ref TrustedAccounts
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue
