AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Elastic Beanstalk Blue-Green deployment. Creates a new application and blue environment,
  or references existing ones, and can stage a temporary green environment and route traffic to it
  by swapping CNAMEs. Set DeploymentStage back to BlueOnly to swap traffic back to blue
  and terminate the green environment.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Blue Deployment
        Parameters:
          - CreateNewBlueResources
          - ApplicationName
          - BlueEnvironmentName
      - Label:
          default: Green Deployment
        Parameters:
          - DeploymentStage
          - GreenEnvironmentName
          - GreenSourceKey
      - Label:
          default: Application Source and Platform
        Parameters:
          - SourceBucket
          - SourceKey
          - SolutionStackName
          - SolutionStackPrefix
          - SolutionStackSuffix
          - EnvironmentType
          - InstanceType
    ParameterLabels:
      CreateNewBlueResources:
        default: Create new application and blue environment?
      DeploymentStage:
        default: Deployment stage

Parameters:
  CreateNewBlueResources:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: >-
      true = create a new Elastic Beanstalk application and blue environment.
      false = reference an existing application and blue environment by the names below.

  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: BlueGreenSampleApp
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 100
    Description: Name of the application to create, or of the existing application to reference.

  BlueEnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: BlueGreenSample-Blue
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]{2,38}[a-zA-Z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: 4-40 characters, letters, numbers and hyphens; cannot start or end with a hyphen.
    Description: Name of the blue environment to create, or of the existing blue environment to reference.

  DeploymentStage:
    Type: String
    Default: BlueOnly
    AllowedValues:
      - BlueOnly
      - GreenStaged
      - TrafficOnGreen
    Description: >-
      BlueOnly = only the blue environment exists (moving here from TrafficOnGreen swaps traffic back to blue
      and terminates green). GreenStaged = create the temporary green environment without routing traffic.
      TrafficOnGreen = create green (if needed) and swap CNAMEs so traffic is routed to green.

  GreenEnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: BlueGreenSample-Green
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]{2,38}[a-zA-Z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: 4-40 characters, letters, numbers and hyphens; cannot start or end with a hyphen.
    Description: Name of the temporary green environment.

  SourceBucket:
    Type: String
    Default: elasticbeanstalk-samples
    Description: >-
      S3 bucket holding the application source bundle. When left as the default
      (elasticbeanstalk-samples) the current region is appended, e.g. elasticbeanstalk-samples-us-east-1.
      Any other value is used as-is.

  SourceKey:
    Type: String
    Default: nodejs-sample.zip
    Description: S3 key of the source bundle deployed to the blue environment (when created by this stack).

  GreenSourceKey:
    Type: String
    Default: nodejs-sample.zip
    Description: S3 key of the source bundle deployed to the green environment.

  SolutionStackName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional explicit solution stack name. Leave empty to automatically select the latest
      available stack matching SolutionStackPrefix and SolutionStackSuffix.

  SolutionStackPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: 64bit Amazon Linux 2023
    Description: Prefix used to find the latest solution stack when SolutionStackName is empty.

  SolutionStackSuffix:
    Type: String
    Default: running Node.js 22
    Description: Suffix used to find the latest solution stack when SolutionStackName is empty.

  EnvironmentType:
    Type: String
    Default: LoadBalanced
    AllowedValues: [LoadBalanced, SingleInstance]
    Description: Environment type for environments created by this stack.

  InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: t3.small
    Description: EC2 instance type for environments created by this stack.

Conditions:
  CreateBlue: !Equals [!Ref CreateNewBlueResources, 'true']
  CreateGreen: !Or
    - !Equals [!Ref DeploymentStage, GreenStaged]
    - !Equals [!Ref DeploymentStage, TrafficOnGreen]
  RouteToGreen: !Equals [!Ref DeploymentStage, TrafficOnGreen]
  NeedsEnvironmentResources: !Or
    - !Condition CreateBlue
    - !Condition CreateGreen
  UseDefaultBucket: !Equals [!Ref SourceBucket, elasticbeanstalk-samples]
  LookupSolutionStack: !And
    - !Condition NeedsEnvironmentResources
    - !Equals [!Ref SolutionStackName, '']
  UseLoadBalancer: !Equals [!Ref EnvironmentType, LoadBalanced]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM roles for Elastic Beanstalk environments
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EBServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: NeedsEnvironmentResources
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: elasticbeanstalk.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                sts:ExternalId: elasticbeanstalk
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSElasticBeanstalkEnhancedHealth
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSElasticBeanstalkManagedUpdatesCustomerRolePolicy

  EBInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: NeedsEnvironmentResources
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSElasticBeanstalkWebTier
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSElasticBeanstalkMulticontainerDocker
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSElasticBeanstalkWorkerTier

  EBInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Condition: NeedsEnvironmentResources
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref EBInstanceRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Solution stack lookup (selects the latest supported platform version)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SolutionStackLookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: LookupSolutionStack
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ListSolutionStacks
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: elasticbeanstalk:ListAvailableSolutionStacks
                Resource: '*'

  SolutionStackLookupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Condition: LookupSolutionStack
    Properties:
      Description: Returns the latest Elastic Beanstalk solution stack matching a prefix and suffix.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt SolutionStackLookupRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import re
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          def version(name):
              m = re.search(r' v(\d+)\.(\d+)\.(\d+) ', name)
              return tuple(int(x) for x in m.groups()) if m else (0, 0, 0)

          def handler(event, context):
              physical_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId', 'solution-stack-lookup')
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, physical_id)
                      return
                  props = event['ResourceProperties']
                  prefix, suffix = props['Prefix'], props['Suffix']
                  stacks = boto3.client('elasticbeanstalk').list_available_solution_stacks()['SolutionStacks']
                  matches = [s for s in stacks if s.startswith(prefix) and s.endswith(suffix)]
                  if not matches:
                      raise Exception('No solution stack matches prefix "%s" and suffix "%s"' % (prefix, suffix))
                  best = sorted(matches, key=version)[-1]
                  print('Selected solution stack: %s' % best)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS,
                                   {'SolutionStackName': best}, 'solution-stack-lookup')
              except Exception as e:
                  print(e)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {}, physical_id, reason=str(e))

  SolutionStackLookup:
    Type: Custom::SolutionStackLookup
    Condition: LookupSolutionStack
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SolutionStackLookupFunction.Arn
      Prefix: !Ref SolutionStackPrefix
      Suffix: !Ref SolutionStackSuffix

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Blue deployment (created only when CreateNewBlueResources = true)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  BlueApplication:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Application
    Condition: CreateBlue
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref ApplicationName
      Description: Blue-Green deployment application

  BlueApplicationVersion:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::ApplicationVersion
    Condition: CreateBlue
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref BlueApplication
      Description: Blue environment application version
      SourceBundle:
        S3Bucket: !If
          - UseDefaultBucket
          - !Sub ${SourceBucket}-${AWS::Region}
          - !Ref SourceBucket
        S3Key: !Ref SourceKey

  BlueEnvironment:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Environment
    Condition: CreateBlue
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref BlueApplication
      EnvironmentName: !Ref BlueEnvironmentName
      Description: Blue environment
      SolutionStackName: !If
        - LookupSolutionStack
        - !GetAtt SolutionStackLookup.SolutionStackName
        - !Ref SolutionStackName
      VersionLabel: !Ref BlueApplicationVersion
      Tier:
        Name: WebServer
        Type: Standard
      OptionSettings:
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: EnvironmentType
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: ServiceRole
          Value: !GetAtt EBServiceRole.Arn
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: IamInstanceProfile
          Value: !Ref EBInstanceProfile
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:instances
          OptionName: InstanceTypes
          Value: !Ref InstanceType
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:healthreporting:system
          OptionName: SystemType
          Value: enhanced
        - !If
          - UseLoadBalancer
          - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
            OptionName: LoadBalancerType
            Value: application
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Temporary green deployment
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GreenApplicationVersion:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::ApplicationVersion
    Condition: CreateGreen
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !If
        - CreateBlue
        - !Ref BlueApplication
        - !Ref ApplicationName
      Description: Green environment application version
      SourceBundle:
        S3Bucket: !If
          - UseDefaultBucket
          - !Sub ${SourceBucket}-${AWS::Region}
          - !Ref SourceBucket
        S3Key: !Ref GreenSourceKey

  GreenEnvironment:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Environment
    Condition: CreateGreen
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !If
        - CreateBlue
        - !Ref BlueApplication
        - !Ref ApplicationName
      EnvironmentName: !Ref GreenEnvironmentName
      Description: Temporary green environment
      SolutionStackName: !If
        - LookupSolutionStack
        - !GetAtt SolutionStackLookup.SolutionStackName
        - !Ref SolutionStackName
      VersionLabel: !Ref GreenApplicationVersion
      Tier:
        Name: WebServer
        Type: Standard
      OptionSettings:
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: EnvironmentType
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentType
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: ServiceRole
          Value: !GetAtt EBServiceRole.Arn
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: IamInstanceProfile
          Value: !Ref EBInstanceProfile
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:instances
          OptionName: InstanceTypes
          Value: !Ref InstanceType
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:healthreporting:system
          OptionName: SystemType
          Value: enhanced
        - !If
          - UseLoadBalancer
          - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
            OptionName: LoadBalancerType
            Value: application
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Traffic routing: swap CNAMEs to green on create, swap back to blue on delete
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CNAMESwapRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: RouteToGreen
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SwapEnvironmentCNAMEs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticbeanstalk:DescribeEnvironments
                  - elasticbeanstalk:SwapEnvironmentCNAMEs
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - autoscaling:DescribeAutoScalingGroups
                  - autoscaling:DescribeLaunchConfigurations
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResource
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - route53:ChangeResourceRecordSets
                  - route53:GetChange
                Resource: '*'

  CNAMESwapFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Condition: RouteToGreen
    Properties:
      Description: Swaps blue/green environment CNAMEs; swaps back to blue when deleted.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 900
      Role: !GetAtt CNAMESwapRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import time
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          eb = boto3.client('elasticbeanstalk')

          def wait_ready(names, context):
              while context.get_remaining_time_in_millis() > 30000:
                  envs = eb.describe_environments(EnvironmentNames=names, IncludeDeleted=False)['Environments']
                  statuses = {e['EnvironmentName']: e['Status'] for e in envs}
                  missing = [n for n in names if n not in statuses]
                  if missing:
                      raise Exception('Environment(s) not found: %s' % ', '.join(missing))
                  if all(s == 'Ready' for s in statuses.values()):
                      return
                  print('Waiting for environments to be Ready: %s' % statuses)
                  time.sleep(15)
              raise Exception('Timed out waiting for environments to become Ready')

          def swap(blue, green, context):
              wait_ready([blue, green], context)
              print('Swapping CNAMEs between %s and %s' % (blue, green))
              eb.swap_environment_cnames(SourceEnvironmentName=blue, DestinationEnvironmentName=green)
              wait_ready([blue, green], context)

          def handler(event, context):
              physical_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId', 'cname-swap-not-performed')
              try:
                  props = event['ResourceProperties']
                  blue, green = props['BlueEnvironmentName'], props['GreenEnvironmentName']
                  request = event['RequestType']
                  if request == 'Create':
                      swap(blue, green, context)
                      physical_id = 'cname-swap-%s-%s' % (blue, green)
                  elif request == 'Update':
                      old = event['OldResourceProperties']
                      if (old['BlueEnvironmentName'], old['GreenEnvironmentName']) != (blue, green):
                          swap(blue, green, context)
                          physical_id = 'cname-swap-%s-%s' % (blue, green)
                  elif request == 'Delete' and physical_id.startswith('cname-swap-') \
                          and physical_id != 'cname-swap-not-performed':
                      # Route traffic back to blue before green is terminated
                      swap(blue, green, context)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, physical_id)
              except Exception as e:
                  print(e)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {}, physical_id, reason=str(e))

  CNAMESwap:
    Type: Custom::EnvironmentCNAMESwap
    Condition: RouteToGreen
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt CNAMESwapFunction.Arn
      BlueEnvironmentName: !If
        - CreateBlue
        - !Ref BlueEnvironment
        - !Ref BlueEnvironmentName
      GreenEnvironmentName: !Ref GreenEnvironment

Outputs:
  ApplicationName:
    Description: Elastic Beanstalk application name
    Value: !If
      - CreateBlue
      - !Ref BlueApplication
      - !Ref ApplicationName

  BlueEnvironmentName:
    Description: Blue environment name
    Value: !If
      - CreateBlue
      - !Ref BlueEnvironment
      - !Ref BlueEnvironmentName

  BlueEnvironmentURL:
    Condition: CreateBlue
    Description: Blue environment endpoint URL
    Value: !Sub http://${BlueEnvironment.EndpointURL}

  GreenEnvironmentName:
    Condition: CreateGreen
    Description: Temporary green environment name
    Value: !Ref GreenEnvironment

  GreenEnvironmentURL:
    Condition: CreateGreen
    Description: Green environment endpoint URL
    Value: !Sub http://${GreenEnvironment.EndpointURL}

  SourceBundleBucket:
    Description: S3 bucket used for the application source bundle
    Value: !If

      - !Sub ${SourceBucket}-${AWS::Region}

  SolutionStack:

  TrafficRouting:
    Description: Environment currently receiving production traffic (via the blue environment's original CNAME)
    Value: !If
      - RouteToGreen
      - !Ref GreenEnvironmentName
      - !Ref BlueEnvironmentName

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained AWS Service Catalog environment for a machine learning workshop.
  Creates admin and end user portfolios, products (VPC, IAM/KMS/S3, AWS Data Exchange,
  infrastructure, application, SageMaker notebook, third-party ML model), a launch role,
  launch constraints, and IAM roles for the lead end user and the standard end user.

Parameters:
  RootS3URL:
    Type: String
    Description: Root S3 URL where the nested CloudFormation product templates are stored (no trailing slash).
    Default: https://aws-service-catalog-reference-architectures.s3.amazonaws.com/blog_content/securing-third-party-data-and-ml-apps
  EnvPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Environment prefix used to name resources.
    Default: user-1
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Only alphanumeric characters and hyphens are allowed.

Resources:
  ###########################################################################
  # Launch role used by Service Catalog to provision products
  ###########################################################################
  SCLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvPrefix}-SCLaunchRole'
      Description: Launch role used by AWS Service Catalog to provision ML workshop products.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SCLaunchRoleProvisioningPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudFormationAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:CreateStack
                  - cloudformation:DeleteStack
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResource
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplateSummary
                  - cloudformation:SetStackPolicy
                  - cloudformation:UpdateStack
                  - cloudformation:ValidateTemplate
                  - cloudformation:CreateChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:DescribeChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:ExecuteChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:DeleteChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:ListChangeSets
                  - cloudformation:ListStackResources
                  - cloudformation:TagResource
                  - cloudformation:UntagResource
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: TemplateReadAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    s3:ExistingObjectTag/servicecatalog:provisioning: 'true'
              - Sid: S3ProvisioningAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:CreateBucket
                  - s3:DeleteBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketPolicy
                  - s3:PutBucketPolicy
                  - s3:DeleteBucketPolicy
                  - s3:PutBucketTagging
                  - s3:GetBucketTagging
                  - s3:PutEncryptionConfiguration
                  - s3:GetEncryptionConfiguration
                  - s3:PutBucketVersioning
                  - s3:GetBucketVersioning
                  - s3:PutBucketPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:GetBucketPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:PutBucketLogging
                  - s3:GetBucketLogging
                  - s3:PutBucketOwnershipControls
                  - s3:PutLifecycleConfiguration
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EC2NetworkingAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:*Vpc*
                  - ec2:*Subnet*
                  - ec2:*RouteTable*
                  - ec2:*Route
                  - ec2:*SecurityGroup*
                  - ec2:*InternetGateway*
                  - ec2:*NatGateway*
                  - ec2:*Address*
                  - ec2:*NetworkAcl*
                  - ec2:*NetworkInterface*
                  - ec2:*FlowLogs*
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DeleteTags
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - ec2:RunInstances
                  - ec2:TerminateInstances
                  - ec2:StartInstances
                  - ec2:StopInstances
                  - ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: IAMAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:DeleteRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:UpdateRole
                  - iam:TagRole
                  - iam:UntagRole
                  - iam:PutRolePolicy
                  - iam:GetRolePolicy
                  - iam:DeleteRolePolicy
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:DetachRolePolicy
                  - iam:ListRolePolicies
                  - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
                  - iam:CreatePolicy
                  - iam:DeletePolicy
                  - iam:GetPolicy
                  - iam:GetPolicyVersion
                  - iam:CreatePolicyVersion
                  - iam:DeletePolicyVersion
                  - iam:ListPolicyVersions
                  - iam:CreateInstanceProfile
                  - iam:DeleteInstanceProfile
                  - iam:GetInstanceProfile
                  - iam:AddRoleToInstanceProfile
                  - iam:RemoveRoleFromInstanceProfile
                  - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: KMSAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:CreateKey
                  - kms:CreateAlias
                  - kms:DeleteAlias
                  - kms:UpdateAlias
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:EnableKeyRotation
                  - kms:GetKeyPolicy
                  - kms:GetKeyRotationStatus
                  - kms:PutKeyPolicy
                  - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
                  - kms:TagResource
                  - kms:UntagResource
                  - kms:ListAliases
                  - kms:ListResourceTags
                  - kms:CreateGrant
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: SageMakerAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DataExchangeAndMarketplaceAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dataexchange:*
                  - aws-marketplace:ViewSubscriptions
                  - aws-marketplace:Subscribe
                  - aws-marketplace:Unsubscribe
                  - aws-marketplace:DescribeAgreement
                  - aws-marketplace:GetAgreementTerms
                  - aws-marketplace:ListEntities
                  - aws-marketplace:DescribeEntity
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: SSMParameterAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                  - ssm:DeleteParameter
                  - ssm:AddTagsToResource
                  - ssm:RemoveTagsFromResource
                  - ssm:ListTagsForResource
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/MLWorkshop/*'
              - Sid: SSMDescribe
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:DescribeParameters
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: LambdaAndLogsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:CreateFunction
                  - lambda:DeleteFunction
                  - lambda:GetFunction
                  - lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                  - lambda:UpdateFunctionCode
                  - lambda:UpdateFunctionConfiguration
                  - lambda:AddPermission
                  - lambda:RemovePermission
                  - lambda:TagResource
                  - lambda:UntagResource
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DeleteLogGroup
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:PutRetentionPolicy
                  - logs:TagResource
                  - logs:TagLogGroup
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ServiceCatalogAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - servicecatalog:*
                Resource: '*'

  ###########################################################################
  # Portfolios
  ###########################################################################
  AdminPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub '${EnvPrefix} ML Workshop Admin Portfolio'
      Description: Portfolio for the admin team containing foundational infrastructure products.
      ProviderName: ML Workshop Admin Team

  EndUserPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub '${EnvPrefix} ML Workshop End User Portfolio'
      Description: Portfolio for end users containing ML application and notebook products.
      ProviderName: ML Workshop Admin Team

  ###########################################################################
  # Admin portfolio products
  ###########################################################################
  VPCProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvPrefix} VPC with Private Subnets and Endpoints'
      Description: VPC with private subnets and VPC endpoints for isolated ML workloads.
      Owner: ML Workshop Admin Team
      Distributor: ML Workshop Admin Team
      SupportDescription: Contact the ML Workshop admin team for support.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/vpc.yaml'

  IAMKMSS3Product:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvPrefix} IAM Roles, KMS Keys and S3 Buckets'
      Description: IAM roles, KMS keys and encrypted S3 buckets for the ML workshop.
      Owner: ML Workshop Admin Team
      Distributor: ML Workshop Admin Team
      SupportDescription: Contact the ML Workshop admin team for support.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/iam-kms-s3.yaml'

  DataExchangeProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvPrefix} AWS Data Exchange'
      Description: Exports a subscribed AWS Data Exchange data set into an encrypted S3 bucket.
      Owner: ML Workshop Admin Team
      Distributor: ML Workshop Admin Team
      SupportDescription: Contact the ML Workshop admin team for support.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/data-exchange.yaml'

  InfrastructureProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvPrefix} ML Workshop Infrastructure'
      Description: Combined infrastructure product for the ML workshop environment.
      Owner: ML Workshop Admin Team
      Distributor: ML Workshop Admin Team
      SupportDescription: Contact the ML Workshop admin team for support.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/infrastructure.yaml'

  ###########################################################################
  # End user portfolio products
  ###########################################################################
  ApplicationProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvPrefix} ML Workshop Application'
      Description: Application product combining notebook and third-party ML model resources.
      Owner: ML Workshop Admin Team
      Distributor: ML Workshop Admin Team
      SupportDescription: Contact the ML Workshop admin team for support.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/application.yaml'

  SageMakerNotebookProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvPrefix} SageMaker Notebook Instance'
      Description: Secure Amazon SageMaker notebook instance deployed into private subnets.
      Owner: ML Workshop Admin Team
      Distributor: ML Workshop Admin Team
      SupportDescription: Contact the ML Workshop admin team for support.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/sagemaker-notebook.yaml'

  ThirdPartyMLModelProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvPrefix} Third-Party ML Model'
      Description: Deploys a third-party ML model from AWS Marketplace as a SageMaker model.
      Owner: ML Workshop Admin Team
      Distributor: ML Workshop Admin Team
      SupportDescription: Contact the ML Workshop admin team for support.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Description: Initial version
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Sub '${RootS3URL}/third-party-ml-model.yaml'

  ###########################################################################
  # Portfolio / product associations
  ###########################################################################

    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref VPCProduct

  IAMKMSS3ProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref IAMKMSS3Product

  DataExchangeProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref DataExchangeProduct

  InfrastructureProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref InfrastructureProduct

  ApplicationProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ApplicationProduct

  SageMakerNotebookProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref SageMakerNotebookProduct

  ThirdPartyMLModelProductAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ThirdPartyMLModelProduct

  ###########################################################################

  ###########################################################################
  VPCLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint

  IAMKMSS3LaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    DependsOn: IAMKMSS3ProductAssociation
    Properties:
      Description: Launch role constraint for the IAM, KMS and S3 product.
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref IAMKMSS3Product
      RoleArn: !GetAtt SCLaunchRole.Arn

  DataExchangeLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    DependsOn: DataExchangeProductAssociation
    Properties:
      Description: Launch role constraint for the AWS Data Exchange product.
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref DataExchangeProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt SCLaunchRole.Arn

  InfrastructureLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    DependsOn: InfrastructureProductAssociation
    Properties:
      Description: Launch role constraint for the infrastructure product.
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref InfrastructureProduct
      RoleArn: !GetAtt SCLaunchRole.Arn

  ApplicationLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint

    Properties:
      Description: Launch role constraint for the application product.

      ProductId: !Ref ApplicationProduct

  SageMakerNotebookLaunchConstraint:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::LaunchRoleConstraint
    DependsOn: SageMakerNotebookProductAssociation
    Properties:
      Description: Launch role constraint for the SageMaker notebook product.
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref SageMakerNotebookProduct

  ###########################################################################

  SCLeadEndUserRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvPrefix}-SCLeadEndUserRole'
      Description: Service Catalog admin lead end user role for the ML workshop.

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:

      Path: /
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AWSServiceCatalogEndUserFullAccess'

                  - cloudformation:List*
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - sagemaker:Describe*
                  - sagemaker:List*
                  - dataexchange:Get*
                  - dataexchange:List*
                  - kms:DescribeKey

                  - s3:ListAllMyBuckets

                  - cloudformation:GetTemplateSummary

                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcEndpoints
                  - sagemaker:Describe*
                  - sagemaker:List*
                  - sagemaker:CreatePresignedNotebookInstanceUrl
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:ListAliases
                  - s3:ListAllMyBuckets
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - ssm:DescribeParameters
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: MLWorkshopSSMParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/MLWorkshop'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/MLWorkshop/*'

                Effect: Allow

  ###########################################################################
  # Portfolio principal associations
  ###########################################################################
  AdminPortfolioLeadEndUserAssociation:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioPrincipalAssociation

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Single-environment dual-stack (IPv4/IPv6) VPC for staging or production with
  public and private subnets, internet gateway, egress-only internet gateway,
  optional NAT gateway, network ACLs, cluster placement group and DHCP options.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Target environment for this network.
    AllowedValues:
      - staging
      - production
    Default: staging

  DeployNatGateway:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Deploy a NAT gateway (with its own Elastic IP) for the private subnets.
      Set to false if a bastion host performs the NAT role.
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Default: 'true'

  BastionVpnPort:
    Type: Number
    Description: Port used by the bastion host VPN service.
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 65535
    Default: 1194

  BastionVpnProtocol:
    Type: String
    Description: Transport protocol used by the bastion host VPN service.
    AllowedValues:
      - udp
      - tcp
    Default: udp

Mappings:
  EnvironmentConfig:
    staging:
      VpcCidr: 10.1.0.0/16
      PublicLbSubnet1Cidr: 10.1.0.0/24
      PublicLbSubnet2Cidr: 10.1.1.0/24
      PublicComputeSubnetCidr: 10.1.2.0/24
      PrivateAppSubnetCidr: 10.1.10.0/24
      PrivateDataSubnetCidr: 10.1.11.0/24
      DomainName: staging.internal
    production:
      VpcCidr: 10.0.0.0/16
      PublicLbSubnet1Cidr: 10.0.0.0/24
      PublicLbSubnet2Cidr: 10.0.1.0/24
      PublicComputeSubnetCidr: 10.0.2.0/24
      PrivateAppSubnetCidr: 10.0.10.0/24
      PrivateDataSubnetCidr: 10.0.11.0/24
      DomainName: production.internal
  ProtocolNumber:
    udp:
      Number: 17
    tcp:
      Number: 6

Conditions:
  CreateNatGateway: !Equals [!Ref DeployNatGateway, 'true']

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC and IPv6 block
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, VpcCidr]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  VPCIpv6CidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DHCP options
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DHCPOptions:
    Type: AWS::EC2::DHCPOptions
    Properties:
      DomainName: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, DomainName]
      DomainNameServers:
        - AmazonProvidedDNS
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-dhcp-options'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  DHCPOptionsAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCDHCPOptionsAssociation
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      DhcpOptionsId: !Ref DHCPOptions

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Gateways
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  EgressOnlyInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EgressOnlyInternetGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicLbSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, PublicLbSubnet1Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 5, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-public-lb-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: presentation

  PublicLbSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, PublicLbSubnet2Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 5, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-public-lb-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: presentation

  PublicComputeSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, PublicComputeSubnetCidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 5, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-public-compute'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: compute

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateAppSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, PrivateAppSubnetCidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 5, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-private-app'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application

  PrivateDataSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref Environment, PrivateDataSubnetCidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [4, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 5, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-private-data'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: data

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public routing
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicDefaultRouteIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicDefaultRouteIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: ::/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicLbSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicLbSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicLbSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicLbSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicComputeSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicComputeSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT gateway (optional)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-nat-eip'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicLbSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-nat'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private routing
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-private-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateDefaultRouteIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateDefaultRouteIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: ::/0
      EgressOnlyInternetGatewayId: !Ref EgressOnlyInternetGateway

  PrivateAppSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateAppSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateDataSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateDataSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public network ACL
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${Environment}-public-nacl'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicInboundHttpIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 100
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80

  PublicInboundHttpIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 101
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      Ipv6CidrBlock: ::/0
      PortRange:
        From: 80
        To: 80

  PublicInboundHttpsIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 110
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 443
        To: 443

  PublicInboundHttpsIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 111
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      Ipv6CidrBlock: ::/0
      PortRange:
        From: 443
        To: 443

  PublicInboundSshIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 120
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: 22
        To: 22

  PublicInboundSshIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 121
      Protocol: 6
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      Ipv6CidrBlock: ::/0
      PortRange:
        From: 22
        To: 22

  PublicInboundVpnIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:
      NetworkAclId: !Ref PublicNetworkAcl
      RuleNumber: 130
      Protocol: !FindInMap [ProtocolNumber, !Ref BastionVpnProtocol, Number]
      RuleAction: allow
      Egress: false
      CidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      PortRange:
        From: !Ref BastionVpnPort
        To: !Ref BastionVpnPort

  PublicInboundVpnIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAclEntry
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained serverless Movies API with DynamoDB, Lambda (Python 3.12), and API Gateway REST API.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Deployment environment name, used as the API Gateway stage name.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and underscores.

Resources:
  MoviesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-movies-${Environment}'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: title
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: title
          KeyType: HASH

  MoviesFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MoviesTableCrudAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:ConditionCheckItem
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt MoviesTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${MoviesTable.Arn}/index/*'

  CreateMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-create-movie-${Environment}'
      RetentionInDays: 1

  GetMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-get-movie-${Environment}'
      RetentionInDays: 1

  UpdateMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-update-movie-${Environment}'
      RetentionInDays: 1

  DeleteMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-delete-movie-${Environment}'
      RetentionInDays: 1

  CreateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: CreateMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-create-movie-${Environment}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt MoviesFunctionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          from decimal import Decimal
          import boto3

          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          HEADERS = {
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
              'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
              'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token',
              'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'OPTIONS,POST,PUT,DELETE,GET'
          }

          def default(o):
              if isinstance(o, Decimal):
                  return int(o) if o % 1 == 0 else float(o)
              raise TypeError

          def respond(status, body):
              return {'statusCode': status, 'headers': HEADERS, 'body': json.dumps(body, default=default)}

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}', parse_float=Decimal)
              except json.JSONDecodeError:
                  return respond(400, {'message': 'Invalid JSON body'})
              if not body.get('title'):
                  return respond(400, {'message': 'title is required'})
              try:
                  table.put_item(
                      Item=body,
                      ConditionExpression='attribute_not_exists(title)'
                  )
              except table.meta.client.exceptions.ConditionalCheckFailedException:
                  return respond(409, {'message': 'Movie already exists'})
              except Exception as e:
                  return respond(500, {'message': str(e)})
              return respond(201, body)

  GetMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: GetMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-get-movie-${Environment}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt MoviesFunctionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          from decimal import Decimal
          from urllib.parse import unquote
          import boto3

          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          HEADERS = {
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
              'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
              'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token',
              'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'OPTIONS,GET'
          }

          def default(o):
              if isinstance(o, Decimal):
                  return int(o) if o % 1 == 0 else float(o)
              raise TypeError

          def respond(status, body):
              return {'statusCode': status, 'headers': HEADERS, 'body': json.dumps(body, default=default)}

          def handler(event, context):
              title = (event.get('pathParameters') or {}).get('title')
              if not title:
                  return respond(400, {'message': 'title path parameter is required'})
              title = unquote(title)
              try:
                  result = table.get_item(Key={'title': title})
              except Exception as e:
                  return respond(500, {'message': str(e)})
              item = result.get('Item')
              if not item:
                  return respond(404, {'message': 'Movie not found'})
              return respond(200, item)

  UpdateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: UpdateMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-update-movie-${Environment}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt MoviesFunctionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          from decimal import Decimal
          import boto3

          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          HEADERS = {
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
              'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
              'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token',
              'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'OPTIONS,POST,PUT,DELETE,GET'
          }

          def default(o):
              if isinstance(o, Decimal):
                  return int(o) if o % 1 == 0 else float(o)
              raise TypeError

          def respond(status, body):
              return {'statusCode': status, 'headers': HEADERS, 'body': json.dumps(body, default=default)}

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}', parse_float=Decimal)
              except json.JSONDecodeError:
                  return respond(400, {'message': 'Invalid JSON body'})
              title = body.pop('title', None)
              if not title:
                  return respond(400, {'message': 'title is required'})
              if not body:
                  return respond(400, {'message': 'No attributes to update'})
              names = {}
              values = {}
              parts = []
              for i, (k, v) in enumerate(body.items()):
                  names[f'#a{i}'] = k
                  values[f':v{i}'] = v
                  parts.append(f'#a{i} = :v{i}')
              try:
                  result = table.update_item(
                      Key={'title': title},
                      UpdateExpression='SET ' + ', '.join(parts),
                      ConditionExpression='attribute_exists(title)',
                      ExpressionAttributeNames=names,
                      ExpressionAttributeValues=values,
                      ReturnValues='ALL_NEW'
                  )
              except table.meta.client.exceptions.ConditionalCheckFailedException:
                  return respond(404, {'message': 'Movie not found'})
              except Exception as e:
                  return respond(500, {'message': str(e)})
              return respond(200, result.get('Attributes', {}))

  DeleteMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: DeleteMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-delete-movie-${Environment}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt MoviesFunctionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          from decimal import Decimal
          import boto3

          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          HEADERS = {
              'Content-Type': 'application/json',
              'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*',
              'Access-Control-Allow-Headers': 'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token',
              'Access-Control-Allow-Methods': 'OPTIONS,POST,PUT,DELETE,GET'
          }

          def default(o):
              if isinstance(o, Decimal):
                  return int(o) if o % 1 == 0 else float(o)
              raise TypeError

          def respond(status, body):
              return {'statusCode': status, 'headers': HEADERS, 'body': json.dumps(body, default=default)}

          def handler(event, context):
              title = (event.get('queryStringParameters') or {}).get('title')
              if not title:
                  try:
                      body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}')
                  except json.JSONDecodeError:
                      return respond(400, {'message': 'Invalid JSON body'})
                  title = body.get('title')
              if not title:
                  return respond(400, {'message': 'title is required'})
              try:
                  result = table.delete_item(
                      Key={'title': title},
                      ConditionExpression='attribute_exists(title)',
                      ReturnValues='ALL_OLD'
                  )
              except table.meta.client.exceptions.ConditionalCheckFailedException:
                  return respond(404, {'message': 'Movie not found'})
              except Exception as e:
                  return respond(500, {'message': str(e)})
              return respond(200, {'message': 'Movie deleted', 'item': result.get('Attributes', {})})

  MoviesApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-movies-api-${Environment}'
      Description: Serverless Movies CRUD API
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  MoviesResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt MoviesApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: Movies

  MovieTitleResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ParentId: !Ref MoviesResource
      PathPart: '{title}'

  CreateMovieMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${CreateMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  UpdateMovieMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: PUT
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${UpdateMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  DeleteMovieMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: DELETE
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${DeleteMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  GetMovieMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MovieTitleResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      RequestParameters:
        method.request.path.title: true
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${GetMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  MoviesOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_MATCH
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'OPTIONS,POST,PUT,DELETE'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:

      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_MATCH
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'OPTIONS,GET'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''

          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty

            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

  CreateMoviePermission:

    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref CreateMovieFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${MoviesApi}/*/POST/Movies'

    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
