AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  SageMaker Studio user profile for an MLOps engineer persona with a scoped IAM
  execution role. Optionally creates a self-contained VPC and a public-internet
  SageMaker Studio domain when an existing domain ID is not supplied.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: User Profile
        Parameters:
          - UserProfileName
      - Label:
          default: Existing SageMaker Studio Domain (optional)
        Parameters:
          - DomainId
          - SecurityGroupIds
          - SubnetIds
      - Label:
          default: New Domain Networking (used only when DomainId is empty)
        Parameters:
          - NewDomainName
          - VpcCidr
          - SubnetCidr

Parameters:
  UserProfileName:
    Type: String
    Default: mlops-engineer
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9](-*[a-zA-Z0-9]){0,62}$'
    Description: Name of the SageMaker Studio user profile for the MLOps engineer.

  DomainId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^d-(-*[a-z0-9]){1,61}$'
    Description: >-
      Existing SageMaker Studio domain ID. Leave empty to create a new VPC and
      public-internet-access domain.

  SecurityGroupIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional security group IDs associated with the existing domain. Applied to
      the user profile and used to restrict job VPC configuration.

  SubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional subnet IDs associated with the existing domain. Used to restrict
      job VPC configuration launched by the execution role.

  NewDomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: mlops-studio-domain
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9](-*[a-zA-Z0-9]){0,62}$'
    Description: Name of the SageMaker Studio domain created when DomainId is empty.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC created when DomainId is empty.

  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for the subnet created when DomainId is empty.

Conditions:
  CreateDomain: !Equals [!Ref DomainId, '']
  UseExistingDomain: !Not [!Condition CreateDomain]
  HasSecurityGroupIds: !Not [!Equals [!Join ['', !Ref SecurityGroupIds], '']]
  HasSubnetIds: !Not [!Equals [!Join ['', !Ref SubnetIds], '']]
  RestrictExistingSecurityGroups: !And
    - !Condition UseExistingDomain
    - !Condition HasSecurityGroupIds
  RestrictExistingSubnets: !And
    - !Condition UseExistingDomain
    - !Condition HasSubnetIds

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM execution role for the MLOps engineer persona
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  MLOpsExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: SageMaker execution role scoped to the MLOps engineer persona.
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Persona
          Value: MLOpsEngineer
        - Key: UserProfile
          Value: !Ref UserProfileName

  MLOpsPassRolePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: MLOpsPassPerUserExecutionRole
      Roles:
        - !Ref MLOpsExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: PassPerUserExecutionRoleToSageMaker
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:PassRole
            Resource: !GetAtt MLOpsExecutionRole.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                iam:PassedToService: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: GetPerUserExecutionRole
            Effect: Allow
            Action: iam:GetRole
            Resource: !GetAtt MLOpsExecutionRole.Arn

  MLOpsPipelinesPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: MLOpsManagePipelines
      Roles:
        - !Ref MLOpsExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ManagePipelines
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreatePipeline
              - sagemaker:UpdatePipeline
              - sagemaker:DescribePipeline
              - sagemaker:DescribePipelineDefinitionForExecution
              - sagemaker:StartPipelineExecution
              - sagemaker:StopPipelineExecution
              - sagemaker:RetryPipelineExecution
              - sagemaker:UpdatePipelineExecution
              - sagemaker:DescribePipelineExecution
              - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutions
              - sagemaker:ListPipelineExecutionSteps
              - sagemaker:ListPipelineParametersForExecution
              - sagemaker:SendPipelineExecutionStepSuccess
              - sagemaker:SendPipelineExecutionStepFailure
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:pipeline/*'
          - Sid: ListPipelines
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:ListPipelines
            Resource: '*'

  MLOpsModelMonitoringPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: MLOpsManageModelMonitoring
      Roles:
        - !Ref MLOpsExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ManageMonitoringSchedules
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateMonitoringSchedule
              - sagemaker:UpdateMonitoringSchedule
              - sagemaker:DeleteMonitoringSchedule
              - sagemaker:DescribeMonitoringSchedule
              - sagemaker:StartMonitoringSchedule
              - sagemaker:StopMonitoringSchedule
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:monitoring-schedule/*'
          - Sid: ManageMonitoringJobDefinitions
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateDataQualityJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:DescribeDataQualityJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:DeleteDataQualityJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:CreateModelQualityJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:DescribeModelQualityJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:DeleteModelQualityJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:CreateModelBiasJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:DescribeModelBiasJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:DeleteModelBiasJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:CreateModelExplainabilityJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:DescribeModelExplainabilityJobDefinition
              - sagemaker:DeleteModelExplainabilityJobDefinition
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:data-quality-job-definition/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model-quality-job-definition/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model-bias-job-definition/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model-explainability-job-definition/*'
          - Sid: ManageMonitoringProcessingJobs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
              - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:processing-job/*'
          - Sid: ListMonitoringResources
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:ListMonitoringSchedules
              - sagemaker:ListMonitoringExecutions
              - sagemaker:ListMonitoringAlerts
              - sagemaker:ListMonitoringAlertHistory
              - sagemaker:ListDataQualityJobDefinitions
              - sagemaker:ListModelQualityJobDefinitions
              - sagemaker:ListModelBiasJobDefinitions
              - sagemaker:ListModelExplainabilityJobDefinitions
              - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
            Resource: '*'

  MLOpsModelsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: MLOpsManageModels
      Roles:
        - !Ref MLOpsExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ManageModels
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateModel
              - sagemaker:DeleteModel
              - sagemaker:DescribeModel
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model/*'
          - Sid: ManageModelPackagesAndGroups
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateModelPackage
              - sagemaker:UpdateModelPackage
              - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackage
              - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackage
              - sagemaker:CreateModelPackageGroup
              - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackageGroup
              - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackageGroup
              - sagemaker:GetModelPackageGroupPolicy
              - sagemaker:PutModelPackageGroupPolicy
              - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackageGroupPolicy
              - sagemaker:ListModelPackages
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model-package/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:model-package-group/*'
          - Sid: ListModels
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:ListModels
              - sagemaker:ListModelPackageGroups
              - sagemaker:ListModelPackages
              - sagemaker:ListModelMetadata
            Resource: '*'

  MLOpsExperimentsLineagePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: MLOpsViewExperimentsAndLineage
      Roles:
        - !Ref MLOpsExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ViewExperimentsTrialsAndLineage
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:DescribeExperiment
              - sagemaker:ListExperiments
              - sagemaker:DescribeTrial
              - sagemaker:ListTrials
              - sagemaker:DescribeTrialComponent
              - sagemaker:ListTrialComponents
              - sagemaker:Search
              - sagemaker:GetSearchSuggestions
              - sagemaker:QueryLineage
              - sagemaker:ListAssociations
              - sagemaker:DescribeArtifact
              - sagemaker:ListArtifacts
              - sagemaker:DescribeAction
              - sagemaker:ListActions
              - sagemaker:DescribeContext
              - sagemaker:ListContexts
              - sagemaker:DescribeLineageGroup
              - sagemaker:ListLineageGroups
              - sagemaker:GetLineageGroupPolicy
            Resource: '*'

  MLOpsJobsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: MLOpsRunJobs
      Roles:
        - !Ref MLOpsExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: CreateJobs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob
              - sagemaker:CreateTransformJob
              - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
              - sagemaker:CreateHyperParameterTuningJob
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:training-job/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:transform-job/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:processing-job/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:hyper-parameter-tuning-job/*'
          - !If
            - RestrictExistingSubnets
            - Sid: DenyJobsOutsideDomainSubnets
              Effect: Deny
              Action:
                - sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob
                - sagemaker:CreateTransformJob
                - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
                - sagemaker:CreateHyperParameterTuningJob
                - sagemaker:CreateModel
              Resource: '*'
              Condition:
                ForAnyValue:StringNotEquals:
                  sagemaker:VpcSubnets: !Ref SubnetIds
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue
          - !If
            - RestrictExistingSecurityGroups
            - Sid: DenyJobsOutsideDomainSecurityGroups
              Effect: Deny
              Action:
                - sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob
                - sagemaker:CreateTransformJob
                - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
                - sagemaker:CreateHyperParameterTuningJob
                - sagemaker:CreateModel
              Resource: '*'
              Condition:
                ForAnyValue:StringNotEquals:
                  sagemaker:VpcSecurityGroupIds: !Ref SecurityGroupIds
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue
          - Sid: DescribeAndStopJobs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:DescribeTrainingJob
              - sagemaker:StopTrainingJob
              - sagemaker:DescribeTransformJob
              - sagemaker:StopTransformJob
              - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
              - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
              - sagemaker:DescribeHyperParameterTuningJob
              - sagemaker:StopHyperParameterTuningJob
              - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobsForHyperParameterTuningJob
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:training-job/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:transform-job/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:processing-job/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:hyper-parameter-tuning-job/*'
          - Sid: ListJobs
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobs
              - sagemaker:ListTransformJobs
              - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
              - sagemaker:ListHyperParameterTuningJobs
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: JobRuntimeContainerImages
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: JobRuntimeContainerImagePull
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecr:*:*:repository/*'
          - Sid: JobRuntimeLogging
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogGroup
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
              - logs:GetLogEvents
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/sagemaker/*'
          - Sid: JobRuntimeMetrics
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
              - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
              - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: JobRuntimeS3Buckets
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
              - s3:CreateBucket
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::sagemaker-*'
          - Sid: JobRuntimeS3Objects
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:DeleteObject
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::sagemaker-*/*'
          - Sid: JobRuntimeVpcNetworking
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
              - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
              - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:DescribeDhcpOptions
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
            Resource: '*'

  MLOpsEndpointsPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: MLOpsManageEndpoints
      Roles:
        - !Ref MLOpsExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ManageEndpoints
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateEndpoint
              - sagemaker:UpdateEndpoint
              - sagemaker:UpdateEndpointWeightsAndCapacities
              - sagemaker:DeleteEndpoint
              - sagemaker:DescribeEndpoint
              - sagemaker:InvokeEndpoint
              - sagemaker:InvokeEndpointAsync
              - sagemaker:CreateEndpointConfig
              - sagemaker:DeleteEndpointConfig
              - sagemaker:DescribeEndpointConfig
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:endpoint/*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:endpoint-config/*'
          - Sid: ListEndpoints
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:ListEndpoints
              - sagemaker:ListEndpointConfigs
            Resource: '*'

  MLOpsStudioPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: MLOpsStudioAppsAndSpaces
      Roles:
        - !Ref MLOpsExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: StudioCreatePresignedUrlForOwnUserProfile
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreatePresignedDomainUrl
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:user-profile/${!sagemaker:DomainId}/${!sagemaker:UserProfileName}'
          - Sid: StudioListAndDescribe
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:ListApps
              - sagemaker:ListDomains
              - sagemaker:ListUserProfiles
              - sagemaker:ListSpaces
              - sagemaker:DescribeApp
              - sagemaker:DescribeDomain
              - sagemaker:DescribeUserProfile
              - sagemaker:DescribeSpace
              - sagemaker:ListTags
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: StudioTagOnCreate
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:AddTags
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*/*'
            Condition:
              'Null':
                sagemaker:TaggingAction: 'false'
          - Sid: StudioManageOwnUserProfileApps
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateApp
              - sagemaker:DeleteApp
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:app/${!sagemaker:DomainId}/${!sagemaker:UserProfileName}/*'
          - Sid: StudioSharedSpacesWithoutOwners
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateApp
              - sagemaker:DeleteApp
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:app/${!sagemaker:DomainId}/*'
            Condition:
              'Null':
                sagemaker:OwnerUserProfileArn: 'true'
          - Sid: StudioRestrictSpacesToOwnerUserProfile
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateSpace
              - sagemaker:UpdateSpace
              - sagemaker:DeleteSpace
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:space/${!sagemaker:DomainId}/*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                sagemaker:OwnerUserProfileArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:user-profile/${!sagemaker:DomainId}/${!sagemaker:UserProfileName}'
              StringEquals:
                sagemaker:SpaceSharingType:
                  - Private
                  - Shared
          - Sid: StudioRestrictSpaceAppsToOwnerUserProfile
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sagemaker:CreateApp
              - sagemaker:DeleteApp
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:app/${!sagemaker:DomainId}/*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                sagemaker:OwnerUserProfileArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:user-profile/${!sagemaker:DomainId}/${!sagemaker:UserProfileName}'
              StringEquals:
                sagemaker:SpaceSharingType:
                  - Private
                  - Shared

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Self-contained networking and domain (only when DomainId is not supplied)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StudioVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-studio-vpc'

  StudioInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-studio-igw'

  StudioVpcGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref StudioInternetGateway

  StudioSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-studio-subnet'

  StudioRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: CreateDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref StudioVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-studio-rt'

    Type: String
    Default: /aws/db-esdk/performance-benchmarks

  RetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1096, 1827, 2192, 2557, 2922, 3288, 3653]

  NamespacePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: DbEsdkPerformance
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_./#:-]+$'

        - !Sub '${NamespacePrefix}/Python'
        - !Sub '${NamespacePrefix}/Go'
        - !Sub '${NamespacePrefix}/Rust'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-MetricNamespaces'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Data Master project - IAM roles for the data pipeline from ingestion through analytics
  (DMS, EventBridge Pipes, Kinesis Firehose, Lambda, Glue, Lake Formation, Step Functions,
  ECS Fargate, EMR Serverless, and AWS Managed Grafana).

Parameters:
  RawDataKmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the existing KMS key used for raw data encryption.
    AllowedPattern: '^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:kms:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:key/[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid KMS key ARN.
  TargetAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: Target AWS Account ID used to scope STS AssumeRole policies.
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]{12}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12-digit AWS account ID.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Ingestion - DMS
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DmsVpcRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows DMS to manage VPC resources for replication instances.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowDmsAssumeRoleFromTargetAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dms.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref TargetAccountId
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonDMSVPCManagementRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  DmsKinesisTargetRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows DMS to write change data to Kinesis Data Streams.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dms.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-dms-kinesis-write
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:DescribeStream
                  - kinesis:DescribeStreamSummary
                  - kinesis:PutRecord
                  - kinesis:PutRecords
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:kinesis:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stream/dm-*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !Ref RawDataKmsKeyArn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Routing - EventBridge Pipes -> Firehose
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EventBridgePipesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows EventBridge Pipes to read from Kinesis and forward to Firehose.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pipes.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-pipes-kinesis-to-firehose
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadSourceStream
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:DescribeStream
                  - kinesis:DescribeStreamSummary
                  - kinesis:GetRecords
                  - kinesis:GetShardIterator
                  - kinesis:ListShards
                  - kinesis:ListStreams
                  - kinesis:SubscribeToShard
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:kinesis:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stream/dm-*
              - Sid: WriteTargetFirehose
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:firehose:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deliverystream/dm-*
              - Sid: InvokeEnrichmentLambda
                Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:dm-*
              - Sid: DecryptSourceStream
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !Ref RawDataKmsKeyArn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  FirehoseAccessRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Allows Kinesis Data Firehose to deliver encrypted raw data to S3.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: firehose.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-firehose-delivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3Delivery
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*/*
              - Sid: KmsRawDataEncryption
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !Ref RawDataKmsKeyArn
              - Sid: TransformLambda
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                  - lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:dm-*
              - Sid: GlueSchemaForFormatConversion
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:GetTable
                  - glue:GetTableVersion
                  - glue:GetTableVersions
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:catalog
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:database/dm_*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/dm_*/*
              - Sid: DeliveryLogging
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/kinesisfirehose/dm-*
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Processing - Lambda
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ProcessingControllerFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the processing controller Lambda function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-processing-controller
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: RawDataAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*/*
              - Sid: KmsRawDataAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !Ref RawDataKmsKeyArn
              - Sid: StartOrchestration
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                  - states:DescribeExecution
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stateMachine:dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:execution:dm-*:*
              - Sid: StartGlueJobs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:StartJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobRun
                  - glue:StartCrawler
                  - glue:GetCrawler
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:job/dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:crawler/dm-*
              - Sid: QueueAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:SendMessage
                  - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                  - sqs:DeleteMessage
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:dm-*
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  RouterFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for the routing Lambda function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-router
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: RouteEvents
                Effect: Allow
                Action: events:PutEvents
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:event-bus/dm-*
              - Sid: RouteToFirehose
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:firehose:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deliverystream/dm-*
              - Sid: RouteToQueues
                Effect: Allow
                Action: sqs:SendMessage
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:dm-*
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cataloging & ETL - Glue
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GlueCrawlerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role for Glue crawlers cataloging Data Master datasets.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-glue-crawler
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !Ref RawDataKmsKeyArn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lakeformation:GetDataAccess
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  GlueJobRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role for Glue ETL jobs transforming Data Master datasets.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-glue-etl
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !Ref RawDataKmsKeyArn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lakeformation:GetDataAccess
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Governance - Lake Formation
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LakeFormationDataAccessRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role used by Lake Formation to access registered data lake locations.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lakeformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-lakeformation-data-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !Ref RawDataKmsKeyArn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws-lakeformation-acceleration/*
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Orchestration - Step Functions
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  StepFunctionsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Execution role for Data Master Step Functions state machines.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-stepfunctions-orchestration
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: InvokeLambda
                Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:dm-*:*
              - Sid: RunGlue
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:StartJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobRun
                  - glue:GetJobRuns
                  - glue:BatchStopJobRun
                  - glue:StartCrawler
                  - glue:GetCrawler
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:job/dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:crawler/dm-*
              - Sid: RunEcsTasks
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecs:RunTask
                  - ecs:StopTask
                  - ecs:DescribeTasks
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  ArnLike:
                    ecs:cluster: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ecs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:cluster/dm-*
              - Sid: RunEmrServerless
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - emr-serverless:StartJobRun
                  - emr-serverless:GetJobRun
                  - emr-serverless:CancelJobRun
                  - emr-serverless:StartApplication
                  - emr-serverless:GetApplication
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:emr-serverless:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:/applications/*
              - Sid: PassWorkloadRoles
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt EcsTaskExecutionRole.Arn
                  - !GetAtt WorkerRole.Arn
                  - !GetAtt EmrServerlessJobRole.Arn
              - Sid: ManagedRuleEvents
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - events:PutTargets
                  - events:PutRule
                  - events:DescribeRule
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule/StepFunctionsGetEventsForECSTaskRule
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule/StepFunctionsGetEventsForEMRServerlessJobRule
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule/StepFunctionsGetEventsForGlueJobRunRule
              - Sid: Logging
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutResourcePolicy
                  - logs:DescribeResourcePolicies
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                  - xray:GetSamplingRules
                  - xray:GetSamplingTargets
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Compute - ECS Fargate
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EcsTaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: ECS task execution role for Data Master Fargate tasks.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-ecs-task-execution-secrets
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/dm/*
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  WorkerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Task role for Data Master Fargate worker containers.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-worker
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DataAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*/*
              - Sid: KmsRawDataAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !Ref RawDataKmsKeyArn
              - Sid: QueueProcessing
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                  - sqs:DeleteMessage
                  - sqs:ChangeMessageVisibility
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:dm-*
              - Sid: TaskCallbacks
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:SendTaskSuccess
                  - states:SendTaskFailure
                  - states:SendTaskHeartbeat
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: Metrics
                Effect: Allow
                Action: cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    cloudwatch:namespace: DataMaster
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Analytics - EMR Serverless
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EmrServerlessJobRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Runtime role for Data Master EMR Serverless jobs.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: emr-serverless.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-emr-serverless-job
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DataAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*/*
              - Sid: KmsRawDataAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !Ref RawDataKmsKeyArn
              - Sid: GlueCatalog
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:GetDatabase
                  - glue:GetDatabases
                  - glue:GetTable
                  - glue:GetTables
                  - glue:GetPartition
                  - glue:GetPartitions
                  - glue:BatchGetPartition
                  - glue:CreateTable
                  - glue:UpdateTable
                  - glue:BatchCreatePartition
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:catalog
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:database/*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/*/*
              - Sid: LakeFormation
                Effect: Allow
                Action: lakeformation:GetDataAccess
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Monitoring - AWS Managed Grafana
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GrafanaWorkspaceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Workspace role for AWS Managed Grafana monitoring of Data Master.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: grafana.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              StringLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:grafana:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:/workspaces/*
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonGrafanaCloudWatchAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-grafana-athena-read
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - athena:GetQueryExecution
                  - athena:GetQueryResults
                  - athena:StartQueryExecution
                  - athena:StopQueryExecution
                  - athena:GetWorkGroup
                  - athena:ListWorkGroups
                  - athena:ListDataCatalogs
                  - athena:ListDatabases
                  - athena:ListTableMetadata
                  - athena:GetTableMetadata
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:GetDatabase
                  - glue:GetDatabases
                  - glue:GetTable
                  - glue:GetTables
                  - glue:GetPartition
                  - glue:GetPartitions
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*
                  - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::dm-*/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !Ref RawDataKmsKeyArn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

Outputs:
  DmsVpcRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the DMS VPC management role.
    Value: !GetAtt DmsVpcRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: dm-dms-vpc-role-arn
  DmsKinesisTargetRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the DMS Kinesis target role.
    Value: !GetAtt DmsKinesisTargetRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: dm-dms-kinesis-target-role-arn
  EventBridgePipesRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge Pipes role.
    Value: !GetAtt EventBridgePipesRole.Arn
    Export:

  FirehoseAccessRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Firehose access role.
    Value: !GetAtt FirehoseAccessRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: dm-firehose-access-role-arn
  ProcessingControllerFunctionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the processing controller Lambda function role.

    Export:

  RouterFunctionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the router Lambda function role.
    Value: !GetAtt RouterFunctionRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: dm-router-function-role-arn
  GlueCrawlerRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Glue crawler role.
    Value: !GetAtt GlueCrawlerRole.Arn
    Export:

    Export:
      Name: dm-glue-job-role-arn
  LakeFormationDataAccessRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lake Formation data access role.
    Value: !GetAtt LakeFormationDataAccessRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: dm-lakeformation-data-access-role-arn
  StepFunctionsRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions orchestration role.
    Value: !GetAtt StepFunctionsRole.Arn
    Export:

  EcsTaskExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS task execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt EcsTaskExecutionRole.Arn
    Export:

  WorkerRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the ECS Fargate worker task role.
    Value: !GetAtt WorkerRole.Arn
    Export:

  EmrServerlessJobRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EMR Serverless job runtime role.
    Value: !GetAtt EmrServerlessJobRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: dm-emr-serverless-job-role-arn
  GrafanaWorkspaceRoleArn:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Composite CloudWatch alarms that monitor the health of a cross-region failover
  application. They cover an existing Remittance API Gateway API, the existing
  GetRemittances and CreateRemittance Lambda functions, and the existing
  dbcluster1-instance1 RDS instance.

Parameters:
  ApiName:
    Type: String
    Default: Remittance API
    Description: Name of the existing API Gateway REST API to monitor.
  GetRemittancesFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: GetRemittances
    Description: Name of the existing GetRemittances Lambda function.
  CreateRemittanceFunctionName:
    Type: String
    Default: CreateRemittance
    Description: Name of the existing CreateRemittance Lambda function.
  DBInstanceIdentifier:
    Type: String
    Default: dbcluster1-instance1
    Description: Identifier of the existing RDS DB instance.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # API Gateway metric alarms
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Api4XXErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Api-4XXError'
      AlarmDescription: API Gateway 4XX errors average above 0 over 5 minutes.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 4XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref ApiName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  Api5XXErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Api-5XXError'
      AlarmDescription: API Gateway 5XX errors average above 1 over 1 minute.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 5XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref ApiName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  ApiLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Api-Latency'
      AlarmDescription: API Gateway latency at or above 10000 ms over 5 minutes.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: Latency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: !Ref ApiName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Unit: Milliseconds
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda metric alarms
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GetRemittancesErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GetRemittances-Errors'
      AlarmDescription: GetRemittances summed errors above 0 over 1 minute.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  CreateRemittanceErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CreateRemittance-Errors'
      AlarmDescription: CreateRemittance summed errors above 0 over 1 minute.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  GetRemittancesInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GetRemittances-Invocations'
      AlarmDescription: GetRemittances summed invocations above 2 over 1 minute.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Invocations
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  CreateRemittanceInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CreateRemittance-Invocations'
      AlarmDescription: CreateRemittance summed invocations above 2 over 1 minute.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Invocations
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  GetRemittancesDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GetRemittances-Duration'
      AlarmDescription: GetRemittances average duration at or above 10000 ms over 15 minutes.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref GetRemittancesFunctionName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Unit: Milliseconds
      TreatMissingData: missing

  CreateRemittanceDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CreateRemittance-Duration'
      AlarmDescription: CreateRemittance average duration at or above 10000 ms over 15 minutes.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref CreateRemittanceFunctionName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Unit: Milliseconds
      TreatMissingData: missing

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # RDS metric alarms (TreatMissingData intentionally unset)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RdsCPUUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Rds-CPUUtilization'
      AlarmDescription: RDS CPU utilization average at or above 70 percent.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsDatabaseConnectionsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Rds-DatabaseConnections'
      AlarmDescription: RDS database connections average at or above 100.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DatabaseConnections
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsDeadlocksAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Rds-Deadlocks'
      AlarmDescription: RDS deadlocks average at or above 10.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: Deadlocks
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsNetworkTransmitThroughputAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Rds-NetworkTransmitThroughput'
      AlarmDescription: RDS network transmit throughput average at or above 10 MiB/s.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: NetworkTransmitThroughput
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsNetworkReceiveThroughputAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Rds-NetworkReceiveThroughput'
      AlarmDescription: RDS network receive throughput average at or above 10 MiB/s.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: NetworkReceiveThroughput
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10485760
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsQueriesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Rds-Queries'
      AlarmDescription: RDS queries average at or above 100.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: Queries
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsDiskQueueDepthAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Rds-DiskQueueDepth'
      AlarmDescription: RDS disk queue depth average at or above 50.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DiskQueueDepth
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 50
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsReadLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Rds-ReadLatency'
      AlarmDescription: RDS read latency average at or above 0.1 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: ReadLatency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  RdsWriteLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-Rds-WriteLatency'
      AlarmDescription: RDS write latency average at or above 0.1 seconds.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: WriteLatency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: !Ref DBInstanceIdentifier
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0.1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Composite alarms
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApiGatewayHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: API Gateway Health
      AlarmDescription: Trips when any API Gateway metric alarm is in ALARM state.
      AlarmRule: !Sub >-
        ALARM("${Api4XXErrorAlarm.Arn}") OR
        ALARM("${Api5XXErrorAlarm.Arn}") OR
        ALARM("${ApiLatencyAlarm.Arn}")

  LambdaHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    DependsOn:
      - GetRemittancesInvocationsAlarm
      - CreateRemittanceInvocationsAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: Lambda Health
      AlarmDescription: Trips when any Lambda errors or duration alarm is in ALARM state.
      AlarmRule: !Sub >-
        ALARM("${GetRemittancesErrorsAlarm.Arn}") OR
        ALARM("${CreateRemittanceErrorsAlarm.Arn}") OR
        ALARM("${GetRemittancesDurationAlarm.Arn}") OR
        ALARM("${CreateRemittanceDurationAlarm.Arn}")

  RdsHealthCompositeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: RDS Health
      AlarmDescription: Trips when any RDS metric alarm is in ALARM state.
      AlarmRule: !Sub >-
        ALARM("${RdsCPUUtilizationAlarm.Arn}") OR
        ALARM("${RdsDatabaseConnectionsAlarm.Arn}") OR
        ALARM("${RdsDeadlocksAlarm.Arn}") OR
        ALARM("${RdsNetworkTransmitThroughputAlarm.Arn}") OR
        ALARM("${RdsNetworkReceiveThroughputAlarm.Arn}") OR
        ALARM("${RdsQueriesAlarm.Arn}") OR
        ALARM("${RdsDiskQueueDepthAlarm.Arn}") OR
        ALARM("${RdsReadLatencyAlarm.Arn}") OR
        ALARM("${RdsWriteLatencyAlarm.Arn}")

Outputs:
  ApiGatewayHealthCompositeAlarmArn:
    Description: ARN of the API Gateway Health composite alarm.
    Value: !GetAtt ApiGatewayHealthCompositeAlarm.Arn
  LambdaHealthCompositeAlarmArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda Health composite alarm.
    Value: !GetAtt LambdaHealthCompositeAlarm.Arn
  RdsHealthCompositeAlarmArn:
    Description: ARN of the RDS Health composite alarm.
    Value: !GetAtt RdsHealthCompositeAlarm.Arn
