final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  QuickSight Admin Console monitoring and data extraction pipeline. Creates seven Glue jobs
  with scheduled triggers, a private S3 bucket for output, five CloudWatch metric streams for
  QuickSight metrics, five Kinesis Data Firehose delivery streams, and a shared IAM role.

Parameters:
  ScriptBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: admin-console-cfn-dataprepare-code
    Description: Name of the predefined S3 bucket that hosts the Glue job scripts.
  ScriptPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: admin-suite/glue-scripts
    Description: Key prefix (without leading or trailing slash) under which the Glue scripts are stored.
  GlueSchedule:
    Type: String
    Default: cron(0 */3 * * ? *)
    Description: Schedule expression for the Glue job triggers (every 3 hours).

Resources:
  # S3 output bucket
  AdminSuiteBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'admin-suite-${AWS::AccountId}'
      AccessControl: Private
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: QuickSightAdminSuite

  # Shared IAM role
  AdminSuiteRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'QuickSightAdminSuiteRole-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: QuickSightAdminSuitePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: QuickSightAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:Describe*
                  - quicksight:List*
                  - quicksight:Get*
                  - quicksight:Search*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: GlueAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - glue:*
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: S3OutputBucketAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${AdminSuiteBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: S3ScriptBucketRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}/*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStream
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetricStreams
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: FirehoseAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                  - firehose:DescribeDeliveryStream
                  - firehose:ListDeliveryStreams
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:firehose:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deliverystream/*'
              - Sid: IAMAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:ListRoles
                  - iam:ListUsers
                  - iam:ListGroups
                  - iam:ListGroupsForUser
                  - iam:ListUserPolicies
                  - iam:ListAttachedUserPolicies
                  - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
                  - iam:ListAttachedGroupPolicies
                  - iam:GetPolicy
                  - iam:GetPolicyVersion
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: IAMPassRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/QuickSightAdminSuiteRole-${AWS::Region}'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService:
                      - glue.amazonaws.com
                      - firehose.amazonaws.com
                      - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com

  # Glue Python shell jobs (Python 3.9, Glue 3.0)
  AssetsAccessJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 1
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--AWS_REGION': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID': !Ref AWS::AccountId
        '--BUCKET_NAME': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
        '--job-language': python

  AssetsMetadataJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 1
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--AWS_REGION': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID': !Ref AWS::AccountId
        '--BUCKET_NAME': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
        '--job-language': python

  FolderAssetsJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 1
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}/etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--AWS_REGION': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID': !Ref AWS::AccountId
        '--BUCKET_NAME': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
        '--job-language': python

  QMetadataJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 1
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}/etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--AWS_REGION': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID': !Ref AWS::AccountId
        '--BUCKET_NAME': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
        '--job-language': python

  QAccessJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_access
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      MaxCapacity: 1
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}/etl_job_admin_suite_q_access.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--AWS_REGION': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID': !Ref AWS::AccountId
        '--BUCKET_NAME': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
        '--job-language': python

  # Glue ETL jobs (G.1X, 2 workers, Glue 5.0)
  DatasetPropertiesJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}/etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--AWS_REGION': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID': !Ref AWS::AccountId
        '--BUCKET_NAME': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'

  DatasourcePropertiesJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties
      Role: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      MaxRetries: 0
      Timeout: 120
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/${ScriptPrefix}/etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--AWS_REGION': !Ref AWS::Region
        '--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID': !Ref AWS::AccountId
        '--BUCKET_NAME': !Ref AdminSuiteBucket
        '--job-language': python
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'

  # Scheduled Glue triggers (every 3 hours)
  AssetsAccessTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_assets_access
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: !Ref GlueSchedule
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref AssetsAccessJob

  AssetsMetadataTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_assets_metadata
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: !Ref GlueSchedule
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref AssetsMetadataJob

  FolderAssetsTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_folder_assets
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: !Ref GlueSchedule
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref FolderAssetsJob

  QMetadataTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_q_metadata
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: !Ref GlueSchedule
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref QMetadataJob

  QAccessTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_q_access
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: !Ref GlueSchedule
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref QAccessJob

  DatasetPropertiesTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_ds_properties
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: !Ref GlueSchedule
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref DatasetPropertiesJob

  DatasourcePropertiesTrigger:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: trigger_admin_suite_datasource_properties
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: !Ref GlueSchedule
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref DatasourcePropertiesJob

  # Kinesis Data Firehose delivery streams (DirectPut -> S3)
  IngestionFirehose:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: admin-suite-quicksight-ingestion-metrics
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
        Prefix: monitoring/quicksight/ingestion_metrics/
        ErrorOutputPrefix: monitoring/quicksight/errors/ingestion_metrics/!{firehose:error-output-type}/
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5

  DashboardFirehose:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: admin-suite-quicksight-dashboard-metrics
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
        Prefix: monitoring/quicksight/dashboard_metrics/
        ErrorOutputPrefix: monitoring/quicksight/errors/dashboard_metrics/!{firehose:error-output-type}/
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5

  SpiceFirehose:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: admin-suite-quicksight-spice-metrics
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
        Prefix: monitoring/quicksight/spice_metrics/
        ErrorOutputPrefix: monitoring/quicksight/errors/spice_metrics/!{firehose:error-output-type}/
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5

  QuickIndexFirehose:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: admin-suite-quicksight-quickindex-metrics
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
        Prefix: monitoring/quicksight/quickindex_metrics/
        ErrorOutputPrefix: monitoring/quicksight/errors/quickindex_metrics/!{firehose:error-output-type}/
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5

  ActionFirehose:
    Type: AWS::KinesisFirehose::DeliveryStream
    Properties:
      DeliveryStreamName: admin-suite-quicksight-action-metrics
      DeliveryStreamType: DirectPut
      ExtendedS3DestinationConfiguration:
        BucketARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteBucket.Arn
        RoleARN: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
        Prefix: monitoring/quicksight/action_metrics/
        ErrorOutputPrefix: monitoring/quicksight/errors/action_metrics/!{firehose:error-output-type}/
        CompressionFormat: UNCOMPRESSED
        BufferingHints:
          IntervalInSeconds: 300
          SizeInMBs: 5

  # CloudWatch metric streams (JSON)
  IngestionMetricStream:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-quicksight-ingestion-stream
      OutputFormat: json
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt IngestionFirehose.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - IngestionRowCount
            - IngestionLatency
            - IngestionInvocationCount
            - IngestionErrorCount

  DashboardMetricStream:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-quicksight-dashboard-stream
      OutputFormat: json
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt DashboardFirehose.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn
      IncludeFilters:
        - Namespace: AWS/QuickSight
          MetricNames:
            - VisualLoadTime
            - DashboardViewLoadTime
            - DashboardViewCount
            - VisualLoadErrorCount

  SpiceMetricStream:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::MetricStream
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-quicksight-spice-stream
      OutputFormat: json
      FirehoseArn: !GetAtt SpiceFirehose.Arn
      RoleArn: !GetAtt AdminSuiteRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Self-contained serverless CRUD API for a Kitten service using Amazon API Gateway
  with direct DynamoDB service integrations (no Lambda). Includes CORS support,
  request validation, and mapped HTTP status codes for success, bad input, and errors.

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$'
    Description: Name of the API Gateway deployment stage.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DynamoDB
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  KittenTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: Kitten
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: KittenId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: KittenId
          KeyType: HASH

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role assumed by API Gateway to call DynamoDB
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApiGatewayDynamoDBRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: KittenTableAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt KittenTable.Arn

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # REST API, resources, model and validator
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  KittenApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: KittenApi
      Description: Serverless CRUD API for Kittens backed by DynamoDB
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  KittenResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt KittenApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: kitten

  KittenIdResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ParentId: !Ref KittenResource
      PathPart: '{id}'

  KittenModel:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Model
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      Name: KittenModel
      ContentType: application/json
      Schema:
        $schema: 'http://json-schema.org/draft-04/schema#'
        title: Kitten
        type: object
        properties:
          name:
            type: string
            minLength: 1
          color:
            type: string
            minLength: 1
        required:
          - name
          - color

  BodyAndParamsValidator:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RequestValidator
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      Name: ValidateBodyAndParams
      ValidateRequestBody: true
      ValidateRequestParameters: true

  ParamsValidator:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RequestValidator
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      Name: ValidateParams
      ValidateRequestBody: false
      ValidateRequestParameters: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Gateway responses (CORS headers on API Gateway generated errors)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Default4xxResponse:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::GatewayResponse
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ResponseType: DEFAULT_4XX
      ResponseParameters:
        gatewayresponse.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
        gatewayresponse.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
        gatewayresponse.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'GET,POST,PUT,DELETE,OPTIONS'"

  Default5xxResponse:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::GatewayResponse
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ResponseType: DEFAULT_5XX
      ResponseParameters:
        gatewayresponse.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
        gatewayresponse.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
        gatewayresponse.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'GET,POST,PUT,DELETE,OPTIONS'"

  BadRequestBodyResponse:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::GatewayResponse
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ResponseType: BAD_REQUEST_BODY
      StatusCode: '400'
      ResponseParameters:
        gatewayresponse.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
        gatewayresponse.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
        gatewayresponse.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'GET,POST,PUT,DELETE,OPTIONS'"
      ResponseTemplates:
        application/json: '{"message": "Invalid request body: name and color are required strings", "details": "$context.error.validationErrorString"}'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # POST /kitten  -> PutItem (KittenId generated from request context)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PostKittenMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ResourceId: !Ref KittenResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      RequestValidatorId: !Ref BodyAndParamsValidator
      RequestModels:
        application/json: !Ref KittenModel
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/PutItem'
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewayDynamoDBRole.Arn
        PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "TableName": "${KittenTable}",
              "Item": {
                "KittenId": { "S": "$context.requestId" },
                "name": { "S": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.path('$.name')).replaceAll("\\'", "'")" },
                "color": { "S": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.path('$.color')).replaceAll("\\'", "'")" }
              }
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '201'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: |
                {
                  "KittenId": "$context.requestId",
                  "message": "Kitten created"
                }
          - StatusCode: '400'
            SelectionPattern: '4\d{2}'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"message": "Bad request"}'
          - StatusCode: '500'
            SelectionPattern: '5\d{2}'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"message": "Internal server error"}'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '201'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
        - StatusCode: '400'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
        - StatusCode: '500'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # GET /kitten  -> Scan
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GetKittensMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ResourceId: !Ref KittenResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/Scan'
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewayDynamoDBRole.Arn
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_TEMPLATES
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "TableName": "${KittenTable}"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: |
                #set($inputRoot = $input.path('$'))
                {
                  "kittens": [
                    #foreach($elem in $inputRoot.Items)
                    {
                      "KittenId": "$util.escapeJavaScript($elem.KittenId.S).replaceAll("\\'", "'")",
                      "name": "$util.escapeJavaScript($elem.name.S).replaceAll("\\'", "'")",
                      "color": "$util.escapeJavaScript($elem.color.S).replaceAll("\\'", "'")"
                    }#if($foreach.hasNext),#end
                    #end
                  ]
                }
          - StatusCode: '400'
            SelectionPattern: '4\d{2}'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"message": "Bad request"}'
          - StatusCode: '500'
            SelectionPattern: '5\d{2}'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"message": "Internal server error"}'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
        - StatusCode: '400'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
        - StatusCode: '500'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # GET /kitten/{id}  -> GetItem
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GetKittenMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ResourceId: !Ref KittenIdResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      RequestValidatorId: !Ref ParamsValidator
      RequestParameters:
        method.request.path.id: true
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/GetItem'
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewayDynamoDBRole.Arn
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_TEMPLATES
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "TableName": "${KittenTable}",
              "Key": {
                "KittenId": { "S": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.params('id')).replaceAll("\\'", "'")" }
              }
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: |
                #set($inputRoot = $input.path('$'))
                #if($inputRoot.toString().contains("Item"))
                {
                  "KittenId": "$util.escapeJavaScript($inputRoot.Item.KittenId.S).replaceAll("\\'", "'")",
                  "name": "$util.escapeJavaScript($inputRoot.Item.name.S).replaceAll("\\'", "'")",
                  "color": "$util.escapeJavaScript($inputRoot.Item.color.S).replaceAll("\\'", "'")"
                }
                #else
                #set($context.responseOverride.status = 404)
                {
                  "message": "Kitten not found"
                }
                #end
          - StatusCode: '400'
            SelectionPattern: '4\d{2}'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"message": "Bad request"}'
          - StatusCode: '500'
            SelectionPattern: '5\d{2}'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"message": "Internal server error"}'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
        - StatusCode: '400'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
        - StatusCode: '404'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
        - StatusCode: '500'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # PUT /kitten/{id}  -> PutItem (replace)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PutKittenMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ResourceId: !Ref KittenIdResource
      HttpMethod: PUT
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      RequestValidatorId: !Ref BodyAndParamsValidator
      RequestParameters:
        method.request.path.id: true
      RequestModels:
        application/json: !Ref KittenModel
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/PutItem'
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewayDynamoDBRole.Arn
        PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "TableName": "${KittenTable}",
              "Item": {
                "KittenId": { "S": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.params('id')).replaceAll("\\'", "'")" },
                "name": { "S": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.path('$.name')).replaceAll("\\'", "'")" },
                "color": { "S": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.path('$.color')).replaceAll("\\'", "'")" }
              }
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: |
                {
                  "KittenId": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.params('id')).replaceAll("\\'", "'")",
                  "message": "Kitten updated"
                }
          - StatusCode: '400'
            SelectionPattern: '4\d{2}'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"message": "Bad request"}'
          - StatusCode: '500'
            SelectionPattern: '5\d{2}'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"message": "Internal server error"}'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
        - StatusCode: '400'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
        - StatusCode: '500'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DELETE /kitten/{id}  -> DeleteItem
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DeleteKittenMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi
      ResourceId: !Ref KittenIdResource
      HttpMethod: DELETE
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      RequestValidatorId: !Ref ParamsValidator
      RequestParameters:
        method.request.path.id: true
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:dynamodb:action/DeleteItem'
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewayDynamoDBRole.Arn
        PassthroughBehavior: WHEN_NO_TEMPLATES
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "TableName": "${KittenTable}",
              "Key": {
                "KittenId": { "S": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.params('id')).replaceAll("\\'", "'")" }
              },
              "ReturnValues": "ALL_OLD"
            }
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: |
                #set($inputRoot = $input.path('$'))
                #if($inputRoot.toString().contains("Attributes"))
                {
                  "KittenId": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.params('id')).replaceAll("\\'", "'")",
                  "message": "Kitten deleted"
                }
                #else
                #set($context.responseOverride.status = 404)
                {
                  "message": "Kitten not found"

          - StatusCode: '400'
            SelectionPattern: '4\d{2}'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"message": "Bad request"}'
          - StatusCode: '500'
            SelectionPattern: '5\d{2}'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{"message": "Internal server error"}'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
        - StatusCode: '400'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
        - StatusCode: '404'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
        - StatusCode: '500'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

    Properties:

        Type: MOCK

        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseParameters:

        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true
          ResponseModels:
            application/json: Empty

  KittenIdOptionsMethod:

    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref KittenApi

      HttpMethod: OPTIONS

      Integration:
        Type: MOCK

        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseParameters:
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: "'Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: "'GET,PUT,DELETE,OPTIONS'"
              method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: "'*'"
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: ''
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseParameters:
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods: true
            method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin: true

  KittenTableArn:

Description: Standard Step Functions state machine with a version and alias, triggered by API Gateway, EventBridge rules, and EventBridge Scheduler.

Resources:
  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      Definition:
        Comment: Single pass state returning 1
        StartAt: PassState
        States:
          PassState:
            Type: Pass
            Result: 1
            End: true

  StateMachineVersion:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachineVersion
    Properties:
      StateMachineArn: !Ref StateMachine
      Description: Initial version

  StateMachineAlias:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachineAlias
    Properties:
      Name: live
      Description: Alias pointing to the initial version
      RoutingConfiguration:
        - StateMachineVersionArn: !Ref StateMachineVersion
          Weight: 100

  # API Gateway trigger
  ApiGatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias

  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-api
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  ApiResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: start

  ApiGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ApiResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGatewayRole.Arn
        PassthroughBehavior: NEVER
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {"input": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.json('$'))", "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachineAlias}"}
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
          - StatusCode: '400'
            SelectionPattern: '4\d{2}'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
        - StatusCode: '400'

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ApiGetMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi

  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      StageName: prod

  # EventBridge rule: terminated state changes
  TerminatedRuleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias

  TerminatedRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Matches EC2 instance terminated state changes
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.ec2
        detail-type:
          - EC2 Instance State-change Notification
        detail:
          state:
            - terminated
      Targets:
        - Id: StateMachineAliasTarget
          Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          RoleArn: !GetAtt TerminatedRuleRole.Arn

  # EventBridge scheduled rule (initially disabled)
  ScheduledRuleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias

  ScheduledRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Runs every minute (initially disabled)
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 minute)
      State: DISABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: StateMachineAliasTarget
          Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          RoleArn: !GetAtt ScheduledRuleRole.Arn

  # EventBridge rule: tag events
  TagRuleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias

  TagRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Description: Responds to tag change events from the AWS Tag service
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.tag
        detail-type:
          - Tag Change on Resource
      Targets:
        - Id: StateMachineAliasTarget
          Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
          RoleArn: !GetAtt TagRuleRole.Arn

  # EventBridge Scheduler schedule
  SchedulerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: scheduler.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref StateMachineAlias

  Schedule:
    Type: AWS::Scheduler::Schedule
    Properties:
      Description: Starts an execution every minute
      ScheduleExpression: rate(1 minute)
      State: ENABLED
      FlexibleTimeWindow:
        Mode: 'OFF'
      Target:
        Arn: !Ref StateMachineAlias
        RoleArn: !GetAtt SchedulerRole.Arn

  StateMachineArn:
    Value: !Ref StateMachine
  StateMachineVersionArn:
    Value: !Ref StateMachineVersion
  StateMachineAliasArn:
    Value: !Ref StateMachineAlias
  ApiEndpoint:
    Value: !Sub https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${ApiStage}/start

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  General purpose VPC networking foundation with two public and two private subnets
  across two availability zones, per-AZ managed NAT gateways, VPC flow logs to
  CloudWatch Logs, an S3 gateway endpoint, and ECR interface endpoints.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Network Configuration
        Parameters:
          - EnvironmentName
          - VpcCidr
          - PublicSubnet1Cidr
          - PublicSubnet2Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet1Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      - Label:
          default: Flow Logs Configuration
        Parameters:
          - FlowLogRetentionInDays
          - FlowLogTrafficType

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: network
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.
    Description: Name prefix applied to resource tags.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.

  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in the first availability zone.

  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in the second availability zone.

  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.10.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in the first availability zone.

  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.11.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in the second availability zone.

  FlowLogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653
    Description: Number of days to retain VPC flow log events.

  FlowLogTrafficType:
    Type: String
    Default: ALL
    AllowedValues:
      - ACCEPT
      - REJECT
      - ALL
    Description: Type of traffic to capture in VPC flow logs.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC and Internet Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT Gateways with Elastic IPs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1'

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-2'

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-2'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Route Tables
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'

  DefaultPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1'

  DefaultPrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2'

  DefaultPrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Flow Logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionInDays

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: vpc-flow-logs-to-cloudwatch
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FlowLogGroup.Arn}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flow-log-role'

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: !Ref FlowLogTrafficType
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-log'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Endpoints
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PublicRouteTable
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for interface VPC endpoints - HTTPS within the VPC CIDR only
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow HTTPS from within the VPC to the interface endpoints
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Allow outbound HTTPS only within the VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-endpoint-sg'

  EcrApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  EcrDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  VpcCidr:
    Description: CIDR block of the VPC
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcCidr'

  AvailabilityZone1:
    Description: First availability zone
    Value: !GetAtt PublicSubnet1.AvailabilityZone
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AZ1'

  AvailabilityZone2:
    Description: Second availability zone
    Value: !GetAtt PublicSubnet2.AvailabilityZone
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AZ2'

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of the public subnet in the first availability zone
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1Id'

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of the public subnet in the second availability zone
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2Id'

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of the private subnet in the first availability zone
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1Id'

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of the private subnet in the second availability zone
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2Id'

  EndpointSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the security group protecting the interface VPC endpoints
    Value: !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EndpointSecurityGroupId'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: VPC for KerberosEMRonEKS Microsoft AD infrastructure with public/private subnets, NAT Gateways, encrypted VPC flow logs, and SSM/Secrets Manager interface endpoints.

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: KerberosEMRonEKS
    Description: Prefix used for naming resources.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/26
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.64/26
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.128/26
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.192/26

Resources:

      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr

          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-MicrosoftAD-VPC'

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-PublicSubnet1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-PublicSubnet2'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-PrivateSubnet1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet

      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']

      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-PrivateSubnet2'

  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc

        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-NatGateway1-EIP'

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name

      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-PrivateRouteTable1'

  DefaultPrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:

    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:

        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-PrivateRouteTable2'

  DefaultPrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub '${NamePrefix} KMS key for VPC flow logs encryption'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:

            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-FlowLogsKey'

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${NamePrefix}-vpc-flowlogs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/${NamePrefix}/vpc-flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsToCloudWatch
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-FlowLogsRole'

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog

      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup

        - Key: Name

        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS from VPC CIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS to VPC CIDR

  SSMEndpoint:

  SSMMessagesEndpoint:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained SageMaker Domain in VPC Only mode with a single test user profile
  and a dedicated execution role for managing SageMaker jobs, experiments, models,
  and Studio applications.

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the SageMaker Domain.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9](-*[a-zA-Z0-9]){0,62}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-63 alphanumeric characters or hyphens, starting with an alphanumeric character.

  TestUserName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the test user profile to create in the domain.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9](-*[a-zA-Z0-9]){0,62}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be 1-63 alphanumeric characters or hyphens, starting with an alphanumeric character.

  DefaultBucketArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the default S3 bucket for the domain (e.g. arn:aws:s3:::my-sagemaker-bucket).
    AllowedPattern: '^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:s3:::[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 bucket ARN.

  VpcId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC::Id
    Description: ID of the VPC in which the domain will be created.

  SubnetIds:
    Type: List<AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id>
    Description: Comma-separated list of subnet IDs for the domain.

  SecurityGroupIds:
    Type: List<AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup::Id>
    Description: Comma-separated list of security group IDs for the domain.

Resources:
  SageMakerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${DomainName}-execution-role'
      Description: !Sub 'Execution role for SageMaker Domain ${DomainName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:SetContext
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SageMakerJobsExperimentsModelsStudio
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SageMakerJobs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrainingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobs
                  - sagemaker:ListTrainingJobsForHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:StopTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTransformJob
                  - sagemaker:ListTransformJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:StopProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeProcessingJob
                  - sagemaker:ListProcessingJobs
                  - sagemaker:CreateAutoMLJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateAutoMLJobV2
                  - sagemaker:StopAutoMLJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeAutoMLJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeAutoMLJobV2
                  - sagemaker:ListAutoMLJobs
                  - sagemaker:ListCandidatesForAutoMLJob
                  - sagemaker:CreateHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:StopHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:DescribeHyperParameterTuningJob
                  - sagemaker:ListHyperParameterTuningJobs
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
              - Sid: SageMakerExperimentsAndLineage
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateExperiment
                  - sagemaker:UpdateExperiment
                  - sagemaker:DeleteExperiment
                  - sagemaker:DescribeExperiment
                  - sagemaker:ListExperiments
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrial
                  - sagemaker:UpdateTrial
                  - sagemaker:DeleteTrial
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrial
                  - sagemaker:ListTrials
                  - sagemaker:CreateTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:UpdateTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:DeleteTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:DescribeTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:ListTrialComponents
                  - sagemaker:AssociateTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:DisassociateTrialComponent
                  - sagemaker:BatchGetMetrics
                  - sagemaker:BatchPutMetrics
                  - sagemaker:CreateAction
                  - sagemaker:UpdateAction
                  - sagemaker:DeleteAction
                  - sagemaker:DescribeAction
                  - sagemaker:ListActions
                  - sagemaker:CreateArtifact
                  - sagemaker:UpdateArtifact
                  - sagemaker:DeleteArtifact
                  - sagemaker:DescribeArtifact
                  - sagemaker:ListArtifacts
                  - sagemaker:CreateContext
                  - sagemaker:UpdateContext
                  - sagemaker:DeleteContext
                  - sagemaker:DescribeContext
                  - sagemaker:ListContexts
                  - sagemaker:AddAssociation
                  - sagemaker:DeleteAssociation
                  - sagemaker:ListAssociations
                  - sagemaker:QueryLineage
                  - sagemaker:GetLineageGroupPolicy
                  - sagemaker:DescribeLineageGroup
                  - sagemaker:ListLineageGroups
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
              - Sid: SageMakerModels
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateModel
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModel
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModel
                  - sagemaker:ListModels
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:UpdateModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackage
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackages
                  - sagemaker:CreateModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:DescribeModelPackageGroup
                  - sagemaker:ListModelPackageGroups
                  - sagemaker:GetModelPackageGroupPolicy
                  - sagemaker:PutModelPackageGroupPolicy
                  - sagemaker:DeleteModelPackageGroupPolicy
                  - sagemaker:BatchDescribeModelPackage
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
              - Sid: SageMakerStudio
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:CreateApp
                  - sagemaker:DeleteApp
                  - sagemaker:DescribeApp
                  - sagemaker:ListApps
                  - sagemaker:CreateSpace
                  - sagemaker:UpdateSpace
                  - sagemaker:DeleteSpace
                  - sagemaker:DescribeSpace
                  - sagemaker:ListSpaces
                  - sagemaker:CreatePresignedDomainUrl
                  - sagemaker:DescribeDomain
                  - sagemaker:ListDomains
                  - sagemaker:DescribeUserProfile
                  - sagemaker:ListUserProfiles
                  - sagemaker:DescribeImage
                  - sagemaker:DescribeImageVersion
                  - sagemaker:ListImages
                  - sagemaker:ListImageVersions
                  - sagemaker:DescribeStudioLifecycleConfig
                  - sagemaker:ListStudioLifecycleConfigs
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
              - Sid: SageMakerTaggingAndSearch
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sagemaker:AddTags
                  - sagemaker:DeleteTags
                  - sagemaker:ListTags
                  - sagemaker:Search
                  - sagemaker:GetSearchSuggestions
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sagemaker:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
              - Sid: DefaultBucketList
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListBucketMultipartUploads
                Resource:
                  - !Ref DefaultBucketArn
              - Sid: DefaultBucketObjectsReadWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:ListMultipartUploadParts
                Resource:
                  - !Sub '${DefaultBucketArn}/*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/sagemaker/*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchMetrics
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:ListMetrics
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ECRPull
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: VpcNetworking
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeDhcpOptions
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcEndpoints
                Resource: '*'

  SageMakerExecutionRolePassRolePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: PassRoleToSageMaker
      Roles:
        - !Ref SageMakerExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: PassSelfToSageMaker
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:PassRole
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                iam:PassedToService: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: GetSelf
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:GetRole
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn

  SageMakerDomain:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::Domain
    DependsOn:
      - SageMakerExecutionRolePassRolePolicy
    Properties:
      DomainName: !Ref DomainName
      AuthMode: IAM
      AppNetworkAccessType: VpcOnly
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      DefaultUserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
        SecurityGroups: !Ref SecurityGroupIds
        SharingSettings:
          NotebookOutputOption: Allowed
          S3OutputPath: !Sub
            - 's3://${BucketName}/sharing'
            - BucketName: !Select [5, !Split [':', !Ref DefaultBucketArn]]
      DefaultSpaceSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
        SecurityGroups: !Ref SecurityGroupIds
      DomainSettings:
        SecurityGroupIds: !Ref SecurityGroupIds
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref DomainName

  TestUserProfile:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::UserProfile
    Properties:
      DomainId: !GetAtt SageMakerDomain.DomainId
      UserProfileName: !Ref TestUserName
      UserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
        SecurityGroups: !Ref SecurityGroupIds
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref TestUserName

Outputs:
  DomainId:
    Description: ID of the SageMaker Domain.
    Value: !GetAtt SageMakerDomain.DomainId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DomainId'

  ExecutionRoleName:
    Description: Name of the SageMaker execution role.
    Value: !Ref SageMakerExecutionRole
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ExecutionRoleName'

  StudioConsoleUrl:
    Description: Direct URL to the SageMaker Studio console for the new domain.
    Value: !Sub
      - 'https://${AWS::Region}.console.aws.amazon.com/sagemaker/home?region=${AWS::Region}#/studio/${DomainId}'
      - DomainId: !GetAtt SageMakerDomain.DomainId
