Description: >-
  Saved CloudWatch Logs Insights query definitions for analyzing Claude Code
  usage, performance, and cost metrics. Queries are organized into folders
  (Real-Time Monitoring, User and Session Analytics, Cost and Attribution,
  Analysis and Debugging) and scoped to the Claude Code metrics log group.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Log Source
        Parameters:
          - LogGroupName
          - QueryFolderPrefix
      - Label:
          default: Rate Limit Thresholds
        Parameters:
          - TokensPerMinuteLimit
          - RequestsPerMinuteLimit
          - RateLimitWarningPercent
    ParameterLabels:
      LogGroupName:
        default: Claude Code metrics log group
      QueryFolderPrefix:
        default: Query folder prefix
      TokensPerMinuteLimit:
        default: Tokens per minute (TPM) limit
      RequestsPerMinuteLimit:
        default: Requests per minute (RPM) limit
      RateLimitWarningPercent:
        default: Rate limit warning threshold (%)

Parameters:
  LogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Default: /aws/claude-code/metrics
    Description: CloudWatch Logs log group that receives Claude Code metrics.
    AllowedPattern: '^[\.\-_/#A-Za-z0-9]+$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 512
  QueryFolderPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: ClaudeCode
    Description: Top-level folder name under which all saved queries are grouped in the Logs Insights console.
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9\-_ ]+$'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
  TokensPerMinuteLimit:
    Type: Number
    Default: 400000
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Tokens-per-minute quota used when computing rate-limit risk.
  RequestsPerMinuteLimit:
    Type: Number
    Default: 4000
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Requests-per-minute quota used when computing rate-limit risk.
  RateLimitWarningPercent:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 100
    Description: Percentage of the TPM/RPM limit at which a minute is flagged as at-risk.

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 1. Real-Time Monitoring
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TokenRatePerUserQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderPrefix}/1-RealTime-Monitoring/Token-Rate-Per-User'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, user_id, user_email, token_type, value
        | filter metric_name = "claude_code.token.usage"
        | stats sum(value) as tokens_per_minute by bin(1m) as minute, user_id, user_email
        | sort minute desc, tokens_per_minute desc
        | limit 500

  RequestRatePerUserQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderPrefix}/1-RealTime-Monitoring/Request-Rate-Per-User'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, user_id, user_email, model
        | filter metric_name = "claude_code.api_request"
        | stats count(*) as requests_per_minute by bin(1m) as minute, user_id, user_email
        | sort minute desc, requests_per_minute desc
        | limit 500

  CurrentTpmRpmQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderPrefix}/1-RealTime-Monitoring/Current-TPM-RPM-Averages'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, metric_name, value
        | filter metric_name in ["claude_code.token.usage", "claude_code.api_request"]
        | fields strcontains(metric_name, "token.usage") * value as tokens,
                 strcontains(metric_name, "api_request") as requests
        | stats sum(tokens) as tpm, sum(requests) as rpm by bin(1m) as minute
        | stats avg(tpm) as avg_tpm, max(tpm) as peak_tpm,
                avg(rpm) as avg_rpm, max(rpm) as peak_rpm,
                count(*) as active_minutes

  RateLimitRiskQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderPrefix}/1-RealTime-Monitoring/Rate-Limit-Risk'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: !Sub |
        fields @timestamp, metric_name, value
        | filter metric_name in ["claude_code.token.usage", "claude_code.api_request"]
        | fields strcontains(metric_name, "token.usage") * value as tokens,
                 strcontains(metric_name, "api_request") as requests
        | stats sum(tokens) as tpm, sum(requests) as rpm by bin(1m) as minute
        | fields minute, tpm, rpm,
                 tpm / ${TokensPerMinuteLimit} * 100 as tpm_pct_of_limit,
                 rpm / ${RequestsPerMinuteLimit} * 100 as rpm_pct_of_limit
        | filter tpm_pct_of_limit >= ${RateLimitWarningPercent} or rpm_pct_of_limit >= ${RateLimitWarningPercent}
        | sort minute desc
        | limit 200

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 2. User and Session Analytics
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SessionUsageQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderPrefix}/2-User-Session-Analytics/Session-Usage'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, session_id, user_id, metric_name, value
        | filter ispresent(session_id)
        | fields strcontains(metric_name, "token.usage") * value as tokens,
                 strcontains(metric_name, "cost.usage") * value as cost_usd,
                 strcontains(metric_name, "api_request") as requests
        | stats min(@timestamp) as session_start,
                max(@timestamp) as session_end,
                sum(tokens) as total_tokens,
                sum(requests) as total_requests,
                sum(cost_usd) as total_cost_usd
          by session_id, user_id
        | fields session_id, user_id, session_start, session_end,
                 (session_end - session_start) / 60000 as duration_minutes,
                 total_tokens, total_requests, total_cost_usd
        | sort total_tokens desc
        | limit 200

  HourlyActivityTimelineQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderPrefix}/2-User-Session-Analytics/Hourly-Activity-Timeline'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, user_id, session_id, metric_name, value
        | fields strcontains(metric_name, "token.usage") * value as tokens,
                 strcontains(metric_name, "api_request") as requests
        | stats sum(tokens) as tokens,
                sum(requests) as requests,
                count_distinct(user_id) as active_users,
                count_distinct(session_id) as active_sessions
          by bin(1h) as hour
        | sort hour asc

  ErrorThrottlingDetectionQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderPrefix}/2-User-Session-Analytics/Errors-And-Throttling'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, user_id, session_id, model, metric_name, status_code, error, @message
        | filter metric_name = "claude_code.api_error"
            or status_code in [429, 500, 502, 503, 529]
            or @message like /(?i)(throttl|rate.?limit|too many requests|overloaded|error)/
        | fields (status_code = 429 or @message like /(?i)(throttl|rate.?limit|too many requests)/) as is_throttle
        | stats count(*) as error_events, sum(is_throttle) as throttle_events
          by bin(5m) as window, user_id, model
        | sort window desc, error_events desc
        | limit 500

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 3. Cost and Attribution
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CostByUserQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderPrefix}/3-Cost-Attribution/Cost-By-User'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, user_id, user_email, value
        | filter metric_name = "claude_code.cost.usage"
        | stats sum(value) as total_cost_usd,
                count_distinct(session_id) as sessions,
                count(*) as cost_events
          by user_id, user_email
        | sort total_cost_usd desc
        | limit 500

  CostByModelQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderPrefix}/3-Cost-Attribution/Cost-By-Model'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, model, value
        | filter metric_name = "claude_code.cost.usage"
        | stats sum(value) as total_cost_usd,
                count_distinct(user_id) as users,
                count(*) as cost_events
          by model
        | sort total_cost_usd desc

  CostByOrganizationQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderPrefix}/3-Cost-Attribution/Cost-By-Organization'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, organization_id, model, value
        | filter metric_name = "claude_code.cost.usage"
        | stats sum(value) as total_cost_usd,
                count_distinct(user_id) as users,
                count_distinct(session_id) as sessions
          by organization_id, model
        | sort organization_id asc, total_cost_usd desc

  CostOverTimeQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderPrefix}/3-Cost-Attribution/Cost-Trend-Daily'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, model, value
        | filter metric_name = "claude_code.cost.usage"
        | stats sum(value) as daily_cost_usd by bin(1d) as day, model
        | sort day asc, daily_cost_usd desc

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # 4. Analysis and Debugging
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ModelEfficiencyQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderPrefix}/4-Analysis-Debugging/Model-Efficiency'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, model, metric_name, token_type, value
        | filter ispresent(model)
        | fields strcontains(metric_name, "token.usage") * strcontains(token_type, "input") * value as input_tokens,
                 strcontains(metric_name, "token.usage") * strcontains(token_type, "output") * value as output_tokens,
                 strcontains(metric_name, "cost.usage") * value as cost_usd,
                 strcontains(metric_name, "api_request") as requests,
                 strcontains(metric_name, "api_request") * duration_ms as request_duration_ms
        | stats sum(input_tokens) as input_tokens,
                sum(output_tokens) as output_tokens,
                sum(cost_usd) as cost_usd,
                sum(requests) as requests,
                sum(request_duration_ms) as total_duration_ms
          by model
        | fields model, input_tokens, output_tokens, cost_usd, requests,
                 output_tokens / input_tokens as output_to_input_ratio,
                 cost_usd / ((input_tokens + output_tokens) / 1000) as cost_per_1k_tokens,
                 (input_tokens + output_tokens) / requests as avg_tokens_per_request,
                 total_duration_ms / requests as avg_latency_ms
        | sort cost_usd desc

  CacheHitRateOverallQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderPrefix}/4-Analysis-Debugging/Cache-Hit-Rate-Overall'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, token_type, value
        | filter metric_name = "claude_code.token.usage"
        | fields strcontains(token_type, "cacheRead") * value as cache_read,
                 strcontains(token_type, "cacheCreation") * value as cache_creation,
                 strcontains(token_type, "input") * value as uncached_input
        | stats sum(cache_read) as cache_read_tokens,
                sum(cache_creation) as cache_creation_tokens,
                sum(uncached_input) as uncached_input_tokens
        | fields cache_read_tokens, cache_creation_tokens, uncached_input_tokens,
                 cache_read_tokens / (cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens + uncached_input_tokens) * 100 as cache_hit_rate_pct,
                 (cache_creation_tokens + uncached_input_tokens) / (cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens + uncached_input_tokens) * 100 as cache_miss_rate_pct

  CacheHitRateOverTimeQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderPrefix}/4-Analysis-Debugging/Cache-Hit-Rate-Over-Time'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, token_type, value
        | filter metric_name = "claude_code.token.usage"
        | fields strcontains(token_type, "cacheRead") * value as cache_read,
                 strcontains(token_type, "cacheCreation") * value as cache_creation,
                 strcontains(token_type, "input") * value as uncached_input
        | stats sum(cache_read) as cache_read_tokens,
                sum(cache_creation) as cache_creation_tokens,
                sum(uncached_input) as uncached_input_tokens
          by bin(1h) as hour
        | fields hour, cache_read_tokens, cache_creation_tokens, uncached_input_tokens,
                 cache_read_tokens / (cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens + uncached_input_tokens) * 100 as cache_hit_rate_pct
        | sort hour asc

  CacheHitRateBySessionQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderPrefix}/4-Analysis-Debugging/Cache-Hit-Rate-By-Session'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, session_id, user_id, token_type, value
        | filter metric_name = "claude_code.token.usage" and ispresent(session_id)
        | fields strcontains(token_type, "cacheRead") * value as cache_read,
                 strcontains(token_type, "cacheCreation") * value as cache_creation,
                 strcontains(token_type, "input") * value as uncached_input
        | stats sum(cache_read) as cache_read_tokens,
                sum(cache_creation) as cache_creation_tokens,
                sum(uncached_input) as uncached_input_tokens
          by session_id, user_id
        | fields session_id, user_id, cache_read_tokens, cache_creation_tokens, uncached_input_tokens,
                 cache_read_tokens / (cache_read_tokens + cache_creation_tokens + uncached_input_tokens) * 100 as cache_hit_rate_pct
        | sort cache_hit_rate_pct asc
        | limit 200

  PeakUsageWindowsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderPrefix}/4-Analysis-Debugging/Peak-Usage-Windows'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, metric_name, value, user_id
        | fields strcontains(metric_name, "token.usage") * value as tokens,
                 strcontains(metric_name, "api_request") as requests
        | stats sum(tokens) as tokens,
                sum(requests) as requests,
                count_distinct(user_id) as active_users
          by bin(15m) as window
        | sort tokens desc
        | limit 25

  SessionDeepDiveQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderPrefix}/4-Analysis-Debugging/Session-Deep-Dive'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        # Replace REPLACE_WITH_SESSION_ID with the session to investigate
        fields @timestamp, session_id, user_id, model, metric_name, token_type, value, status_code, duration_ms, @message
        | filter session_id = "REPLACE_WITH_SESSION_ID"
        | sort @timestamp asc
        | limit 1000

  FieldExplorerQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderPrefix}/4-Analysis-Debugging/Field-Explorer'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        # Inspect raw records; expand rows to discover all available metric attributes
        fields @timestamp, @logStream, metric_name, @message
        | sort @timestamp desc
        | limit 50

  DailyUsageSummaryQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${QueryFolderPrefix}/4-Analysis-Debugging/Daily-Usage-Summary'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, metric_name, token_type, value, user_id, session_id
        | fields strcontains(metric_name, "token.usage") * value as tokens,
                 strcontains(metric_name, "token.usage") * strcontains(token_type, "cacheRead") * value as cache_read_tokens,
                 strcontains(metric_name, "cost.usage") * value as cost_usd,
                 strcontains(metric_name, "api_request") as requests,
                 strcontains(metric_name, "api_error") as errors
        | stats sum(tokens) as total_tokens,
                sum(cache_read_tokens) as cache_read_tokens,
                sum(requests) as total_requests,
                sum(errors) as total_errors,
                sum(cost_usd) as total_cost_usd,
                count_distinct(user_id) as active_users,
                count_distinct(session_id) as sessions
          by bin(1d) as day
        | sort day desc

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: AppSync GraphQL API (SuperCoolAPI) with IAM auth, full CloudWatch logging, and DynamoDB data sources backed by Table1.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # CloudWatch Logs role for AppSync
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  AppSyncLoggingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSAppSyncPushToCloudWatchLogs"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # GraphQL API
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SuperCoolAPI:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: SuperCoolAPI
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
      LogConfig:
        CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncLoggingRole.Arn
        FieldLogLevel: ALL
        ExcludeVerboseContent: false

  SuperCoolAPISchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Definition: |
        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

        type Todo {
          id: ID!
          description: String
        }

        type Query {
          getTodo(id: ID!): Todo
        }

        type Mutation {
          addTodo(id: ID!, description: String): Todo
        }

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DynamoDB table
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Table1:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: Table1
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM role and policy for DynamoDB data sources
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DynamoDBDataSourceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  DynamoDBReadWritePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: Table1ReadWriteAccess
      Roles:
        - !Ref DynamoDBDataSourceRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
              - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
              - dynamodb:ConditionCheckItem
              - dynamodb:DeleteItem
              - dynamodb:DescribeTable
              - dynamodb:GetItem
              - dynamodb:GetRecords
              - dynamodb:GetShardIterator
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:Query
              - dynamodb:Scan
              - dynamodb:UpdateItem
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt Table1.Arn
              - !Sub "${Table1.Arn}/index/*"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DynamoDB data sources (different table/region referencing approaches)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # Approach 1: !Ref table name, pseudo-parameter region
  Table1DataSourceRef:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    DependsOn: DynamoDBReadWritePolicy
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Name: Table1DataSourceRef
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSourceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref Table1
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region

  # Approach 2: table name and region parsed from the table ARN
  Table1DataSourceArn:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    DependsOn: DynamoDBReadWritePolicy
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Name: Table1DataSourceArn
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSourceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Select [1, !Split ["/", !GetAtt Table1.Arn]]
        AwsRegion: !Select [3, !Split [":", !GetAtt Table1.Arn]]

  # Approach 3: !Sub-based table name and region
  Table1DataSourceSub:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    DependsOn: DynamoDBReadWritePolicy
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      Name: Table1DataSourceSub
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt DynamoDBDataSourceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Sub "${Table1}"
        AwsRegion: !Sub "${AWS::Region}"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Resolvers
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GetTodoResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: SuperCoolAPISchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SuperCoolAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getTodo
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt Table1DataSourceRef.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "GetItem",
          "key": {
            "id": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.args.id)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #if($ctx.error)

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Shared VPC for EMR on EKS and Celeborn shuffle service cluster. Creates two public
  and two private subnets across two Availability Zones, an Internet Gateway, one NAT
  Gateway per AZ, an S3 gateway endpoint, interface VPC endpoints for core AWS services,
  and VPC Flow Logs encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: emr-eks-celeborn
    Description: Name prefix applied to resource tags and export names.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9-]*$'

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'

  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/20
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in the first Availability Zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'

  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.16.0/20
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in the second Availability Zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'

  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.64.0/18
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in the first Availability Zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'

  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.128.0/18
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in the second Availability Zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'

  FlowLogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 90
    Description: Number of days to retain VPC Flow Logs in CloudWatch Logs.
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1827, 3653]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT Gateways (one per AZ)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1'

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-2'

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-2'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Route tables
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'

  DefaultPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1'

  DefaultPrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2'

  DefaultPrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Endpoints
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PublicRouteTable
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  VpcEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow HTTPS from within the VPC to interface VPC endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS from VPC CIDR
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: HTTPS responses within VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpce-sg'

  SsmEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  SsmMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  Ec2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  Ec2Endpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  MonitoringEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.monitoring'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  StsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sts'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  EmrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.elasticmapreduce'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  KmsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kms'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Flow Logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'Customer-managed key for ${EnvironmentName} VPC Flow Logs'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flowlogs-key'

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${EnvironmentName}'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionInDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc-flow-log/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flowlogs-role'

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flowlog'

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the shared VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  VpcCidr:
    Description: CIDR block of the shared VPC
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcCidr'

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of the public subnet in the first Availability Zone
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1Id'

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of the public subnet in the second Availability Zone
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2Id'

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of the private subnet in the first Availability Zone
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1Id'

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of the private subnet in the second Availability Zone
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2Id'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  VPC with IPv4 and Amazon-provided IPv6 ranges across three Availability Zones,
  with optional public subnets (Internet Gateway and public route table) and
  always-present private subnets sharing a single private route table.

Parameters:
  VpcName:
    Type: String
    Default: my-vpc
    Description: Identifier used to name the VPC and its related resources.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-_]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Only alphanumeric characters, hyphens and underscores are allowed.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: IPv4 CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28.

  SubnetCidrBits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 8
    MinValue: 4
    MaxValue: 12
    Description: >-
      Number of host bits for each IPv4 subnet (e.g. 8 yields /24 subnets from a /16 VPC).
      The VPC must be large enough to hold six subnets of this size.

  CreatePublicSubnets:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create public subnets, an Internet Gateway and a public route table.

Conditions:
  HasPublicSubnets: !Equals [!Ref CreatePublicSubnets, 'true']

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Ref VpcName

  VPCIpv6CidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true

  # Public networking (optional)

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-igw'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 6, !Ref SubnetCidrBits]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-public-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 6, !Ref SubnetCidrBits]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-public-2'

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 6, !Ref SubnetCidrBits]]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 6, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      AssignIpv6AddressOnCreation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-public-3'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${VpcName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRouteIpv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicDefaultRouteIpv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: '::/0'
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: HasPublicSubnets
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # Private networking (always created)

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock, 6, !Ref SubnetCidrBits]]

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  VPC infrastructure for OpenSearch cross-region resilience. Deployable in both
  primary and secondary regions. Creates a VPC with three public and three private
  subnets across separate Availability Zones, an Internet Gateway, configurable
  NAT Gateway topology (single or one per AZ), and VPC Flow Logs to CloudWatch Logs.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: Environment name used for resource naming and tagging.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters and hyphens.

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'

  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet in AZ 1.

  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet in AZ 2.

  PrivateSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet in AZ 3.

  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.101.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet in AZ 1.

  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.102.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet in AZ 2.

  PublicSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.103.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet in AZ 3.

  NatGatewayMode:
    Type: String
    Default: single
    AllowedValues:
      - single
      - per-az
      - none
    Description: >-
      NAT Gateway topology. "single" creates one NAT Gateway shared by all private
      subnets (cost-effective). "per-az" creates one NAT Gateway per Availability
      Zone (high availability). "none" creates no NAT Gateways.

  FlowLogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 7
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365]
    Description: Retention period in days for VPC Flow Logs in CloudWatch Logs.

  FlowLogTrafficType:
    Type: String
    Default: ALL
    AllowedValues:
      - ALL
      - ACCEPT
      - REJECT
    Description: Type of traffic to capture in VPC Flow Logs.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: General
        Parameters:
          - EnvironmentName
      - Label:
          default: Network Addressing
        Parameters:
          - VpcCidr
          - PrivateSubnet1Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet2Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet3Cidr
          - PublicSubnet1Cidr
          - PublicSubnet2Cidr
          - PublicSubnet3Cidr
      - Label:
          default: NAT Gateway
        Parameters:
          - NatGatewayMode
      - Label:
          default: VPC Flow Logs
        Parameters:
          - FlowLogRetentionDays
          - FlowLogTrafficType

Conditions:
  CreateNatGateway: !Not [!Equals [!Ref NatGatewayMode, none]]
  CreatePerAzNatGateways: !Equals [!Ref NatGatewayMode, per-az]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC & Internet Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public Subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-public-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-public-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-public-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: public

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private Subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-private-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-private-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-private-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public Routing
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT Gateways
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-nat-eip-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-nat-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: CreatePerAzNatGateways
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-nat-eip-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: CreatePerAzNatGateways
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-nat-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway3EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: CreatePerAzNatGateways
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-nat-eip-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: CreatePerAzNatGateways
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway3EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-nat-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private Routing (one route table per AZ)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-private-rt-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-private-rt-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !If
        - CreatePerAzNatGateways
        - !Ref NatGateway2
        - !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  PrivateRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-private-rt-3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateDefaultRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !If
        - CreatePerAzNatGateways
        - !Ref NatGateway3
        - !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Flow Logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPCFlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-${AWS::Region}'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCFlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc-flow-log/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flow-logs-to-cloudwatch'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt VPCFlowLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${VPCFlowLogGroup.Arn}:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: !Ref FlowLogTrafficType
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref VPCFlowLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt VPCFlowLogRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-opensearch-vpc-flowlog'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC.
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  VpcCidr:
    Description: CIDR block of the VPC.
    Value: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcCidr'

  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of public subnet 1.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1Id'

  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of public subnet 2.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2Id'

  PublicSubnet3Id:
    Description: ID of public subnet 3.
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet3Id'

  PublicSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-delimited list of public subnet IDs.
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PublicSubnet1, !Ref PublicSubnet2, !Ref PublicSubnet3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnetIds'

  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of private subnet 1.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1Id'

  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of private subnet 2.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2Id'

  PrivateSubnet3Id:
    Description: ID of private subnet 3.
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet3Id'

  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-delimited list of private subnet IDs.
    Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateSubnet1, !Ref PrivateSubnet2, !Ref PrivateSubnet3]]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetIds'

  InternetGatewayId:
    Description: ID of the Internet Gateway.
    Value: !Ref InternetGateway
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-InternetGatewayId'

  NatGateway1Id:
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Description: ID of NAT Gateway 1 (shared by all private subnets in single mode).
    Value: !Ref NatGateway1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NatGateway1Id'

  NatGateway2Id:
    Condition: CreatePerAzNatGateways
    Description: ID of NAT Gateway 2 (per-az mode only).
    Value: !Ref NatGateway2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NatGateway2Id'

  NatGateway3Id:
    Condition: CreatePerAzNatGateways
    Description: ID of NAT Gateway 3 (per-az mode only).
    Value: !Ref NatGateway3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NatGateway3Id'

  NatGatewayIds:
    Condition: CreateNatGateway
    Description: Comma-delimited list of NAT Gateway IDs.
    Value: !If
      - CreatePerAzNatGateways
      - !Join [',', [!Ref NatGateway1, !Ref NatGateway2, !Ref NatGateway3]]
      - !Ref NatGateway1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-NatGatewayIds'

  VPCFlowLogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs group receiving VPC Flow Logs.
    Value: !Ref VPCFlowLogGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VPCFlowLogGroupName'

  EnvironmentName:
    Description: Environment name for this deployment.
    Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-EnvironmentName'

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Fully isolated private VPC for an AI-powered customer support application.
  Three private subnets across AZs with no internet access, VPC endpoints for
  Bedrock, ECR, CloudWatch Logs/Monitoring, DynamoDB, RDS Data API, Secrets
  Manager, SSM, KMS, S3 and X-Ray, VPC Flow Logs encrypted with a rotating
  customer-managed KMS key, and per-component security groups with HTTPS-only egress.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: ai-support
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    Description: Prefix used for resource names and tags.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.20.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.20.0.0/20
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.20.16.0/20
  PrivateSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.20.32.0/20
  FlowLogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 365
    AllowedValues: [30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1096, 1827, 2192, 2557, 2922, 3288, 3653]
  AgentRuntimeNeedsDynamoDB:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Allow the Agent Runtime security group direct HTTPS egress to DynamoDB.
  McpRuntimeNeedsDynamoDB:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Allow the MCP Runtime security group direct HTTPS egress to DynamoDB.
  LambdaNeedsDynamoDB:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Allow the Lambda security group direct HTTPS egress to DynamoDB.

Conditions:
  AgentDynamoDB: !Equals [!Ref AgentRuntimeNeedsDynamoDB, 'true']
  McpDynamoDB: !Equals [!Ref McpRuntimeNeedsDynamoDB, 'true']
  LambdaDynamoDB: !Equals [!Ref LambdaNeedsDynamoDB, 'true']

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS key for VPC Flow Logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'CMK for ${EnvironmentName} VPC Flow Logs'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                'kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-flowlogs-key'

  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flowlogs'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC and private subnets (no IGW, no NAT)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      InstanceTenancy: default
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-2'

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-3'

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt'

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC Flow Logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${EnvironmentName}'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FlowLogsKmsKey.Arn

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'aws:SourceAccount': !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                'aws:SourceArn': !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc-flow-log/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn}:*'

  VpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceType: VPC
      ResourceId: !Ref Vpc
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogGroupName: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc-flowlog'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VpcEndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Interface VPC endpoints - HTTPS from application components only
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: Deny all outbound (placeholder rule)
          IpProtocol: icmp
          FromPort: 252
          ToPort: 86
          CidrIp: 127.0.0.1/32
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpce-sg'

  AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Agent Runtime - HTTPS-only egress to VPC endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: HTTPS to interface VPC endpoints
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-agent-runtime-sg'

  McpRuntimeSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: MCP Runtime - HTTPS-only egress to VPC endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: HTTPS to interface VPC endpoints
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-mcp-runtime-sg'

  LambdaSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Lambda functions - HTTPS-only egress to VPC endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - Description: HTTPS to interface VPC endpoints
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          DestinationSecurityGroupId: !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-lambda-sg'

  VpcEndpointIngressFromAgentRuntime:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Description: HTTPS from Agent Runtime
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup

  VpcEndpointIngressFromMcpRuntime:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Description: HTTPS from MCP Runtime
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref McpRuntimeSecurityGroup

  VpcEndpointIngressFromLambda:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref VpcEndpointSecurityGroup
      Description: HTTPS from Lambda functions
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref LambdaSecurityGroup

  # S3 gateway endpoint egress (required for ECR image layers) for all components
  AgentRuntimeEgressS3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup
      Description: HTTPS to S3 gateway endpoint
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      DestinationPrefixListId: !GetAtt PrefixListLookup.S3PrefixListId

  McpRuntimeEgressS3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref McpRuntimeSecurityGroup
      Description: HTTPS to S3 gateway endpoint
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      DestinationPrefixListId: !GetAtt PrefixListLookup.S3PrefixListId

  LambdaEgressS3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref LambdaSecurityGroup
      Description: HTTPS to S3 gateway endpoint
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      DestinationPrefixListId: !GetAtt PrefixListLookup.S3PrefixListId

  # Direct DynamoDB (gateway endpoint) egress for components that need it
  AgentRuntimeEgressDynamoDB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Condition: AgentDynamoDB
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref AgentRuntimeSecurityGroup
      Description: HTTPS to DynamoDB gateway endpoint
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      DestinationPrefixListId: !GetAtt PrefixListLookup.DynamoDBPrefixListId

  McpRuntimeEgressDynamoDB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Condition: McpDynamoDB
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref McpRuntimeSecurityGroup
      Description: HTTPS to DynamoDB gateway endpoint
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      DestinationPrefixListId: !GetAtt PrefixListLookup.DynamoDBPrefixListId

  LambdaEgressDynamoDB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupEgress
    Condition: LambdaDynamoDB
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref LambdaSecurityGroup
      Description: HTTPS to DynamoDB gateway endpoint
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      DestinationPrefixListId: !GetAtt PrefixListLookup.DynamoDBPrefixListId

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Custom resource to resolve AWS-managed prefix list IDs for S3 / DynamoDB
  # (runs outside the VPC; only calls ec2:DescribePrefixLists)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrefixListLookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DescribePrefixLists
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ec2:DescribePrefixLists
                Resource: '*'

  PrefixListLookupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Resolves S3 and DynamoDB managed prefix list IDs
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt PrefixListLookupRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, 'prefix-list-lookup')
                      return
                  region = os.environ['AWS_REGION']
                  s3_name = f'com.amazonaws.{region}.s3'
                  ddb_name = f'com.amazonaws.{region}.dynamodb'
                  ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                  resp = ec2.describe_prefix_lists(
                      Filters=[{'Name': 'prefix-list-name', 'Values': [s3_name, ddb_name]}]
                  )
                  ids = {p['PrefixListName']: p['PrefixListId'] for p in resp['PrefixLists']}
                  data = {
                      'S3PrefixListId': ids[s3_name],
                      'DynamoDBPrefixListId': ids[ddb_name],
                  }
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, data, 'prefix-list-lookup')
              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Error': str(e)}, 'prefix-list-lookup')

  PrefixListLookup:
    Type: Custom::PrefixListLookup
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt PrefixListLookupFunction.Arn
      Region: !Ref AWS::Region

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
