final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  VPC for an Amazon EKS cluster spanning three Availability Zones, with three public
  and three private subnets, an Internet Gateway, one NAT Gateway per AZ, per-AZ
  private route tables, a control plane security group, and an application ingress
  security group.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: General
        Parameters:
          - EnvironmentName
      - Label:
          default: VPC Network Configuration
        Parameters:
          - VpcCidr
          - PublicSubnet1Cidr
          - PublicSubnet2Cidr
          - PublicSubnet3Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet1Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet2Cidr
          - PrivateSubnet3Cidr

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-cluster
    Description: Name used to tag and identify all resources created by this stack.
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64

  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix between /16 and /28.

  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/20
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in the first Availability Zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix between /16 and /28.

  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.16.0/20
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in the second Availability Zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix between /16 and /28.

  PublicSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.32.0/20
    Description: CIDR block for the public subnet in the third Availability Zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix between /16 and /28.

  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.64.0/18
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in the first Availability Zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix between /16 and /28.

  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.128.0/18
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in the second Availability Zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix between /16 and /28.

  PrivateSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.192.0/18
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet in the third Availability Zone.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])/(1[6-9]|2[0-8])$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block with a prefix between /16 and /28.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # VPC and Internet Gateway
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-igw'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-3'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/elb
          Value: '1'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  PrivateSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-3'
        - Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb
          Value: '1'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Public routing
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-rt'

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # NAT Gateways (one per AZ, each with its own Elastic IP)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1'

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-2'

  NatGateway3EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-3'

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-2'

  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway3EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat-3'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private routing (one route table per AZ)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1'

  PrivateDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2'

  PrivateDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  PrivateRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-3'

  PrivateDefaultRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3

  PrivateSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable3

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Security groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ControlPlaneSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Cluster communication between the EKS control plane and worker nodes
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Allow all outbound traffic
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-control-plane-sg'

  ControlPlaneSecurityGroupSelfIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref ControlPlaneSecurityGroup
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref ControlPlaneSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: '-1'
      Description: Allow all traffic between the control plane and worker nodes sharing this group

  ControlPlaneSecurityGroupVpcHttpsIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref ControlPlaneSecurityGroup
      CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      IpProtocol: tcp
      FromPort: 443
      ToPort: 443
      Description: Allow worker nodes and pods in the VPC to reach the Kubernetes API server

  ApplicationSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Public application ports for HTTP, HTTPS, and ingress or service mesh gateway traffic
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 80
          ToPort: 80
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: HTTP
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: HTTPS
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 8080
          ToPort: 8080
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Alternate HTTP for ingress gateway
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 8443
          ToPort: 8443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Alternate HTTPS for ingress gateway
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 15021
          ToPort: 15021
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Service mesh gateway status and health check
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 15443
          ToPort: 15443
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Service mesh gateway mTLS passthrough
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 31400
          ToPort: 31400
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Service mesh gateway TCP
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Allow all outbound traffic
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-application-sg'

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'

  ControlPlaneSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group for EKS control plane communication with worker nodes
    Value: !Ref ControlPlaneSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ControlPlaneSecurityGroupId'

  ApplicationSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group exposing application and ingress gateway ports to the internet
    Value: !Ref ApplicationSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ApplicationSecurityGroupId'

  SecurityGroupIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of all security group IDs
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref ControlPlaneSecurityGroup
        - !Ref ApplicationSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-SecurityGroupIds'

  SubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of all public and private subnet IDs
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - - !Ref PublicSubnet1
        - !Ref PublicSubnet2
        - !Ref PublicSubnet3
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet3
    Export:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Transform: AWS::LanguageExtensions
Description: IAM execution role for a SageMaker HyperPod cluster integrated with Amazon EKS.

Parameters:
  ResourceNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Prefix used to name resources. The role is named <prefix>ExecRole.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9+=,.@_-]{1,56}$'
  EKSClusterName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the EKS cluster that orchestrates the HyperPod cluster.
  VpcId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC::Id
    Description: ID of the VPC used by the HyperPod cluster.
  SecurityGroupIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: Comma-delimited list of security group IDs used by the HyperPod cluster.
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Description: Comma-delimited list of private subnet IDs used by the HyperPod cluster.
  S3BucketName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket that holds the HyperPod lifecycle scripts.
  RigS3Bucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) Name of the RIG input S3 bucket.
  RigOutputS3Bucket:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: (Optional) Name of a separate RIG output S3 bucket.
  CreateRigResources:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create RIG resources.
  EnableGatedAccess:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to enable gated access for RIG.

Conditions:
  RigFlagEnabled: !Equals [!Ref CreateRigResources, 'true']
  HasRigInputBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref RigS3Bucket, '']]
  CreateRigPolicy: !And
    - !Condition RigFlagEnabled
    - !Condition HasRigInputBucket
  GatedAccessEnabled: !And
    - !Condition CreateRigPolicy
    - !Equals [!Ref EnableGatedAccess, 'true']
  HasSeparateRigOutputBucket: !And
    - !Condition CreateRigPolicy
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref RigOutputS3Bucket, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref RigOutputS3Bucket, !Ref RigS3Bucket]]
  HasPrivateSubnets: !Not [!Equals [!Join ['', !Ref PrivateSubnetIds], '']]
  HasSecurityGroups: !Not [!Equals [!Join ['', !Ref SecurityGroupIds], '']]

Resources:
  ExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerClusterInstanceRolePolicy'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-eks-cni-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EksCniDescribeAndAttach
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AttachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:DescribeTags
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeInstanceTypes
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EksCniCreateTags
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:*:*:network-interface/*'
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-hyperpod-eks-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: EniManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
                  - ec2:UnassignPrivateIpAddresses
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:network-interface/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc/${VpcId}'
              - Sid: Ec2Describe
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeDhcpOptions
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EcrPull
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchDescribeAlarms
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: EksPodIdentity
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks-auth:AssumeRoleForPodIdentity
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:eks:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:cluster/${EKSClusterName}'
              - Sid: LifecycleScriptsList
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${S3BucketName}'
              - Sid: LifecycleScriptsRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${S3BucketName}/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: SageMaker-HyperPod-Prerequisites
          Value: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}ExecRole'

  RigPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::RolePolicy
    Condition: CreateRigPolicy
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref ExecutionRole
      PolicyName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-rig-policy'
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: RigInputBucketList
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RigS3Bucket}'
          - Sid: RigInputBucketRead
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RigS3Bucket}/*'
          - Sid: RigLambdaInvoke
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - lambda:InvokeFunction
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*SageMaker*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:lambda:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:function:*sagemaker*'
          - !If
            - GatedAccessEnabled
            - Sid: GatedAccessS3Read
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - s3:GetObject
              Resource:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:*:accesspoint/*sagemaker*'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:*:accesspoint/*sagemaker*/object/*'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*sagemaker*/*'
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue
          - !If
            - GatedAccessEnabled
            - Sid: GatedAccessSqs
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - sqs:SendMessage
                - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                - sqs:DeleteMessage
                - sqs:ChangeMessageVisibility
                - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                - sqs:GetQueueUrl
              Resource:
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*SageMaker*'
                - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*sagemaker*'
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue
          - !If
            - HasSeparateRigOutputBucket
            - Sid: RigOutputBucketList
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - s3:ListBucket
              Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RigOutputS3Bucket}'
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue
          - !If
            - HasSeparateRigOutputBucket
            - Sid: RigOutputBucketReadWrite
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
                - s3:GetObject
                - s3:PutObject
                - s3:DeleteObject
              Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RigOutputS3Bucket}/*'
            - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  Fn::ForEach::SubnetEniPolicies:
    - SubnetId
    - !Ref PrivateSubnetIds
    - SubnetEniPolicy&{SubnetId}:
        Type: AWS::IAM::RolePolicy
        Condition: HasPrivateSubnets
        Properties:
          RoleName: !Ref ExecutionRole
          PolicyName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-eni-${SubnetId}'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SubnetEniManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
                  - ec2:UnassignPrivateIpAddresses
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:subnet/${SubnetId}'

  Fn::ForEach::SecurityGroupEniPolicies:
    - SecurityGroupId
    - !Ref SecurityGroupIds
    - SecurityGroupEniPolicy&{SecurityGroupId}:
        Type: AWS::IAM::RolePolicy
        Condition: HasSecurityGroups
        Properties:
          RoleName: !Ref ExecutionRole
          PolicyName: !Sub '${ResourceNamePrefix}-eni-${SecurityGroupId}'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SecurityGroupEniManagement
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterfacePermission
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:ModifyNetworkInterfaceAttribute
                  - ec2:UnassignPrivateIpAddresses
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:security-group/${SecurityGroupId}'

Outputs:
  ExecutionRoleName:
    Description: Name of the SageMaker HyperPod execution role.
    Value: !Ref ExecutionRole
  ExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the SageMaker HyperPod execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt ExecutionRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Self-contained private subnet tier with three private subnets across
  us-east-1a, us-east-1b and us-east-1c. Each subnet has its own route table with
  a default route to a per-AZ NAT gateway, is associated with a provided network
  ACL, and is served by an S3 gateway VPC endpoint.

Parameters:
  VpcId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC::Id
    Description: ID of the target VPC in which to create the private subnets.

  NatGatewayIdAZ1:
    Type: String
    Description: ID of the NAT gateway in us-east-1a (e.g. nat-0123456789abcdef0).
    AllowedPattern: "^nat-[0-9a-f]{8,17}$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid NAT gateway ID (nat-xxxxxxxx).

  NatGatewayIdAZ2:
    Type: String
    Description: ID of the NAT gateway in us-east-1b (e.g. nat-0123456789abcdef0).
    AllowedPattern: "^nat-[0-9a-f]{8,17}$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid NAT gateway ID (nat-xxxxxxxx).

  NatGatewayIdAZ3:
    Type: String
    Description: ID of the NAT gateway in us-east-1c (e.g. nat-0123456789abcdef0).
    AllowedPattern: "^nat-[0-9a-f]{8,17}$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid NAT gateway ID (nat-xxxxxxxx).

  NetworkAclId:
    Type: String
    Description: ID of the network ACL to associate with all private subnets (e.g. acl-0123456789abcdef0).
    AllowedPattern: "^acl-[0-9a-f]{8,17}$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid network ACL ID (acl-xxxxxxxx).

Mappings:
  SubnetConfig:
    PrivateSubnetAZ1:
      Cidr: 10.24.24.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: us-east-1a
    PrivateSubnetAZ2:
      Cidr: 10.24.25.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: us-east-1b
    PrivateSubnetAZ3:
      Cidr: 10.24.26.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: us-east-1c
    SubnetGroup:
      Cidr: 10.24.24.0/21

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Private subnets
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateSubnetAZ1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, PrivateSubnetAZ1, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, PrivateSubnetAZ1, AvailabilityZone]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-us-east-1a"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnetAZ2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, PrivateSubnetAZ2, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, PrivateSubnetAZ2, AvailabilityZone]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-us-east-1b"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateSubnetAZ3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, PrivateSubnetAZ3, Cidr]
      AvailabilityZone: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, PrivateSubnetAZ3, AvailabilityZone]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-us-east-1c"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Route tables (one per subnet / AZ)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateRouteTableAZ1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-rtb-us-east-1a"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateRouteTableAZ2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-rtb-us-east-1b"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  PrivateRouteTableAZ3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-rtb-us-east-1c"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Default routes to per-AZ NAT gateways
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateDefaultRouteAZ1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableAZ1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayIdAZ1

  PrivateDefaultRouteAZ2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableAZ2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayIdAZ2

  PrivateDefaultRouteAZ3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableAZ3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayIdAZ3

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Subnet / route table associations
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociationAZ1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetAZ1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableAZ1

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociationAZ2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetAZ2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableAZ2

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociationAZ3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetAZ3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableAZ3

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Subnet / network ACL associations
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PrivateSubnetNetworkAclAssociationAZ1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetAZ1
      NetworkAclId: !Ref NetworkAclId

  PrivateSubnetNetworkAclAssociationAZ2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetAZ2
      NetworkAclId: !Ref NetworkAclId

  PrivateSubnetNetworkAclAssociationAZ3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetNetworkAclAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetAZ3
      NetworkAclId: !Ref NetworkAclId

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # S3 gateway VPC endpoint attached to all private route tables
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  S3VpcEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      ServiceName: !Sub "com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3"
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTableAZ1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTableAZ2
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTableAZ3
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowFullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "*"
            Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-s3-gateway-endpoint"
        - Key: StackName
          Value: !Ref AWS::StackName
        - Key: Tier
          Value: private

Outputs:
  PrivateSubnetIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of the private subnet IDs (us-east-1a, us-east-1b, us-east-1c).
    Value: !Join
      - ","
      - - !Ref PrivateSubnetAZ1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetAZ2
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetAZ3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetIds"

  PrivateRouteTableIds:
    Description: Comma-separated list of the private route table IDs (us-east-1a, us-east-1b, us-east-1c).
    Value: !Join
      - ","
      - - !Ref PrivateRouteTableAZ1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTableAZ2
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTableAZ3
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-PrivateRouteTableIds"

  PrivateSubnetGroupCidr:
    Description: CIDR block encompassing the private subnet group.
    Value: !FindInMap [SubnetConfig, SubnetGroup, Cidr]
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnetGroupCidr"

  S3VpcEndpointId:
    Description: ID of the S3 gateway VPC endpoint.
    Value: !Ref S3VpcEndpoint
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::Region}-${AWS::StackName}-S3VpcEndpointId"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Baseline IAM groups, roles, instance profiles, and managed policies for common
  operational personas (System Administrator, IAM Administrator, Instance Operations,
  Read-Only Administrator, and Read-Only Billing).

Parameters:
  LoggingKmsKeyAliasPattern:
    Type: String
    Default: 'alias/*log*'
    Description: >-
      Alias pattern identifying KMS keys used for logging (for example CloudTrail or
      CloudWatch Logs encryption keys). These keys are protected from tampering.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Groups
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SystemAdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      Path: /

  IAMAdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      Path: /

  InstanceOpsGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      Path: /

  ReadOnlyAdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      Path: /

  ReadOnlyBillingGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      Path: /

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Roles (EC2-assumable) and Instance Profiles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SystemAdminRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  SystemAdminInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref SystemAdminRole

  IAMAdminRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  IAMAdminInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref IAMAdminRole

  InstanceOpsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  InstanceOpsInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref InstanceOpsRole

  ReadOnlyAdminRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Path: /
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  ReadOnlyAdminInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref ReadOnlyAdminRole

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Managed Policies
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SystemAdminPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: System administrator - near-full access outside of IAM, MFA required.
      Groups:
        - !Ref SystemAdminGroup
      Roles:
        - !Ref SystemAdminRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAllExceptIAMAndBillingWithMFA
            Effect: Allow
            NotAction:
              - 'iam:*'
              - 'aws-portal:*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent: 'true'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Three-tier VPC (web, application, database) spanning three Availability Zones,
  with an Internet Gateway for the web tier and one NAT Gateway per AZ for the
  application and database tiers.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'

  WebSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
  WebSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
  WebSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24

  AppSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.10.0/24
  AppSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.11.0/24
  AppSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.12.0/24

  DbSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.20.0/24
  DbSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.21.0/24
  DbSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.22.0/24

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  # Web tier subnets
  WebSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-1'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  WebSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-2'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  WebSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-3'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  # Application tier subnets
  AppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-1'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: app

  AppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-2'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: app

  AppSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-3'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: app

  # Database tier subnets
  DbSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref DbSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-1'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: db

  DbSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref DbSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-2'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: db

  DbSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref DbSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-3'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: db

  # Web tier routing (shared route table)
  WebRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-rt'

  WebDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  WebSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  WebSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  WebSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref WebRouteTable

  # NAT Gateways (one per AZ, in web subnets)
  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-1'

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-2'

  NatGateway3EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-3'

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-2'

  NatGateway3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway3EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet3
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-3'

  # Application tier routing (one route table per subnet)
  AppRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-rt-1'

  AppDefaultRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  AppSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable1

  AppRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:

          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-rt-2'

    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  AppSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable2

  AppRouteTable3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-rt-3'

  AppDefaultRoute3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AppRouteTable3
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway3

  AppSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet3

  DbSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref DbSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable1

  DbRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-db-rt-2'

  DbDefaultRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref DbRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

    Type: String
    Default: eks-quickstart
    Description: Prefix used for all IAM role names.
  SsmParameterPath:
    Type: String
    Default: /quickstart/amazon-eks
    AllowedPattern: ^/.*[^/]$
    Description: SSM Parameter Store path under which role ARNs are stored.

Resources:
  CopyZipsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${RolePrefix}-CopyZips-${AWS::Region}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: copy-zips
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectTagging
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:PutObjectTagging
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*

  GetResourceInfoRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${RolePrefix}-ResourceReader-${AWS::Region}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess

  CreateVpcRoleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${RolePrefix}-CreateVpcRole-${AWS::Region}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: create-vpc-role
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/CloudFormation-Kubernetes-VPC
                Condition:
                  ArnEqualsIfExists:
                    iam:PolicyARN:
                      - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaENIManagementAccess
                      - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  DeleteBucketContentsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${RolePrefix}-DeleteBucketContents-${AWS::Region}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: delete-bucket-contents
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:ListBucketVersions
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersion
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*

  CleanupLoadBalancersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${RolePrefix}-CleanupLoadBalancers-${AWS::Region}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cleanup-load-balancers
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeLoadBalancers
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTags
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                Resource: '*'

  CleanupSecurityGroupDependenciesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role

      RoleName: !Sub ${RolePrefix}-CleanupSecurityGroupDependencies-${AWS::Region}

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:

            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cleanup-sg-dependencies
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                Resource: '*'

  CleanupLambdasRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${RolePrefix}-CleanupLambdas-${AWS::Region}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cleanup-lambdas
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:ListFunctions
                  - lambda:GetFunction
                  - lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration
                  - lambda:UpdateFunctionConfiguration
                  - lambda:DeleteFunction
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DetachNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface

  GetCallerArnRole:

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: get-caller-arn
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                  - cloudtrail:LookupEvents
                  - iam:GetRole
                Resource: '*'

  RegisterTypeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub ${RolePrefix}-RegisterType-${AWS::Region}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:

            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: register-type
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:RegisterType
                  - cloudformation:DeregisterType
                  - cloudformation:DescribeType
                  - cloudformation:DescribeTypeRegistration
                  - cloudformation:ListTypeVersions
                  - cloudformation:ListTypes
                  - cloudformation:SetTypeDefaultVersion
                  - cloudformation:SetTypeConfiguration

              - Effect: Allow

              - Effect: Allow

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Lab VPC with web and application tier subnets across two AZs, a shared route table, a web security group, and VPC endpoints for S3, Kinesis Data Firehose, and Kinesis Data Streams.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  WebSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for web tier subnet 1.
  WebSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for web tier subnet 2.
  AppSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for application tier subnet 1.
  AppSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for application tier subnet 2.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  WebSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-subnet-1'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  WebSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref WebSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-subnet-2'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: web

  AppSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-subnet-1'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: app

  AppSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AppSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-app-subnet-2'
        - Key: Tier
          Value: app

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rt'

  WebSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  WebSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref WebSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  AppSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  AppSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AppSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  WebSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Web tier security group allowing HTTPS from within the VPC
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
          Description: HTTPS from VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-web-sg'

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref RouteTable
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action:
              - 's3:GetObject'
              - 's3:ListBucket'
            Resource: '*'

  FirehoseInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kinesis-firehose'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref WebSecurityGroup

  KinesisStreamsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.kinesis-streams'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref WebSubnet1
        - !Ref WebSubnet2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref WebSecurityGroup

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: ID of the VPC
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'
  WebSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of web tier subnet 1
    Value: !Ref WebSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-WebSubnet1Id'
  WebSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of web tier subnet 2
    Value: !Ref WebSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-WebSubnet2Id'
  AppSubnet1Id:
    Description: ID of application tier subnet 1
    Value: !Ref AppSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AppSubnet1Id'
  AppSubnet2Id:
    Description: ID of application tier subnet 2
    Value: !Ref AppSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-AppSubnet2Id'
  WebSecurityGroupId:
    Description: ID of the web tier security group
    Value: !GetAtt WebSecurityGroup.GroupId
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-WebSecurityGroupId'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Shared per-account IAM roles and instance profiles that support multiple Amazon EKS
  cluster deployments driven by Lambda-backed CloudFormation custom resources. Deploy
  once per account (and Region-independent names are derived from NamePrefix).

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Naming
        Parameters:
          - NamePrefix
          - SsmConfigPath
    ParameterLabels:
      NamePrefix:
        default: Common name prefix
      SsmConfigPath:
        default: SSM configuration path segment

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: EKS-Shared
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,31}$'
    ConstraintDescription: 1-32 characters; letters, numbers, and hyphens; must start with a letter or number.
    Description: Common prefix used to derive every IAM role, policy, and instance profile name in this template.
  SsmConfigPath:
    Type: String
    Default: eks-config
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+$'
    Description: >-
      Path segment under which shared Systems Manager parameters are stored. Parameters are
      resolved from /<NamePrefix>/<SsmConfigPath>/*.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda execution roles for custom-resource handlers
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CopyZipsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-CopyZips'
      Description: Execution role for the custom resource that copies deployment assets between S3 buckets.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-CopyZips'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadSourceAssets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:GetObjectTagging
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*'
              - Sid: WriteDestinationAssets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:PutObjectTagging
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*/*'
              - Sid: ListBuckets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::*'

  ResourceReaderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-ResourceReader'
      Description: Execution role for the custom resource that reads properties of arbitrary AWS resources.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-ResourceReader'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CloudControlRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudcontrol:GetResource
                  - cloudcontrol:ListResources
                  - cloudformation:DescribeType
                  - cloudformation:ListTypes
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResource
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:ListStackResources
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: UnderlyingServiceRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - eks:Describe*
                  - eks:List*
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:GetInstanceProfile
                  - iam:ListRoles
                  - iam:ListInstanceProfiles
                  - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
                  - iam:ListRolePolicies
                  - iam:GetRolePolicy
                  - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
                  - autoscaling:Describe*
                  - lambda:GetFunction
                  - lambda:ListFunctions
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:ListAllMyBuckets
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:DescribeParameters
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - kms:ListAliases
                Resource: '*'

  CreateVpcRoleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-CreateVpcRole'
      Description: Execution role for the custom resource that creates the VPC-related IAM role used by Lambda handlers.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-CreateVpcRole'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ManageVpcRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:DeleteRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:TagRole
                  - iam:UntagRole
                  - iam:UpdateAssumeRolePolicy
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                  - iam:DetachRolePolicy
                  - iam:PutRolePolicy
                  - iam:DeleteRolePolicy
                  - iam:GetRolePolicy
                  - iam:ListAttachedRolePolicies
                  - iam:ListRolePolicies
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${NamePrefix}-*'
              - Sid: RestrictManagedPolicyAttachment
                Effect: Deny
                Action:
                  - iam:AttachRolePolicy
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  ArnNotEquals:
                    iam:PolicyARN:
                      - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole'
                      - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'

  DeleteBucketContentsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-DeleteBucketContents'
      Description: Execution role for the custom resource that empties S3 buckets before deletion.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'

        dependent security groups and network interfaces, after cluster teardown.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:

            Statement:

                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteTargetGroup
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteListener

              - Sid: SecurityGroupAndEniCleanup

Description: >-
  IAM user and group for sending email through Amazon SES via SMTP. A Lambda-backed
  custom resource converts the user's secret access key into an SES SMTP password and
  stores the SMTP username and password as SecureString parameters in SSM Parameter Store.

Parameters:
  UserName:
    Type: String
    Default: SMTPUser
    Description: Name of the IAM user to create for SES SMTP sending.
    AllowedPattern: '[\w+=,.@-]+'
    MinLength: 1
    MaxLength: 64
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IAM user name.

  AccessKeyVersion:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    Description: >-
      Access key rotation version. Increment this value to rotate the access key and
      regenerate the SMTP credentials.

  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Number of days to retain the Lambda function's execution logs.
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653

  KmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: >-
      Optional ARN of a customer-managed KMS key used to encrypt the SecureString
      parameters. Leave blank to use the AWS-managed key (alias/aws/ssm).
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:kms:[a-z0-9-]+:\d{12}:key/[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be blank or a valid KMS key ARN.

Conditions:
  HasKmsKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KmsKeyArn, '']]

Resources:
  SMTPGroup:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Group
    Properties:
      GroupName: !Sub '${UserName}-group'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SESSendEmailOnly
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ses:SendEmail
                  - ses:SendRawEmail
                Resource: '*'

  SMTPUser:
    Type: AWS::IAM::User
    Properties:
      UserName: !Ref UserName
      Groups:
        - !Ref SMTPGroup

  SMTPUserAccessKey:
    Type: AWS::IAM::AccessKey
    Properties:
      UserName: !Ref SMTPUser
      Serial: !Ref AccessKeyVersion
      Status: Active

  SMTPPasswordFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-smtp-password-generator'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays

  SMTPPasswordFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SMTPPasswordFunctionPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt SMTPPasswordFunctionLogGroup.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:PutParameter
                  - ssm:DeleteParameter
                  - ssm:AddTagsToResource
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/ses/${UserName}/*'
              - !If
                - HasKmsKey
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - kms:Encrypt
                    - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  Resource: !Ref KmsKeyArn
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  SMTPPasswordFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-smtp-password-generator'
      Description: Converts an IAM secret access key into an SES SMTP password and stores credentials in SSM.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt SMTPPasswordFunctionRole.Arn
      LoggingConfig:
        LogGroup: !Ref SMTPPasswordFunctionLogGroup
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import base64
          import hashlib
          import hmac
          import logging
          import os

          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          ssm = boto3.client('ssm')

          # Values defined by AWS's published SES SMTP credential conversion algorithm.
          DATE = '11111111'
          SERVICE = 'ses'
          MESSAGE = 'SendRawEmail'
          TERMINAL = 'aws4_request'
          VERSION = 0x04


          def sign(key, msg):
              return hmac.new(key, msg.encode('utf-8'), hashlib.sha256).digest()


          def calculate_smtp_password(secret_access_key, region):
              signature = sign(('AWS4' + secret_access_key).encode('utf-8'), DATE)
              signature = sign(signature, region)
              signature = sign(signature, SERVICE)

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  WebSocket API (API Gateway v2) backed by a single Python Lambda function that pushes
  live grant-processing job status updates to connected clients. Includes a DynamoDB
  connections table, a dedicated CMK for Lambda environment variable encryption, and
  account-level API Gateway CloudWatch logging into KMS-encrypted log groups.

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$'
    Description: Name of the WebSocket API deployment stage.

  RelatedFunctionNames:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: 'grant-job-processor,grant-job-notifier'
    Description: >-
      Names of other Lambda functions in this account that are also allowed to use the
      Lambda environment-variable KMS key for decryption.

  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 90
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1827, 3653]
    Description: Retention period for API Gateway log groups.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS key for Lambda environment variable encryption
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaEnvKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for encrypting grant status WebSocket Lambda environment variables
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountKeyAdministrationWithoutDecrypt
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - kms:Create*
              - kms:Describe*
              - kms:Enable*
              - kms:List*
              - kms:Put*
              - kms:Update*
              - kms:Revoke*
              - kms:Disable*
              - kms:Get*
              - kms:Delete*
              - kms:TagResource
              - kms:UntagResource
              - kms:ScheduleKeyDeletion
              - kms:CancelKeyDeletion
              - kms:RotateKeyOnDemand
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowDecryptOnlyForApprovedLambdaFunctions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
                kms:EncryptionContext:LambdaFunctionName: !Split
                  - ','
                  - !Join
                    - ','
                    - - !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-grant-status-ws'
                      - !Join [',', !Ref RelatedFunctionNames]

  LambdaEnvKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-grant-status-lambda-env'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref LambdaEnvKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS key for API Gateway CloudWatch Logs
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApiLogsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for encrypting API Gateway CloudWatch Logs log groups
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyUsage: ENCRYPT_DECRYPT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccountKeyAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'

            Effect: Allow

              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DynamoDB table tracking WebSocket connections
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:

      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

        - AttributeName: connectionId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:

          KeyType: HASH
