        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda execution role and function
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  WebSocketHandlerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: GrantStatusWebSocketAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ConnectionsTableReadWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt ConnectionsTable.Arn

                Effect: Allow
                Action: kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt LambdaEnvKey.Arn
              - Sid: PushToConnectedClients
                Effect: Allow
                Action: execute-api:ManageConnections
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}/POST/@connections/*'

  WebSocketHandlerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-grant-status-ws'
      Description: Handles WebSocket routes and pushes grant-processing job status updates
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt WebSocketHandlerRole.Arn
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 256
      KmsKeyArn: !GetAtt LambdaEnvKey.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          CONNECTIONS_TABLE: !Ref ConnectionsTable
          CONNECTION_TTL_SECONDS: '86400'
          LOG_LEVEL: INFO
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging
          import os
          import time

          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(os.environ.get("LOG_LEVEL", "INFO"))

          TABLE = boto3.resource("dynamodb").Table(os.environ["CONNECTIONS_TABLE"])
          TTL_SECONDS = int(os.environ.get("CONNECTION_TTL_SECONDS", "86400"))


          def _response(status, body=None):
              resp = {"statusCode": status}
              if body is not None:
                  resp["body"] = json.dumps(body)
              return resp


          def _management_client(request_context):
              endpoint = "https://{}/{}".format(
                  request_context["domainName"], request_context["stage"]
              )
              return boto3.client("apigatewaymanagementapi", endpoint_url=endpoint)


          def _send(client, connection_id, payload):
              try:
                  client.post_to_connection(
                      ConnectionId=connection_id, Data=json.dumps(payload).encode("utf-8")
                  )
                  return True
              except ClientError as err:
                  code = err.response.get("Error", {}).get("Code")
                  if code == "GoneException":
                      logger.info("Removing stale connection %s", connection_id)
                      TABLE.delete_item(Key={"connectionId": connection_id})
                  else:
                      logger.exception("Failed to post to %s", connection_id)
                  return False


          def _all_connection_ids():
              kwargs = {"ProjectionExpression": "connectionId"}
              while True:
                  page = TABLE.scan(**kwargs)
                  for item in page.get("Items", []):
                      yield item["connectionId"]
                  if "LastEvaluatedKey" not in page:
                      break
                  kwargs["ExclusiveStartKey"] = page["LastEvaluatedKey"]


          def handle_connect(ctx):
              now = int(time.time())
              TABLE.put_item(
                  Item={
                      "connectionId": ctx["connectionId"],
                      "connectedAt": now,
                      "ttl": now + TTL_SECONDS,
                  }
              )
              return _response(200)


          def handle_disconnect(ctx):
              TABLE.delete_item(Key={"connectionId": ctx["connectionId"]})
              return _response(200)


          def handle_send_status(ctx, event):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get("body") or "{}")
              except json.JSONDecodeError:
                  return _response(400, {"error": "Body must be valid JSON"})

              job_id = body.get("jobId")
              status = body.get("status")
              if not job_id or not status:
                  return _response(400, {"error": "jobId and status are required"})

              payload = {
                  "type": "grantJobStatus",
                  "jobId": job_id,
                  "status": status,
                  "detail": body.get("detail"),
                  "timestamp": int(time.time()),
              }
              client = _management_client(ctx)
              delivered = sum(1 for cid in _all_connection_ids() if _send(client, cid, payload))
              logger.info("Delivered status for job %s to %d connections", job_id, delivered)
              return _response(200, {"delivered": delivered})


          def handle_default(ctx):
              client = _management_client(ctx)
              _send(
                  client,
                  ctx["connectionId"],
                  {
                      "type": "error",
                      "message": "Unknown action. Use {\"action\": \"sendStatus\", \"jobId\": \"...\", \"status\": \"...\"}",
                  },
              )
              return _response(200)


          def handler(event, context):
              ctx = event.get("requestContext", {})
              route = ctx.get("routeKey")
              logger.debug("Route %s connection %s", route, ctx.get("connectionId"))

              if route == "$connect":
                  return handle_connect(ctx)
              if route == "$disconnect":
                  return handle_disconnect(ctx)
              if route == "sendStatus":
                  return handle_send_status(ctx, event)
              return handle_default(ctx)

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Serverless webhook handler that receives Stripe webhook events, looks up the
  matching Squarespace Commerce order and inventory, and publishes a formatted
  sales notification to an SNS topic for relaying to Slack.

Parameters:
  SquarespaceApiToken:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    MinLength: 1
    Description: Squarespace Commerce API key (Bearer token) with Orders and Inventory read access.
  StripeWebhookSecret:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    MinLength: 1
    AllowedPattern: '^whsec_.+'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a Stripe webhook signing secret beginning with whsec_.
    Description: Stripe webhook endpoint signing secret (whsec_...).
  HandledEventTypes:
    Type: String
    Default: payment_intent.succeeded,checkout.session.completed
    Description: Comma-separated Stripe event types that trigger a notification. Other events are acknowledged and ignored.
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1827, 3653]
    Description: Retention period for the Lambda function's log group.

Resources:
  SalesNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sales-notifications'
      DisplayName: Sales Notifications

  WebhookFunctionLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AWS::StackName}-webhook-handler'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  WebhookFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: WebhookHandlerPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: WriteLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt WebhookFunctionLogGroup.Arn
              - Sid: PublishSalesNotifications
                Effect: Allow
                Action: sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref SalesNotificationTopic

  WebhookFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: WebhookFunctionLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-webhook-handler'
      Description: Handles Stripe webhooks, enriches with Squarespace order/inventory data, and publishes to SNS.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt WebhookFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 29
      MemorySize: 256
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TOPIC_ARN: !Ref SalesNotificationTopic
          SQUARESPACE_API_TOKEN: !Ref SquarespaceApiToken
          STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET: !Ref StripeWebhookSecret
          EVENT_TYPES: !Ref HandledEventTypes
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os, json, hmac, hashlib, time, base64, urllib.request
          import boto3

          sns = boto3.client('sns')
          API = 'https://api.squarespace.com/1.0/commerce'

          def sq(path):
              req = urllib.request.Request(API + path, headers={
                  'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + os.environ['SQUARESPACE_API_TOKEN'],
                  'User-Agent': 'stripe-slack-sales-webhook'})
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as f:
                  return json.load(f)

          def verify(body, header):
              items = [p.split('=', 1) for p in (header or '').split(',') if '=' in p]
              t = next((v for k, v in items if k.strip() == 't'), None)
              sigs = [v for k, v in items if k.strip() == 'v1']
              try:
                  if not t or not sigs or abs(time.time() - int(t)) > 300:
                      return False
              except ValueError:
                  return False
              secret = os.environ['STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET'].encode()
              expected = hmac.new(secret, f'{t}.{body}'.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()
              return any(hmac.compare_digest(expected, s) for s in sigs)

          def resp(code, msg):
              return {'statusCode': code, 'headers': {'Content-Type': 'application/json'},
                      'body': json.dumps({'message': msg})}

          def handler(event, context):
              body = event.get('body') or ''
              if event.get('isBase64Encoded'):
                  body = base64.b64decode(body).decode('utf-8')
              headers = {k.lower(): v for k, v in (event.get('headers') or {}).items()}
              if not verify(body, headers.get('stripe-signature')):
                  return resp(400, 'invalid signature')

              evt = json.loads(body)
              types = [s.strip() for s in os.environ.get('EVENT_TYPES', '').split(',') if s.strip()]
              if types and evt.get('type') not in types:
                  return resp(200, 'ignored event type')

              obj = evt.get('data', {}).get('object', {})
              order_id = (obj.get('metadata') or {}).get('squarespace_order_id')
              if not order_id:
                  print(f"No squarespace_order_id metadata on {evt.get('id')}")
                  return resp(200, 'ignored: no squarespace_order_id')

              order = sq('/orders/' + order_id)
              items = order.get('lineItems', [])
              variant_ids = [i['variantId'] for i in items if i.get('variantId')][:50]
              stock = {}
              if variant_ids:
                  for v in sq('/inventory/' + ','.join(variant_ids)).get('inventory', []):
                      stock[v.get('variantId')] = v

              lines = []
              for i in items:
                  inv = stock.get(i.get('variantId'), {})
                  left = 'unlimited' if inv.get('isUnlimited') else inv.get('quantity', 'n/a')
                  lines.append(f"- {i.get('productName')} x{i.get('quantity')} (SKU {i.get('sku', 'n/a')}, stock left: {left})")

              total = order.get('grandTotal') or {}
              msg = (f":tada: New sale! Squarespace order #{order.get('orderNumber')}\n"
                     f"Customer: {order.get('customerEmail', 'n/a')}\n"
                     f"Total: {total.get('value')} {total.get('currency')}\n"
                     f"Stripe: {evt.get('type')} ({obj.get('id')})\n"
                     "Items:\n" + '\n'.join(lines or ['- (none)']))

              sns.publish(TopicArn=os.environ['TOPIC_ARN'],
                          Subject=f"New sale: order #{order.get('orderNumber')}"[:100],
                          Message=msg)
              return resp(200, 'ok')

  WebhookFunctionErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-webhook-handler-errors'
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when the webhook handler Lambda function reports any invocation errors within one minute.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: !Ref WebhookFunction
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  WebhookApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-webhook-api'
      Description: Receives Stripe webhook events.
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  WebhooksResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref WebhookApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt WebhookApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: webhooks

  WebhooksPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref WebhookApi
      ResourceId: !Ref WebhooksResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${WebhookFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  WebhookApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: WebhooksPostMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref WebhookApi
      Description: Webhook API deployment

  WebhookApiProdStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref WebhookApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref WebhookApiDeployment
      StageName: prod
      Description: Production stage

  WebhookFunctionApiPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref WebhookFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebhookApi}/*/POST/webhooks'

Outputs:
  WebhookUrl:
    Description: URL to configure as the Stripe webhook endpoint.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${WebhookApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/${WebhookApiProdStage}/webhooks'
  SalesNotificationTopicArn:
    Description: SNS topic ARN to subscribe the Slack relay (e.g. AWS Chatbot or a Slack-forwarding Lambda) to.
    Value: !Ref SalesNotificationTopic
  WebhookFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the webhook handler Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt WebhookFunction.Arn
  ErrorAlarmName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch alarm on webhook handler errors.
    Value: !Ref WebhookFunctionErrorAlarm

  DaxEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableDax, 'true']

      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: customerId

          AttributeType: S

        - AttributeName: customerId

    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:

      Tags:

    Properties:

      Tags:
        - Key: Name

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained test environment for an Amazon ElastiCache for Redis replication group
  (cluster mode enabled, Multi-AZ across two Availability Zones) with customer-managed KMS
  encryption, an encrypted SNS topic for CloudWatch alarm notifications, and an IAM role
  for sending SSM Automation signals in resilience or gameday testing runbooks.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/22
    Description: CIDR block for the test VPC
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the first private subnet
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for the second private subnet
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
  CacheNodeType:
    Type: String
    Default: cache.t4g.small
    Description: Node type for the ElastiCache replication group
  RedisEngineVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '7.1'
    Description: Redis engine version
  RedisPort:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6379
    Description: Port used by the Redis replication group

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Networking
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-vpc

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2

  RedisSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allows Redis traffic between the private subnets
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref RedisPort
          ToPort: !Ref RedisPort
          CidrIp: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
          Description: Redis from private subnet 1
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref RedisPort
          ToPort: !Ref RedisPort
          CidrIp: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
          Description: Redis from private subnet 2
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref RedisPort
          ToPort: !Ref RedisPort
          CidrIp: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
          Description: Redis to private subnet 1
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref RedisPort
          ToPort: !Ref RedisPort
          CidrIp: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
          Description: Redis to private subnet 2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-redis-sg

  RedisSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::SubnetGroup
    Properties:
      Description: Subnet group spanning two Availability Zones for the Redis replication group
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Encryption
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  EncryptionKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed key for ElastiCache and SNS encryption in the resilience test environment
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowElastiCacheUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: '*'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:CreateGrant
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
                kms:ViaService: !Sub elasticache.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchToUseKeyForSns
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
          - Sid: AllowSnsToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  EncryptionKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${AWS::StackName}-redis-resilience
      TargetKeyId: !Ref EncryptionKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ElastiCache for Redis (cluster mode enabled)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RedisReplicationGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::ReplicationGroup
    Properties:
      ReplicationGroupDescription: Cluster-mode-enabled Redis replication group for resilience testing
      Engine: redis
      EngineVersion: !Ref RedisEngineVersion
      CacheNodeType: !Ref CacheNodeType
      CacheParameterGroupName: default.redis7.cluster.on

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Self-contained AWS AppSync GraphQL API for a simple songs service, secured with
  IAM authorization, X-Ray tracing enabled, backed by a DynamoDB table, with a
  two-step pipeline resolver for the addSong mutation.

Parameters:
  ApiName:
    Type: String
    Default: SongsApi
    Description: Name of the AppSync GraphQL API.

Resources:
  SongsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH

  AppSyncDynamoDBServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncSongsTableAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt SongsTable.Arn
                  - !Sub "${SongsTable.Arn}/*"

  SongsGraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ApiName
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
      XrayEnabled: true

  SongsGraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

        type Song {
          id: ID!
          name: String
          artist: String
        }

        type Query {
          getSongs: [Song]
        }

        type Mutation {
          addSong(name: String!, artist: String): Song
        }

  SongsTableDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: SongsTableDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncDynamoDBServiceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref SongsTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region

  NoneDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: NoneDataSource
      Type: NONE

  ValidateArtistFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: ValidateArtist
      Description: Validates that the artist argument is present and contains only letters.
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt NoneDataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          const artist = ctx.args.artist;
          if (artist === undefined || artist === null || artist === '') {
            util.error('Artist is required', 'ValidationError');
          }
          if (!/^[A-Za-z]+$/.test(artist)) {
            util.error('Artist must contain only letters', 'ValidationError');
          }
          return { payload: ctx.args };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  AddSongToTableFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: AddSongToTable
      Description: Writes a new song into DynamoDB with an auto-generated id.
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt SongsTableDataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          return {
            operation: 'PutItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: util.autoId() }),
            attributeValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({
              name: ctx.args.name,
              artist: ctx.args.artist,
            }),
          };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          if (ctx.error) {
            util.error(ctx.error.message, ctx.error.type);
          }
          return ctx.result;
        }

  AddSongPipelineResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: SongsGraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: addSong
      Kind: PIPELINE
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt ValidateArtistFunction.FunctionId
          - !GetAtt AddSongToTableFunction.FunctionId
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        export function request(ctx) {
          return {};
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.prev.result;
        }

  GetSongsResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: SongsGraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getSongs
      Kind: UNIT
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt SongsTableDataSource.Name
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: 1.0.0
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';

        export function request(ctx) {
          return { operation: 'Scan' };
        }

        export function response(ctx) {
          if (ctx.error) {
            util.error(ctx.error.message, ctx.error.type);
          }
          return ctx.result.items;
        }

Outputs:
  GraphQLApiId:
    Description: AppSync GraphQL API ID.
    Value: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.ApiId
  GraphQLApiUrl:
    Description: AppSync GraphQL endpoint URL.
    Value: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.GraphQLUrl
  GraphQLApiArn:
    Description: AppSync GraphQL API ARN (use for IAM policies granting appsync:GraphQL).
    Value: !GetAtt SongsGraphQLApi.Arn
  SongsTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table storing songs.
    Value: !Ref SongsTable

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Cognito user pool (email sign-in) with a regional REST API secured by a Cognito authorizer. Exposes a protected GET /me and an unauthenticated GET /open, both backed by one Lambda function.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: cognito-api-demo
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]+$'
    Description: Prefix used for naming resources (lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens).

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-user-pool'
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameConfiguration:
        CaseSensitive: false
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-app-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      EnableTokenRevocation: true
      AccessTokenValidity: 60
      IdTokenValidity: 60
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: minutes
        IdToken: minutes
        RefreshToken: days

  IdentityFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

  IdentityFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-identity'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt IdentityFunctionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      MemorySize: 128
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json

          def handler(event, context):
              request_context = event.get("requestContext") or {}
              authorizer = request_context.get("authorizer") or {}
              claims = authorizer.get("claims")
              body = {
                  "path": event.get("path"),
                  "authenticated": bool(claims),
                  "claims": claims or {},
              }
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "headers": {
                      "Content-Type": "application/json",
                      "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*",
                  },
                  "body": json.dumps(body),
              }

  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-api'
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  CognitoAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-cognito-authorizer'
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Type: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
      ProviderARNs:
        - !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  MeResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: me

  OpenResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: open

  MeGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MeResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: COGNITO_USER_POOLS
      AuthorizerId: !Ref CognitoAuthorizer
      # Specifying a scope makes the authorizer validate access tokens (not ID tokens).
      AuthorizationScopes:
        - aws.cognito.signin.user.admin
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${IdentityFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  OpenGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref OpenResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${IdentityFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  ApiInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      FunctionName: !Ref IdentityFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*/GET/*'

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - MeGetMethod
      - OpenGetMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      Description: Initial deployment

  ProdStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      StageName: prod

Outputs:

    Description: Cognito user pool ID
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Cognito user pool ARN
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  UserPoolClientId:
    Description: App client ID (no secret)

  MeEndpoint:

  OpenEndpoint:

  HasAccountAlias: !Equals [!Ref AccountAlias, 'true']
  HasCloudWatchAlarmGraphs: !Equals [!Ref CloudWatchAlarmGraphs, 'true']
  HasCodePipelineApproval: !Equals [!Ref CodePipelineApproval, 'true']
  HasAnyFeature: !Or
  - !Condition HasAutomatedMonitoring
  - !Condition HasAccountAlias
  - !Condition HasCloudWatchAlarmGraphs
  - !Condition HasCodePipelineApproval
Resources:
  Connection:
    Type: 'AWS::Events::Connection'
    Properties:
      AuthorizationType: API_KEY
      AuthParameters:
        ApiKeyAuthParameters:
          ApiKeyName: 'X-API-Key'
          ApiKeyValue: !Sub '${EndpointId}${AWS::AccountId}'
      Description: 'marbot connection'
  ApiDestination:
    Type: 'AWS::Events::ApiDestination'
    Properties:
      ConnectionArn: !GetAtt 'Connection.Arn'
      Description: 'marbot API destination'
      HttpMethod: POST
      InvocationEndpoint: !Sub 'https://api.marbot.io/${Stage}/endpoint/${EndpointId}'
      InvocationRateLimitPerSecond: 5
  ApiDestinationRole:
    Type: 'AWS::IAM::Role'
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
        - Effect: Allow
          Principal:
            Service: 'events.amazonaws.com'
          Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
      - PolicyName: 'invoke-api-destination'
        PolicyDocument:
          Version: '2012-10-17'
          Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: 'events:InvokeApiDestination'
            Resource: !GetAtt 'ApiDestination.Arn'
  KeepAliveRule:
    Type: 'AWS::Events::Rule'
    Properties:
      Description: 'Keeps the marbot connection alive (every 30 days)'
      ScheduleExpression: 'rate(30 days)'
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
      - Id: marbot
        Arn: !GetAtt 'ApiDestination.Arn'
        RoleArn: !GetAtt 'ApiDestinationRole.Arn'
        Input: !Sub |
          {
            "Type": "marbot-account-connection-alive",
            "AccountId": "${AWS::AccountId}",
            "Region": "${AWS::Region}",
            "StackName": "${AWS::StackName}",
            "StackId": "${AWS::StackId}"
          }
  PermissionsBoundary:
    Condition: HasAutomatedMonitoring
    Type: 'AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy'
    Properties:
      Description: 'Permissions boundary for the marbot cross-account role'
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
        - Sid: AllowMonitoringManagement
          Effect: Allow
          Action:
          - 'cloudwatch:*'
          - 'events:*'
          - 'sns:*'
          - 'tag:GetResources'
          - 'iam:ListAccountAliases'
          - 'codepipeline:PutApprovalResult'
          - 'codepipeline:GetPipelineState'
          - 'apigateway:GET'
          - 'autoscaling:Describe*'
          - 'cloudfront:Get*'
          - 'cloudfront:List*'
          - 'dynamodb:Describe*'
          - 'dynamodb:List*'
          - 'ec2:Describe*'
          - 'ecs:Describe*'
          - 'ecs:List*'
          - 'elasticache:Describe*'
          - 'elasticloadbalancing:Describe*'
          - 'es:Describe*'
          - 'es:List*'
          - 'lambda:Get*'
          - 'lambda:List*'
          - 'rds:Describe*'
          - 'rds:List*'
          - 'sqs:Get*'
          - 'sqs:List*'
          - 'states:Describe*'
          - 'states:List*'
          Resource: '*'
        - Sid: DenyIamPrivilegeEscalation
          Effect: Deny
          NotAction:
          - 'iam:ListAccountAliases'
          Resource: '*'
          Condition:
            StringLike:
              'aws:RequestedService': 'iam'
        - Sid: DenyBoundaryChanges
          Effect: Deny
          Action:
          - 'iam:DeleteRolePermissionsBoundary'
          - 'iam:PutRolePermissionsBoundary'
          - 'iam:CreatePolicyVersion'
          - 'iam:DeletePolicy'
          - 'iam:DeletePolicyVersion'
          - 'iam:SetDefaultPolicyVersion'
          Resource: '*'
  Role:
    Condition: HasAnyFeature
    Type: 'AWS::IAM::Role'
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
        - Effect: Allow
          Principal:
            AWS: !Sub
            - 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${MarbotAccountId}:root'
            - MarbotAccountId: !FindInMap [StageMap, !Ref Stage, AccountId]
          Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
          Condition:
            StringEquals:
              'sts:ExternalId': !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]
      PermissionsBoundary: !If [HasAutomatedMonitoring, !Ref PermissionsBoundary, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      Policies:
      - !If
        - HasAutomatedMonitoring
        - PolicyName: 'automated-monitoring'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
            - Sid: ReadResources
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
              - 'tag:GetResources'
              - 'apigateway:GET'
              - 'autoscaling:Describe*'
              - 'cloudfront:Get*'
              - 'cloudfront:List*'
              - 'dynamodb:Describe*'
              - 'dynamodb:List*'
              - 'ec2:Describe*'
              - 'ecs:Describe*'
              - 'ecs:List*'
              - 'elasticache:Describe*'
              - 'elasticloadbalancing:Describe*'
              - 'es:Describe*'
              - 'es:List*'
              - 'lambda:Get*'
              - 'lambda:List*'
              - 'rds:Describe*'
              - 'rds:List*'
              - 'sqs:Get*'
              - 'sqs:List*'
              - 'states:Describe*'
              - 'states:List*'
              - 'cloudwatch:Describe*'
              - 'cloudwatch:List*'
              - 'cloudwatch:Get*'
              - 'events:Describe*'
              - 'events:List*'
              - 'sns:Get*'
              - 'sns:List*'
              Resource: '*'
            - Sid: ManageAlarms
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
              - 'cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm'
              - 'cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms'
              - 'cloudwatch:TagResource'
              - 'cloudwatch:UntagResource'
              Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cloudwatch:*:${AWS::AccountId}:alarm:marbot-*'
            - Sid: ManageRules
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
              - 'events:PutRule'
              - 'events:DeleteRule'
              - 'events:PutTargets'
              - 'events:RemoveTargets'
              - 'events:EnableRule'
              - 'events:DisableRule'
              - 'events:TagResource'
              - 'events:UntagResource'
              Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:events:*:${AWS::AccountId}:rule/marbot-*'
            - Sid: ManageTopics
              Effect: Allow
              Action:
              - 'sns:CreateTopic'
              - 'sns:DeleteTopic'
              - 'sns:Subscribe'
              - 'sns:Unsubscribe'
              - 'sns:SetTopicAttributes'
              - 'sns:TagResource'
              - 'sns:UntagResource'
              Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sns:*:${AWS::AccountId}:marbot-*'
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      - !If
        - HasAccountAlias
        - PolicyName: 'account-alias'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action: 'iam:ListAccountAliases'
              Resource: '*'
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      - !If
        - HasCloudWatchAlarmGraphs
        - PolicyName: 'cloudwatch-alarm-graphs'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
              - 'cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms'
              - 'cloudwatch:GetMetricWidgetImage'
              Resource: '*'
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      - !If
        - HasCodePipelineApproval
        - PolicyName: 'codepipeline-approval'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
            - Effect: Allow
              Action:
              - 'codepipeline:GetPipelineState'
              - 'codepipeline:PutApprovalResult'
              Resource: '*'
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
  AccountConnection:
    Type: 'Custom::MarbotAccountConnection'
    DependsOn: KeepAliveRule
    Version: '1.0'
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !Sub
      - 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:sns:${AWS::Region}:${MarbotAccountId}:${TopicName}'
      - MarbotAccountId: !FindInMap [StageMap, !Ref Stage, AccountId]
        TopicName: !FindInMap [StageMap, !Ref Stage, ServiceTokenTopic]
      EndpointId: !Ref EndpointId
      AccountId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      StackName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
      StackId: !Ref 'AWS::StackId'
      RoleArn: !If [HasAnyFeature, !GetAtt 'Role.Arn', '']
      ExternalId: !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]
      AutomatedMonitoring: !Ref AutomatedMonitoring
      AccountAlias: !Ref AccountAlias
      CloudWatchAlarmGraphs: !Ref CloudWatchAlarmGraphs
      CodePipelineApproval: !Ref CodePipelineApproval
      ApiDestinationArn: !GetAtt 'ApiDestination.Arn'
Outputs:
  StackName:
    Description: 'Stack name.'
    Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
  ApiDestinationArn:
    Description: 'ARN of the marbot API destination.'
    Value: !GetAtt 'ApiDestination.Arn'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ApiDestinationArn'
  RoleArn:
    Condition: HasAnyFeature
    Description: 'ARN of the cross-account role assumed by marbot.'
    Value: !GetAtt 'Role.Arn'
  ExternalId:
    Description: 'External ID required to assume the marbot role.'
    Value: !Select [2, !Split ['/', !Ref 'AWS::StackId']]
deploy_error_message: EndpointId: Required parameter has no Default value
deploy_logs: ['EndpointId: Required parameter has no Default value']
deploy_failed_resources: [{"logical_name": "EndpointId", "status_reason": "Required parameter has no Default value"}]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Self-contained backend for a simple mobile or web application. Provisions a
  DynamoDB table with a global secondary index, a Cognito identity pool that
  allows unauthenticated guest access, and an IAM role for unauthenticated
  identities with access to Mobile Analytics, Cognito Sync, SNS, and DynamoDB.

Parameters:
  IdentityPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: AppIdentityPool
    AllowedPattern: "[\\w ]+"
    Description: Name of the Cognito identity pool (alphanumeric, underscores, and spaces only).

Resources:
  AppTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: N
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 10
        WriteCapacityUnits: 10
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: IdIndex
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: id
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: 5
            WriteCapacityUnits: 10

  IdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: !Ref IdentityPoolName
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true

  UnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Role assumed by unauthenticated (guest) Cognito identities.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud": !Ref IdentityPool
              "ForAnyValue:StringLike":
                "cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr": unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: UnauthenticatedGuestAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: MobileAnalytics
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: CognitoSync
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-sync:*
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-sync:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identitypool/${IdentityPool}/*"
              - Sid: SnsPublish
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:Publish
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:sns:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*"
              - Sid: DynamoDBWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                Resource: !GetAtt AppTable.Arn

  IdentityPoolRoleAttachment:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPoolRoleAttachment
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolId: !Ref IdentityPool
      Roles:
        unauthenticated: !GetAtt UnauthenticatedRole.Arn

Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref AppTable
  TableArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table.
    Value: !GetAtt AppTable.Arn
  IdentityPoolId:
    Description: ID of the Cognito identity pool.
    Value: !Ref IdentityPool
  UnauthenticatedRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by unauthenticated identities.
    Value: !GetAtt UnauthenticatedRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Data lake catalog and transform layer. Creates a Glue Data Catalog database, an optional
  Glue crawler for incremental schema and partition discovery on an existing S3 source bucket,
  and an optional Glue Spark ETL job with job bookmarks and continuous CloudWatch logging.
  The crawler and the job share one IAM service role.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Naming
        Parameters:
          - NamePrefix
          - Environment
      - Label:
          default: Source Data
        Parameters:
          - SourceBucketArn
          - SourcePrefix
      - Label:
          default: Crawler
        Parameters:
          - EnableCrawler
          - CrawlerSchedule
      - Label:
          default: ETL Job
        Parameters:
          - EnableEtlJob
          - EtlScriptS3Location
          - TargetBucketArn
          - TargetPrefix
          - GlueVersion
          - WorkerType
          - NumberOfWorkers
          - JobTimeoutMinutes
          - MaxConcurrentRuns
          - LogRetentionDays

Parameters:
  NamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Naming prefix for the database, crawler, and job (lowercase letters, digits, underscores).
    Default: datalake
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,39}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must start with a lowercase letter and contain only lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (max 40 chars).

  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Deployment environment.
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod

  SourceBucketArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the existing S3 bucket the crawler scans (e.g. arn:aws:s3:::my-raw-bucket).
    AllowedPattern: '^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:s3:::[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid S3 bucket ARN.

  SourcePrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Key prefix within the source bucket to crawl (e.g. raw/). Leave empty to crawl the whole bucket.
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[^/].*/$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a prefix that does not start with '/' and ends with '/'.

  EnableCrawler:
    Type: String
    Description: Whether to create the Glue crawler.
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'

  CrawlerSchedule:
    Type: String
    Description: Cron expression for the crawler schedule (Glue cron syntax). Defaults to daily at 02:00 UTC.
    Default: cron(0 2 * * ? *)
    AllowedPattern: '^cron\(.+\)$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a Glue cron expression, e.g. cron(0 2 * * ? *).

  EnableEtlJob:
    Type: String
    Description: Whether to create the Glue Spark ETL job.
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'

  EtlScriptS3Location:
    Type: String
    Description: S3 URI of the ETL script (e.g. s3://my-scripts-bucket/glue/etl.py). Required when the ETL job is enabled.
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^s3://[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]/.+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid s3://bucket/key URI.

  TargetBucketArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of the S3 bucket for transformed output. Leave empty to grant no write access.
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^arn:aws[a-zA-Z-]*:s3:::[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid S3 bucket ARN.

  TargetPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Key prefix within the target bucket for transformed output (e.g. curated/).
    Default: curated/
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[^/].*/$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a prefix that does not start with '/' and ends with '/'.

  GlueVersion:
    Type: String
    Description: Glue version for the ETL job.
    Default: '4.0'
    AllowedValues:
      - '3.0'
      - '4.0'
      - '5.0'

  WorkerType:
    Type: String
    Description: Glue worker type for the ETL job.
    Default: G.1X
    AllowedValues:
      - G.1X
      - G.2X
      - G.4X
      - G.8X

  NumberOfWorkers:
    Type: Number
    Description: Number of workers for the ETL job.
    Default: 2
    MinValue: 2
    MaxValue: 299

  JobTimeoutMinutes:
    Type: Number
    Description: ETL job timeout in minutes.
    Default: 60
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 10080

  MaxConcurrentRuns:
    Type: Number
    Description: Maximum number of concurrent runs of the ETL job.
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 1000

  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Description: Retention period in days for the ETL job CloudWatch log group.
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1827
      - 3653

Rules:
  EtlJobRequiresScript:
    RuleCondition: !Equals
      - !Ref EnableEtlJob
      - 'true'
    Assertions:
      - Assert: !Not
          - !Equals
            - !Ref EtlScriptS3Location
            - ''
        AssertDescription: EtlScriptS3Location must be provided when EnableEtlJob is true.

Conditions:
  CreateCrawler: !Equals
    - !Ref EnableCrawler
    - 'true'
  CreateEtlJob: !Equals
    - !Ref EnableEtlJob
    - 'true'
  HasTargetBucket: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref TargetBucketArn
      - ''
  HasScriptLocation: !Not
    - !Equals
      - !Ref EtlScriptS3Location
      - ''
  GrantScriptRead: !And
    - !Condition CreateEtlJob
    - !Condition HasScriptLocation

Resources:
  GlueDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Sub '${NamePrefix}_${Environment}_db'
        Description: !Sub 'Data lake catalog database for ${NamePrefix} (${Environment}).'

  GlueServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-glue-service-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SourceBucketRead
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ListSourceBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource: !Ref SourceBucketArn
              - Sid: ReadSourceObjects
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub '${SourceBucketArn}/*'
        - PolicyName: TargetBucketWrite
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - !If
                - HasTargetBucket
                - Sid: ListTargetBucket
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:ListBucket
                    - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  Resource: !Ref TargetBucketArn
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - !If
                - HasTargetBucket
                - Sid: WriteTargetObjects
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:GetObject
                    - s3:PutObject
                    - s3:DeleteObject
                  Resource: !Sub '${TargetBucketArn}/*'
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - !If
                - GrantScriptRead
                - Sid: ReadEtlScript
                  Effect: Allow
                  Action:
                    - s3:GetObject
                  Resource: !Sub
                    - 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ScriptPath}'
                    - ScriptPath: !Select
                        - 1
                        - !Split
                          - 's3://'
                          - !Ref EtlScriptS3Location
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
              - Sid: WriteJobLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws-glue/jobs/${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-etl:*'

  GlueCrawler:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Crawler
    Condition: CreateCrawler
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-crawler'
      Description: !Sub 'Incremental schema and partition discovery for ${NamePrefix} (${Environment}).'
      Role: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
      DatabaseName: !Ref GlueDatabase
      Targets:
        S3Targets:
          - Path: !Sub
              - 's3://${SourceBucketName}/${SourcePrefix}'
              - SourceBucketName: !Select
                  - 5
                  - !Split
                    - ':'
                    - !Ref SourceBucketArn
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: !Ref CrawlerSchedule
      SchemaChangePolicy:
        UpdateBehavior: LOG
        DeleteBehavior: LOG
      RecrawlPolicy:
        RecrawlBehavior: CRAWL_NEW_FOLDERS_ONLY
      Tags:
        Environment: !Ref Environment
        NamePrefix: !Ref NamePrefix

  EtlJobLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: CreateEtlJob
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws-glue/jobs/${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-etl'
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  EtlJob:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Condition: CreateEtlJob
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${NamePrefix}-${Environment}-etl'
      Description: !Sub 'Spark ETL job for ${NamePrefix} (${Environment}).'
      Role: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: !Ref GlueVersion
      WorkerType: !Ref WorkerType
      NumberOfWorkers: !Ref NumberOfWorkers
      Timeout: !Ref JobTimeoutMinutes
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: !Ref MaxConcurrentRuns
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Ref EtlScriptS3Location
      DefaultArguments:
        '--job-language': python
        '--job-bookmark-option': job-bookmark-enable
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'
        '--continuous-log-logGroup': !Ref EtlJobLogGroup
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--DATABASE_NAME': !Ref GlueDatabase
        '--TARGET_PATH': !If
          - HasTargetBucket
          - !Sub
            - 's3://${TargetBucketName}/${TargetPrefix}'
            - TargetBucketName: !Select
                - 5
                - !Split
                  - ':'
                  - !Ref TargetBucketArn
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Tags:
        Environment: !Ref Environment
        NamePrefix: !Ref NamePrefix

Outputs:
  DatabaseName:
    Description: Name of the Glue Data Catalog database.
    Value: !Ref GlueDatabase
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-DatabaseName'

  GlueServiceRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the shared Glue service role.
    Value: !GetAtt GlueServiceRole.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GlueServiceRoleArn'

  CrawlerName:
    Condition: CreateCrawler
    Description: Name of the Glue crawler.
    Value: !Ref GlueCrawler

  EtlJobName:
    Condition: CreateEtlJob
    Description: Name of the Glue ETL job.
    Value: !Ref EtlJob

  EtlJobLogGroupName:
    Condition: CreateEtlJob
    Description: CloudWatch log group for the ETL job.

Description: 'Security: KMS customer managed key with alias and optional deletion alerts'
Metadata:
  'AWS::CloudFormation::Interface':
    ParameterGroups:
    - Label:
        default: 'Parent Stacks'
      Parameters:
      - ParentAlertStack
    - Label:
        default: 'KMS Parameters'
      Parameters:
      - Service
Parameters:
  ParentAlertStack:
    Description: 'Optional but recommended stack name of parent alert stack based on operations/alert.yaml template.'
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  Service:
    Description: 'Which AWS service is allowed to use this CMK? Use ALL_SERVICES for all services in the account, or S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS to allow public decryption of S3 objects.'
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
    - 'ALL_SERVICES'
    - 'S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS'
    - connect
    - dms
    - ssm
    - ec2
    - elasticfilesystem
    - es
    - kinesis
    - kinesisvideo
    - lambda
    - lex
    - redshift
    - rds
    - secretsmanager
    - ses
    - s3
    - importexport
    - sqs
    - workmail
    - workspaces
    Default: 'ALL_SERVICES'
Conditions:
  HasAlertTopic: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ParentAlertStack, '']]
  HasServiceAllServices: !Equals [!Ref Service, 'ALL_SERVICES']
  HasServiceS3PublicAccess: !Equals [!Ref Service, 'S3_PUBLIC_ACCESS']
Resources:
  Key:
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Type: 'AWS::KMS::Key'
    Properties:
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
        - Sid: AllowRootAccountAdministration
          Effect: Allow
          Principal:
            AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
          Action: 'kms:*'
          Resource: '*'
        - !If
          - HasServiceAllServices
          - Sid: AllowCallerAccountUsage
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: '*'
            Action:
            - 'kms:Encrypt'
            - 'kms:Decrypt'
            - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
            - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
            - 'kms:CreateGrant'
            - 'kms:ListGrants'
            - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:CallerAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
          - !If
            - HasServiceS3PublicAccess
            - Sid: AllowPublicS3Decrypt
              Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: '*'
              Action: 'kms:Decrypt'
              Resource: '*'
              Condition:
                StringEquals:
                  'kms:ViaService': !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            - Sid: AllowCallerAccountUsageViaService
              Effect: Allow
              Principal:
                AWS: '*'
              Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:CreateGrant'
              - 'kms:ListGrants'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
              Resource: '*'
              Condition:
                StringEquals:
                  'kms:CallerAccount': !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                  'kms:ViaService': !Sub '${Service}.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
  KeyAlias:
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Type: 'AWS::KMS::Alias'
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref Key
  KeyDeletionAlertRule:
    Condition: HasAlertTopic
    Type: 'AWS::Events::Rule'
    Properties:
      Description: 'Alert when the KMS key is scheduled for deletion or disabled'
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
        - 'aws.kms'
        detail-type:
        - 'AWS API Call via CloudTrail'
        resources:
        - !GetAtt Key.Arn

Description: Scheduled enforcement of account-level S3 Block Public Access using an SSM Automation document triggered daily by EventBridge.

Resources:
  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: S3AccountPublicAccessBlockPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:

                  - s3:PutAccountPublicAccessBlock
                  - s3:GetAccountPublicAccessBlock
                Resource: '*'

  S3BlockPublicAccessDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enables S3 Block Public Access settings at the account level.
        assumeRole: '{{ AutomationAssumeRole }}'
        parameters:
          AutomationAssumeRole:
            type: String
            description: The ARN of the role that allows Automation to perform the actions on your behalf.
            default: ''
          AccountId:
            type: String
            description: The AWS account ID to enforce S3 Block Public Access on.
            default: '{{ global:ACCOUNT_ID }}'
        mainSteps:
          - name: PutAccountPublicAccessBlock
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              Service: s3control
              Api: PutPublicAccessBlock
              AccountId: '{{ AccountId }}'
              PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
                BlockPublicAcls: true
                BlockPublicPolicy: true
                IgnorePublicAcls: true
                RestrictPublicBuckets: true
            isEnd: true

  EventBridgeInvokeSSMRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartSSMAutomationPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${S3BlockPublicAccessDocument}:*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Cognito authentication layer (OAuth2 client credentials flow) for an Amazon Bedrock
  AgentCore Gateway. Creates a user pool, hosted domain, resource server with custom
  scopes, a confidential app client, stores the client credentials in Secrets Manager,
  and publishes configuration values to SSM Parameter Store.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    Description: Project name used for naming and tagging resources.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$'
    ConstraintDescription: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens only.

  RequireSymbols:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether the user pool password policy requires symbols.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cognito User Pool
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: agentcore-gateway-pool
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: 'OFF'
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: !Ref RequireSymbols
      UserPoolTags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName
        Component: agentcore-gateway-auth

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Domain: !Join
        - '-'
        - - !Ref AWS::Region
          - !Select
            - 0
            - !Split
              - '-'
              - !Select
                - 2
                - !Split
                  - '/'
                  - !Ref AWS::StackId

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: agentcore-gateway
      Name: agentcore-gateway
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to AgentCore Gateway tools
        - ScopeName: write
          ScopeDescription: Write access to AgentCore Gateway tools
        - ScopeName: admin
          ScopeDescription: Administrative access to AgentCore Gateway

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: agentcore-gateway-client
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - agentcore-gateway/read
        - agentcore-gateway/write
        - agentcore-gateway/admin
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Custom resource: store client secret in Secrets Manager
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ClientSecretFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoClientSecretToSecretsManager
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:DescribeUserPoolClient
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:CreateSecret
                  - secretsmanager:PutSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                  - secretsmanager:DeleteSecret
                  - secretsmanager:TagResource
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${ProjectName}/cognito/client-secret-*
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName

  ClientSecretFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Description: Reads the Cognito app client secret and stores it in Secrets Manager.
      Runtime: python3.13
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt ClientSecretFunctionRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging
          import urllib.request

          import boto3
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          cognito = boto3.client("cognito-idp")
          secrets = boto3.client("secretsmanager")


          def send_response(event, context, status, data=None, physical_id=None, reason=None):
              body = json.dumps({
                  "Status": status,
                  "Reason": reason or f"See CloudWatch Log Stream: {context.log_stream_name}",
                  "PhysicalResourceId": physical_id or context.log_stream_name,
                  "StackId": event["StackId"],
                  "RequestId": event["RequestId"],
                  "LogicalResourceId": event["LogicalResourceId"],
                  "NoEcho": True,
                  "Data": data or {},
              }).encode("utf-8")
              req = urllib.request.Request(
                  event["ResponseURL"],
                  data=body,
                  method="PUT",
                  headers={"Content-Type": "", "Content-Length": str(len(body))},
              )
              with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
                  logger.info("CloudFormation response status: %s", resp.status)


          def upsert_secret(name, value, project):
              try:
                  secrets.describe_secret(SecretId=name)
                  resp = secrets.put_secret_value(SecretId=name, SecretString=value)
                  return resp["ARN"]
              except ClientError as e:
                  if e.response["Error"]["Code"] != "ResourceNotFoundException":
                      raise
              resp = secrets.create_secret(
                  Name=name,
                  Description="Cognito OAuth2 client credentials for AgentCore Gateway",
                  SecretString=value,
                  Tags=[{"Key": "Project", "Value": project}],
              )
              return resp["ARN"]


          def delete_secret(name):
              try:
                  secrets.delete_secret(SecretId=name, ForceDeleteWithoutRecovery=True)
              except ClientError as e:
                  if e.response["Error"]["Code"] != "ResourceNotFoundException":
                      raise


          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info("Request type: %s", event["RequestType"])
              props = event["ResourceProperties"]
              secret_name = props["SecretName"]
              physical_id = event.get("PhysicalResourceId") or secret_name

              try:
                  if event["RequestType"] == "Delete":
                      try:
                          delete_secret(physical_id)
                      except Exception as e:
                          logger.error("Failed to delete secret %s: %s", physical_id, e)
                      send_response(event, context, "SUCCESS", physical_id=physical_id)
                      return

                  client = cognito.describe_user_pool_client(
                      UserPoolId=props["UserPoolId"],
                      ClientId=props["ClientId"],
                  )["UserPoolClient"]

                  value = json.dumps({
                      "client_id": client["ClientId"],
                      "client_secret": client["ClientSecret"],
                      "user_pool_id": props["UserPoolId"],
                  })

                  arn = upsert_secret(secret_name, value, props.get("ProjectName", ""))

                  # If the secret name changed on update, CloudFormation will issue a
                  # Delete for the old physical ID after this update succeeds.
                  send_response(
                      event, context, "SUCCESS",
                      data={"SecretArn": arn, "SecretName": secret_name},
                      physical_id=secret_name,
                  )
              except Exception as e:
                  logger.exception("Custom resource failed")
                  send_response(event, context, "FAILED", physical_id=physical_id, reason=str(e)[:500])

  ClientSecretStore:
    Type: Custom::CognitoClientSecret
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt ClientSecretFunction.Arn
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientId: !Ref UserPoolClient
      SecretName: !Sub ${ProjectName}/cognito/client-secret
      ProjectName: !Ref ProjectName

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SSM parameters for consumption by the gateway stack
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DiscoveryUrlParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/discovery-url
      Type: String
      Description: Cognito OIDC discovery URL for AgentCore Gateway

      Tags:

  ClientIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:

      Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
      Tags:

  UserPoolIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/user-pool-id
      Type: String
      Description: Cognito user pool ID for AgentCore Gateway

      Tags:

  UserPoolArnParameter:

    Properties:
      Name: /protein-agent/cognito/user-pool-arn

      Tags:
        Project: !Ref ProjectName

  DomainUrlParameter:

      Tags:

Outputs:

    Description: Cognito user pool ID
    Value: !Ref UserPool
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolId

  UserPoolArn:
    Description: Cognito user pool ARN
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-UserPoolArn

  ClientId:
    Description: Cognito app client ID
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-ClientId

  DiscoveryUrl:
    Description: OIDC discovery URL
    Value: !Sub https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}/.well-known/openid-configuration
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DiscoveryUrl

  DomainUrl:
    Description: Cognito hosted domain URL
    Value: !Sub https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com
    Export:
      Name: !Sub ${AWS::StackName}-DomainUrl

  TokenEndpoint:

    Export:
