AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Reusable DynamoDB table with optional sort key, GSIs, TTL, streams, auto scaling, AWS Backup and CloudWatch alarms'

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: 'Table Parameters'
        Parameters:
          - TableName
          - PartitionKeyName
          - PartitionKeyType
          - SortKeyName
          - SortKeyType
          - TimeToLiveAttributeName
          - StreamViewType
          - PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled
          - SSEEnabled
      - Label:
          default: 'Additional Attribute Definitions'
        Parameters:
          - Attribute1Name
          - Attribute1Type
          - Attribute2Name
          - Attribute2Type
          - Attribute3Name
          - Attribute3Type
      - Label:
          default: 'Global Secondary Indexes'
        Parameters:
          - Index1Name
          - Index1PartitionKeyName
          - Index1SortKeyName
          - Index2Name
          - Index2PartitionKeyName
          - Index2SortKeyName
      - Label:
          default: 'Capacity Parameters'
        Parameters:
          - BillingMode
          - MinReadCapacityUnits
          - MaxReadCapacityUnits
          - MinWriteCapacityUnits
          - MaxWriteCapacityUnits
          - TargetUtilization
      - Label:
          default: 'Backup Parameters'
        Parameters:
          - BackupRetentionPeriod
      - Label:
          default: 'Alerting Parameters'
        Parameters:
          - AlertTopicArn

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Description: 'Optional name of the table (leave blank to let CloudFormation generate a name).'
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  PartitionKeyName:
    Description: 'Name of the partition key.'
    Type: String
    MinLength: 1
  PartitionKeyType:
    Description: 'Type of the partition key.'
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues: [S, N, B]
  SortKeyName:
    Description: 'Optional name of the sort key (leave blank for no sort key).'
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  SortKeyType:
    Description: 'Type of the sort key (only used if SortKeyName is set).'
    Type: String
    Default: N
    AllowedValues: [S, N, B]
  Attribute1Name:
    Description: 'Optional name of an additional attribute definition (must be used by an index key).'
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  Attribute1Type:
    Description: 'Type of additional attribute 1.'
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues: [S, N, B]
  Attribute2Name:
    Description: 'Optional name of an additional attribute definition (must be used by an index key).'
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  Attribute2Type:
    Description: 'Type of additional attribute 2.'
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues: [S, N, B]
  Attribute3Name:
    Description: 'Optional name of an additional attribute definition (must be used by an index key).'
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  Attribute3Type:
    Description: 'Type of additional attribute 3.'
    Type: String
    Default: S
    AllowedValues: [S, N, B]
  Index1Name:
    Description: 'Optional name of global secondary index 1 (requires Index1PartitionKeyName).'
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  Index1PartitionKeyName:
    Description: 'Partition key attribute of global secondary index 1 (must be defined as an attribute).'
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  Index1SortKeyName:
    Description: 'Optional sort key attribute of global secondary index 1 (must be defined as an attribute).'
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  Index2Name:
    Description: 'Optional name of global secondary index 2 (requires Index2PartitionKeyName).'
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  Index2PartitionKeyName:
    Description: 'Partition key attribute of global secondary index 2 (must be defined as an attribute).'
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  Index2SortKeyName:
    Description: 'Optional sort key attribute of global secondary index 2 (must be defined as an attribute).'
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  TimeToLiveAttributeName:
    Description: 'Optional name of the Time to Live attribute (leave blank to disable TTL).'
    Type: String
    Default: ''
  StreamViewType:
    Description: 'Stream view type (disabled turns off DynamoDB Streams).'
    Type: String
    Default: disabled
    AllowedValues: [disabled, KEYS_ONLY, NEW_IMAGE, OLD_IMAGE, NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES]
  BillingMode:
    Description: 'Billing mode of the table.'
    Type: String
    Default: PROVISIONED
    AllowedValues: [PROVISIONED, PAY_PER_REQUEST]
  MinReadCapacityUnits:
    Description: 'Minimum read capacity units (PROVISIONED only).'
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
  MaxReadCapacityUnits:
    Description: 'Maximum read capacity units (PROVISIONED only).'
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
  MinWriteCapacityUnits:
    Description: 'Minimum write capacity units (PROVISIONED only).'
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
  MaxWriteCapacityUnits:
    Description: 'Maximum write capacity units (PROVISIONED only).'
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
  TargetUtilization:
    Description: 'Target utilization in percent for auto scaling (PROVISIONED only).'
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    MinValue: 20
    MaxValue: 90
  PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled:
    Description: 'Enable point-in-time recovery.'
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
  SSEEnabled:
    Description: 'Enable server-side encryption with the AWS managed KMS key (aws/dynamodb).'
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
  BackupRetentionPeriod:
    Description: 'Number of days to retain daily backups (0 disables AWS Backup).'
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 0
  AlertTopicArn:
    Description: 'Optional ARN of an SNS topic for alarms and backup vault notifications (leave blank to disable alerting).'
    Type: String
    Default: ''

Conditions:
  HasTableName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TableName, '']]
  HasSortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SortKeyName, '']]
  HasAttribute1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Attribute1Name, '']]
  HasAttribute2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Attribute2Name, '']]
  HasAttribute3: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Attribute3Name, '']]
  HasIndex1: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref Index1Name, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref Index1PartitionKeyName, '']]
  HasIndex1SortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Index1SortKeyName, '']]
  HasIndex2: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref Index2Name, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref Index2PartitionKeyName, '']]
  HasIndex2SortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Index2SortKeyName, '']]
  HasAnyIndex: !Or [!Condition HasIndex1, !Condition HasIndex2]
  HasTimeToLive: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TimeToLiveAttributeName, '']]
  HasStream: !Not [!Equals [!Ref StreamViewType, 'disabled']]
  IsProvisioned: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, 'PROVISIONED']
  HasSSE: !Equals [!Ref SSEEnabled, 'true']
  HasBackup: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BackupRetentionPeriod, 0]]
  HasAlertTopic: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlertTopicArn, '']]

Resources:
  Table:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !If [HasTableName, !Ref TableName, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasAttribute1
          - AttributeName: !Ref Attribute1Name
            AttributeType: !Ref Attribute1Type
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasAttribute2
          - AttributeName: !Ref Attribute2Name
            AttributeType: !Ref Attribute2Type
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !If
          - HasAttribute3
          - AttributeName: !Ref Attribute3Name
            AttributeType: !Ref Attribute3Type
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          KeyType: HASH
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            KeyType: RANGE
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes: !If
        - HasAnyIndex
        - - !If
            - HasIndex1
            - IndexName: !Ref Index1Name
              KeySchema:
                - AttributeName: !Ref Index1PartitionKeyName
                  KeyType: HASH
                - !If
                  - HasIndex1SortKey
                  - AttributeName: !Ref Index1SortKeyName
                    KeyType: RANGE
                  - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
              Projection:
                ProjectionType: ALL
              ProvisionedThroughput: !If
                - IsProvisioned
                - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref MinReadCapacityUnits
                  WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref MinWriteCapacityUnits
                - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
          - !If
            - HasIndex2
            - IndexName: !Ref Index2Name
              KeySchema:
                - AttributeName: !Ref Index2PartitionKeyName
                  KeyType: HASH
                - !If
                  - HasIndex2SortKey
                  - AttributeName: !Ref Index2SortKeyName
                    KeyType: RANGE
                  - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
              Projection:
                ProjectionType: ALL
              ProvisionedThroughput: !If
                - IsProvisioned
                - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref MinReadCapacityUnits
                  WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref MinWriteCapacityUnits
                - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
            - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - IsProvisioned
        - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref MinReadCapacityUnits
          WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref MinWriteCapacityUnits
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: !Ref PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled
      SSESpecification: !If
        - HasSSE
        - SSEEnabled: true
          SSEType: KMS
        - SSEEnabled: false
      StreamSpecification: !If
        - HasStream
        - StreamViewType: !Ref StreamViewType
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      TimeToLiveSpecification: !If
        - HasTimeToLive
        - AttributeName: !Ref TimeToLiveAttributeName
          Enabled: true
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  ScalingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dynamodb-autoscaling
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'dynamodb:DescribeTable'
                  - 'dynamodb:UpdateTable'
                Resource: !GetAtt Table.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm'
                  - 'cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms'
                  - 'cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics'
                  - 'cloudwatch:SetAlarmState'
                  - 'cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms'
                Resource: '*'

  ReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      MinCapacity: !Ref MinReadCapacityUnits
      MaxCapacity: !Ref MaxReadCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${Table}'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: 'dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits'
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  ReadScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-read-scaling'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ReadScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: !Ref TargetUtilization
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization

  WriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      MinCapacity: !Ref MinWriteCapacityUnits
      MaxCapacity: !Ref MaxWriteCapacityUnits
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${Table}'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: 'dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits'
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  WriteScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-write-scaling'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref WriteScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: !Ref TargetUtilization
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization

  BackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    Condition: HasBackup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
      Notifications: !If
        - HasAlertTopic
        - BackupVaultEvents:
            - BACKUP_JOB_STARTED
            - BACKUP_JOB_COMPLETED
            - RESTORE_JOB_STARTED
            - RESTORE_JOB_COMPLETED
            - RECOVERY_POINT_MODIFIED
          SNSTopicArn: !Ref AlertTopicArn
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  BackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Condition: HasBackup
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: daily
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref BackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 5 * * ? *)'
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            CompletionWindowMinutes: 1440
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: !Ref BackupRetentionPeriod

  BackupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: HasBackup
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dynamodb-backup
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'dynamodb:DescribeTable'
                  - 'dynamodb:CreateBackup'
                Resource: !GetAtt Table.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'dynamodb:DescribeBackup'
                  - 'dynamodb:DeleteBackup'
                Resource: !Sub '${Table.Arn}/backup/*'

  BackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Condition: HasBackup
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref BackupPlan
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
        IamRoleArn: !GetAtt BackupRole.Arn
        Resources:
          - !GetAtt Table.Arn

  ReadThrottleEventsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: HasAlertTopic
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: 'Reads are throttled. Increase read capacity or check access patterns.'
      Namespace: 'AWS/DynamoDB'
      MetricName: ReadThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref Table
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopicArn
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopicArn

  WriteThrottleEventsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: HasAlertTopic
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: 'Writes are throttled. Increase write capacity or check access patterns.'
      Namespace: 'AWS/DynamoDB'
      MetricName: WriteThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref Table
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopicArn
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopicArn

  ThrottledRequestsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: HasAlertTopic
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: 'Requests are throttled. Increase capacity or check access patterns.'
      Namespace: 'AWS/DynamoDB'
      MetricName: ThrottledRequests
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref Table
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopicArn
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopicArn

  UserErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: HasAlertTopic
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: 'Requests to DynamoDB generated HTTP 400 errors (account and region wide).'
      Namespace: 'AWS/DynamoDB'
      MetricName: UserErrors
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopicArn
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopicArn

  SystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: HasAlertTopic
    Properties:
      AlarmDescription: 'Requests to DynamoDB generated HTTP 500 errors.'
      Namespace: 'AWS/DynamoDB'
      MetricName: SystemErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref Table
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopicArn
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopicArn

Outputs:
  StackName:
    Description: 'Stack name.'
    Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
  TableName:
    Description: 'Name of the DynamoDB table.'
    Value: !Ref Table
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-TableName'
  StreamArn:
    Condition: HasStream
    Description: 'ARN of the DynamoDB stream.'
    Value: !GetAtt Table.StreamArn
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-StreamArn'
deploy_error_message: PartitionKeyName: Required parameter has no Default value
deploy_logs: ['PartitionKeyName: Required parameter has no Default value']
deploy_failed_resources: [{"logical_name": "PartitionKeyName", "status_reason": "Required parameter has no Default value"}]

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: DynamoDB tables for the talr AWS account-vending automation tool, with Application Auto Scaling for the accountInfo and taskStatus tables.

Parameters:
  Stage:
    Type: String
    Description: Deployment stage appended to every table name (e.g. dev, test, prod).
    MinLength: 1
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must contain only alphanumeric characters, hyphens, underscores, or periods.

Resources:
  CbInfoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-cbInfo-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountCbAlias
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountCbAlias
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  AccountInfoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-accountInfo-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountEmailAddress
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: accountId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountEmailAddress
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: gsiRequestId
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: requestId
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: KEYS_ONLY
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: 1
            WriteCapacityUnits: 1
        - IndexName: gsiAccountId
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: accountId
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: 1
            WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  TaskStatusTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-taskStatus-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: eventTimestamp
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: eventTimestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      StreamSpecification:
        StreamViewType: NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES

  NipapCfnTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-nipapCfn-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: nipapAlias
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: nipapAlias
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  OpsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-ops-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: layer
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: layer
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  DxInterfaceTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-dxInterface-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: divisionDcRegion
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: vlan
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: divisionDcRegion
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: vlan
          KeyType: RANGE
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  ClaStatusTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-claStatus-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  ConfigRulesComplianceTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-configRulesCompliance-${Stage}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: pollTimestamp
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: pollTimestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1

  ScalingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: talr-dynamodb-autoscaling
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTable
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AccountInfoTable.Arn
                  - !Sub '${AccountInfoTable.Arn}/index/*'
                  - !GetAtt TaskStatusTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricStatistics
                  - cloudwatch:SetAlarmState
                  - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
                Resource: '*'

  # accountInfo table
  AccountInfoTableReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  AccountInfoTableReadScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub 'talr-accountInfo-${Stage}-read-scaling'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref AccountInfoTableReadScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: 50.0
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization

  AccountInfoTableWriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  AccountInfoTableWriteScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub 'talr-accountInfo-${Stage}-write-scaling'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref AccountInfoTableWriteScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: 50.0
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization

  # accountInfo gsiRequestId index
  GsiRequestIdReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}/index/gsiRequestId'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  GsiRequestIdReadScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub 'talr-accountInfo-${Stage}-gsiRequestId-read-scaling'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref GsiRequestIdReadScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: 50.0
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization

  GsiRequestIdWriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:
      MinCapacity: 1
      MaxCapacity: 10
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}/index/gsiRequestId'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  GsiRequestIdWriteScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub 'talr-accountInfo-${Stage}-gsiRequestId-write-scaling'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref GsiRequestIdWriteScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        TargetValue: 50.0
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization

  # accountInfo gsiAccountId index
  GsiAccountIdReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Properties:

      MaxCapacity: 10
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/${AccountInfoTable}/index/gsiAccountId'

      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  GsiAccountIdReadScalingPolicy:

    Properties:

      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling

      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Secure, highly available network foundation and ECS cluster for a containerised Streamlit application.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet in the first availability zone
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet in the second availability zone
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet in the first availability zone
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet in the second availability zone

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2'

  NatGateway1EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-1'

  NatGateway2EIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-2'

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway1EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGateway2EIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  DefaultPublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-1'

  DefaultPrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-2'

  DefaultPrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc/flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 7

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:vpc-flow-log/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogDeliveryPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FlowLogGroup.Arn}:*'

  VPCFlowLog:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Test environment for validating Service Catalog preventive controls. Provisions
  a VPC with two subnets, a security group, a customer managed KMS key, DMS and
  ElastiCache subnet groups, a SageMaker execution role, and one Service Catalog
  launch role per product type under test.

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Network
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TestVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 172.16.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  TestSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref TestVPC
      CidrBlock: 172.16.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-subnet-1'

  TestSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref TestVPC
      CidrBlock: 172.16.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-subnet-2'

  TestSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Service Catalog preventive control test resources
      VpcId: !Ref TestVPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Allow all outbound traffic
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-test-sg'

  TestSecurityGroupSelfIngress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroupIngress
    Properties:
      GroupId: !Ref TestSecurityGroup
      IpProtocol: '-1'
      SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref TestSecurityGroup
      Description: Allow traffic between test resources in this group

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # KMS
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  TestKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for Service Catalog preventive control tests
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowLaunchRolesUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !GetAtt ALBLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt ALBListenerLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt ALBTargetGroupLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt AutoScalingLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt DMSEndpointLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt DMSInstanceLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt DynamoDBLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt EBSLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt EFSLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt ElastiCacheLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt ElasticsearchLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt FSxLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt KinesisLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt SNSLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt SQSLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt SageMakerLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt S3LaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowLaunchRolesGrantsForAwsResources
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !GetAtt ALBLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt ALBListenerLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt ALBTargetGroupLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt AutoScalingLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt DMSEndpointLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt DMSInstanceLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt DynamoDBLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt EBSLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt EFSLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt ElastiCacheLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt ElasticsearchLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt FSxLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt KinesisLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt SNSLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt SQSLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt SageMakerLaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt S3LaunchRole.Arn
                - !GetAtt SageMakerExecutionRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:RevokeGrant
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                kms:GrantIsForAWSResource: true

  TestKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-test-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref TestKmsKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DMS
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DMSVpcRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dms-vpc-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dms.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonDMSVPCManagementRole'

  DMSReplicationSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::DMS::ReplicationSubnetGroup
    DependsOn: DMSVpcRole
    Properties:
      ReplicationSubnetGroupDescription: DMS replication subnet group for preventive control tests
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref TestSubnet1
        - !Ref TestSubnet2

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # ElastiCache
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ElastiCacheSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::ElastiCache::SubnetGroup
    Properties:
      Description: ElastiCache subnet group for preventive control tests
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref TestSubnet1
        - !Ref TestSubnet2

  # AWS::ElastiCache::SecurityGroup only applies to EC2-Classic, so the cache
  # security group is a VPC security group intended for ElastiCache clusters.
  ElastiCacheSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ElastiCache test clusters
      VpcId: !Ref TestVPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 6379
          ToPort: 6379
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref TestSecurityGroup
          Description: Redis from test resources
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 11211
          ToPort: 11211
          SourceSecurityGroupId: !Ref TestSecurityGroup
          Description: Memcached from test resources
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: '-1'
          CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
          Description: Allow all outbound traffic
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cache-sg'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SageMaker execution role
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  SageMakerExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Shared launch role permissions
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  LaunchRoleBasePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: Base permissions required by every Service Catalog launch role
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: CloudFormationStackOperations
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudformation:CreateStack
              - cloudformation:DeleteStack
              - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
              - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
              - cloudformation:GetTemplateSummary
              - cloudformation:SetStackPolicy
              - cloudformation:ValidateTemplate
              - cloudformation:UpdateStack
              - cloudformation:CreateChangeSet
              - cloudformation:DescribeChangeSet
              - cloudformation:ExecuteChangeSet
              - cloudformation:DeleteChangeSet
              - cloudformation:ListChangeSets
              - cloudformation:TagResource
              - cloudformation:UntagResource
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ServiceCatalogTemplateAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                s3:ExistingObjectTag/servicecatalog:provisioning: 'true'
          - Sid: ServiceCatalogTemplateBuckets
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::cf-templates-*'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::sc-*'
          - Sid: ServiceCatalogOperations
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - servicecatalog:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: ReadNetworkAndKeys
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeVpcs
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
              - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
              - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
              - ec2:DescribeAccountAttributes
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:ListAliases
              - kms:ListKeys
            Resource: '*'

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Service Catalog launch roles
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  ALBLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for Application Load Balancer products
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref LaunchRoleBasePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ALBPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:CreateLoadBalancer
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeleteLoadBalancer
                  - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
                  - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyLoadBalancerAttributes
                  - elasticloadbalancing:SetSecurityGroups
                  - elasticloadbalancing:SetSubnets
                  - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
                  - elasticloadbalancing:RemoveTags
                  - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:AWSServiceName: elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com

  ALBListenerLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for Application Load Balancer listener products
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref LaunchRoleBasePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ALBListenerPermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - elasticloadbalancing:CreateListener

                  - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyListener
                  - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
                  - elasticloadbalancing:AddListenerCertificates
                  - elasticloadbalancing:RemoveListenerCertificates
                  - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
                  - elasticloadbalancing:RemoveTags

  ALBTargetGroupLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for Application Load Balancer target group products
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: servicecatalog.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref LaunchRoleBasePolicy
      Policies:

            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow

                  - elasticloadbalancing:CreateTargetGroup

                  - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroup
                  - elasticloadbalancing:ModifyTargetGroupAttributes
                  - elasticloadbalancing:RegisterTargets
                  - elasticloadbalancing:DeregisterTargets
                  - elasticloadbalancing:Describe*
                  - elasticloadbalancing:AddTags
                  - elasticloadbalancing:RemoveTags
                Resource: '*'

  AutoScalingLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      Description: Service Catalog launch role for Auto Scaling products
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:

                  - elasticloadbalancing:DescribeTargetGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow

                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:AWSServiceName: autoscaling.amazonaws.com

  DMSEndpointLaunchRole:

    Properties:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Serverless AI campaign orchestration platform. Turns a plain language marketing
  instruction into a delivered multi channel campaign using Step Functions, Lambda,
  Amazon Bedrock, DynamoDB, S3, Cognito-protected HTTP API, optional OpenSearch
  Serverless semantic search and CloudWatch monitoring.

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: General
        Parameters:
          - ProjectName
          - LogRetentionDays
          - AllowedCorsOrigin
      - Label:
          default: Generative AI
        Parameters:
          - BedrockModelId
          - EnableSemanticSearch
          - EmbeddingModelId
      - Label:
          default: Delivery and sender identity
        Parameters:
          - DeliveryMode
          - SenderEmailAddress
          - SesConfigurationSetName
          - SmsOriginationIdentity
          - SmsConfigurationSetName
          - DefaultRateLimitPerMinute
          - MaxCustomersPerCampaign
      - Label:
          default: Monitoring
        Parameters:
          - AlarmNotificationEmail

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: ai-campaigns
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{2,19}$"
    ConstraintDescription: 3-20 characters, lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter.
    Description: Prefix used for resource names.

  BedrockModelId:
    Type: String
    Default: global.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0
    Description: Amazon Bedrock model or inference profile ID used by the generative pipeline steps.

  EnableSemanticSearch:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: Create the OpenSearch Serverless vector collection and semantic search endpoint.

  EmbeddingModelId:
    Type: String
    Default: amazon.titan-embed-text-v2:0
    Description: Bedrock embedding model used by semantic search (1024 dimensions expected).

  DeliveryMode:
    Type: String
    Default: DRY_RUN
    AllowedValues: [DRY_RUN, LIVE]
    Description: DRY_RUN simulates sends and records them; LIVE sends through SES and AWS End User Messaging SMS.

  SenderEmailAddress:
    Type: String
    Default: no-reply@example.com
    Description: Verified SES sender address used for the email channel.

  SesConfigurationSetName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional SES configuration set used to publish delivery events.

  SmsOriginationIdentity:
    Type: String
    Default: phone-00000000000000000000000000000000
    Description: AWS End User Messaging SMS origination identity (phone number ID, ARN, pool or sender ID).

  SmsConfigurationSetName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional AWS End User Messaging SMS configuration set used to publish delivery events.

  DefaultRateLimitPerMinute:
    Type: Number
    Default: 60
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Messages per minute per channel when no CONFIG item exists in the rate limit table.

  MaxCustomersPerCampaign:
    Type: Number
    Default: 200
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 500
    Description: Maximum customers targeted by a single campaign execution.

  AlarmNotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ops@example.com
    Description: Email subscribed to the alarm topic. Leave as ops@example.com to skip the subscription.

  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 180, 365]
    Description: Retention for the state machine log group.

  AllowedCorsOrigin:
    Type: String
    Default: "*"
    Description: Origin allowed to call the HTTP API from a browser.

Conditions:
  SemanticSearchEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableSemanticSearch, "true"]
  HasAlarmEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmNotificationEmail, "ops@example.com"]]

Resources:
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Encryption
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  DataKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "Customer managed key for ${ProjectName} campaign data stores"
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableAccountAdministration
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsForStateMachineLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub "logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt*
              - kms:Decrypt*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vendedlogs/states/${ProjectName}-*"
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsToPublishToEncryptedTopics
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowMessagingServicesToPublishToEncryptedTopics
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ses.amazonaws.com
                - sms-voice.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref AWS::AccountId

  DataKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/${ProjectName}-data"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DataKey

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Data stores
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  CustomerProfilesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-customer-profiles"
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: customerId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: segment
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: customerId
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: segment-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: segment
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref DataKey

  ChannelRateLimitsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-channel-rate-limits"
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: channel
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: windowId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: channel
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: windowId
          KeyType: RANGE
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: expiresAt
        Enabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref DataKey

  MessageDeliveryTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-message-delivery"
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: messageId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: campaignId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: customerId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: messageId
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: campaign-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: campaignId
              KeyType: HASH
            - AttributeName: customerId
              KeyType: RANGE
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: INCLUDE
            NonKeyAttributes:
              - status
              - channel
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: expiresAt
        Enabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref DataKey

  CampaignAssetsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DataKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireOldVersions
            Status: Enabled
            NoncurrentVersionExpiration:
              NoncurrentDays: 30

  CampaignAssetsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref CampaignAssetsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: "false"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # IAM
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  PipelineFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: campaign-pipeline
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadCustomerProfiles
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt CustomerProfilesTable.Arn
                  - !Sub "${CustomerProfilesTable.Arn}/index/*"
              - Sid: RateLimits
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                Resource: !GetAtt ChannelRateLimitsTable.Arn
              - Sid: DeliveryTracking
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                Resource: !GetAtt MessageDeliveryTable.Arn
              - Sid: CampaignAssets
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: !Sub "${CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Sid: DataKeyUsage
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt DataKey.Arn
              - Sid: InvokeBedrock
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                  - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:*::foundation-model/*"
                  - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:bedrock:*:${AWS::AccountId}:inference-profile/*"
              - Sid: SendEmail
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ses:SendEmail
                  - ses:SendRawEmail
                Resource: "*"
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    ses:FromAddress: !Ref SenderEmailAddress
              - Sid: SendSms
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sms-voice:SendTextMessage
                Resource: "*"

  ApiFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  ParseInstructionFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-parse-instruction"
      Description: Converts a plain language instruction into a structured campaign plan using Bedrock.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Architectures: [arm64]
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 90
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineFunctionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          MODEL_ID: !Ref BedrockModelId
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, os, re, boto3

          br = boto3.client("bedrock-runtime")
          ALLOWED = ("email", "sms")
          PROMPT = """You are a marketing campaign planner. Convert the instruction into a JSON object with keys:
          "objective" (string), "segment" (string or null, a customer segment name),
          "criteria" (object mapping customer profile attribute names to required values),
          "channels" (array using only "email" and "sms"), "tone" (string),
          "baseMessage" (campaign message under 600 characters; use {{firstName}} for personalisation).
          Respond with JSON only.

          Instruction:
          """


          def ask(prompt, max_tokens=1000):
              r = br.converse(
                  modelId=os.environ["MODEL_ID"],
                  messages=[{"role": "user", "content": [{"text": prompt}]}],
                  inferenceConfig={"maxTokens": max_tokens, "temperature": 0.2},
              )
              text = "".join(c.get("text", "") for c in r["output"]["message"]["content"])
              m = re.search(r"\{.*\}", text, re.S)
              if not m:
                  raise ValueError("Model did not return JSON")
              return json.loads(m.group(0))


          def handler(event, context):
              instruction = event["instruction"]
              raw = ask(PROMPT + instruction)
              channels = [c for c in raw.get("channels") or [] if c in ALLOWED] or list(ALLOWED)
              criteria = raw.get("criteria") if isinstance(raw.get("criteria"), dict) else {}
              segment = raw.get("segment")
              plan = {
                  "objective": str(raw.get("objective") or instruction)[:500],
                  "segment": segment if isinstance(segment, str) and segment else None,
                  "criteria": criteria,
                  "channels": channels,
                  "tone": str(raw.get("tone") or "friendly")[:100],
                  "baseMessage": str(raw.get("baseMessage") or "")[:600],
              }
              return {**event, "plan": plan}

  SegmentCustomersFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-segment-customers"
      Description: Selects opted-in target customers matching the campaign plan.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Architectures: [arm64]
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 512
      Timeout: 120
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineFunctionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          PROFILES_TABLE: !Ref CustomerProfilesTable
          MAX_CUSTOMERS: !Ref MaxCustomersPerCampaign
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, os, re, boto3
          from decimal import Decimal
          from boto3.dynamodb.conditions import Attr, Key

          table = boto3.resource("dynamodb").Table(os.environ["PROFILES_TABLE"])
          MAX = int(os.environ["MAX_CUSTOMERS"])
          FIELDS = ("customerId", "firstName", "email", "phone", "preferredChannel", "channelEngagement", "locale")


          def _plain(o):
              if isinstance(o, Decimal):
                  return int(o) if o % 1 == 0 else float(o)
              if isinstance(o, (set, frozenset)):
                  return list(o)
              return str(o)


          def handler(event, context):
              plan = event.get("plan", {})
              flt = Attr("optIn").eq(True)
              for k, v in (plan.get("criteria") or {}).items():
                  if isinstance(v, (str, int, float, bool)) and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9_]{1,64}", k):
                      flt = flt & Attr(k).eq(v)
              kw = {"FilterExpression": flt}
              segment = plan.get("segment")
              items = []
              while len(items) < MAX:
                  if segment:
                      r = table.query(IndexName="segment-index", KeyConditionExpression=Key("segment").eq(segment), **kw)
                  else:
                      r = table.scan(**kw)
                  items += r["Items"]
                  if "LastEvaluatedKey" not in r:
                      break
                  kw["ExclusiveStartKey"] = r["LastEvaluatedKey"]
              customers = [{f: i[f] for f in FIELDS if f in i} for i in items[:MAX]]
              customers = json.loads(json.dumps(customers, default=_plain))
              return {**event, "customers": customers, "segmentSize": len(customers)}

  PredictChannelFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-predict-channel"
      Description: Predicts the best delivery channel for each targeted customer.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Architectures: [arm64]
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineFunctionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          CONTACT = {"email": "email", "sms": "phone"}


          def handler(event, context):
              allowed = event["plan"]["channels"]
              out = []
              for c in event.get("customers", []):
                  engagement = c.pop("channelEngagement", None) or {}
                  scores = {}
                  for ch in allowed:
                      if not c.get(CONTACT[ch]):
                          continue
                      score = float(engagement.get(ch, 0.1))
                      if c.get("preferredChannel") == ch:
                          score += 0.5
                      scores[ch] = round(score, 3)
                  if scores:
                      best = max(scores, key=scores.get)
                      out.append({**c, "channel": best, "channelScore": scores[best]})
              return {**event, "customers": out, "reachable": len(out)}

  SafetyCheckFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${ProjectName}-safety-check"
      Description: Reviews generated campaign content for safety and compliance using Bedrock.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Architectures: [arm64]
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 90
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineFunctionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          MODEL_ID: !Ref BedrockModelId
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, os, re, boto3

          br = boto3.client("bedrock-runtime")
          PROMPT = """You are a marketing compliance reviewer. Review the campaign below for harassment or hate,
          deceptive or misleading claims, adult content, requests for sensitive personal data, illegal or
          regulated products, and disregard for opt-out norms.
          Respond with JSON only: {"approved": true or false, "reasons": [strings], "categories": [strings]}.

          Objective: %s
          Message:
          %s
          """


          def ask(prompt, max_tokens=500):
              r = br.converse(
                  modelId=os.environ["MODEL_ID"],
                  messages=[{"role": "user", "content": [{"text": prompt}]}],
                  inferenceConfig={"maxTokens": max_tokens, "temperature": 0},
              )
              text = "".join(c.get("text", "") for c in r["output"]["message"]["content"])
              m = re.search(r"\{.*\}", text, re.S)
              return json.loads(m.group(0)) if m else {}


          def handler(event, context):
              plan = event["plan"]
              message = plan.get("baseMessage", "").strip()
              if not message:
                  verdict = {"approved": False, "reasons": ["Empty campaign message"], "categories": ["empty"]}
              else:
                  try:
                      r = ask(PROMPT % (plan.get("objective", ""), message))
                  except ValueError:
                      r = {}
                  verdict = {
                      "approved": r.get("approved") is True,
                      "reasons": [str(x)[:300] for x in r.get("reasons") or []][:10],
                      "categories": [str(x)[:50] for x in r.get("categories") or []][:10],
                  }
                  if not r:
                      verdict["reasons"] = ["Safety review returned no verdict"]
              return {**event, "safety": verdict}

  AdaptContentFunction:
